en.name: Castle Combo
en.desc: Shop the messenger's market and build a 3×3 realm: purses, shield sets, clever placements
en.rules:
Goal: buy cards from the market the messenger stands at, build your 3×3 realm, and have the most points once everyone has 9 cards.
On your turn:
· You may spend 1 key first (once per turn): move the messenger to the other market, or discard its 3 face-up cards and refill.
· Then buy 1 card from the messenger's market: pay gold to place it face-up, or place it face-down for free.
· A face-up card must be orthogonally adjacent within 3 rows by 3 columns; a face-down card gains you 6 gold and 2 keys.
· Cards with 📯 move the messenger to the other market when bought face-up.
· Abilities resolve immediately: gain gold/keys, store gold on purse cards, discard from a river for its cost, etc.
Scoring:
· At the end, each card scores its bottom-line condition (shields, positions, banners, keys…).
· Leftover gold auto-fills purse cards (2 pts each); each key is 1 pt.

· Ties break on leftover gold, then the win is shared.

zh.name: 勃艮第城堡：特别版
zh.desc: 投掷骰子，建设领地，经营货物与葡萄园；自由组合特别版扩展。
zh.rules:
目标
五个阶段结束后，得分最高者获胜。平分时比较已填格数，再比较顺序轨较后的位置。团队模式平分时，空格较多的团队获胜。
准备与流程
每位玩家选择起始城堡。游戏分五个阶段，每阶段五轮；每轮所有玩家同时掷两枚骰子，再按顺序轨轮流完成自己的回合。白骰决定本轮货物放入哪个仓库。每次使用一枚骰子执行一个动作，可以在两次动作之间使用黑市和其他能力。用完骰子后结束回合。
骰子与工人
一名工人可将骰点增加或减少一，1与6循环相接；可以花多名工人。取工人动作不受骰点限制。
四种基本动作
取板块：从骰点对应的公共仓库取一块，放入自己的三格仓库。满仓时先弃掉旧板块。
放板块：使用骰点对应的领地格，颜色须匹配，并与已放板块相邻。放置后立即执行板块效果。同一城镇不得放同类建筑，起重机除外。
卖货：卖出骰点对应的一整种货物，每片获得与人数对应的2、3或4分，整次卖货另获得1银。个人货物仓最多容纳三种货物。
取工人：使用任意骰子，取得两名工人。
黑市
每回合最多花2银购买一块黑市板块，放入自己的仓库；可在使用骰子之前、之间或之后购买。旅馆与葡萄园商店共享该购买次数。
板块效果
城堡给予一次任意骰点动作。船只从任选公共仓库取走自己能存放的货物，并将顺序标记前进一格，同格后来者压在上面，下一轮才采用新顺序。矿在每阶段结束时产生1银。修道院提供持续能力或终局得分。
牲畜按原版连续牧场计分：放下时，计算该牧场内同种牲畜的总数量。鹅获得2分并再计该牧场一种牲畜的数量；之后任何牲畜计分都包含鹅。
市场取得船或牲畜；工坊取得建筑；教堂取得城堡、矿或修道院；仓库免费卖货；旅舍获得4工人；银行获得2银；市政厅免费放另一块仓储板块；瞭望塔获得4分。建筑允许放置，即使其效果当前无法执行。
完成区域
填满一个同色连续区域，获得区域大小的三角数分值（1、3、6、10、15、21、28、36），再加当前阶段10、8、6、4或2分。起始城堡不触发效果或完成分。填满领地内全部同色格，前两名获得颜色奖励：首名5、6或7分，次名2、3或4分。
终局
每枚银1分，每片未卖货1分，每两工人1分，再结算修道院、盾牌与葡萄园。
扩展
额外板块加入修道院27、28、起重机与鹅。起重机触发任意建筑能力，并在终局可视为任意一种计分建筑。白色城堡给予白骰当前点数的一次动作，允许花工人调整。旅馆可放任意颜色区域，每区域最多一个，完成该区域时大小加一。贸易路线按从左至右逐片填入已卖货物，数字吻合便获得奖励；可在开局调整路线片顺序。
边境哨所：用连续的板块连接两个哨所，获得阶段分；连接第三个再获得一次阶段分，并争夺哨所奖励。城堡连接变体只用于11至18号图：新板块还必须直接邻接城堡，或经同色已放板块连到城堡；城堡仍按通常规则放置。可花两枚骰子和5分取回之前阶段移出的城堡。
盾牌：花两枚同点骰子从对应仓库取一面盾牌，工人可调整点数。盾牌必须贴在已放的城堡上，可替换旧盾；阶段末先付每盾1银贡金，再领取矿收入。无法或不愿付款的盾牌弃掉。
葡萄园：双六角占两个仓储格；用相应骰点取得或放置，可翻转两色方向。首片只可放在底层点数1或4的位置，之后需与已放双六角相邻。依自选顺序执行覆盖的两项奖励；填满一层取得一枚自选葡萄奖励。终局，每枚奖励可计一个对应颜色的连续葡萄区，按该区大小的三角数得分，每区和每枚奖励均只计一次。
团队
四人分为相邻两人一队，共用领地、货物、工人和银。每人有两格私人仓库，团队另有两格共享仓库；不能使用队友私人板块或骰子。双方可建设整张团队领地。
原版单人挑战
25轮内填满37格即获胜。每轮白骰放货后，按仓库从上至下移除一块板块，空仓则顺时针寻找。只能经河流扩张到其他地区。放船取货后移除其他仓库的货物，可用自选五片货物换黑市板块，背面向上存放；背面板块可放任意色，不触发效果。修道院计分能力立即结算。完成整色改为免费从黑市取一块直接放置。每次获得分数时可花银购买额外分数；达到目标分数后清零，目标减少5（最低5），并获得一次任意动作。
Châteauma
官方自动对手占一个玩家名额，使用郡卡取得板块、连锁效果、完成卡片和争夺颜色奖励。白骰1至4选择左卡，5至6选择右卡。三个难度决定郡卡完成分；修正A、B预填领地，C让其先手，D启用额外动作格。它不使用工人，不执行修道院能力，终局每修道院4分。平分时自动对手获胜。该模式不支持旅馆、团队图和原版单人图，移除2号盾牌。

en.name: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition
en.desc: Roll dice, develop a duchy, trade goods and grow vineyards with modular Special Edition expansions.
en.rules:
Goal
After five phases, the highest score wins. Ties favor more filled spaces, then the later position on the turn track. Team ties favor more empty spaces.
Setup and play
Choose a starting castle. Each of five phases has five rounds. Everyone rolls two dice; players then take turns in track order. The white die assigns the round’s goods tile to a depot. Each die pays for one action. Finish your turn after using both dice and any desired purchases.
Workers
A worker changes a die by one, with 1 and 6 adjacent. Spend several workers if needed. Taking workers ignores the die value.
Four basic actions
Take a tile from the numbered depot matching your die and store it on one of your three key spaces. Discard stored tiles first if necessary.
Place a stored tile on a matching-color duchy space with the die’s number, adjacent to a previously placed tile, and trigger its effect. A town cannot contain duplicate buildings, except cranes.
Sell all goods of the die’s number for 2/3/4 points per tile in a 2/3/4-player game and one silver per sale. Store at most three different goods types.
Take two workers using any die.
Black depot
Once per turn, spend two silver for one tile, before, between or after die actions. Inns and the vineyard store share this purchase limit.
Tile effects
A castle grants one action with any die value. A ship takes all goods you can store from one chosen depot and moves your turn marker one step forward, on top of other markers there. The new order applies next round. A mine produces one silver after each phase. Monasteries grant ongoing abilities or scoring.
Livestock scores all animals of its type in the same printed contiguous pasture. Geese score two plus one chosen animal type there; later livestock scoring includes geese.
Market: take a ship or livestock. Workshop: take a building. Church: take a castle, mine or monastery. Warehouse: sell a goods type. Boarding house: four workers. Bank: two silver. Town hall: place another stored tile. Watchtower: four points. You may place a building even if its effect cannot be used.
Completed areas
Fill a contiguous printed color area to score its triangular size value (1, 3, 6, 10, 15, 21, 28, 36), plus 10/8/6/4/2 points in phases A–E. Your starting castle grants no effect or area score. The first two players to fill every space of one color gain 5/6/7 and 2/3/4 points, respectively.
Final scoring
One point per silver and unsold goods tile, one per two workers, plus monasteries, shields and vineyards.
Expansions
Extra tiles add monasteries 27–28, the crane and geese. A crane triggers any building effect and can count as any scoring building at the end. White castles grant an action using the white die, adjustable with workers. Inns fit any color, at most one per area, and increase its scoring size by one. Sold goods fill trade routes from left to right; matching numbers grant rewards. You may arrange route pieces during setup if enabled.
Border posts: connecting two posts scores the phase bonus; connecting the third scores another phase bonus and competes for the border bonus tile. Castle connections apply only to boards 11–18: a new tile must also touch a castle or connect to one through placed tiles of its color. Castles follow normal placement. Both dice and five points retrieve an unclaimed castle removed in an earlier phase.
Shields: spend two equal dice, adjusting with workers, to claim a shield from that depot. Attach it to a placed castle, replacing a previous shield if desired. At phase end, pay one silver per shield before mine income or discard it.
Vineyards: double hexes occupy two storage spaces. Take or place one using the matching die; flip to exchange its colors. The first tile must occupy a bottom-layer space numbered 1 or 4; later tiles must touch existing vines. Resolve both covered rewards in your chosen order. Complete a layer to choose a vine bonus. At the end, each bonus scores one matching connected color area using triangular scoring. Each area and bonus scores once.
Teams
Four players form two adjacent pairs. Share a duchy, goods, workers and silver. Each player has two private storage spaces; the team has two shared spaces. You cannot use your partner’s dice or private tiles. Both players may build anywhere on the team duchy.
Original solo challenge
Fill all 37 spaces within 25 rounds. After placing goods with the white die, remove the top tile from that depot, continuing clockwise if empty. Expand between regions only via rivers. After a ship takes goods, discard goods in other depots. You may exchange any five owned goods for a black-depot tile, stored face down; it fits any color but grants no effect. Scoring monasteries score immediately. Completing a color grants a black-depot tile to place directly instead of bonus points. Whenever scoring points, you may buy extra points with silver. Reaching the target resets your score, lowers the target by five to a minimum of five, and grants a free action.
Châteauma
The official automa occupies one player slot and uses county cards to acquire tiles, trigger effects, complete cards and claim bonuses. White die 1–4 selects its left card, 5–6 its right. Three difficulty tiers set county scores. Modifiers A/B prefill its duchy, C gives it the first turn, and D enables extra-action spaces. It uses no workers and ignores monastery abilities; each monastery scores four at the end. The automa wins ties. Inns, team boards and original solo boards are incompatible; shield 2 is removed.

zh.name: 卡坦岛
zh.desc: 拓荒、修路、交易,在卡坦岛上建起你的势力
zh.rules:
目标:自己回合内率先达到 10 分者立即获胜。
准备:
· 版图随机生成:19 块地形按螺旋摆数字碟,红色高产的 6 与 8 永不相邻;沙漠上放强盗。
· 蛇形开局:正序各放 1 村 1 路,再逆序放第 2 村 1 路;第二座村庄立即收获相邻地形的资源。
· 任何建筑之间至少隔 2 条边(全程生效)。
流程(每回合):
· 可先打 1 张骑士,再掷 2 颗骰子;对应数字的地形产出资源,相邻村庄获得 1 张、城市获得 2 张。
· 掷出 7:不产出;手牌超过 7 张者弃一半(向下取整),随后移动强盗到新地形,并从该地块有建筑的一名玩家手中随机偷 1 张。
· 行动阶段(任意顺序、不限次数):建造、与银行兑换、向其他玩家发报价,或打出 1 张发展卡(当回合买的不能打)。
· 建造费用:路要 1 木材 1 砖块,村庄要 1 木材 1 砖块 1 羊毛 1 小麦。
· 城市要 2 小麦 3 矿石(替换村庄),发展卡要 1 羊毛 1 小麦 1 矿石。
· 与银行按 4:1 兑换;建有港口建筑可 3:1,专属港口 2:1。
· 新路必须接自家路网,不可穿过对手建筑;新村必须连着自家路。
交易:
· 报价是一口价:其他人只能接受或拒绝,不接受还价;不能同种资源互换。
发展卡:
· 骑士:移动强盗并偷 1 张;累计打出 3 张获得「最大军队」2 分,被超过则易主。
· 修路:免费修 2 条路;丰收:从银行任取 2 张资源。
· 垄断:收取其他所有玩家手中全部的该种资源;胜利点:暗藏 1 分,获胜时亮出。
计分:
· 村庄 1 分、城市 2 分;最长连续道路达到 5 条获得 2 分(被对手建筑打断可能失去,平手持有者优先)。
· 银行每种资源 19 张;某次产出若不够全员分,该资源当次无人获得(仅一人受影响则拿走剩余)。

en.name: CATAN
en.desc: Settle, build roads, and trade your way across the island
en.rules:
Goal: reach 10 victory points on your own turn to win immediately.
Setup:
· The island is generated at random: number discs are placed in a spiral over 19 terrain hexes, and the red high-yield 6s and 8s are never adjacent; the robber starts on the desert.
· Snake draft: in seat order each player places 1 settlement + 1 road, then in reverse order a second pair; your second settlement immediately yields the resources of its adjacent hexes.
· Buildings must always be at least two edges apart.
Each turn:
· You may play 1 Knight, then roll both dice; hexes with the matching number produce: 1 card per adjacent settlement, 2 per city.
· On a 7: nothing produces; anyone holding more than 7 cards discards half (rounded down), then you move the robber to a new hex and steal 1 random card from a player with a building there.
· Action phase (any order, any number of times): build, trade with the supply, make trade offers, or play 1 development card (not one bought this turn).
· Building costs: a road takes 1 wood and 1 brick; a settlement takes 1 wood, 1 brick, 1 wool and 1 wheat.
· A city takes 2 wheat and 3 ore (upgrading a settlement); a development card takes 1 wool, 1 wheat and 1 ore.
· Trade with the supply at 4:1; a generic port gives 3:1, a matching port 2:1.
· New roads must connect to your network and may not pass through an opponent’s building; new settlements must touch your own road.
Trading:
· Offers are take-it-or-leave-it: others may only accept or decline, no counteroffers; trading a resource for itself is not allowed.
Development cards:
· Knight: move the robber and steal 1 card; 3 played Knights earn Largest Army (2 VP), lost if surpassed.
· Road Building: build 2 roads free; Invention: take any 2 resources from the supply.
· Monopoly: take every card of one resource from all other players; Victory Point: kept hidden, revealed when you win.
Scoring:
· Settlement 1 VP, city 2 VP; the longest continuous route of at least 5 roads earns 2 VP (it can be lost when an opponent’s building cuts it; ties favor the holder).
· The supply holds 19 of each resource; if a production roll cannot pay everyone, that resource pays nobody (a lone recipient takes what remains).

zh.name: 盒中猫
zh.desc: 量子吃墩:颜色打出时才宣告,别把自己逼进悖论
zh.rules:
目标:预报每轮要赢的墩数并精准命中,几轮后总分最高者获胜。
准备:
· 牌只有数字没有颜色:数字 1~6(3 人)/1~8(4 人)/1~9(5 人),每个数字 5 张。
· 每人起手 10 张(5 人局 9 张),各自扣置 1 张移出本轮。
· 从起始玩家开始顺时针预报赢墩数:3 人局只能报 1、3 或 4;4~5 人局报 1、2 或 3。
流程:
· 轮到你时打出一张牌并宣告它的颜色;研究板上同色同数字的格子只能被占一次。
· 宣告与领出色不同的颜色,须公开标记「没有领出色」;已标记没有的颜色不能再宣告。
· 领出者原则上不能领红(王牌);红已被观测过、或整手牌都无法宣告其他颜色时除外。
· 墩的归属:有红取红中数字最大者,否则取领出色中数字最大者;赢家领出下一墩。
· 手牌剩 1 张时本轮结束(共 8 墩,5 人局 7 墩);若轮到你时没有任何合法宣告,悖论发生,本轮立即中止、当前墩作废。
结算:
· 每赢 1 墩获得 1 分;预报命中再加奖励分,等于研究板上你的标记最大连通片(横竖相邻)的格数。
· 引发悖论者改为每赢 1 墩扣 1 分,且不得奖励分。
· 轮数等于人数,起始玩家每轮左移;总分最高者获胜,平分比较最后一轮得分,再平分则共享胜利。

en.name: Cat in the Box
en.desc: Quantum trick-taking: a card's color is declared only as you play it — don't paradox yourself
en.rules:
Goal: predict how many tricks you will win each round and hit it exactly; highest total score after all rounds wins.
Setup:
· Cards have numbers but no color: numbers 1-6 (3 players) / 1-8 (4 players) / 1-9 (5 players), 5 copies of each.
· Each player is dealt 10 cards (9 with 5 players), then sets 1 card face down out of the round.
· Starting from the round start player and going clockwise, predict your tricks: with 3 players only 1, 3 or 4 is allowed; with 4-5 players choose 1, 2 or 3.
Play:
· On your turn, play a card and declare its color; on the research board, each color-number space can be claimed only once.
· Declaring a color different from the led color publicly marks that you have none of the led color; a color you have marked as none can never be declared again.
· The trick leader may not lead red (trump), unless red has already been observed or no card in hand can be declared any other color.
· Trick winner: highest number in red if any, otherwise highest number in the led color; the winner leads the next trick.
· The round ends when 1 card remains in hand (8 tricks, 7 with 5 players); if you have no legal declaration on your turn, a paradox occurs and the round stops immediately with the current trick voided.
Scoring:
· 1 point per trick won; a successful prediction adds a bonus equal to the largest connected group (orthogonally adjacent) of your tokens on the research board.
· The player who caused the paradox scores -1 per trick won instead and gets no bonus.
· Rounds equal the player count, with the start player rotating left; highest total wins, ties break on the final round score, and further ties share the victory.

zh.name: 洞穴农夫
zh.desc: 12 回合经营矮人家园:坑道挖矿、森林放牧、锻造武器去远征,别忘了喂饱全家
zh.rules:
目标:12 回合后,家园经营得分最高者获胜。
准备:
· 每人一块家园版图(山体 3 行 4 列、森林 3 行 4 列)、2 名矮人与入门居所;起始食物按座位 1/1/2/3 份。
· 阶段卡分四阶段洗混,每回合开始翻开一张新行动格。
流程:
· 每回合轮流向空行动格放置 1 名矮人并执行该格;必须先放徒手矮人,再按武器强度升序放武装矮人(可付 1 红宝石插队)。
· 累积格上的物资每回合累加,拿走即清空。
· 挖隧道开洞穴、建家具(每只矮人都需要居所空位)、铺草原垦田播种、围牧场养动物、锻造武器后远征获得战利品。
· 红宝石是万能资源:1:1 兑换物资(兑换牛需另付 1 食物)、兑换单块板块、让矮人插队。
收获(按回合与标记):
· 田地各收 1 份作物。
· 每名矮人吃 2 食物(当轮新生吃 1),喂不饱领乞讨牌(每张扣 3 分)。
· 每类农场动物不少于 2 只时繁殖 1 只。
计分:动物、谷物(每 2 份计 1 分,向上取整)、蔬菜、红宝石、矮人、金币各计分;牧场/矿场/家具按面值。
· 缺一类农场动物扣 2 分,未开发格扣 1 分,乞讨牌扣 3 分;黄底家具另有奖励分。平局共享胜利。
单人:固定阶段卡序,第 5 回合起每轮收获;累积格超过 6 份物资会清空(可付红宝石保留)。

en.name: Caverna
en.desc: Develop your dwarf homestead over 12 rounds: mine tunnels, farm the forest, forge weapons for expeditions — and keep everyone fed
en.rules:
Goal: after 12 rounds, the most valuable homestead wins.
Setup:
· Each player gets a home board (3 rows by 4 columns of mountain, plus 3 rows by 4 columns of forest), 2 dwarfs and an entry-level dwelling; starting food is 1/1/2/3 by seat order.
· Stage cards are shuffled within four stages; one new action space is revealed each round.
Flow:
· Take turns placing 1 dwarf on an empty action space and resolving it. Unarmed dwarfs must be placed first, then armed ones in ascending weapon strength (pay 1 ruby to skip the order).
· Goods accumulate on accumulation spaces each round; taking them empties the space.
· Dig tunnels and caverns, furnish rooms (every dwarf needs dwelling space), lay meadows and fields, fence pastures, forge weapons and go on expeditions for loot.
· Rubies are wild: exchange 1:1 for goods (cattle costs 1 extra food), exchange for single tiles, or skip the dwarf play order.
Harvest (by round and token):
· Collect 1 crop per field.
· Feed 2 food per dwarf (1 per newborn); unfed dwarfs take begging markers (each costs 3 points).
· Every farm animal type with at least 2 breeds 1.
Scoring: animals, grain (every 2 score 1 point, rounded up), vegetables, rubies, dwarfs and gold all score; pastures, mines and furnishings score their printed value.
· Each missing farm animal type costs 2 points, each undeveloped space costs 1, each begging marker costs 3; yellow furnishing tiles grant bonus points. Ties are shared wins.
Solo: fixed stage order, harvest every round from round 5; accumulation spaces holding more than 6 goods are cleared (pay 1 ruby per space to keep).

zh.name: 冠军挑战者!
zh.desc: 组建梦幻战队打七轮夺旗巡回赛,攒粉丝进决赛,捧起冠军杯
zh.rules:
目标:7 轮巡回赛后,粉丝总数前两名进入决赛,决赛胜者夺冠。
流程(每轮两段):
· 组牌:从指定牌堆抽 5 张展示,留下至多 1~2 张(可以一张不留),可整手重抽一次。
· 取完后还能撤掉卡组里的弱卡:卡组越薄,越容易翻到强卡。
· 比赛:与本轮对手夺旗。双方轮流翻牌比力量,攻方总力量达到持旗方即夺旗。
· 失旗的卡进替补席(6 格,同名叠放);牌堆翻空或替补席爆满的一方输掉本场比赛。
· 胜者捧走本轮奖杯,奖杯的粉丝值保密。
· 需要抉择的卡效果会暂停比赛,等当事人操作完再继续。
牌堆配置:
· 第 1~2 轮:A 级取 2 张。
· 第 3~4 轮:A 级 2 张或 B 级 1 张。
· 第 5~7 轮:B 级 2 张或 C 级 1 张。
决赛:
· 7 轮后粉丝前两名进决赛,赛前只能撤卡整备;决赛胜者捧起冠军杯。

en.name: Challengers!
en.desc: Draft your dream team, fight seven capture-the-flag rounds, and lift the cup in the final
en.rules:
Goal: after 7 tournament rounds, the two players with the most fans meet in the final, and the finalist who wins it lifts the cup.
Each round has two parts:
· Deck phase: draw 5 cards from this round’s pile and keep up to 1–2 (you may keep none); one full redraw is allowed.
· Afterwards you may trim weak cards from your deck — a thinner deck cycles your best cards more often.
· Match phase: a flag duel against this round’s opponent. Take turns flipping cards and comparing power; the attacker captures the flag by matching the holder’s total power.
· Beaten cards go to a 6-slot bench (same names stack); running out of deck cards or bench space loses the match.
· The winner takes the round’s trophy, whose fan value stays secret.
· Card effects that need a decision pause the match until that player answers.
Pile schedule:
· Rounds 1–2: take 2 from A.
· Rounds 3–4: take 2 from A or 1 from B.
· Rounds 5–7: take 2 from B or 1 from C.
The final:
· After 7 rounds the top two in fans advance; only trimming is allowed before the final. The winner of the final is the champion.

zh.name: 三国杀：承天之弈
zh.desc: 以武将构筑军营，在双人对弈中运筹制胜。包含布将为子与可选的逆命天澜。
zh.rules:
目标：
使对手在濒死结算中无法回复至正体力，或使被将的对手进入其回合结束。

构筑：
选择主帅和与其同名的起始武将，构筑含起始武将在内的40张武将卡组。同名称与称号最多3张，执行现行禁限。单势力卡组体力上限5；双势力卡组体力上限4，副势力最多10张。

开局：
起始武将正面朝上置于战场，其余武将洗为军营。双方各摸4张游戏牌，各可使用一次手气卡。

回合：
重置己方武将并选择翻正，然后依次进行准备、判定、摸牌、出牌、弃牌和结束阶段。通常摸2张牌，出牌阶段结束时上阵2名武将；先手首回合分别为1张和1名。弃牌阶段先休整战场至5名，再弃手牌至当前体力值。

技能：
具备行动权且满足条件时可以发动。必须先锁定并能够支付全部费用，再依文字顺序支付。支付费用休整发动者自身时，可以额外摸1张牌。每名武将在同一时机只能发动一次技能，结算后保留原行动权。

助阵：
符合类别或势力的非临时武将从战场进入休整区时，可改为进入己方尚未满员的助阵区。技能生效时满足条件则界限突破；助阵武将不在战场上。

将军：
濒死中每局可倒置主帅一次，休整任意数量己方武将并摸等量牌。被将的玩家在自己的回合结束时落败。

流放：
背面朝上的流放牌仅本方可看，普通效果不影响流放区。

en.name: Sanguosha: Chengtian Zhiyi
en.desc: Build an army of generals for a tactical duel. Includes Bu Jiang Wei Zi and the optional Ni Ming Tian Lan set.
en.rules:
Goal:
defeat an opponent who cannot recover above zero health during a dying resolution, or reach the end of their turn while their commander is checked.

Deck:
choose a commander and a starting general with the same name. Build exactly 40 general cards, including the starting general. Use at most three copies of the same name and title, subject to current bans and restrictions. A single-faction deck starts at 5 maximum health. A two-faction deck starts at 4, with at most 10 generals from its secondary faction.

Setup:
place the starting general face up on the battlefield and shuffle the remaining generals into the army. Each player draws four game cards and may take one mulligan.

Turn:
reset your generals and optionally reveal any of them. Proceed through preparation, judgement, draw, play, discard and end phases. Normally draw two cards and deploy two generals after the play phase. The first player draws and deploys only one on their first turn. In the discard phase, first rest generals down to five, then discard hand cards down to current health.

Skills:
you need priority and must meet every requirement. Reserve and be able to pay the complete cost, then pay it in printed order. If you rest the activating general as a cost, you may draw one extra card. A general may activate only once per timing. You retain priority after its skill resolves.

Support:
an eligible non-temporary general leaving your battlefield for rest may instead support one of your generals whose support area is not full. Meet its printed requirements when the skill takes effect to break through. Support generals are outside the battlefield.

Check:
once per game while dying, invert your commander, rest any number of your generals and draw that many cards. A checked player loses at the end of their own turn.

Exile:
only the owner can inspect face-down exiled cards. Ordinary effects cannot affect exile.

search.py: san guo sha cheng tian zhi yi bu jiang wei zi ni ming tian lan

zh.name: 推理事件簿
zh.desc: 独自调查伦敦、黑幕与红景镇案件，询问人物、观察现场并揭开真相。
zh.rules:
目标：
· 调查案件，收集线索并回答结案问题。
准备：
· 选择伦敦基础版、黑幕或红景镇系列，再选择案件。
· 每局由一人操作；红景镇开局另选一名少年角色。
· 从结案页继续下一章，会保留相应结果和角色。
· 直接选章使用默认开局；案件中的编号对应下方卡片。
调查：
· 点选卡片，再点击底部行动按钮执行；选择不消耗时间。
· 地点用于前往，人物用于交谈，物品和证据类别用于检查。
· 询问时选择其他人物或物品，向当前人物提问。
· 基础版可联系专家，再选择分析对象并执行行动。
· 再点选中卡可取消选择；结束询问后可与其他人物交谈。
· 通常移动消耗20分钟，询问和检查消耗5分钟。
· 个别案件或行动的耗时不同，以案件内时间变化为准。
· 允许搜证的地点才可现场搜证，每次消耗5分钟。
· 观察持续40秒；结束后选择看到的证据类别并检查。
· 人物、地点和特殊物品随正文揭示加入卡区。
· 线索和人物会随调查进展与游戏内时间改变。
· 轻点正文或卡区翻页；右下角三角表示还有下一段。
· 普通末页可直接选卡行动；观察、选择和结案另行确认。
· 选中人物或物品，可查看关联案卷与已知人物资料。
· 案卷可查看带时间与对象的记录、编辑笔记。
· 对局进度由本机自动保存。
黑幕：
· 使用跟踪、恫吓、擅闯和贿赂行动卡调查。
· 行动针对当前地点或正在询问的人物。
· 贿赂需要至少20美元；实际收支随剧情自动结算。
红景镇：
· 使用体能、头脑、沟通行动卡；提示卡用于索取线索。
· 可进行的检定和提示随当前地点、人物及剧情改变。
· 检定掷一枚六面骰，加上角色对应能力与难度修正。
· 简单增加1点，普通不变，困难减少1点。
· 合计5至6获得1个成功，7或以上获得2个成功。
· 当前单角色模式累计至少1个成功便通过检定。
· 未通过时可消耗1点体力追加掷骰，成功数累加。
· 也可接受失败并继续剧情；通过后无需追加掷骰。
· 少数剧情直接询问行动结果，按提示选择成功或失败。
· 回总部睡觉可恢复体力；特殊剧情可能限制恢复或能力。
结算：
· 按剧情指引提交结案报告；部分剧情自动进入结案。
· 逐题选择卡片并提交；选答题可以跳过。
· 必答题答错会扣分并返回调查。
· 得分包含答案、调查结果、耗时和累计奖惩。

en.name: Chronicles of Crime
en.desc: Investigate London, Noir and Redview cases. Interview witnesses, search scenes and uncover the truth.
en.rules:
Goal:
· Investigate the case, gather clues and answer the closing questions.
Setup:
· Choose London, Noir or Redview, then select a case.
· One player investigates; Redview also requires a teenager role.
· Continue from the closing report to retain relevant results and your role.
· Direct chapter selection uses the default start. References match the cards below.
Investigation:
· Select a card, then press its action button. Selection costs no time.
· Travel to locations, talk to people, and examine items or evidence categories.
· During an interview, select another person or item to ask about them.
· In the base game, contact an expert, then select a subject to analyze.
· Tap a selected card again to deselect it. End an interview before starting another.
· Travel usually costs 20 minutes; questions and item checks cost 5 minutes.
· Some cases and actions use different costs, reflected in the game clock.
· Eligible locations allow scene searches, each costing 5 game minutes.
· Observe for 40 seconds, then select the evidence categories you noticed and examine them.
· People, locations and special items appear as the story reveals them.
· Clues and characters can change with progress and game time.
· Tap the story or card area to read on; a triangle marks the next passage.
· Act directly on the last passage; observation, choices and closing use explicit buttons.
· Select a person or item to read related records and known profiles.
· Case file contains timed investigation records and notes.
· Progress is saved automatically on this device.
Noir:
· Use Follow, Intimidate, Break In and Bribe action cards.
· Actions target your current location or the person you are interviewing.
· Bribery requires at least $20. The story applies all income and spending.
Redview:
· Use Fitness, Mind and Speech action cards, or the Hint card for leads.
· Available tests and hints depend on your location, interview and progress.
· Roll one six-sided die and add the matching ability and difficulty modifier.
· Easy adds +1, Normal adds 0 and Hard adds −1.
· A total of 5–6 gives 1 success; a total of 7 or more gives 2.
· This single-character mode requires at least 1 accumulated success to pass.
· If you fail, you may spend 1 energy to roll an extra die. Successes accumulate.
· You may accept failure and continue. Once you pass, no extra roll is needed.
· A few story prompts ask for an action result directly; select success or failure as prompted.
· Sleep at HQ to recover energy. Special events can restrict recovery or abilities.
Scoring:
· Follow the story to submit the closing report. Some events start it automatically.
· Select and submit a card for each question; optional questions may be skipped.
· A wrong mandatory answer costs points and returns you to the investigation.
· Scoring includes answers, investigation results, time and accumulated penalties.

zh.name: 噤声寻宝记
zh.desc: 深入龙穴构筑牌库，夺取神器并在巨龙追击前撤离。
zh.rules:
游戏目标：
深入地下城取得神器，返回入口撤离。游戏结束时，在有计分资格的玩家中，总分最高者获胜。
开局准备：
每人有 10 点生命和 10 张初始牌，洗牌后抽取 5 张。启用的扩展卡牌加入地下城牌库，专属组件按所选地图布置。
回合行动：
出牌、移动、获取卡牌、战斗和购买物品可以交错进行。打出手牌后，获得牌面所示的技能、战斗力、移动力及其他效果。
· 支付技能获取地下城公共牌或常备牌，新获得的卡牌放入弃牌堆。
· 支付战斗力击败怪物，立即获得奖励；怪物牌不加入个人牌库。
· 支付技能使用装置牌，立即结算效果；装置牌不加入个人牌库。
· 在市场房间中，每件市场物品的价格为 7 枚金币。
结束回合前必须打出全部手牌，并用完已获得的魔法泉销毁机会。回合结束时弃置打出区的牌，再抽取 5 张牌。未使用的技能、战斗力和移动力不会保留到下回合，金币保留。
需要抽牌但牌库为空时，将弃牌堆洗混，组成新的牌库。
移动与房间：
沿通道进入相邻房间，通常消耗 1 点移动力，脚印表示所需数量。通道每有一个怪物图标，需要支付 1 点战斗力，否则受到 1 点伤害。通过带锁的通道需要万能钥匙，通过升降梯需要支付 1 枚金币。
进入水晶洞穴后，本回合不能继续使用移动力，除非卡牌效果允许。传送不消耗移动力，可以越过通道限制，但目的地仍须是相邻房间。
进入房间时可以领取秘密或神像，神器需要在所在房间主动拾取。通常只能携带一件神器，每个背包将携带上限增加一件。携带神器返回入口即成功撤离，没有神器不能返回入口。
巨龙袭击：
每制造 1 点噪音，将个人供给区的 1 个方块放入噪音区。移除噪音时收回噪音区的方块；不足的部分抵消本回合之后的噪音。袭击开始时，将所有玩家噪音区的方块放入龙袋。
回合末补齐地下城公共牌列，并结算新牌的到来效果。本次补牌中只要出现巨龙袭击标记，补牌结束后触发一次袭击，不因同时出现多个标记重复触发。
按怒气等级抽取方块，公共牌列中每张危险牌使抽取数量增加一个。每抽到自己的一个方块，受到 1 点伤害；黑色方块不会造成伤害。抽出的方块离开龙袋。拾取神器或龙蛋会提高怒气。
撤离与计分：
生命降至零，或承受通道等伤害时供给方块不足，玩家倒下。首位撤离或倒下的玩家触发撤离倒计时。此后每轮轮到该玩家时触发袭击，前三次依次多抽 1、2、3 个方块；第四次轮到该玩家，所有仍在探索的玩家倒下。地下城牌库耗尽也会使所有仍在探索的玩家倒下。
全部玩家撤离或倒下后，游戏结束。没有神器，或在地下城深处倒下，均不能计分；携带神器在地表倒下，仍可计分。
· 神器、卡牌、市场物品和收藏按各自分值计分，每枚金币计 1 分。
· 成功撤离额外获得 20 分，每个诅咒扣除 2 分。
总分相同，最高分神器较高者获胜；仍相同则并列。
沉没宝藏：
在两个水域房间之间移动，通常至少消耗 2 点移动力。如果在水域开始回合，且整回合未进入有空气的房间，回合末受到 1 点伤害。潜水装备免除缺氧伤害及水域移动的额外费用。
木乃伊的诅咒：
与木乃伊处于同一区域时，可以选择以下一种方式与它战斗。
· 支付 2 点战斗力，获得 4 枚金币和 1 个诅咒。
· 支付 3 点战斗力，移除一半诅咒，移除数量向上取整。
每次战斗后投掷金字塔骰。木乃伊移入新区域时，该区域玩家获得 1 个诅咒。
黄金与蛛丝：
清除通道蛛网需要额外支付 1 点移动力或战斗力，并收集该蛛网。领取被蛛网覆盖的房间奖励，需要支付 1 点战斗力。蛛网按标示分值计分。
在矿脉相邻房间中，支付 2 点技能和 1 个个人供给区的方块采矿，获得所示金币。每条矿脉整局只能开采一次，采矿后本回合不能再使用移动力。
有计分资格的采矿者按矿脉数量排名，前三名额外获得 20、10、5 分。矿脉数量相同，开采过的最深矿脉较深者优先。
猿王神庙：
经过器具所在通道时收集器具，器具分为齿轮、猴子扳手和香蕉。在丛林地图中，每类器具分别按数量的平方计分，三类分数相加；例如，两个齿轮和一个香蕉共计 5 分。支付 3 点战斗力击败青铜守卫，可以取得其剩余器具中的一件。
在神庙地图中，在齿轮连接的房间消耗同符号器具，可以改变齿轮方向。器具不直接计分；怒气提高至特定等级时，也可能引发齿轮旋转。
双局战役：
先进行丛林对局，再进行神庙对局，第二局保留第一局收集的器具。第一局有计分资格的前三名，分别获得 20、10、5 分战役奖励。最终胜负按第二局得分及战役奖励决定，不累加第一局总分。
蛛后宝库奖励：
每次支付 8 点技能，并放置 1 个个人供给区的方块。每项奖励整局只能领取一次。
· 奖励 1：获得 5 枚金币。
· 奖励 2：获得 3 枚金币和 1 点战斗力。
· 奖励 3：获得 3 枚金币和 1 点移动力。
· 奖励 4：获得 3 枚金币，恢复 1 点生命。
· 奖励 5：获得 1 张“秘密典籍”，恢复 1 点生命。
· 奖励 6：获得 1 张“秘密典籍”和 1 枚金币。
· 奖励 7：获得 1 张“秘密典籍”和 1 枚金币。
· 奖励 8：获得 1 张“秘密典籍”和 2 枚金币。

en.name: Clank!
en.desc: Build your deck, steal an artifact, and escape the dragon.
en.rules:
Goal:
Take an artifact from the dungeon and escape through the entrance. At the end of the game, the eligible player with the highest score wins.
Setup:
Each player starts with 10 health and a shuffled deck of 10 cards. Draw 5 cards. Shuffle enabled expansion cards into the Dungeon Deck and use the components for the chosen map.
Turn actions:
Play cards, move, acquire cards, fight and buy items in any order. Playing a card gives you its skill, combat, movement and other effects.
· Spend skill to acquire Dungeon Row or reserve cards. Put acquired cards in your discard pile.
· Spend combat to defeat monsters and receive their rewards. Monster cards do not enter your deck.
· Spend skill to use a Device and resolve its effect immediately. Device cards do not enter your deck.
· In a market room, each Market item costs 7 gold.
Before ending your turn, play every hand card and use any available Magic Spring trash effects. Then discard your played cards and draw 5 cards. Unused skill, combat and movement expire; keep your gold.
When you need to draw from an empty deck, shuffle your discard pile to form a new deck.
Movement and rooms:
Follow a tunnel to an adjacent room, usually for 1 movement; footprints show the cost. For each monster symbol, spend 1 combat or take 1 damage. A locked tunnel requires a Master Key, and an elevator requires 1 gold.
After entering a Crystal Cave, you cannot spend movement again this turn unless an effect allows it. Teleporting costs no movement and ignores tunnel restrictions, but the destination must be adjacent.
On entry, you may collect a secret or monkey idol; take an artifact as a separate action in its room. You may carry one artifact, plus one per Backpack. Return to the entrance with an artifact to escape. You cannot return without one.
Dragon attacks:
For each Clank! you make, move 1 cube from your personal supply to the Clank! area. Removing Clank! returns your cubes; any excess cancels later Clank! this turn. At the start of an attack, move every player’s Clank! cubes into the Dragon Bag.
At turn end, refill the Dungeon Row and resolve the new cards’ Arrive effects. If any refill card has a dragon attack symbol, trigger one attack after refilling. Multiple symbols in the same refill do not cause multiple attacks.
Rage determines how many cubes are drawn, plus one for each Danger card in the row. Each of your cubes drawn deals 1 damage to you; black cubes deal none. Drawn cubes leave the bag. Taking an artifact or Dragon Egg increases rage.
Escape and scoring:
You are knocked out at zero health, or if you lack supply cubes to take damage outside the bag. The first player to escape or be knocked out starts the countdown. Each time their turn returns, attack with 1, then 2, then 3 extra cubes. On their fourth return, all remaining explorers are knocked out. An empty Dungeon Deck also knocks out all remaining explorers.
The game ends when everyone has escaped or been knocked out. A player without an artifact, or knocked out in the Depths, cannot score. A player knocked out above the Depths can still score with an artifact.
· Score artifacts, cards, Market items and collectibles at their values. Each gold is worth 1 point.
· Escaping awards 20 extra points. Each Curse token loses 2 points.
Break score ties using each player’s highest-value artifact. Remaining ties share victory.
Sunken Treasures:
Moving between two water rooms normally costs at least 2 movement. If you start in water and never enter a room with air, take 1 damage at turn end. Diving Gear prevents air damage and removes the extra underwater movement cost.
The Mummy’s Curse:
While in the Mummy’s zone, choose one of these ways to fight it.
· Spend 2 combat to gain 4 gold and 1 Curse token.
· Spend 3 combat to remove half your Curse tokens, rounded up.
Roll the pyramid die after each fight. When the Mummy enters a new zone, players there gain 1 Curse token.
Gold and Silk:
To clear a tunnel web, spend 1 extra movement or combat and collect the web. Collecting rewards in a webbed room costs 1 combat. Collected webs score their printed values.
In a room beside a mine, spend 2 skill and 1 cube from your personal supply to claim its gold. Each mine can be claimed once per game. After mining, you cannot spend movement again this turn.
Eligible miners rank by mines claimed. The top three gain 20, 10 and 5 extra points. Break ties using each player’s deepest claimed mine.
Temple of the Ape Lords:
Collect ape-aratus when passing through its tunnel. Types are Cog, Monkey Wrench and Banana. In the Jungle, square the count of each type and add the three scores: two Cogs and one Banana score 5 points. Spend 3 combat to defeat the Bronze Guardian and take one remaining ape-aratus.
In the Temple, spend a matching ape-aratus in a room connected to a gear to change its orientation. Ape-aratus does not score directly. Rage increases at certain levels can also rotate gears.
Two-game campaign:
Play the Jungle game, then the Temple game, carrying your collected ape-aratus into the second game. The top three eligible players in the first game receive campaign bonuses of 20, 10 and 5 points. The final result uses the second-game score plus this bonus, without adding the first-game total.
Spider Queen’s Cache:
Spend 8 skill and place 1 cube from your personal supply per claim. Each reward can be claimed once per game.
· Reward 1: Gain 5 gold.
· Reward 2: Gain 3 gold and 1 combat.
· Reward 3: Gain 3 gold and 1 movement.
· Reward 4: Gain 3 gold and recover 1 health.
· Reward 5: Gain 1 Secret Tome and recover 1 health.
· Reward 6: Gain 1 Secret Tome and 1 gold.
· Reward 7: Gain 1 Secret Tome and 1 gold.
· Reward 8: Gain 1 Secret Tome and 2 gold.

zh.name: 噤声寻宝记：地下墓穴
zh.desc: 探索不断拼接的地下城，构筑牌库，夺取神器并逃出龙穴。
zh.rules:
在不断扩展的地下墓穴中构筑牌库、寻找神器，再返回墓穴出口。所有玩家逃出或昏迷后，得分最高者获胜；平分时比较最贵神器的价值。

你的回合:
自由安排打牌、移动、购牌、使用装置、战斗、开锁和购买市场物品。蓝色技能用于购牌与装置，剑用于战斗，靴用于移动。获得的牌通常进入弃牌堆，怪物和装置的文字立即执行。回合结束前须打完手牌，未花费的资源不会保留。清理打出区，抽五张牌，再补齐六张地下城牌。

地图与探索:
每次移动到下一间房通常花一靴。通道上的额外脚印、锁、怪物和冥币另行支付；可用剑抵消怪物伤害。自愿承受的伤害不能使你昏迷，且必须有个人方块标记。锁一旦打开，所有人都可通过。进入水晶洞穴或跌入陷坑后，本回合不能继续花靴，传送仍然可用。
沿地图边缘的通道探索时，先揭示新板块，再选择朝向并完成原移动。可以中断移动打牌或获得资源。传送忽略通道图标和单向箭头，仍然触发房间效果。传送门连接其他传送门，完整的一次移动仍须支付两端通道的图标。

宝藏与房间:
每回合首次进入一间房可获得该房间奖励；下回合须重新进入才可再获奖励。开锁器还可打开宝箱、图书室或监牢，分别获得大秘密、秘密典籍或释放囚犯。每处神龛每人只能标记一次，放置个人方块并获得等同已标神龛数的金币。一个背包增加一件神器容量。拿取神器会增加巨龙怒气。

龙袭与逃生:
补入的新牌带龙袭图标时，巨龙袭击一次。把全部噪音方块放入龙袋，再按怒气及危险图标抽取方块。黑色方块移至银行，玩家色方块造成对应玩家伤害；每个白色幽灵方块使仍在探险的所有玩家受伤，随后回到噪音区。
携带神器返回墓穴出口后，可完成本回合，再退出并获得 20 分逃脱奖励。昏迷时没有神器，或身处深处或冥界，通常得零分；安全区中携带神器昏迷仍可计分。计分包括神器、金币、卡牌、秘密、囚犯、市场物品和其他奖励。已离场玩家的席次改为固定四方块龙袭，两人局为六方块，没有倒计时。牌库不足以补齐牌列或袭击结束时龙袋为空，所有在场玩家立刻昏迷并结算。

可选扩展:
巢穴与失落密室加入陷坑、魔法屏障、特殊神龛和房间怪物。战利品放在个人供应区，提供持续能力或分数。冥界为独立地图，通过梯子或单向滑道进入；回合从冥界开始时支付一枚冥币，无法支付则制造两点噪音。冥界有专用市场、命运牌、鹰身女妖、神器增强器和小恶魔助手。
冒险派对加入可选反应：对手满足条件时，可把对应手牌置于反应区并补抽一张，直到自己的下一回合才执行该牌。六角色各有不同的起始牌和能力。五至六人局使用额外神器、补给和隐形斗篷；同一玩家不得从同一房间拿取第二件神器。三个扩展可以独立开关。

en.name: Clank! Catacombs
en.desc: Explore a changing dungeon, build your deck, steal an artifact, and escape the dragon.
en.rules:
Build your deck, explore the changing Catacombs, recover an artifact, and return to the Crypt. When everyone has escaped or been knocked out, the highest eligible score wins. Break ties with the most valuable artifact.

Your turn:
Play cards, move, buy cards, use devices, fight, pick locks, and visit the Market in any order. Skill buys cards and devices; Swords defeat monsters; Boots move you. Acquired cards normally enter your discard pile. Devices and defeated monsters resolve immediately. Play every card in hand before ending your turn. Unspent resources expire. Discard your played cards, draw five, and refill the six-card Dungeon Row.

Movement and discovery:
Moving to the next room normally costs one Boot. Pay for extra footprints, locks, monsters, and Undercoin tolls along the whole tunnel. Swords prevent tunnel monster damage. You cannot voluntarily take damage that would knock you out or that you cannot mark with cubes from your supply. Opened locks stay open for everyone. Entering a Crystal Cave or falling into a Pit Trap stops further Boot movement for the turn, but not teleportation.
To explore, reveal the next tile, choose its orientation, and complete your original move. You may pause to play cards or gain resources. Teleportation ignores tunnel icons and arrows but still triggers rooms. Portals connect to other portals; a full move still pays icons at both ends.

Treasure and rooms:
Collect each room’s entry reward only on your first entry each turn. You must re-enter on a later turn to collect again. A Lockpick opens a chest for a major secret, a library for a Secret Tome, or a prison to free prisoners. Mark each Wayshrine at most once per player, placing a supply cube and taking Gold equal to your marked Wayshrines. A Backpack adds one artifact slot. Taking an artifact increases rage.

Dragon attacks and escape:
A dragon icon on a newly refilled card triggers one attack. Move all Clank! cubes into the bag and draw according to rage plus Danger. Black cubes go to the Bank. Colored cubes damage their player. Each white Ghost damages every active player, then returns to the Clank! area.
Return to the Crypt with an artifact, finish your turn, then escape with a 20-point Mastery token. Knocked-out players normally score zero without an artifact or in the Depths or Underworld. An artifact carrier knocked out in safety still scores. Add artifacts, Gold, cards, secrets, prisoners, market items, and other rewards. An eliminated seat causes a fixed four-cube attack on each of its turns, or six cubes in a two-player game. There is no countdown. If the row cannot be refilled, or the bag is empty after an attack, all remaining players are knocked out immediately and the game ends.

Optional expansions:
Lairs & Lost Chambers adds Pit Traps, Magic Barriers, special chambers, and room monsters. Trophies remain in your supply and provide abilities or points. The Underworld is a separate map reached by ladders or one-way chutes. Starting a turn there costs one Undercoin; if you cannot pay, make two Clank! instead. It has its own Market, Fate cards, harpies, artifact enhancers, and Imp Assistants.
Adventuring Party adds optional reactions: when an opponent meets a condition, place the matching card in your reaction area and draw a replacement. Resolve it on your next turn. Six unique characters have distinct starting decks and abilities. Five- and six-player games add artifacts, reserve cards, and Invisibility Cloaks; a player cannot take two artifacts from the same room. Each expansion can be enabled separately.

zh.name: 绝顶聪明
zh.desc: 六骰三选填表,连锁奖励滚雪球
zh.rules:
目标:用六颗骰子在计分表五个色区填格,终局总分最高者获胜。
准备:每人一张计分表;4 人打 4 轮、3 人 5 轮、2 人 6 轮。
流程:
· 主动玩家掷全部 6 颗骰子,从中选一颗填入色区,点数比它低的骰子进入托盘;再掷再选,至多选三颗,之后其余骰子也进托盘。
· 其他玩家从托盘各捡一颗填表;托盘里没有能用的,才可从主动玩家留下的骰位挑一颗。
· 白骰是百搭:任选色区;选蓝区时按蓝骰+白骰的点数和填。蓝骰只能配白骰填蓝区。
色区:
· 黄区:按格子印的点数打叉,完成一列得该列星分(10/14/16/20)。
· 蓝区:按蓝+白点数和打叉,按总勾数查表得分(最多 56)。
· 绿区:填入点数须不小于当格要求,分数逐格递增(最多 66)。
· 橙区:直接填点数,印有翻倍标记的格子按 2 倍或 3 倍计分。
· 紫区:每格必须比前一格大;前一格是 6 则任意。
奖励:打叉/填格会触发表上奖励——任一色区打叉、紫/橙填 6、狐狸、重掷与额外骰,奖励可以连锁。
行动:重掷(主动玩家重掷全部待选骰)与额外骰(多用一颗骰,每颗骰每回合限一次)各 7 格,靠轮次与奖励解锁。
解锁节奏:第 1/3 轮开始各解锁 1 次重掷,第 2 轮解锁 1 颗额外骰。
第 4 轮开始时,全员再选一次「任一区打叉」或「紫/橙填 6」。
结算:五区各自计分;每只狐狸等于你最低一区的分数。末轮结束后每人还能用掉剩余额外骰。
总分高者胜,平分比最高单一分区,再平则共同获胜。
单人:共 6 轮,每轮先当主动玩家、再当被动玩家——重掷全部 6 骰,点数最低的 3 颗进托盘(并列由你选)。
从中捡 1 颗填表,不可用重掷;终局按评级表评价。

en.name: That's Pretty Clever!
en.desc: Pick dice, mark your sheet, chain the bonuses
en.rules:
Goal: fill the five colored areas of your scoresheet with six dice; highest total at the end wins.
Setup: one sheet per player; 4 rounds with 4 players, 5 with 3, 6 with 2.
Play:
· The active player rolls all 6 dice, picks one and marks its area; every lower-valued die goes to the silver platter. Roll and pick again, up to three picks, then the rest go to the platter too.
· Each other player then takes one die from the platter; only if none there is usable may they take one of the dice the active player left behind.
· The white die is a joker: pick any area; for blue it scores as blue + white. The blue die only scores in blue, also as blue + white.
Areas:
· Yellow: cross off the printed number; complete a column for its star points (10/14/16/20).
· Blue: cross off the blue+white sum; score by total crosses (up to 56).
· Green: each entry must meet the cell minimum; points grow per cell (up to 66).
· Orange: write the value as-is; cells with a multiplier mark score double or triple.
· Purple: each entry must top the previous one; after a 6, anything goes.
Bonuses: marking cells triggers printed bonuses — a free cross, a 6 in purple/orange, foxes, rerolls and extra dice — and bonuses can chain.
Actions: rerolls (active player rerolls all remaining dice) and extra dice (use one more die, each die at most once per turn) have 7 slots each, unlocked by rounds and bonuses.
Unlocks: rounds 1 & 3 unlock a reroll, round 2 an extra die.
At round 4 everyone picks a free cross or a 6.
Scoring: each area scores separately; each fox scores your lowest area. After the last round everyone may spend leftover extra dice.
Highest total wins; ties break on the best single area, then shared victory.
Solo: 6 rounds; each round you play the active player first, then the passive player — reroll all 6 dice, the 3 lowest go to the platter (you break ties), take one of them, no rerolls.
Your final score is rated on a scale.

zh.name: 立方聪明
zh.desc: 双骰定蓝区,连击叉满绿松石
zh.rules:
目标:在五个色区中尽量多地得分;终局每只狐狸奖励等于你最低分区的分数,总分最高者获胜。
流程:
· 2 人玩 6 轮,3 人 5 轮,4 人 4 轮;每轮每人当一次主动玩家。
· 单人玩 6 轮:每轮你先当主动玩家,再扮演被动玩家——重掷全部 6 骰,点数最低的 3 颗上银盘,从中选 1 颗录入。
· 每轮开始所有人领取轮次奖励:重掷(第 1 轮)、额外骰(第 2 轮)、数字百搭(第 3 轮)。
· 第 4 轮获得黑色 ?:任选色区,自选 1-6 点立即录入。
· 主动玩家掷全部 6 骰,选 1 颗放上骰位并录入对应色区;点数更小的骰全部放上银盘。
· 余骰可再掷,至多掷 3 次、放 3 颗骰;三颗都不想要可放弃本次投掷。
· 随后其他玩家同时从银盘各选 1 颗骰录入(骰不移走);银盘骰全不可用时,才可改用主动玩家骰位上的骰。
· 回合末每人可用额外骰行动:任选一颗骰(含已用过的)再录入一次,每颗骰每回合限用一次。
色区:
· 黄区:按第几次投掷叉对应行的对应点数格;被动只能叉灰格。同列上下两格都叉,触发两格之间印出的奖励。
· 绿松石区:叉与骰值同数的格;骰位(被动为银盘)上每有一颗同点骰可多叉 1 格。叉满某行或某列的全部深色格,触发对应奖励。
· 蓝区:填蓝骰与白骰点数之和,从中央 7 向两侧逐格延伸,相邻两格必须差 1;填 7 可重置数列(两个 7 不相邻)。
· 棕区:叉与骰值同数的格,只能从左向右,可跳格但不可回头;相邻两格都叉触发两格之间印出的奖励。
· 粉区:从左向右依次填,每格二选一——填半数(向上取整)拿格下奖励,或填骰值乘星标倍数(放弃奖励)。
· 白骰是颜色百搭,可当任意色使用;蓝区填数恒为蓝骰加白骰之和。
行动:
· 重掷仅主动玩家可用:重掷全部刚掷的骰;数字百搭把所选骰视作另一点数录入(印数字的格必须用该值);额外骰回合末使用。
· 行动格从左往右依次解锁(圈),使用时划掉;三条行动轨圈满另有行尾奖励。
· ? 奖励必须立即使用:自选 1-6 点按对应色区规则录入,可连锁触发新奖励;黑色 ? 可任选色区。
结算:
· 黄区与绿松石区按每行叉数查表。
· 蓝区按最左侧与最右侧已填格印出的分值计分,每个不大于 4 或不小于 10 的已填数再加 4 分。
· 棕区按总叉数查表;粉区求填入值之和;每只狐狸 = 最低分区得分(有区为 0 分则狐狸为 0 分)。
· 平分则单区最高者胜,再平共享胜利。

en.name: Clever Cubed
en.desc: Two dice feed the blue row, combos cross the turquoise
en.rules:
Goal: Score across five colored areas; at the end each fox scores your lowest area, highest total wins.
Play:
· 6 rounds with 2 players, 5 with 3, 4 with 4; each player is the active player once per round.
· Solo plays 6 rounds: each round you act as the active player, then as the passive player — reroll all 6 dice, the 3 lowest go to the silver platter, and you record one of them.
· At the start of each round everyone collects its bonus: reroll (round 1), extra die (round 2), number joker (round 3).
· Round 4 grants a black ?: pick any area and record a value of 1-6 immediately.
· The active player rolls all 6 dice, places one on a dice slot and records it in its area; all lower dice go to the silver platter.
· The rest may be rerolled, at most 3 rolls and 3 placed dice; you may forfeit a roll instead.
· Then every other player simultaneously records one die from the silver platter (dice stay put); only if no platter die is usable may they use a die from the active player's slots.
· At the end of the turn, anyone may spend extra-die actions: pick any die (even used ones) and record it once more; each die once per turn.
Areas:
· Yellow: cross the matching number in the row of your current roll; passive players may only cross the grey cells. Crossing both cells of a column triggers the bonus printed between them.
· Turquoise: cross cells of the die's number; each matching die on your slots (platter, when passive) adds one more cross. Filling every dark cell of a row or column triggers its bonus.
· Blue: enter the sum of the blue and white dice, extending from the central 7 to either side; neighbors must differ by exactly 1. A 7 resets the sequence (two 7s never touch).
· Brown: cross the matching number, left to right only; you may skip cells but never go back. Crossing both cells around a gap triggers the bonus printed between them.
· Pink: fill left to right; each cell is a choice — half the die (rounded up) to take the bonus below, or die × the star multiplier (forfeiting it).
· The white die is wild for any color; blue entries always sum the blue and white dice.
Actions:
· Reroll: active player only, reroll everything just rolled; Number joker: record the chosen die as another value (a printed box forces its value); Extra die: used at turn end.
· Action boxes unlock left to right (circle) and are spent by crossing; filling a full track grants its end bonus.
· ? bonuses must be used immediately: pick a value 1-6 and record it under that area's rules, possibly chaining into more bonuses; the black ? works in any area.
Scoring:
· Yellow and turquoise score per row by crosses.
· Blue scores the values printed at the leftmost and rightmost filled cells, plus 4 per filled entry of 4 or less / 10 or more.
· Brown scores by total crosses; pink sums its entries; each fox = your lowest area score (0 if any area is empty).
· Ties go to the highest single area, then shared victory.

zh.name: 行动代号
zh.desc: 红蓝对抗:队长一句话,队员猜词板
zh.rules:
目标:按身份翻开词语,先找齐己方全部词的一队获胜。
准备:
· 全员分红蓝两队,每队至少 2 人,并各选一名队长。
· 词板共 25 个词:先手队 9 个、后手队 8 个、中立 7 个、刺客 1 个;归属只有两名队长能看到。
流程:
· 两队轮流行动。轮到的一方由队长给出线索:一个词加一个数字,数字表示该线索指向几个己方的词。
· 线索不能是词板上尚未翻开的词,也不能把它包含在内。
· 队员在词板上点词:点一下提出候选,再点一下确认翻开;每回合最多翻「线索数字加 1」个,可随时主动结束回合。
翻牌结果:
· 己方词:可以继续猜。
· 对方词:等于替对方翻开,回合结束。
· 中立词:回合结束。
· 刺客:本队立即落败。

en.name: Codenames
en.desc: Red vs blue: one-word clues, team guesses
en.rules:
Goal: reveal words by identity; the first team to find all of its words wins.
Setup:
· Split into red and blue teams of at least 2 players each, with one captain per team.
· The board holds 25 words: 9 for the starting team, 8 for the other team, 7 neutral, 1 assassin. Only the two captains can see the assignments.
Play:
· Teams alternate. On your team’s turn the captain gives a clue: one word plus a number — the number is how many of your team’s words the clue points to.
· The clue may not be a word still hidden on the board, nor contain one.
· Teammates guess on the board: tap a word to propose it, tap again to confirm the reveal. At most the clue number plus one words may be revealed per turn, and the turn may be ended at any time.
Reveal results:
· Your team’s word: keep guessing.
· A rival word: revealed for their benefit; the turn ends.
· A neutral word: the turn ends.
· The assassin: your team loses immediately.

zh.name: 咖啡烘焙师
zh.desc: 单人袋构筑:选豆、控温烘焙、杯测冲煮,冲出一杯完美咖啡
zh.rules:
目标:把生豆烘到最佳烘焙度,杯测拿下高分。
单杯模式自选一张咖啡卡;挑战模式连烘三炉(组别 I→II→III),按总分评定烘焙师头衔。
准备:按卡片把咖啡豆、硬豆、水分、缺陷豆和风味片装进袋子;水分越多,温控器起始格越靠前。
袋旁红区格(10、12)上放着烟片。
烘焙流程:每轮温控器前进一格(首轮不动),格号就是本轮抽片数。
移进红区格时格上的烟片入袋,且本轮多烘 2 级;抽出的水分片立即移出游戏。
抽片后可用效果,再结算烘焙:所有豆升 1 级(红区升 2 级),4 级再烘变焦豆,硬豆只能升到 0 级;供给耗尽则该豆原样回袋。
即时效果(每炉各限一次,先即时后风味):
· 野性风味:把抽出的 0 级豆和 1 级豆各一枚放上野性风味板的两格(可跨轮集齐),集齐立即换得百搭风味片。
· 额外抽 2(付醇度片):再抽 2 枚。
· 重抽 2(付任意风味片):选 2 枚放回袋再抽 2 枚。
· 抽 5 去 2(付香气片):抽 5 枚,将其中 2 枚移出游戏,其余回袋。
· 清除(付任意风味片):抽出的焦豆、烟片、缺陷豆全部移出游戏。
风味效果(付的风味片停到杯效激活格,占满 2 格获得杯效):
· 醇度=浓缩:2 枚豆合 1 枚,等级相加;仅允许两枚 1 级、1 级加 2 级、1 级加 3 级或两枚 2 级。
· 酸度=保鲜:恰好 2 枚豆本轮不烘直接回袋(硬豆、缺陷豆、焦豆不可)。
· 香气=分散:1 枚豆拆成 2 枚低级豆,拆分方式如下。
· 2 级拆成两枚 1 级;3 级拆成 1 级加 2 级;4 级拆成 1 级加 3 级或两枚 2 级。
参与的豆立即回袋不烘。每炉杯效与激活格颜色的搭配随机。
杯效:
· 额外豆:顶左杯位预放 1 枚 3 级豆;甜味:顶中杯位放甜味标记。
· 甄选:第 2 排 2 个杯位各抽 2 选 1;交换:满杯后 2 枚回袋,抽 3 选 2 填回。
· 托盘:托盘加 2 格。
杯测:温控器走完 14 格或主动停烘后,逐枚抽片决定入杯或入托盘(托盘满只能入杯);水分片直接弃掉。
杯位按从上到下、从左到右依次填充,袋空或满杯即计分。
计分:烘焙分按杯中豆总烘焙度查卡表,表外 0 分。
风味分按卡面需求匹配 1/2/3/4 枚,分别计 1/3/6/10 分。
百搭片可代任意需求;甜味在非指定卡也可代任意。
技巧分:同级豆 3/4/5/6/7 枚以上分别计 1/2/3/4/5 分,每级各算一组。
减分:硬豆、焦豆、烟片各扣 1 分;缺陷豆扣 2 分;杯中零风味扣 3 分;有空杯位扣 5 分。
挑战:第 2、3 炉可选难度由上炉分数决定(≤9 仅初级,10-14 加中级,≥15 全开)。
组别 I 的专家卡需曾达「中级烘焙师」(挑战总分 35+)才解锁。
总分头衔:60+ 烘焙大师、53-59 顶尖烘焙师、47-52 全城最佳、40-46 首席烘焙师。
35-39 中级烘焙师、28-34 熟手烘焙师、20-27 助理烘焙师、19 以下学徒。

en.name: Coffee Roaster
en.desc: Solo bag-building: pick a bean, roast it right, and cup the perfect brew
en.rules:
Goal: roast green beans to their sweet spot and score high at cupping.
Single mode: play any one coffee card. Challenge mode: roast three batches (groups I→II→III) and earn a roaster title from your total.
Setup: fill the bag with the beans, hard beans, moisture, defective beans and flavor tokens shown on the card; more moisture means an earlier thermostat start.
Smoke tokens sit on the red spaces (10, 12).
Roasting: each round the thermostat advances one space (not on round 1); its number is how many tokens you draw.
Moving onto a red space drops its smoke tokens into the bag and beans roast 2 extra levels that round; drawn moisture is removed from the game.
After optional effects, all beans roast up 1 level (2 in a red zone); level-4 beans burn, hard beans only reach level 0, and if the supply runs dry a bean returns unroasted.
Immediate effects (once per batch each; immediate before flavor):
· Wild flavor: place a level-0 and a level-1 bean onto the two slots of the wild-flavor board (across rounds) to gain the wild token.
· Draw 2 more (pay body).
· Redraw 2 (pay any flavor): return 2 drawn tokens, draw 2 new ones.
· 5 pick 2 (pay aroma): draw 5, remove 2 of them from the game, rest go back.
· Removal (pay any flavor): remove all drawn burnt, smoke and defective tokens.
Flavor effects (the paid token parks on a cup-effect activation slot; fill both slots to earn it):
· Body = concentrate: merge 2 beans into 1, levels add; only two level-1, level-1 plus level-2, level-1 plus level-3, or two level-2.
· Acidity = preserve: exactly 2 beans skip roasting and return to the bag (not hard/defective/burnt).
· Aroma = disperse: split 1 bean into 2 lower ones, as follows.
· Level 2 into two level-1; level 3 into level-1 plus level-2; level 4 into level-1 plus level-3 or two level-2.
Beans involved return to the bag unroasted. Cup-effect slot colors are randomized each batch.
Cup effects:
· Extra bean: the top-left cup space is pre-filled with a level-3 bean; sweetness: the top-middle space holds a sweetness marker.
· Selection: the two row-2 spaces draw 2 keep 1; exchange: when full, return 2, draw 3 and refill 2.
· Tray: 2 extra tray spaces.
Cupping: after the thermostat passes 14 or you stop early, draw one token at a time and choose cup or tray (tray full means cup); moisture is discarded.
Spaces fill top-to-bottom, left-to-right; scoring starts when the cup is full or the bag is empty.
Scoring: roast points come from the total roast level looked up on the card, 0 off-scale.
Flavor points: matching 1/2/3/4 required tokens scores 1/3/6/10.
Wild counts as anything; sweetness counts as anything on cards not requiring it.
Skill points: 3/4/5/6/7 or more beans of one level score 1/2/3/4/5, each level scored separately.
Penalties: hard, burnt and smoke tokens cost 1 point each; defective 2; no flavor in cup 3; any empty space 5.
Challenge: the difficulty you may pick for batches 2 and 3 depends on the previous score (≤9 beginner only, 10-14 adds moderate, ≥15 all).
Expert cards of group I require a lifetime best challenge total of 35+.
Titles: 60+ Master roaster, 53-59 Top roaster, 47-52 Best in town, 40-46 Chief roaster.
35-39 Mid-level roaster, 28-34 Journeyman, 20-27 Assistant, below 19 Apprentice.

zh.name: 柯尔特快车
zh.desc: 编程行动洗劫列车,枪林弹雨里抢最多的钱
zh.rules:
目标:五轮抢劫后,战利品总价值最高的匪徒获胜。
准备:
· 列车由车头与人数相同的车厢组成;警长和保险箱($1000)在车头。
· 车厢地板上放有宝石($500)与钱袋($250-$500);钱袋面值只有持有者能看。
· 每人获得 10 张行动卡、6 颗子弹和 1 个 $250 钱袋。
流程:每轮分谋划与动手两阶段;回合卡规定本轮回合数与轮末事件。
· 每轮开始洗混自己的牌库并抽 6 张;未打出的手牌轮末放回牌库。
· 谋划:从起始玩家开始轮流打出一张行动卡,或从牌库抽 3 张。
· 隧道回合的牌暗置;加速回合连续行动两次;反转回合逆时针进行。
· 动手:公共牌堆按打出顺序逐张强制执行,目标在执行时才选定。
· 移动:车内移相邻一节,车顶移一至三节;打出就必须移动。
· 换层:在同一车厢的车内与车顶之间切换。
· 警长:移动警长一节;其车厢内的匪徒逃上车顶并各吃一颗子弹。
· 开枪:车内只能打相邻车厢,车顶沿视线打任意距离;不能打同位置的人。
· 中弹者把你的一颗子弹洗进牌库;子弹是抽到手也无用的废卡。
· 抢劫:拿走所在车厢同层的一件战利品。
· 殴打:令同位置的匪徒掉一件战利品到地板,并将其推到相邻车厢。
· 公共子弹共 13 颗,发完即止。
事件:每轮结束后结算回合卡上的事件。
· 愤怒警长:车顶的匪徒各吃一颗子弹,警长向车尾移一节。
· 旋转臂:所有车顶的匪徒移到车尾顶。
· 刹车:所有车顶的匪徒向车头移一节。
· 全拿走:第二个保险箱放入警长所在车厢。
· 乘客反抗:车厢内的匪徒各吃一颗子弹。
· 顺手牵羊:独占一处(同车厢同层)的匪徒拿走该处一个钱袋。
· 警长的报复:警长正上方的匪徒失去自己最便宜的钱袋。
· 劫持列车长:车头的匪徒各得 $250。
角色:每人随机扮演一名角色,各有一项能力。
· 幽灵:每轮自己的第一个回合可暗置打牌。
· 美女:只要还有其他可选目标,就不能成为开枪或殴打的目标。
· 神偷:殴打令对方掉出钱袋时,直接据为己有。
· 穿顶:开枪可以打同一车厢另一层的匪徒。
· 击退:被其击中的匪徒沿射击方向退一节。
· 多谋:每轮开始抽 7 张牌而非 6 张。
结束:
· 开枪最多者获得 $1000 神枪手奖;并列则各得一份。
· 战利品总价值最高者获胜;并列时吃子弹最少者胜。

en.name: Colt Express
en.desc: Program your moves, rob the train, dodge the bullets
en.rules:
Goal: after five rounds, the bandit with the most valuable loot wins.
Setup:
· The train has a locomotive plus one car per player; the Marshal and a strongbox ($1000) start in the locomotive.
· Gems ($500) and purses ($250-$500) lie on the car floors; purse values are secret to their owner.
· Each player takes 10 action cards, 6 bullets and one $250 purse.
Play: each round has a Schemin' and a Stealin' phase; the round card sets the turns and an end-of-round event.
· At the start of each round, shuffle your deck and draw 6 cards; unplayed cards return to the deck.
· Schemin': starting from the first player, play one action card to the common pile or draw 3 cards.
· Cards are played face down in tunnel turns; speeding turns give two actions; switching turns run counter-clockwise.
· Stealin': the pile is executed in the order played; targets are chosen as each card resolves.
· Move: one car inside, one to three on the roof; you must move.
· Floor Change: switch between inside and roof of the same car.
· Marshal: move the Marshal one car; bandits inside his car flee to the roof and each take a bullet.
· Fire: from inside, shoot an adjacent car; from the roof, shoot along line of sight; never your own spot.
· The target takes one of your bullets into their deck; bullets are dead cards when drawn.
· Robbery: take one loot from your car and floor.
· Punch: a bandit on your spot drops one loot and is pushed to an adjacent car.
· The 13 neutral bullets run out for good.
Events: resolve the round card's event after each round.
· Angry Marshal: bandits on roofs take a bullet, then the Marshal moves one car back.
· Swivel Arm: all bandits on roofs move to the rearmost roof.
· Braking: all bandits on roofs move one car forward.
· Take It All: a second strongbox is placed in the Marshal's car.
· Passengers' Rebellion: bandits inside cars each take a bullet.
· Pickpocketing: a bandit alone on a spot takes one purse there.
· Marshal's Revenge: the bandit right above the Marshal loses their cheapest purse.
· Hostage-Taking: bandits in or on the locomotive each gain $250.
Characters: each player randomly plays a character with a special ability.
· Ghost: may play face down on the first turn of each round.
· Belle: cannot be targeted by Fire or Punch while another target is available.
· Cheyenne: when her punch makes a purse drop, she keeps it.
· Tuco: his Fire can hit a bandit on the other floor of his car.
· Django: bandits he hits are knocked one car along the shot's direction.
· Doc: draws 7 cards at the start of each round instead of 6.
End:
· The bandit who shot the most earns the $1000 Gunslinger award; tied shooters each earn it.
· The highest loot total wins; ties are broken by the fewest bullets taken.

zh.name: 康考迪亚
zh.desc: 在罗马帝国拓展贸易网络，借助人物牌发展城市，让诸神见证你的繁荣。
zh.rules:
目标：
在罗马帝国建立房屋、发展殖民者与贸易，并收集人物牌。终局时每张人物牌按其神祇为你计分，最高分者获胜。
准备：
游戏支持2至5人。Italia地图适合2至4人，Imperium地图适合3至5人。自动地图在2至3人时使用Italia，4至5人时使用Imperium；与人数不符的手动选择会采用该人数的官方地图。按城市背面字母分别随机分配货物；每省最贵货物成为省奖励。每人拥有7张起手牌、15座房屋和陆海各3名殖民者，其中陆海各1名从Roma出发，其余4名留在12格仓库。仓库起始有2粮食及砖块、工具、葡萄酒、布料各1。随机先手获得5钱，后续座次依次多1钱；末席持有大执政官。市场按I至人数的牌堆分别洗牌、依次叠放，展示7张。
流程：
轮到你时打出1张人物牌并执行其行动。自己已打出的牌堆只向对手展示顶牌；购买的牌立即进入手牌。
· 建筑师：移动点等于你在版图上的殖民者总数，可分配给任意己方殖民者，也可少用。陆地殖民者走陆路，海上殖民者走海路；从城市出发到相邻路线用1点，从路线经过城市到另一条同类路线再用1点。可以穿过已占用的路线并计算每步，不能停在被占用的路线上。全部移动结束后，可在己方殖民者所在路线两端的城市建任意数量的房屋。每人每城最多1座，Roma不能建房。砖城支付1粮食；其余城市支付1砖块和1份该城货物。钱币基础费用按砖、粮、工具、酒、布依次为1、2、3、4、5，乘以建成后该城总房屋数。
· 执政官：选择尚未生产的省份，领取其奖励货物1份，并让该省所有玩家的每座房屋各生产1份城市货物，然后将奖励翻为钱币面；也可领取所有已翻面奖励的金币总数并将其全部复原。布料奖励的背面为1钱，其余为2钱。持有大执政官者选择生产时必须领取双份省奖励，随后把大执政官交给右手玩家；房屋产量不翻倍，收钱不传递大执政官。
· 商人：起手商人先获得3钱，购买的商人先获得5钱，然后最多交易两种货物，可买入或卖出任意数量，受资金和仓库容量限制。砖、粮、工具、酒、布的固定单价为3、4、5、6、7。
· 元老：最多购买2张市场牌，支付牌面费用及原槽位附费。7个槽位附费依次为无、任意货物、任意货物、布料、布料、任意货物与布料、2布料。全部购买结束后才左移并补牌。领事只买1张，忽略槽位附费。
· 外交官：复制其他玩家弃牌顶牌的行动，不能复制外交官或护民官。自己弃牌顶仍是外交官。
· 殖民官：每支付1粮食和1工具，就从仓库部署1名陆地或海上殖民者至Roma或自己已有房屋的城市；也可领取5钱及每名已在版图的己方殖民者各1钱。
· 护民官：收回全部弃牌（含本牌），每超过3张获得1钱；此外可支付1粮食和1工具，从仓库部署1名殖民者至Roma。
· 石匠、农夫、铁匠、酿酒师、织工：分别让自己所有对应砖、粮、工具、酒、布城市的房屋各生产1份货物。
仓库：
每份货物及每名尚未部署的殖民者占1格，共12格。不能主动丢弃货物；生产超过剩余空间时，自己选择接收哪些新货物，必须填满剩余格。钱币和货物供应不限，每人殖民者上限6名。玩家之间不能交易。
结束与计分：
首位建出第15座房屋，或买光市场与牌堆最后1张牌的玩家，获得Concordia奖励7分；其他玩家各执行最后1回合，然后同时计分。计算手牌与弃牌中的全部人物牌，每张按其神祇获得下列分数：
· 维斯塔：现金与仓库货物市价合计，每满10钱获得1分。
· 朱庇特：每座非砖城房屋获得1分。
· 萨图恩：每个拥有己方房屋的省份获得1分。
· 墨丘利：每种己方房屋能生产的货物获得2分。
· 玛尔斯：每名已在版图的己方殖民者获得2分。
· 密涅瓦：按对应专精城市计分，砖、粮、工具每座3分，葡萄酒每座4分，布料每座5分。
分数最高者获胜。同分时，持有大执政官者优先；若其不在同分者中，沿大执政官向右传递的方向最先取得它的同分玩家优先。
中间计分（可选，默认关闭）：
每人第一次打出护民官收牌后立即记录当时分数。所有人都完成后，最高分者获得2钱，第二名获得1钱；并列同一名次者获得相同奖励。这些分数不会保留到终局。

en.name: Concordia
en.desc: Expand your trade network across the Roman Empire. Build cities and collect personality cards to earn the gods’ favour.
en.rules:
Goal:
Build houses, develop colonists and trade, and collect personality cards. Each card scores for its god at the end; the highest score wins.
Setup:
For 2–5 players. Italia supports 2–4 and Imperium supports 3–5. Auto uses Italia for 2–3 and Imperium for 4–5; an incompatible manual selection uses the official map for the player count. Shuffle city tokens within each letter group. Each province’s most valuable good becomes its bonus. Each player has 7 starting cards, 15 houses and 3 colonists of each type. One land and one sea colonist start in Roma; the other four occupy the 12-space storehouse, together with 2 food and 1 each of brick, tool, wine and cloth. A random first player receives 5 coins; each later seat receives one more. The last player holds Praefectus Magnus. Shuffle market decks I through the player count separately, stack in that order, and display 7 cards.
Turns:
Play one personality card and carry out its action. Only the top card of each opponent’s discard pile is visible. Purchased cards immediately enter your hand.
· Architect: Movement points equal your colonists on the map. Distribute them freely; unused points are allowed. Land colonists use land routes and sea colonists sea routes. Leaving a city for an adjacent route costs 1 point; moving from a route through a city to another adjacent route costs 1 more. You may pass through occupied routes, paying for every step, but cannot stop on an occupied route. After all movement, build any number of houses in cities adjacent to your colonists. At most one house per player per city; none in Roma. A brick city costs 1 food; other cities cost 1 brick and 1 of that city’s good. Coin costs are 1/2/3/4/5 for brick/food/tool/wine/cloth, multiplied by the total houses in the city after building.
· Prefect: Choose an active province, receive one bonus good, produce one good per house there for every owner, and flip the marker to coins. Alternatively collect all visible coins and reactivate those markers. Cloth markers show 1 coin, all other goods 2. Praefectus Magnus must double the province bonus when its owner produces, then passes to the player on the right. House production is unchanged. Collecting coins neither doubles the coins nor passes Magnus.
· Mercator: Gain 3 coins with a starting Mercator or 5 with a purchased one, then buy and/or sell up to two types of goods in any quantity your cash and space permit. Fixed prices for brick/food/tool/wine/cloth are 3/4/5/6/7.
· Senator: Buy up to 2 market cards, paying their printed costs plus the original slot surcharge. The seven surcharges are none, any good, any good, cloth, cloth, any good plus cloth, and 2 cloth. Shift and refill only after both purchases. Consul buys one card without a slot surcharge.
· Diplomat: Copy another player’s top discard action, excluding Diplomat and Tribune. Your own top discard remains the Diplomat.
· Colonist: Pay 1 food and 1 tool per new land or sea colonist, deploying from storage to Roma or a city with your house. Alternatively gain 5 coins plus 1 for each of your colonists already on the map.
· Tribune: Recover all discards, including this card, and gain 1 coin for each recovered card beyond the third. You may also pay 1 food and 1 tool to deploy one colonist from storage into Roma.
· Mason, Farmer, Smith, Vintner, Weaver: Produce one good at each of your houses in the corresponding brick, food, tool, wine or cloth city.
Storehouse:
Each good and each undeployed colonist occupies one of 12 spaces. You may not discard existing goods. If production exceeds free space, choose which new goods to receive, filling all free spaces. Goods and coins are unlimited; colonists are limited to 6 per player. Players cannot trade with each other.
Ending and scoring:
The first player to build a 15th house or buy the last remaining card receives the 7-point Concordia bonus. Every other player gets one final turn, then scores every card in hand and discard by its god:
· Vesta: 1 point per full 10 coins of cash plus the market value of stored goods.
· Jupiter: 1 point per house in a non-brick city.
· Saturnus: 1 point per province containing your house.
· Mercurius: 2 points per good type produced by your houses.
· Mars: 2 points per colonist on the map.
· Minerva: 3 points per matching brick, food or tool house; 4 per wine house; 5 per cloth house.
Most points wins. Ties favour the holder of Praefectus Magnus, then the first tied player who would receive it when passing to the right.
Intermediate scoring (optional, off by default):
After each player’s first Tribune recovery, record their current score. Once everyone has done so, first place receives 2 coins and second place 1 coin; tied players at a position receive the same reward. These scores do not carry into final scoring.

zh.name: 绿茵反击
zh.desc: 二人足球对决:组建球队、排兵布阵,用传球、过人、头球与射门攻破对方球门
zh.rules:
目标:上下两个半场进球多者获胜;平局即平局,无加时。
准备:
· 组建 16 人球队(1 名门将、15 名外场球员):可直接用预设两队。
· 或轮流选秀:共 8 轮,每轮亮出 4 名球员,双方轮流挑选。
· 双方各自在己方半场布置首发 11 人,确认后中圈开球。
流程(持球方每次行动四选一):
· 移动阶段:攻方动 4 人 → 守方动 5 人 → 攻方再动 2 人;每人至多移动其速度格数。
· 传球:标准传球至多 11 格;一脚传球至多 6 格(须刚接到球)。
· 高球 15 格内瞄准队友头顶;长传不限距离。
· 高球与长传需精度判定(长传属性+骰:高球 ≥8,长传 ≥9),失败则落点变成松球。
· 传球与射门路线上的防守者会自动尝试拦截。
· 射门:距球门 11 格内或禁区内;射门+骰 对 门将扑救+骰;骰出 1 直接打飞。
· 禁区外射门、抢点射门、刁钻角度各减 1 点,合计至多减 2 点。
对抗:
· 带球者进入防守者邻格会被自动抢断:骰出 6 或 抢断+骰 ≥10 即丢球。
· 带球可穿过对方球员脚下(穿裆):耗 2 格速度,对方抢断判定加 1。
· 守方移动阶段可铲球(抢断+骰 对 盘带+骰);背后铲球骰出 1-2 即犯规。
· 犯规可能致伤(全属性减 1)并吃牌:骰 ≥ 裁判宽容度出牌,两黄变一红罚下。
· 禁区内犯规判点球;攻方也可放弃定位球,选择继续比赛。
定位球(任意球/角球):
· 双方交替摆放球员,任意球顺序为攻 2、守 2、攻 2、守 2、攻 3、守 2。
· 角球攻守交替,每次各摆 2 人,共 6 次。
· 每次摆放均可跳过;摆放时也可进行换人,一次换人占一个摆放名额。
· 任意球摆完由球旁球员短传、高球、长传或直接射门;角球可高球传中(落点必争顶)或低平球。
· 点球自动摆位,非主罚球员退出禁区;门将扑救减 2。
其他死球:
· 高球落点 2 格内,双方各至多 2 人争顶(头球+骰);攻方可顶传、顶射或停球。
· 界外球由攻方选一人掷出 ≤6 格:掷向脚下可直接接球,掷向头顶按高球争顶;掷出前攻方可先移动至多 2 人。
· 球门球由门将在小禁区开出:标准传球或高球长传(不得直入对方进攻三区)。
· 门将得球后三选一:手抛、大脚开出,或放在脚下继续比赛。
· 进球后双方自动回到各自确认的阵型,失球方中圈开球。
结束:每半场有行动数预算(默认 20 次,可选 12/30),用尽即半场结束;全场结束比进球数。

en.name: Counter Attack
en.desc: A two-player football duel: build a squad, set your formation, and score with passing, dribbling, headers and shots
en.rules:
Goal: score more goals than your opponent over two halves; a draw stands, no extra time.
Setup:
· Build a 16-player squad (1 goalkeeper, 15 outfield players), or use the preset squads.
· Draft mode: 8 rounds, 4 players revealed each round, taking turns to pick.
· Both sides arrange their starting 11 on their own half, then confirm to kick off at the center.
Play (on each action the team in possession chooses one):
· Movement phase: attack moves 4 players → defense moves 5 → attack moves 2 more; each up to its Pace.
· Pass: standard pass up to 11 hexes; first-time pass up to 6 hexes (must have just received the ball).
· High ball: within 15 onto a teammate; long ball: unlimited range.
· High and long balls need an accuracy check (High Pass + die: high ≥8, long ≥9); failure turns the landing spot into a loose ball.
· Defenders along a pass or shot path automatically attempt to intercept.
· Shoot: within 11 hexes of goal or inside the box; Shooting + die vs the keeper's Saving + die; a die roll of 1 blasts off target.
· Shots from outside the box, snapshots and difficult angles each cost 1 point, capped at 2.
Duels:
· Entering a defender's adjacent hex triggers an automatic steal: a die of 6 or Tackling + die ≥10 wins the ball.
· The carrier may dribble through an opponent's hex (nutmeg): costs 2 Pace and gives the defender a 1-point bonus.
· In the defense step the defense may tackle (Tackling + die vs Dribbling + die); tackling from behind fouls on a die of 1-2.
· Fouls may injure (all attributes reduced by 1) and draw cards: a die ≥ the referee's Leniency books the player; two yellows make a red.
· A foul inside the box is a penalty; the attack may instead waive the set piece and play on.
Set pieces (free kick / corner):
· Both sides take turns placing players; free kick order: A2, D2, A2, D2, A3, D2.
· Corners: 2 players each, alternating, 6 turns in total.
· Each placement turn can be skipped; a substitution may be made while placing and costs one placement slot.
· After a free kick the player by the ball plays a short pass, high ball, long ball or direct shot; a corner is crossed (always contested) or played low.
· Penalties are set up automatically with non-takers moved out of the box; the keeper saves at a 2-point penalty.
Other restarts:
· Up to 2 players per side within 2 hexes of a high ball's landing spot contest the header (Heading + die); the attack may head-pass, head at goal or control.
· Throw-ins: the attack picks a thrower for up to 6 hexes — to the feet is receivable, to the head is contested; the attack may first move up to 2 players.
· Goal kicks: the keeper plays from the six-yard box — a standard pass or a high/long kick (not into the opposing final third).
· With the ball the keeper chooses one of three: throw out, kick long, or drop to feet and play on.
· After a goal both sides return to their confirmed formations; the conceding side kicks off at the center.
End: each half has an action budget (20 by default, or 12/30); when it runs out the half ends, and goals decide the match.

zh.name: 诡影寻踪
zh.desc: 每人一条秘密线索,推理神秘生物的唯一栖息地
zh.rules:
目标:率先综合所有人的线索,找到神秘生物唯一的栖息地。
准备:版图由 6 块板块随机拼成;每位玩家秘密获得一条关于栖息地的线索(仅自己可见),所有人线索的交集只有 1 格。
初始放置:
· 从起始玩家开始顺时针,每人轮流把自己的 2 个方块放到「按自己线索不可能是栖息地」的格子,每次 1 个,共 2 轮。
流程(每回合二选一):
· 问人:任选 1 个没有方块的格子,指定 1 名其他玩家。
· 系统按对方线索自动作答:可能是栖息地则放对方的圆片,不可能则放对方的方块。
· 若对方放了方块,你必须再把自己的 1 个方块放到按你线索不可能是栖息地的格子。
· 搜索:选 1 个按你线索可能是栖息地且没有方块的格子,先放上自己的圆片。
· 其余玩家从你左手边开始依次自动作答:全部放圆片则你直接获胜;一旦有人放方块,搜索中止,你同样须再放 1 个自己的方块。
约束:
· 有方块的格子不能再放任何标记,也不能再问人或搜索。
· 同一格子不能放自己的第二个标记;圆片可以多人叠放。
· 任何时刻都可给格子做私人笔记(✓/✗/?),仅自己可见。
结束:有人搜索成功即获胜,终局揭示所有人的线索与栖息地。
线索一览(距离均含所在格本身):
· 在两种地形之一上(如「在森林或沼泽上」)。
· 距某种地形 1 格以内;距熊或狮的领地 1 格以内。
· 距立石或棚屋 2 格以内;距熊或狮的领地 2 格以内。
· 距某种颜色的结构物 3 格以内。
· 进阶模式另含以上全部线索的否定式。

en.name: Cryptid
en.desc: One secret clue each — deduce the creature’s only habitat
en.rules:
Goal: be the first to locate the creature’s only possible habitat by combining everyone’s clues.
Setup: the board is assembled from 6 random map tiles; each player secretly receives one clue about the habitat (visible only to you). The intersection of all clues is exactly one space.
Opening:
· Starting with the first player and going clockwise, each player takes turns placing their 2 cubes on spaces that CANNOT be the habitat according to their own clue, one at a time, for 2 rounds.
Play (each turn, choose one):
· Question: pick any space without a cube and name another player.
· The system answers by their clue: their disc if the habitat could be there, their cube if not.
· If they placed a cube, you must also place one of your cubes on a space that cannot be the habitat by your clue.
· Search: pick a space that could be the habitat by your clue and has no cube; place your disc there first.
· Every other player answers clockwise from your left: if everyone places a disc, you win; as soon as anyone places a cube the search stops, and you must place one of your cubes too.
Constraints:
· A space with a cube cannot take any more pieces and cannot be questioned or searched.
· You can never have two of your own pieces on one space; discs of different players may stack.
· At any time you may mark spaces with private notes (✓/✗/?), visible only to you.
End: a successful search wins the game; all clues and the habitat are then revealed.
Clue list (distances include the element’s own space):
· On one of two terrain types (e.g. “on forest or swamp”).
· Within 1 space of a terrain type; within 1 space of bear or cougar territory.
· Within 2 spaces of a standing stone or a shack; within 2 spaces of bear or cougar territory.
· Within 3 spaces of a structure of one colour.
· Advanced mode adds the negation of every clue above.

zh.name: 百变英雄
zh.desc: 叠加装备改变英雄，抢先出完手牌
zh.rules:
目标：先拥有至少 10 胜利点，再成为某轮第一个出完手牌的人。该轮第一名奖励不能用于立即获胜。
准备：
每个点数 1–10 取与人数相等的角色卡；双人改用每值 3 张。每人 1 胜利点、2 能量、1 张升华、1 张科多拉和 1 张随机升级；双人随机升级为 3 张。每轮洗匀全部角色卡，每人发 10 张，双人发 15 张；卡上的升级永久保留。
准备阶段可以安装科多拉，支付 2 胜利点，将该角色置于手牌外押注，本轮不能打出。每张科多拉可单独押注。准备后开始出牌。
出牌：
领出者打出任意张同值牌。其余玩家依次打出张数相同、点数相等或更大的同值牌组，或过牌。原双人局必须严格大于。过牌后仍可再次参与；多人局同值接牌跳过下一位尚未出完的玩家。被跳过者之后仍可参与。
当连续过牌或跳过使行动回到最后出牌者时，牌墩结束，由其领出新牌墩；若其已出完，则由左侧下一位未出完者领出。只剩一人有手牌时，本轮结束。
升级：
自己回合出牌前，可免费把任意库存升级永久装入手牌。每张卡最多容纳光环、左手、右手、伙伴各一张。光环重设基础点数，左右手修正点数，最终可以为零或负数。升级不能移除；下轮重新发牌，可能换人持有。
伙伴能力：
· 燃火兔（Burny）：支付 1 能量，该卡计为两张。
· 利刃兽（Edge）：支付 1 能量，作为同组其他牌点数的百搭；必须至少有一张固定点数牌，不能全是百搭。
· 恶灵球（Spector）：支付 1 能量，若这组牌最终赢得牌墩，每张已发动的恶灵球获得 1 胜利点；被压过则无奖励。
· 小魅灵（Charmy）：支付 1 能量，合法打出后反转当前牌墩的大小比较方向；双人仍不允许同值接牌。牌墩结束后恢复递增。
· 升华（Ascended Form）：支付 2 能量，必须单张打出，可以压任何普通牌组；之后只能接另一张已发动的升华。多人局升华接升华仍跳过下家，原双人局不跳过。
· 科多拉（Kodora）：准备阶段押注。若第一出完，收回押注的 2 胜利点并额外获得 2 胜利点，再检查获胜门槛；否则押注丢失。押注牌下轮重新洗回。
带伙伴能力的卡不发动能力打出时，每张获得 1 能量；这些能量不能用于同一组其他牌的发动费用。自己回合可用 4 能量换 1 胜利点；回合末或名次结算后超过 6 能量时，选择兑换若干次后将剩余能量减至 6。
名次奖励：
下列每项依次为“胜利点／能量／随机升级”，按第一至末名排列：
2 人：4／0／2；−1／1／2。
3 人：5／0／1；2／1／2；−1／2／3。
4 人：5／0／1；3／1／2；1／2／2；−1／2／3。
5 人：5／0／1；3／1／2；2／1／2；1／2／2；−1／2／3。
6 人：5／0／1；4／1／1；3／1／2；2／2／2；1／2／3；−1／3／3。
出完时立即领取名次奖励；积分最低为零。末名结算后若仍有至少 10 胜利点，降至 9。升级袋耗尽时只抽剩余卡。下一轮由本轮末名先手。
结束：
六轮后仍无人正常获胜，若第六轮第一名的积分独占最高，其立即获胜。否则第六轮第一名与所有积分最高者进入第七轮决赛，由这些人中第六轮名次最差者先手。洗匀全部牌库，原双人每人发 15 张，原多人发 10 张，余牌不公开；仍使用原游戏人数对应的同值规则。决赛第一位出完者获胜，不要求积分门槛。

en.name: Custom Heroes
en.desc: Craft evolving heroes and race to empty your hand
en.rules:
Goal: Have at least 10 victory points, then be the first to empty your hand in a round. That round’s placement reward cannot satisfy this requirement.
Setup:
Use one set of values 1–10 per player; with two players use three sets. Each player starts with 1 VP, 2 power, an Ascended Form, a Kodora and one random advancement (three random advancements with two players). Shuffle all character cards each round, keeping all sleeved advancements attached. Deal ten cards each, or fifteen in an originally two-player game.
During upkeep, you may sleeve Kodora and wager 2 VP per Kodora, setting those characters aside for the round. Then everyone confirms readiness.
Play:
The leader plays any number of cards of one value. Each following player plays the same number of matching cards with an equal or higher value, or passes. Originally two-player games require a strictly higher value. Passing does not prevent playing later. In multiplayer games, matching the previous value skips the next unfinished player; they may participate later.
When consecutive passes or skips return to the last player who played, that player wins the trick and leads again. If they have finished, the next unfinished player to their left leads. The round ends when only one player has cards.
Crafting:
At the start of your turn, before playing, freely sleeve advancements from your inventory into cards in your hand. Each card may have one aura, left-hand item, right-hand item and buddy. An aura replaces the base value; items modify it. Values can be zero or negative. Advancements cannot be removed, and the card may be dealt to someone else next round.
Abilities:
· Burny: Pay 1 power for this card to count as two cards.
· Edge: Pay 1 power to match another fixed-value card in the set. At least one card must have a fixed value; an entirely wild set is illegal.
· Spector: Pay 1 power; if this play wins the trick, gain 1 VP per activated Spector. Being beaten gives no reward.
· Charmy: Pay 1 power. After a legal play, reverse the comparison direction for this trick. Two-player games still require unequal values. The next trick returns to ascending.
· Ascended Form: Pay 2 power and play it alone to beat any ordinary set. Only another activated Ascended Form can follow. Ascended-on-Ascended skips in multiplayer, but not in an originally two-player game.
· Kodora: Wager 2 VP during upkeep and set the card aside. If you finish first, recover the wager and gain 2 additional VP before checking victory. Otherwise lose the wager. The card returns to the deck next round.
Playing a card with an unused ability gains 1 power per card, after paying all activation costs. This new power cannot pay for other abilities in the same play. On your turn, trade 4 power for 1 VP. At the end of a turn or placement scoring, if you exceed 6 power, choose exchanges and discard any remaining excess down to 6.
Placement:
Each entry is VP / power / random advancements, from first to last:
2 players: 4/0/2; −1/1/2.
3 players: 5/0/1; 2/1/2; −1/2/3.
4 players: 5/0/1; 3/1/2; 1/2/2; −1/2/3.
5 players: 5/0/1; 3/1/2; 2/1/2; 1/2/2; −1/2/3.
6 players: 5/0/1; 4/1/1; 3/1/2; 2/2/2; 1/2/3; −1/3/3.
Claim your reward immediately on finishing. VP cannot fall below zero. If last place still has at least 10 VP after scoring, reset to 9. Draw only the advancements remaining if the bag runs out. Last place leads the next round.
Ending:
If nobody wins normally after six rounds and the sixth-round winner has uniquely the most VP, they win. Otherwise that winner and everyone tied for most VP enter a seventh-round final, led by the qualifier who placed worst in round six. Shuffle the entire deck; deal fifteen each in an originally two-player game, otherwise ten. Keep unused cards hidden and retain the original game’s equal-value rule. The first player to empty their hand wins, regardless of VP.

zh.name: DECKO
zh.desc: 扑克×卡组构筑:下注抢底池,买牌改牌组,王牌各显神通
zh.rules:
目标:十二轮结束后,持有筹码最多的玩家获胜。
· 若有玩家率先达到 60 枚筹码(五人局为 70 枚),游戏立即结束。
准备:
· 每名玩家获得 20 枚筹码、十四张相同的起始牌,以及两次借贷额度。
· 每次借贷立即获得 10 枚筹码,终局结算时每次扣除 5 枚。
流程:每一轮按顺序进行以下阶段
· 起始注:奖池放入本轮的最小注,担任盲位的玩家同时下最小注。
· 发牌:从自己的抽牌堆抽取五张牌;抽牌堆抽空时,将弃牌堆洗回作为新的抽牌堆。
· 下注:从盲位左手边的玩家开始轮流行动,选择加注、跟注或弃牌。
· 每轮首次行动前,可以烧毁一张手牌并补抽一张。
· 摊牌:未弃牌的玩家必须用手牌组成所能达到的最高牌型,牌型最大者赢走全部下注与奖池。
· 购买:本轮未获胜也未弃牌的玩家按牌型获得 $0 至 $9 的资金。
· 资金可用于购买市场牌、特殊行动与王牌。
牌型:从大到小依次为皇家同花顺、同花顺、四条、同花、顺子、葫芦、三条、两对、一对、高牌。
· 葫芦在同花和顺子之下;比较牌型时不使用踢脚,完全相同的牌型平分底池。
· 弃牌的玩家可以免费拿取一张市场牌;手牌上限为七张,牌组下限为七张。
特殊规则:
· 第四轮和第八轮是万能牌回合,当轮启用一张影响全场的规则变体。
· 市场牌和王牌各带有特殊能力;王牌分为六种,只能在对应的行动时机使用。
终局结算:先偿还全部借贷,之后筹码最多的玩家获胜;筹码相同时抽牌比较大小。

en.name: DECKO
en.desc: Poker hands meet deck-building: bet, buy, and bend the rules with jokers
en.rules:
Goal: after 12 rounds, the player with the most chips wins.
· If any player reaches 60 chips (70 in a 5-player game), the game ends immediately.
Setup:
· Each player receives 20 chips, an identical 14-card starting deck, and two loan markers.
· Each loan grants 10 chips immediately and costs 5 chips at the end of the game.
Play: each round proceeds through the following phases in order
· Ante: the house pot receives the minimum bet, and the blind player bets the same amount.
· Deal: draw five cards from your own deck; when it runs out, shuffle your discard pile to form a new deck.
· Betting: starting with the player to the left of the blind, take turns raising, calling, or folding.
· Before your first action each round, you may burn one card from your hand to draw one.
· Showdown: players who have not folded must form the highest set their hand allows; the highest set wins all bets and the pot.
· Buy: players who neither won nor folded receive $0 to $9 according to their set rank.
· The money can be spent on market cards, special actions, and jokers.
Sets: from strongest to weakest — royal flush, straight flush, four of a kind, flush, straight, full house, three of a kind, two pair, one pair, high card.
· A full house ranks below a flush and a straight; there are no kickers, and identical sets split the pot.
· A player who folds takes one market card for free; the hand limit is seven cards and the deck minimum is seven.
Special rules:
· Rounds 4 and 8 are wildcard rounds, each activating a table-wide rules twist.
· Market cards and jokers carry their own abilities; jokers come in six types, each usable only at its matching timing.
Final scoring: repay all loans first, then the player with the most chips wins; ties are broken by drawing cards.

zh.name: 谍报风云
zh.desc: 两队密码战:给队友加密,破译截对手
zh.rules:
目标:先集齐 2 个拦截指示物的队伍获胜;集齐 2 个错误传讯指示物的队伍落败。
准备:
· 全员分成白队与黑队,每队至少 2 人。
· 每队各持有 4 个关键词(编号 ①-④),只有本队成员能看到。
流程:
· 每轮两队各由一名加密者(按队内顺序轮换)秘密抽取一个三位密码:1-4 中 3 个不重复数字的排列,并依次写下 3 条提示。
· 白队提示先公布:白队解读自家密码,黑队同时尝试拦截;双方锁定答案后揭晓。
· 随后公布黑队提示,黑队解读、白队拦截,同样结算。
· 第一轮双方不能拦截,但仍要解读自家密码。
· 一轮结束检查胜负;未分胜负则进入下一轮,最多 8 轮。
计分:
· 本队解读错误:本队获得 1 个错误传讯指示物。
· 拦截对方成功:本队获得 1 个拦截指示物;两者可在同一半场同时发生。
提示规范:
· 提示必须与关键词含义相关;不能包含关键词本身,不能与已公布过的提示重复。
· 不能借发音、字数、位置等游戏外信息提示;提示公布后不能修改。
平局:
· 双方同时达成胜负条件,或 8 轮结束未分胜负:按「拦截数减错误数」计分,高者胜。
· 仍平:双方各猜对方 4 个关键词,命中多者胜;再平则共享胜利。

en.name: Decrypto
en.desc: Team code war: clue your side, crack theirs
en.rules:
Goal: the first team to collect 2 Interception tokens wins; a team with 2 Miscommunication tokens loses.
Setup:
· Split into White and Black teams, at least 2 players each.
· Each team holds 4 keywords (①-④), visible only to teammates.
Play:
· Each round, one Encryptor per team (rotating in seat order) secretly draws a 3-digit code — a permutation of 1-4 — and writes 3 clues in order.
· White clues are revealed first: White decodes their own code while Black tries to intercept; both lock in answers, then the code is revealed.
· Then Black clues are revealed; Black decodes and White intercepts.
· In round 1 neither team may intercept, but you still decode your own code.
· Win/loss is checked at the end of each round; at most 8 rounds.
Scoring:
· Decode your own code wrong: your team takes 1 Miscommunication token.
· Intercept the enemy code: your team takes 1 Interception token; both can happen in the same half-round.
Clue rules:
· Clues must relate to the keyword's meaning; never contain the keyword itself, never repeat a clue already given.
· No hints via sounds, word length or positions; clues cannot be changed once revealed.
Tiebreak:
· If both teams trigger a win/loss condition at once, or 8 rounds pass: score = interceptions minus miscommunications, higher wins.
· Still tied: each team guesses the enemy's 4 keywords; most hits wins; still tied, the victory is shared.

zh.name: 深海任务
zh.desc: 协力吃墩:各自领任务,沉默配合完成全船目标
zh.rules:
目标:全队合作,每人认领自己的任务卡并在打墩中完成它;任何一张任务失败,全船失败。
牌:
· 四种花色各 1~9,另有潜艇(将牌)1~4。
· 必须跟花色;潜艇大于所有花色牌,潜艇之间数字大者胜。
准备:
· 持有潜艇 4 的人是船长:先领任务,开第一墩。
· 按卡背点数凑齐本关总点数后,从船长开始依次认领;与船长比墩数的任务,船长不能领。
声呐沟通:
· 每两墩之间,每人可用一次声呐:亮出一张花色牌,并标注「最高 / 唯一 / 最低」,表明它在你手中该花色里的地位。
· 打出该牌后,展示撤下。
电子版公开信息:
· 每人已吃的牌全程展示,按花色与点数排序;未出的手牌仍保密。
胜负:
· 全员任务完成即过关,可挑战下一难度(任务点数加 1)。
· 失败可带同一批任务重试,或换一批重抽。

en.name: The Crew: Deep Sea
en.desc: Co-op trick-taking: claim tasks and fulfil them together in silence
en.rules:
Goal: cooperate — everyone claims task cards and fulfils them during tricks; a single failed task sinks the whole crew.
Cards:
· Four suits of 1–9, plus submarines (trump) 1–4.
· You must follow suit; submarines outrank every suited card, and among submarines the higher number wins.
Setup:
· The holder of submarine 4 is the captain: claims a task first and leads the first trick.
· Tasks are dealt until their point values reach the mission total, then claimed in order starting from the captain; the captain cannot take a task that compares against the captain.
Radio (sonar):
· Once between tricks, each player may radio: reveal a suit card and tag it “highest / only / lowest” for that suit in your hand.
· The reveal clears once that card is played.
Digital edition:
· Everyone’s captured cards stay visible, sorted by suit and number; unplayed hands remain secret.
Result:
· All tasks completed = mission passed, and the next difficulty awaits (task points increase by 1).
· On failure, retry with the same tasks or redraw a new set.

zh.name: 王权骰铸
zh.desc: 七位英雄，以专属骰子、技能和战术手牌展开双人决斗。
zh.rules:
目标：
将对手的生命降至0；同一结算双方均降至0时平局。
准备：
