Components include 48 region cards, 14 events and 12 Skies Darken cards; only the prescribed subset of events and Skies Darken cards enters each game.
Turn:
Take up to 4 actions with one character and up to 1 with the other, in either order, without returning to a character after switching. Solo play gives the rotating character 4 actions and Frodo 1. Then draw two player cards together, fully resolve each Skies Darken card, reduce hands to 7, and resolve shadow cards one at a time equal to the current threat rate.
Actions:
· Travel: Move along one path or battle line, paying special path costs. Bring any local friendly troops and consenting characters. If Frodo travels, the initiating player also spends 1 stealth or rolls a search at the destination.
· Fellowship: With consent, give or take one region card matching your current region to or from another player at your location. Tokens cannot be traded.
· Prepare: At a haven, discard a region card for its matching token. Solo play also requires the card to match your region.
· Muster: At a friendly colored location, spend 1 friendship to add one matching troop.
· Attack: With both friendly and shadow troops present, shift the Eye to your region and roll 1–3 battle dice, no more than the friendly troops present.
· Capture: With a friendly troop and no shadow troops present, spend 3 valor to turn a shadow stronghold into a haven, shift the Eye there and gain 2 hope. Objectives and characters may change these conditions.
Battles and searches:
Rout removes one shadow troop; exchange removes one from each side; overrun removes one friendly troop except at havens; Nazgul removes two friendly troops if a Nazgul is in the region. Present characters may spend resistance to reroll dice or valor to remove one additional shadow troop each. Search dice equal Nazgul in Frodo’s region plus shadow troops at his location, capped at 7. Weary loses 1 hope; exposed loses 1 except at a haven; recall sends one Nazgul from the region to Mordor; slip by does nothing. Present characters may spend resistance to reroll; Sam may spend friendship to ignore weary or exposed. Before a search Frodo may put on the Ring: lose 1 hope, move the Eye there, and ignore local shadow troops, but not Nazgul.
Shadow:
Skies Darken raises threat one space; lose 2 hope if the Eye is already in Frodo’s region, otherwise move it there; add 3 shadow troops to the indicated location and battle; shuffle the shadow discard onto its deck. After drawing a shadow card inspect the new top card’s back: red resolves the upper advance section; black resolves the lower reinforce section and order. Advance moves all shadow troops on that line once, with troops at its endpoint staying, then battles from front to back. Reinforce adds one shadow troop and battles, then moves the Eye or Nazgul. A haven occupied by shadow troops without friendly troops falls, losing 3 hope. Each missing shadow troop or undrawable player card loses 1 hope.
Events, abilities and ending:
Ordinary events and anytime abilities may be used between actions and shadow cards, never during a battle, search, or another card’s full resolution. Tom Bombadil may be used after a roll. Full character, event and objective details are available during play. Once every other objective is complete, Frodo at Mount Doom spends 5 resistance and rolls a final search, adding one die per missing hope, still capped at 7. Survive to win together.

search.py: mo jie ming yun tong meng

zh.name: 快餐连锁大亨
zh.desc: 招聘员工、培训晋升、营销造势、开店抢客:最狠的快餐资本局
zh.rules:
目标:银行第二次破产后的晚餐结束时,现金最多者胜。
每回合 7 阶段:
· 重组——把员工安排进组织架构,受 CEO 槽位限制,经理只管一层。
· 定序——上岗卡少者先选回合顺序。
· 工作——按顺序执行员工行动:招聘(CEO 免费 1 次)、培训(换高级卡)。
· 工作还包括:营销(制造需求)、生产与采购(备货)、建房、开餐厅。
· 晚餐——按房屋编号结算:能供全部需求且「单价+距离」最小的连锁店成交。
· 晚餐平局先比女侍数量,再比回合顺序;花园房单价翻倍;CFO 收入增加 50%。
· 发薪——每张带工资图标的卡付 $5,可先解雇。
· 营销——进行中的营销按板号升序给覆盖房屋加需求。
· 清理——未售食饮丢弃,冷冻柜最多存 10 件。
里程碑:首个达成某项的玩家获得永久增益,同回合达成者都有份。
银行第一次破产:翻开储备卡补充银行,并投票决定 CEO 槽位数。

en.name: Food Chain Magnate
en.desc: Hire, train, market, and open restaurants: the cutthroat fast-food capitalism game
en.rules:
Goal: when dinnertime ends after the bank breaks for the second time, most cash wins.
Each round has 7 phases:
· Restructuring — assign staff into your org, limited by CEO slots; managers report only to the CEO.
· Order of Business — fewest staffed cards picks turn order first.
· Working — in turn order, run your staff: recruit (CEO hires 1 free), train (swap into better cards).
· Working also covers: market (create demand), produce and buy drinks (stock up), build houses, open restaurants.
· Dinnertime — resolve houses by number: the chain that can fulfill all demand at the lowest price+distance sells.
· Dinner ties go to more waitresses, then turn order; gardens double unit price; the CFO adds 50% revenue.
· Payday — pay $5 per card with a salary icon; you may fire first.
· Marketing — running campaigns add demand to covered houses in ascending tile order.
· Cleanup — unsold food and drinks are discarded; the freezer keeps up to 10.
Milestones: the first player to achieve each gets a permanent bonus; everyone achieving it the same round gets it too.
First bank break: reveal reserve cards to refill the bank and vote on CEO slots.

search.py: kuai can lian suo da heng

zh.name: 魔戒同盟
zh.desc: 合作吃墩:扮演远征队角色,各自达成目标护送魔戒
zh.rules:
目标:全队合作打墩,每名角色完成自己的目标;全部达成则章节胜利,任一目标失败则全队失败,可重试。
牌:
· 丘陵、山脉、暗影、森林各 1~8,另有魔戒 1~5。
· 必须跟花色;领出花色中点数最大者赢墩。
· 魔戒不是将牌:魔戒花色被打破前不能领出(手上只剩魔戒牌除外);任何人打出魔戒牌后即告打破。
· 至尊戒(魔戒 1):打出时可声明赢下本墩,无视花色与点数。
流程:
· 拿到至尊戒的玩家是持戒者,自动扮演弗罗多并领出第一墩。
· 其余玩家从持戒者左手边依次选择角色,带星标的角色必须全部有人扮演。
· 部分角色有准备动作:抽威胁牌、与其他角色交换手牌等。
章节:
· 短章一轮定胜负;长章进行多轮,已完成角色的进度保留,全部角色完成才通关。

en.name: Fellowship of the Ring
en.desc: Co-op trick-taking: play fellowship characters and fulfil every goal
en.rules:
Goal: cooperate through tricks — every character must complete their own goal; all goals met wins the chapter, any single failure loses the round (retry allowed).
Cards:
· Hills, Mountains, Shadows and Forests of 1–8, plus Rings 1–5.
· You must follow suit; the highest card of the led suit wins the trick.
· Rings are not trump: they cannot be led until the ring suit is broken (someone has played a ring), unless you hold only rings.
· The One Ring (Ring 1): when played, you may declare it to win any trick.
Flow:
· The player dealt the One Ring is the ring-bearer, plays Frodo and leads the first trick.
· Starting to the ring-bearer’s left, players pick characters in turn; every starred character must be picked.
· Some characters have setup steps: drawing threat cards, exchanging cards with others, and so on.
Chapters:
· Short chapters last one round; long chapters run several rounds and keep completed characters — finish them all to clear the chapter.

zh.name: 绝命少女:恐怖快乐小径
zh.desc: 单人恐怖生存:扮演最后的少女,救出营员并反杀屠夫
zh.rules:
目标:扮演最后的少女,救出营员并杀死屠夫汉斯;少女死亡则失败。
准备:屠夫与受害者按设置卡落位;你获得 6 张零费行动卡作起手牌。
回合流程:
· 行动:打出行动卡并掷骰判定;走动每格消耗 1 点时间。
· 计划:用剩余时间购买新行动卡,然后时间重置为 6 点。
· 杀手:屠夫锁定最近的目标、移动并攻击,再抽 1 张恐怖卡。
· 恐慌:本回合有受害者死亡时,杀手所在格的受害者掷骰逃跑。
· 维护:恐怖卡组抽空后揭示终章卡;可自由调配手持物品。
掷骰:5 与 6 算成功;3 与 4 可弃 2 张手牌转为成功。
救人:少女在出口格可救出同格的受害者;集满奖励格解锁终极能力。

en.name: Final Girl: Camp Happy Trails
en.desc: Solo horror survival: play the final girl, save the campers and slay the butcher
en.rules:
Goal: play the final girl, rescue campers and slay Hans the butcher; if the girl dies, you lose.
Setup: the killer and victims are placed by a setup card; you start with 6 zero-cost action cards.
Each round:
· Action: play action cards and roll to resolve them; walking costs 1 time per space.
· Planning: spend remaining time on new action cards, then time resets to 6.
· Killer: the butcher targets the closest victim or you, moves, attacks, then draws a terror card.
· Panic: if a victim died this turn, victims on the killer space roll to flee.
· Upkeep: reveal the finale once the terror deck runs out; rearrange held items freely.
Dice: 5 and 6 are successes; 3 and 4 can be converted by discarding 2 cards.
Rescue: on an exit space you may save victims with you; fill all reward slots to unlock the ultimate.

zh.name: 终极角斗场
zh.desc: 百位传说泰坦的骰子对决:选秀组队、暗置升级,一路守擂到最后
zh.rules:
游戏目标：
每人组建一支泰坦队伍，派出泰坦进行一对一战斗。失去全部泰坦的玩家被淘汰，最后留在游戏中的玩家获胜。
组建队伍：
· 从公开的 3 名候选泰坦中轮流招募，每次选择 1 名，随后补充候选。每人招募 3 名泰坦，放在自己的板凳上。
· 每人获得升级卡：两人局 5 张，三至五人局 4 张。
· 组队完成后，结算泰坦的“游戏开始时”能力。有目标需要选择时，按提示完成选择。
每场战斗的流程：
决定参战 → 准备升级 → 轮流战斗 → 结算胜负，然后开始下一场。
1. 决定参战：
轮到你时，选择以下一项：
· 参战：派出 1 名可用泰坦，并收回自己此前扣置的全部升级卡。场上第一名泰坦成为冠军，第二名成为挑战者。
· 跳过：从手牌扣置 1 张升级卡，本场不参战。该卡暂时不能使用，直到你之后参战时收回。
没有升级卡可扣置时，必须参战。若剩余可参战玩家必须全部上场才能凑齐两名参战者，也必须参战。
已有冠军留场时，只需选出一名挑战者；冠军无需再次决定是否参战。
2. 准备升级：
· 两名参战者分别选择任意数量的升级卡，也可以不打出。
· 双方确认准备后，同时揭示所选升级卡，结算揭示效果及“战斗开始时”能力。
· 升级卡通常只在本场战斗中生效，战斗结束后弃置。
· 速度较高的泰坦先行动；速度相同时，挑战者先行动。
3. 轮流战斗：
· 双方轮流进行回合。自己的回合开始时，先结算毒素、火焰和相关能力。
· 每回合通常行动 1 次，每枚行动标记再增加 1 次。一次行动通常是掷骰，并结算泰坦攻击表中对应骰面的效果。
· 额外行动必须用完，之后才轮到对手。需要选择骰子、能力或目标时，由提示指定的玩家完成选择。
骰面与终极技：
· 蓝、绿、黄、红：查看该泰坦攻击表中同色一栏，结算伤害和附加效果。同一种颜色对不同泰坦可能有不同作用。
· Charge（充能）：充能标记为灰暗面时，翻到彩色面，并立即再行动 1 次；已是彩色面时，发动终极技，再翻回灰暗面。这次不会因 Charge 额外获得行动。
· Miss（未命中）：通常没有效果，但仍可能触发卡牌上与 Miss 有关的能力。
· 终极形态：部分终极技会解锁强化能力，其效果见角色详情。终极形态与充能状态分别保留和变化。
伤害与常用效果：
· 力量：每枚使该泰坦每次造成的伤害增加 1 点；不会让原本不造成伤害的效果变成伤害。
· 护甲：每次受到伤害时，减少等同于护甲值的伤害，最低为 0。每枚护甲标记使护甲值增加 1。
· 闪避：将受到伤害时，必须消耗 1 枚，挡下本次全部伤害。
· 随从：只有当单次伤害足以击败自己时，才必须消耗 1 枚，挡下本次全部伤害。
· 毒素：自己的回合开始时，每枚造成 1 点伤害。
· 火焰：自己的回合开始时，每枚造成 1 点伤害，然后再增加 1 枚火焰标记。战斗结束后移除火焰。
· 毒素和火焰的伤害不受护甲、闪避或随从保护。
· 治疗：回复生命，不能超过生命上限。吸血：按对手实际失去的生命回复自己。
· 直接击败：使目标立即被击败，护甲、闪避和随从无法阻止。
祝福与诅咒：
· 持有祝福时，每次行动掷 2 枚骰，由自己选择其中 1 枚结算。
· 持有诅咒时，同样掷 2 枚骰，但由对手选择。
· 掷出相同骰面时，只结算一次，然后失去该标记。
· 同一种标记不能叠加。已持有其中一种时，再获得另一种，会抵消原有标记。
战斗结束与下一场：
· 击败对手的泰坦后，胜者抽 1 张升级卡，并以冠军身份留场。
· 冠军保留当前生命，不会自动回满；通常保留其他状态标记和终极形态，但移除火焰、弃置本场升级卡，并将充能翻回灰暗面。
· 双方同时被击败时，都没有胜利奖励，下一场重新选出两名参战者。
· 没有任何可用泰坦的玩家被淘汰，直到只剩一名玩家。
特殊能力：
卡牌有特殊说明时，以卡牌效果为准。“团队力量”在该泰坦位于场上或板凳时均可生效，具体作用见角色详情。

en.name: Final Titan
en.desc: A dice-rolling duel of a hundred legendary titans: draft your roster, set secret upgrades, and hold the belt
en.rules:
Goal:
Build a team of Titans and send them into one-on-one fights. A player who loses all their Titans is eliminated. The last player remaining wins.
Build your team:
· Take turns recruiting from 3 face-up candidates. Choose 1 Titan, then refill the candidates. Each player recruits 3 Titans and places them on their bench.
· Each player receives upgrade cards: 5 in a two-player game, or 4 with three to five players.
· After recruitment, resolve the Titans’ “Start of Game” abilities. Follow the prompts whenever an ability requires a target.
Fight overview:
Fight or skip → Prepare upgrades → Take turns → Resolve the result, then begin the next fight.
1. Fight or skip:
On your turn, choose one of these options:
· Fight: Send in 1 available Titan and take back all upgrade cards you previously set aside. The first Titan in the arena becomes the Champion; the second becomes the Challenger.
· Skip: Set aside 1 upgrade card from your hand face down and sit out this fight. That card is unavailable until you enter a later fight and take it back.
You must fight if you have no upgrade card to set aside. You must also fight if every remaining eligible player is needed to fill the two places in the arena.
If a Champion is already in the arena, only a Challenger needs to be chosen. The Champion does not choose whether to fight again.
2. Prepare upgrades:
· Both fighters choose any number of upgrade cards, including none.
· Once both confirm they are ready, reveal their chosen upgrades together. Resolve “When Revealed” effects and “Start of Fight” abilities.
· Upgrades normally last for this fight only and are discarded when it ends.
· The Titan with higher Speed takes the first turn. If tied, the Challenger goes first.
3. Take turns:
· Alternate taking turns. At the start of your turn, resolve Poison, Fire, and relevant abilities.
· You normally take 1 Action per turn, plus 1 for each Action token. An Action usually means rolling the die and resolving the matching entry on your Titan’s attack chart.
· You must use all available Actions before passing the turn. Whenever a die, ability, or target must be chosen, the player named in the prompt makes that choice.
Die and Ultimate:
· Blue, green, yellow, red: Find the matching color on your Titan’s attack chart and resolve its damage and additional effects. The same color can have different effects for different Titans.
· Charge: If your Charge token is gray, flip it to colored and immediately take 1 more Action. If it is already colored, use your Ultimate, then flip it back to gray. This second Charge does not grant an extra Action.
· Miss: Normally has no effect, but may still trigger card abilities that refer to a Miss.
· Ultimate Form: Some Ultimates unlock a stronger ability, described in Titan details. Ultimate Form and Charge are separate states.
Damage and effects:
· Power: Each token adds 1 to each instance of damage your Titan deals. It does not make an effect deal damage if it originally deals none.
· Armor: Reduce each instance of incoming damage by your Armor value, to a minimum of 0. Each Armor token increases that value by 1.
· Dodge: When you would take damage, you must spend 1 token to prevent all damage from that instance.
· Minion: Only when a single instance of damage would defeat you, you must spend 1 token to prevent all damage from that instance.
· Poison: At the start of your turn, take 1 damage per token.
· Fire: At the start of your turn, take 1 damage per token, then gain 1 more Fire token. Remove Fire when the fight ends.
· Armor, Dodge, and Minions do not protect against Poison or Fire damage.
· Heal: Restore life without exceeding your maximum. Drain: Heal yourself by the amount of life the foe actually loses.
· Defeat: Immediately defeat the target. Armor, Dodge, and Minions cannot prevent this effect.
Blessed and Cursed:
· With a Blessed token, roll 2 dice for each Action and choose 1 to resolve.
· With a Cursed token, also roll 2 dice, but the foe chooses which one resolves.
· If both dice show the same face, resolve it once, then lose the token.
· These tokens do not stack. If you have one type and would gain the other, lose the existing token instead.
After the fight:
· Defeat the foe’s Titan to win. Draw 1 upgrade card and stay in the arena as the Champion.
· Keep your current life; you do not automatically heal to full. Normally keep your other status tokens and Ultimate Form, but remove Fire, discard this fight’s upgrades, and flip Charge back to gray.
· If both Titans are defeated at the same time, neither player gains a victory reward. Choose two new fighters for the next fight.
· A player with no Titans remaining is eliminated. Continue until only one player remains.
Special abilities:
Specific card effects take precedence over the general rules. A Titan’s Team Power can apply while that Titan is in the arena or on the bench; see Titan details for its effect.

zh.name: 萌鼠摘月
zh.desc: 垃圾场小鼠造火箭:跑图采集攒建材,灯串鼠洞滚雪球,把四只鼠送上奶酪月亮
zh.rules:
目标:火箭完工前攒最多分。终局触发:有玩家第四只鼠进入火箭,本轮结束后完局。
或有玩家放下第八个计分标记,则本轮结束后再加一轮。
回合流程:
· 移动二选一:一只鼠前进一至五格;或二至四只鼠各前进一至三格,全部停在同色的不同格。
· 只能朝火箭方向走;自己的鼠不能同格,起点除外。
· 停入有其他玩家鼠的格,须付给该格每位玩家一奶酪。
· 无力支付则按差额拿取霉奶酪:每拿一个立即获得三奶酪,终局扣两分。
· 管道捷径:从入口格出发交出管身所示建材,一步直达出口格。
· 采集:本回合移动过的鼠按落格产出。
· 黄格获得奶酪,白格获得苹果核,蓝格获得灯泡,绿橙格获得所示建材。
· 采集数量为格面数字再加灯串加成。
· 灯泡驱动灯串标记前进;标记每到达或越过一盏灯泡,该灯泡对应的路径格以后采集加一,可叠加。
· 每越过一盏建筑灯,各计一次建筑灯轨。
· 苹果核驱动鼠洞标记顺时针走;到岔口选向上或向左。
· 经过图书馆旁免费获得一本漫画;经过育儿室旁养一只新鼠,全场最多两次;经过储食旁计一次储食轨。
· 购物:本回合停在摊位格的鼠可购一件。
· 仓鼠处六奶酪买背包,青蛙处七奶酪买能量饮料,疯鸦处十二奶酪买瓶盖。
· 也可免费偷一件,但该鼠回到起点。
· 建造:交两个计算器与一个铁罐建座舱;交三个苏打与两个铁罐建货舱。
· 交五个醋瓶与两个苏打建推进器。以上建造各计对应计分轨。
· 每集齐三件一套再计整箭轨。捐十奶酪计补给轨。次数不限。
· 发射台:鼠到达即成宇航员,占宇航员轨最左空格。
· 并二选一:获得一枚奖章(终局值三分),或从育儿室养一只鼠到起点。
· 若它并非第四只进入火箭的鼠,且此后场上已无可移动之鼠,则只能选养鼠。
物品:背包与漫画均从下个回合起生效。能量饮料在采集时使用,当次采集总量翻倍,每回合限一瓶。
瓶盖为终局加分。
计分:八条计分轨得分,加瓶盖得分,加奖章每个三分,减霉奶酪每个两分,加剩余建材与奶酪每四个一分。
平分则比宇航员数,再平则共享胜利。

en.name: First Rat
en.desc: Junkyard rats build a rocket: race, collect, light up the string, and fly four rats to the Cheese Moon
en.rules:
Goal: score the most before the rocket is done. The end is triggered when a player moves their fourth rat into the rocket; finish the current round.
Alternatively, when a player places their eighth score marker, finish the round and then play one more.
Each turn:
· Move, one of: advance one rat one to five spaces; or advance two to four rats one to three spaces each, all ending on different spaces of one color.
· Always move towards the rocket; your own rats may not share a space, except at Start.
· Ending on a space with other players' rats costs you one Cheese per player there.
· If you cannot pay, take Moldy Cheese for the shortfall: each gives three Cheese now, minus two points at the end.
· Pipes: from a pipe's entry space, hand in the depicted material to jump to its exit as a single step.
· Collect: rats moved this turn yield their landing space.
· Yellow gives Cheese, white Apple Cores, blue Lightbulbs, green and orange the depicted building material.
· The amount is the printed number plus the light string bonus.
· Lightbulbs advance your light string marker; every bulb it reaches or passes gives its path space a plus-one yield from now on, stacking.
· Passing each of the three construction lights scores the Construction Lights track once.
· Apple Cores advance your burrow marker clockwise; at each fork choose up or left.
· Passing the Library grants a free comic; passing the Nursery raises one new rat, at most twice per game; passing the Stored Food scores its track.
· Shopping: a rat that ended this turn on a booth space may buy one item.
· Six Cheese for a Backpack from the Hamster, seven for an Energy Drink from the Frog, twelve for a Bottle Cap from the Crow.
· Or steal one item for free, but that rat returns to Start.
· Build: pay two Calculators and one Tin Can for the Cockpit; three Soda and two Tin Cans for the Cargo Bay.
· Pay five Vinegar and two Soda for the Thruster. Each build scores the matching track.
· Each full set of all three parts also scores the Rocket track. Donate ten Cheese to score Provisions. No limits.
· Launchpad: a rat arriving becomes a Rattronaut on the leftmost free space of its track.
· Then choose: one Award worth three points, or raise one rat from the Nursery to Start.
· If it is not your fourth rat into the rocket, and no movable rats of yours would remain in play, you must raise.
Items: Backpacks and Comics take effect from your next turn. An Energy Drink doubles one collection, at most one per turn.
Bottle Caps score at the end.
Scoring: the eight tracks, plus Bottle Caps, plus three points per Award, minus two per Moldy Cheese, plus one point per four leftover building materials and Cheese.
Ties go to the most Rattronauts, then shared.

zh.name: 七翻天
zh.desc: 别翻到重复数字,集齐 7 张立赚 15 分
zh.rules:
目标:按轮累计得分,一轮结束后有玩家总分达到 200 且独居第一时游戏结束,总分最高者获胜。
准备:
· 牌堆共 94 张:数字牌 0 有一张。
· 数字牌 1 至 12 各有多少数字就有多少张(1 一张、2 两张……12 十二张)。
· 修正牌为加 2、加 4、加 6、加 8、加 10 与翻倍,各一张。
· 行动牌「冻结」「连翻三张」「第二次机会」各三张。
· 每轮先给每人发一张明牌;发到行动牌时立即结算,然后再继续发牌。
流程:
· 从发牌员左手边开始,轮流向每位活跃玩家发牌:轮到你时选择「要牌」再翻一张,或「停牌」。
· 停牌即锁定本轮得分并退出本轮;面前至少有一张牌才能停牌。
· 翻到与面前已有数字重复的数字牌即爆掉:本轮出局,获得 0 分。
· 集齐 7 张不同数字牌立即结束本轮,并额外获得 15 分(修正牌与行动牌不计入这 7 张)。
· 冻结:指定一名活跃玩家(可以是自己),其立即按停牌结算并退出本轮。
· 连翻三张:指定一名活跃玩家连续翻三张牌,爆掉或集齐 7 张即提前停止。
· 连翻期间翻出的冻结与连翻三张,在翻完后才结算。
· 第二次机会:抵消一次爆牌,弃掉它与那张重复数字牌;同时只能持有一张。
· 再次获得第二次机会须转赠其他活跃玩家,无人可赠则弃掉;一轮结束时一律弃掉。
计分:
· 先算数字牌总和,有翻倍牌则总和翻倍,再加修正牌分值,最后加 Flip 7 的 15 分奖励。
· 停牌与冻结都按上述方式保留得分;爆掉者本轮获得 0 分。
结束:
· 一轮结束后,若有玩家总分达到 200 且无人与其并列第一,游戏结束。
· 若并列第一则继续下一轮,直到出现唯一胜者。

en.name: Flip 7
en.desc: Don't flip a duplicate — collect 7 numbers for +15
en.rules:
Goal: scores accumulate over rounds. The game ends after a round in which a player reaches 200 points and holds the sole lead; the highest total wins.
Setup:
· The deck has 94 cards: a single 0 among the number cards.
· Number cards 1–12 each have as many copies as their number (one 1, two 2s … twelve 12s).
· Modifier cards: +2, +4, +6, +8, +10 and ×2, one each.
· Action cards: Freeze, Flip Three and Second Chance, three each.
· At the start of each round every player is dealt one face-up card; any action card dealt is resolved immediately before dealing continues.
Play:
· Starting from the dealer's left, each active player is offered a card in turn: choose Hit to flip another card, or Stay.
· Staying banks your round score and leaves the round; you need at least one card in front of you to Stay.
· Flipping a number you already have in front of you is a bust: you're out of the round and score 0.
· Collecting 7 different number cards ends the round immediately and scores +15 (modifier and action cards don't count toward the 7).
· Freeze: pick an active player (maybe yourself); they bank their score and leave the round at once.
· Flip Three: pick an active player who must flip three cards in a row, stopping early on a bust or a Flip 7.
· Freeze and Flip Three cards revealed along the way resolve only after all three flips.
· Second Chance: cancels one bust — discard it together with the duplicate number card. You may hold only one at a time.
· A second Second Chance must be passed to another active player, or discarded if nobody can take it; all unused ones are discarded at the end of the round.
Scoring:
· Add up your number cards, double the sum if you have the ×2 card, then add any modifier cards, and finally the +15 Flip 7 bonus.
· Staying and being frozen both keep this score; busting scores 0 for the round.
End:
· After a round, if any player has 200 or more points with no tie for first place, the game ends.
· On a tie for the lead, play continues until there is a single winner.

zh.name: 勇闯牌皇镇
zh.desc: 扑克牌驱动的西部拓荒:走商路、抢匪地、下矿洞、逛小镇,别被警长逮住
zh.rules:
目标:三轮开拓后总分最高者获胜。
· 总分构成:现金每 4 元计 1 分,黄金每 2 块计 1 分。
· 另加银星(矿洞底层与旅馆产出,终局结算)与库存星星。
· 平分先比通缉值少,再比黄金与现金多。
准备:标准 52 张扑克牌洗牌;每人 4 元与 2 块黄金,墓地中央墓碑已圈。
· 从 12 张赏金卡抽 3 张公共展示。
流程:每轮依次进行六个阶段。
· 重洗全部牌;扣一张警长卡(不看);进行五个回合。
· 扑克结算;淘金与做工;警长逮捕。
· 之后进入下一轮,三轮后游戏结束。
回合:翻 3 张公共牌,每人同时各自指派三张牌的用途。
· 一张作花色,决定去哪个区:红桃商路、黑桃匪地、方块矿洞、梅花小镇。
· 一张作点数,决定去区内哪一点;一张记入本轮 5 格扑克列。
· 不满意可放弃花色与点数,改去墓地圈一块墓碑(扑克牌仍须记入)。
改牌:花 2 块黄金可把花色牌改成任意花色。
· 花 1 块黄金可把点数加减 1(不限次数,A 与 K 之间不环绕)。
四区:
· 商路:点数不小于站值才能向右推进,可连续冲过多站。
· 停下的站才圈下并获得奖励;跳过的站被划掉、永久失去。
· 匪地:点数圈对应抢劫目标(已圈不可再抢),抽抢劫卡判定。
· 卡值不小于目标点数则抢劫成功,获得全部通缉、星星与现金;失败只获得通缉与一半星星。
· 每行三个目标全部圈完,获得行末奖励行动。
· 矿洞:只能沿连线下降,点数须落在入口值域内;四层矿室,底层产终局银星。
· 小镇:点数进对应建筑,首次到访另有建筑顶部奖励;已圈建筑可重复到访。
奖励行动:板上各处会给出某区的奖励行动——免费、不限点数、可以连锁。
扑克结算:每轮结束按你扑克列的 5 张牌比牌型。
· 一对获得 2 元与 1 星,最高皇家同花顺获得 10 元与 9 星。
淘金做工:每个淘金盘获得 1 块黄金,每个锤子获得 2 元。
逮捕:每个通缉值可花 1 块黄金贿赂免捕;否则翻警长卡,卡值不小于你的通缉值则无事。
· 否则二选一罚金:第 1/2/3 轮为 10/14/18 元或 4/6/8 星。
· 通缉值达到 14 必须扣星。
赏金卡:同一回合内先达成者获得卡面星数,回合结束翻到低档面。
· 之后达成者获得低档星数;每人每张限一次。

en.name: Fliptown
en.desc: Poker-driven Wild West: ride the trail, rob the badlands, dig the mine, dodge the sheriff
en.rules:
Goal: after three rounds, the highest total wins.
· Total score: every $4 of cash scores 1 point, every 2 gold scores 1 point.
· Plus silver stars (from the deepest Mine chamber and the Hotel, scored at the end) and stars in your inventory.
· Ties break on fewer Wanted, then more gold, then more cash.
Setup: shuffle a standard 52-card deck; each player starts with $4 and 2 gold, with the center tombstone pre-circled.
· Reveal 3 of the 12 Bounty cards face up.
Each round has six phases in order.
· Reshuffle everything; set aside one Sheriff card face down; play five turns.
· Score poker hands; pan and work; the Sheriff makes arrests.
· Then the next round begins; the game ends after round three.
Turn: 3 shared cards are revealed and every player simultaneously assigns a role to each.
· One card sets the suit, choosing a region: hearts Trail, spades Badlands, diamonds Mine, clubs Town.
· One card sets the value, choosing the spot within that region; one goes into your 5-card poker column for the round.
· You may forgo the suit and value cards and circle a tombstone in the Cemetery instead (the poker card is still recorded).
Modifying cards: pay 2 gold to change the suit card to any suit.
· Pay 1 gold to adjust the value card by 1 (any number of times, no wrapping between A and K).
Regions:
· Trail: your value must meet the station value to advance right; you may rush past several stations.
· Only the station you stop at is circled for its reward; skipped stations are crossed out forever.
· Badlands: circle the robbery target matching your value (taken targets are gone); draw a robbery card.
· If the card value meets or beats the target, the robbery succeeds: gain all its Wanted, stars and cash; otherwise gain only the Wanted and half the stars.
· Circle all three targets of a row to earn its end-of-row bonus action.
· Mine: descend along links only; your value must fall within an entry range; four levels, the deepest yields end-game silver stars.
· Town: enter the building matching your value; the first visit also grants the bonus printed at the top; circled buildings can be revisited.
Bonus actions: many sites grant a bonus action in some region — free, value-free, and they can chain.
Poker: at round end your 5-card poker column scores by hand rank.
· One pair earns $2 and 1 star, up to a royal flush earning $10 and 9 stars.
Panning and work: each gold pan earns 1 gold; each hammer earns $2.
Arrest: pay 1 gold per Wanted to bribe your way out; otherwise reveal the Sheriff card — if its value meets or beats your Wanted you are safe.
· Otherwise choose a fine (round 1/2/3: $10/$14/$18 or 4/6/8 stars).
· At 14 Wanted you must lose stars.
Bounties: the first player to meet one within the same turn scores its printed stars, then the card flips to its lower side.
· Later achievers score the lower amount; each player scores each Bounty once.

zh.name: 森森不息
zh.desc: 种植树木，吸引生物，建立相互依存的森林生态。
zh.rules:
目标与胜负:
2–5 人轮流建立森林。第三张冬季牌出现时立即结束，按树木、生物及洞穴合计分数决定名次，同分共同获胜。洞穴中的每张牌获得 1 分；手牌不计分。卡牌详情列明其效果、奖励与计分方式。
准备:
每人起手 6 张，没有树木时可整手移除并重抽一次，灌木不算树木。基础版按 2／3／4／5 人移除 30／20／10／0 张；启用一个扩展移除 55／40／25／10 张，两个扩展移除 90／60／45／30 张。余牌分成三堆，将两张冬季牌洗入底堆，第三张放在底堆顶，再叠上其余两堆。按座位顺序行动。
回合行动:
选择抽牌或出牌。抽牌时逐张从牌库或林间空地取牌，共两张，手牌上限 10 张；已有 9 张只能抽一张，已有 10 张必须出牌。抽到前两张冬季牌时展示并补抽，第三张在任何时候出现均立即结束，不完成剩余效果。
出牌与位置:
选择一张手牌及使用的半边，将等于费用的其他手牌支付到空地。树木及灌木独立放置，生物必须放在其牌面对应的上、下、左、右位置。通常每个位置只能放一张。任意手牌均可免费背面种为树苗；树苗算树木但不属于任何树种。每次种植树木或树苗，都从牌库向空地翻一张牌；种灌木不翻牌，灌木也不算树木。回合完全结束时，空地若有至少 10 张牌，将其全部移除。
效果、奖励与持续效果:
出牌后可分别选择使用或跳过效果及奖励。若支付的每张牌至少一半具有所用牌的树种符号，可获奖励；两者都用时先效果后奖励。免费放置不支付费用，不使用该牌自身的效果和奖励，仍可触发现有持续效果。基础蘑菇从下一完整回合起生效；灰喇叭菌和灌木从放置后起生效。持续抽牌先于所放牌的效果与奖励。额外回合在当前回合完全结束后依次进行。
特殊放置与批次:
欧洲野兔可不限数量共用同侧位置，山兔不能共槽。欧洲蟾蜍只能与以前回合放下的一张同种蟾蜍共槽，每槽最多两张。荨麻允许其所在树木或灌木顶部任意数量蝴蝶共槽。鼹鼠须先用当前手牌选择整个出牌批次，支付并全部放置后，再自由选择逐张结算顺序；后来抽到的牌不得加入原批次或用于其支付。嵌套鼹鼠以当时手牌建立独立批次，完成后返回上一批。水䶄先将选定手牌全部种为树苗，再为每棵翻牌，最后结算鸡油菌。
计分提示:
只有露出的半边参与计分。兔类共同计数，蝙蝠至少有三种时，每张蝙蝠才获得 5 分；不同种蝴蝶组成集合，重复种另组，1–7 种的组合分别获得 0／3／6／12／20／35／55 分。火蝾螈 1／2／至少 3 张合计 5／15／25 分。紫木蜂只增加山毛榉、欧洲七叶树、椴树、大斑啄木鸟与苔藓使用的树木数量，不复制树的分数或符号。完整逐牌说明可在卡牌详情中查看。
本局选项:
高山及林缘扩展可独立启用，默认均启用。不含探索扩展、特殊洞穴、起手轮抽、官方单人模式或工坊作者的平衡变体。

en.name: Forest Shuffle
en.desc: Plant trees, attract wildlife, and build an interconnected forest.
en.rules:
Goal and victory:
2–5 players take turns building forests. The third winter card ends the game immediately. Score trees, dwellers and caves; tied highest totals share victory. Each cave card scores 1 point; hand cards score nothing. Card details explain individual effects, bonuses and scoring.
Setup:
Deal six cards each. A player with no tree may remove the entire hand and redraw once; shrubs are not trees. For 2/3/4/5 players remove 30/20/10/0 cards from the base game, 55/40/25/10 with one expansion, or 90/60/45/30 with both. Divide the remaining cards into three similar piles. Shuffle two winter cards into the bottom pile, put the third on top of that pile, then stack the other piles above it. Play in seat order.
Turn actions:
Either draw or play. Draw two cards one at a time, choosing deck or clearing for each. The hand limit is ten: with nine, draw one; with ten, play. Reveal and replace either of the first two winter cards. The third winter ends the game immediately on any reveal, interrupting remaining effects.
Playing and placement:
Choose a hand card and the half to use. Pay its cost with other hand cards into the clearing. Trees and shrubs stand alone; dwellers occupy their printed top, bottom, left or right slot. Normally each slot holds one card. Any hand card may instead be planted face down as a free sapling: it counts as a tree without a tree species. Each tree or sapling reveals one deck card into the clearing. Shrubs neither reveal a card nor count as trees. After the entire turn, remove the clearing if it contains at least ten cards.
Effects, bonuses and permanent effects:
You may use or skip the effect and bonus separately. Earn a bonus when each payment card shows the played half’s tree symbol on at least one half. Resolve effect before bonus. Free placements have no cost and do not use their own effects or bonuses, but can trigger existing permanent effects. Base mushrooms activate from your next full turn; Black Trumpet and shrubs activate from placement onward. Permanent draws precede the placed card’s effect and bonus. Take extra full turns after completing the current turn.
Shared slots and batches:
Any number of European Hares may share a same-side slot; Mountain Hares cannot share. A Common Toad may share with one of its species placed on an earlier turn, at most two per slot. Stinging Nettle allows unlimited butterflies above its tree or shrub. For a Mole, choose the entire batch from the current hand, pay and place everything, then choose the resolution order. Later draws cannot join or pay for that batch. A nested Mole starts a separate batch from the hand at that time, then returns to the parent batch. Water Vole plants all chosen saplings first, reveals one clearing card per sapling, then resolves Chanterelles.
Scoring reminders:
Only the exposed half scores. Both hare species count together. Bats score 5 each with at least three species. Butterfly sets of 1–7 different species score 0/3/6/12/20/35/55, with duplicates forming additional sets. Fire Salamanders score 5/15/25 in total for 1/2/at least 3. Violet Carpenter Bees increase tree counts only for Beech, Horse Chestnut, Linden, Great Spotted Woodpecker and Moss, without duplicating tree points or symbols. Inspect cards for full individual explanations.
Options:
Alpine and Woodland Edge can be enabled independently; both are on by default. Exploration, special caves, drafting, official solo mode and workshop balance variants are excluded.

zh.name: 为了北境森林
zh.desc: 单人吃墩:走访八块领地,用恰到好处的对话说服各位统治者
zh.rules:
目标:独自拜访北境森林的八块领地,通过对话(吃墩)说服统治者。
· 游戏结束时,友好领地的星数之和达到胜利线即获胜。
准备:
· 八块领地按目标墩数 0-7 排开,星值分别为 4/3/2/1/1/2/3/4。
· 教学局由四名骑士担任盟友,八张女王与国王洗匀后各置一块领地担任统治者。
· 完整局将 24 张角色卡洗匀后按花色发放,每种花色第 1 张为盟友,第 2、3 张为统治者。
· 32 张对话牌(爪/花/叶/瞳四花色,各 1-8 点)洗成牌堆,摸 8 张手牌。
流程:每次拜访依次进行——
· 选择一块未拜访的领地。
· 可让任意名已友好的统治者前来替换盟友,每位占一个盟友位,拜访结束后离场。
· 对话时每墩可先激活至多一个盟友能力(每次拜访每个盟友限一次)。
· 翻开牌堆顶牌作为统治者的发言;你必须跟出同花色,没有同花色才可任意出牌。
· 回应与发言同花色且点数更大,或发言非王牌花色(统治者花色)而你打出王牌花色,即赢得此墩。
· 赢墩的回应牌入计分牌堆,否则入弃牌堆。
· 手牌或牌堆任一耗尽,拜访立即结束。
结算:
· 计分牌堆的牌数恰好等于目标墩数,则统治者转为友好;否则拜访失败,统治者离场。
· 拜访结束后所有对话牌重洗,补摸 8 张,选择下一块领地。
结束:八块领地全部拜访完毕(或提前认输)后结算星数;胜利线为标准 16、进阶 18、理想 20。

en.name: For Northwood!
en.desc: Solo trick-taking: visit eight fiefs and win over their rulers through precise dialogue
en.rules:
Goal: visit the eight fiefs of Northwood alone and win over their rulers through dialogues (tricks).
· At the end, you win if your friendly fiefs' stars reach the victory line.
Setup:
· The eight fiefs are laid out with target scores 0-7 and star values 4/3/2/1/1/2/3/4.
· Intro game: the four Jacks are your allies, and the shuffled Queens and Kings become the rulers, one per fief.
· Full game: shuffle all 24 character cards and deal by suit — the first card of each suit is an ally, the second and third are rulers.
· Shuffle the 32 dialogue cards (suits Claws/Flowers/Leaves/Eyes, valued 1-8) into a deck and draw 8.
Play: each visit proceeds in order —
· Choose an unvisited fief.
· Any number of friendly rulers may substitute for allies, one per ally slot; they leave when the visit ends.
· Dialogue: before each trick you may activate at most one ally ability (each ally once per visit).
· The top card of the deck is revealed as the ruler's statement; you must follow its suit if able.
· You score the trick if your response is a higher card of the statement's suit, or if the statement is not the trump suit (the ruler's suit) but your response is.
· Scored responses go to the score pile, others to the discard pile.
· The visit ends immediately when your hand or the deck runs out.
Scoring:
· If the score pile exactly equals the target, the ruler turns friendly; otherwise the visit fails and the ruler leaves.
· After a visit, reshuffle all dialogue cards, draw 8, and choose the next fief.
End: the game ends when all eight fiefs are visited (or you concede early); victory lines: Standard 16, Advanced 18, Idealist 20.

search.py: wei le bei jing sen lin

zh.name: 星期五
zh.desc: 帮助鲁滨逊磨炼本领，战胜荒岛危机与两艘海盗船。
zh.rules:
目标：
帮助鲁滨逊战胜两个海盗。在绿色、黄色和红色三个阶段中改善牌库，迎接最后两场战斗。
准备：
18 张起始牌、30 张冒险牌、随机公开的 2 艘海盗船。难度 1 移除「十分愚笨」，普通衰老牌洗匀放在困难衰老牌上。难度 2 起始牌库多加入一张暗衰老牌；难度 3 再加入「十分愚笨」；难度 4 同难度 3，但以 18 生命开始、上限 20。其他难度以 20 生命开始、上限 22。
冒险：
揭开两张冒险牌，选择一张，另一张弃掉。轮末只剩一张时可以直接弃掉。按当前阶段的颜色确定目标战斗力。
抽牌：
逐张抽取白框数量的免费牌，放在左侧。可以提前停止。免费牌抽完或被「停止」能力阻止后，每支付 1 生命可抽一张额外牌，放在右侧。至少抽一张牌才能结算。即使战斗力已经足够，也可以继续抽牌和使用能力。
能力：
每张牌每场战斗可以主动使用一次，顺序自选。一个能力必须执行完才能开启另一个。恢复生命不能超过本难度的上限。额外抽牌放右侧。「销毁」将另一张牌翻背，其战斗力和持续能力取消，战后移出游戏。「翻倍」只能用于另一张牌，同一张牌每战只能翻倍一次。复制可以复制已使用过的能力，不能复制复制能力或衰老能力。降低阶段仅影响冒险牌，最低降到绿色。
排列：
逐张查看至多三张牌，可以提前停止，至多弃掉一张，其余自选顺序放回牌堆顶端。替换：将另一张已出牌弃掉，在原位置抽一张替代牌；两次替换依次完成，中间不能使用新牌的能力。置底：将另一张牌放到牌堆底，来自左侧时可以在原位置补一张。置底前牌堆必须有牌，必要时先重洗。
衰老：
衰老牌的负面能力强制生效。战末失去生命不能计入销毁预算。「最高归零」先按原始正战斗力选择一张，再计算翻倍；多个归零分别影响不同的最高牌。「停止」只在免费区阻止普通免费抽牌，能力抽牌不受影响。移走或销毁衰老牌会取消其持续能力。
胜负：
手动结束战斗，战斗力达到目标则获得该冒险牌作为知识牌，放入鲁滨逊弃牌堆。战斗力不足则支付差值生命，可以用这笔费用销毁本场已出牌：普通牌每张 1，衰老牌每张 2；不能额外支付生命扩大预算。其他牌进入鲁滨逊弃牌堆，未战胜的冒险进入冒险弃牌堆。
重洗：
需要抽牌而鲁滨逊牌堆为空时，将一张暗衰老牌与鲁滨逊弃牌洗成新牌堆。暗牌顺序不可查看。衰老牌耗尽后再需要重洗会失败。生命降到零仍可继续，无法支付所需生命时立即失败。
阶段：
冒险牌堆用完后，洗匀冒险弃牌并进入下一阶段。红色阶段结束后，自选海盗战斗顺序。必须战胜两艘海盗船，不能主动认输。海盗特殊规则写在船牌上；「半数计分」自动使用战斗力最高的合法组合，所有正面衰老牌必须计入。
计分：
现存战斗牌原始战斗力之和（衰老牌统一每张 −5），每艘战胜的海盗加 15，每点胜局剩余生命加 5，冒险弃牌中每张未战胜冒险减 3。两堆弃牌、已销毁牌和三个牌堆数量可随时查看。

en.name: Friday
en.desc: Help Robinson build his deck, survive the island and defeat two pirate ships.
en.rules:
Goal:
Help Robinson improve his deck through the green, yellow and red steps, then defeat both pirates.
Setup:
Shuffle 18 starting cards and 30 hazards. Reveal 2 random pirates. For level 1, remove Very stupid; shuffle normal aging cards above the separately shuffled difficult cards. Level 2 adds one unseen aging card to the starting deck. Level 3 includes Very stupid. Level 4 uses the level 3 setup but starts with 18 life and a maximum of 20; other levels start with 20 and have a maximum of 22.
Hazards:
Reveal two and choose one; discard the other. A final single hazard may be discarded without fighting. The current step colour determines the target.
Draw:
Draw free fighting cards one at a time, up to the white-box number, on the left. You may stop early. After free draws are exhausted or stopped, each additional card costs 1 life and goes on the right. At least one fighting card must be drawn before ending a fight. Reaching the target never ends a fight automatically.
Abilities:
Use each face-up card once per fight, in any order, completing one ability before starting another. Healing is limited by the level’s life supply. Ability draws go on the right. Destroy turns another card face down, cancelling its points and ongoing effects; remove it after the fight. Double affects another card, at most once per target per fight. Copy may reuse an already-used ability but cannot copy Copy or an aging ability. Step reduction only affects hazards, down to green.
Sort:
Look at up to three cards one by one, discard at most one, then return the others in any order. Exchange discards another played card and draws its replacement in the same position. Complete both exchanges before using any newly drawn ability. Below the stack moves another card to the bottom; a card from the free side may be replaced in its original position. If the stack is empty, reshuffle before placing the card below it.
Aging:
Negative abilities are compulsory. End-of-fight life costs do not increase the destruction allowance. Highest card = 0 affects one card with the highest original positive value before doubling; multiple such effects affect distinct cards. Stop prevents ordinary free draws only while on the free side; ability draws remain possible. Removing or destroying an aging card cancels its ongoing effect.
Fight result:
End manually. Meet the target to gain the hazard as a knowledge card in your Robinson discard. Otherwise pay the shortfall in life and use that amount to destroy played cards: 1 per ordinary card, 2 per aging card. You cannot pay extra life to increase this allowance. Discard remaining fighting cards; undefeated hazards enter the hazard discard.
Reshuffle:
Only when another card is needed and the Robinson stack is empty, shuffle the Robinson discard with one unseen aging card. You lose if another reshuffle is required after aging cards run out. Zero life is allowed; an unaffordable required payment loses immediately.
Steps:
When the hazard stack runs out, shuffle its discard for the next colour. After red, choose which pirate to fight first. Both must be defeated; pirates cannot be deliberately lost. Ship cards show their special rules. The half-counting pirate automatically uses the strongest legal combination, including all face-up aging cards.
Score:
Sum original values of all remaining fighting cards (each aging card is −5), add 15 per defeated pirate and 5 per life remaining in a win, then subtract 3 per undefeated hazard in the hazard discard. Both discard piles, destroyed cards and all three stack counts may be inspected at any time.

zh.name: 奶酪世家
zh.desc: 经营法式奶酪工坊，随着转盘安排熟成、拓展市场与订单。
zh.rules:
目标：
经营自己的奶酪工坊，在餐酒馆、奶酪店、节庆和城市四个场地放置奶酪，结合建筑、水果和订单获得最多声望。采用第二印基础版，支持1–4人；本版本未包含《Formaggio》扩展。
准备：
每人获得15枚奶酪、软质、硬质、蓝纹工人各一及随机玩家板。转盘的场地与资源随机配置，获得左侧资源2个、对面资源1个。1–2人、3人、4人使用各自插板；I、II可分别配置，0面仅供4人使用。选择高级建筑时，多人从4片中各留1片并向左传，重复至各留4片；单人依次从新抽的4、3、2、1片中各留1片。可用保留的高级建筑替换任意默认建筑，也可保留默认建筑。
回合：
所有玩家同时操作自己面前的象限。每回合至多派一位工人制酪、派一位工人采集资源，两者顺序任意，也可不做。可随时建造、挤奶或使用已建成建筑。所有人完成后，转盘顺时针旋转90度，进入下一回合。
· 制酪：选择可用工人，再选择当前场地的空格，类型须与工人一致。在该格放一枚奶酪，工人等待该格标示的1、2或3回合后收回。每次放置时可完成一张类型与熟成都匹配的已有订单；不能追溯完成新抽到的订单。果味或果酱格必须支付一水果，将其移至对应已用区。
· 采集：可用任意工人占据当前资源的空置1、2或3位，立即获得相应数量资源，等待相应回合后收回。已被工人占据的资源位不能使用。
· 挤奶：支付2、3、4或5牲畜，选择个人板上尚未用过的挤奶位，立即在当前场地放置符合其类型、熟成要求的额外奶酪，不派工人，不占用普通制酪行动；果味或果酱格仍须支付水果。每个挤奶位通常一局只能使用一次。
· 建筑：支付建筑资源后建成并启用对应能力。能力可在条件满足时使用，默认第二能力每回合只额外获得一次资源。高级建筑的效果见建筑详情。放置时以已建成的能力处理触发，事件发生后才建成的能力不能追溯生效。
场地计分：
· 餐酒馆：每完整占据一张双人桌，所有自家奶酪的分值提高。配对桌数为0、1、2、至少3时，铜/银/金奶酪每枚分别获得0/2/4、1/3/5、2/4/6、3/6/9分。
· 奶酪店：占据1–6个不同货架分别获得0、2、5、9、14、20分。上半货架每枚铜/银/金奶酪另获1/2/3分；下半货架的铜位可弃一资源换任意一资源，银位获得任意一资源，金位获得两种不同资源。
· 节庆：自家奶酪与免费试吃点按上下左右相邻形成连通组；不同玩家的奶酪不能连接。每组1–7枚分别获得0、2、4、6、9、12、15分，以后每增加一枚再获5分。
· 城市：每枚奶酪影响其接触的所有区域。每区影响最多者获得该区客户分：1–2人局3/4/5分，3人局5/6/7分，4人局7/8/9分；并列时各获0、2或3分，分别对应1–2、3、4人局。
其他计分与结束：
已用果味水果数乘以已用果酱水果数。完成1–6张订单分别获得1、3、5、8、11、14分，以后每张再获4分。每两份闲置资源获得1分，未完成订单也算闲置资源。另计所有已建成建筑的终局分。
任一玩家放完15枚奶酪后，本回合全员完成即结束。工人是否熟成不影响奶酪计分。工人宿舍允许拥有者在转盘额外旋转一次后多行动一回合。总分最高者获胜，平分时放置奶酪更多者获胜，仍平则共享胜利。
单人公司：
公司先抽订单，由玩家在当前场地选择类型、熟成匹配的空格放置公司奶酪，不支付水果；没有匹配空格或奶酪时，公司保留该订单并在终局每张获得3分。公司有15、17、18、19枚奶酪，分别对应四个难度；其基础声望随已放奶酪按公司板提高。公司只争夺城市客户，不计算其他场地分，客户固定3/4/5分。第二级放置第10枚、第三级第8枚、第四级第6枚奶酪后，从下一回合开始每回合抽两单。第三级起，公司在果味或果酱格放置奶酪时获得水果，每2/4/6/8水果分别获得1/3/6/10分，此后每两水果再获5分。第四级最后抽到银单时封锁本回合2资源位，金单封锁3资源位。玩家或公司用完奶酪都会触发本回合结束；比较总分，再比较已放奶酪数，仍平时共享胜利。

en.name: Fromage
en.desc: Run a French creamery: age cheese, expand your workshop, and compete for customers.
en.rules:
Goal:
Earn the most Prestige through four Venues, Structures, Fruit, and Orders. This is the second-printing base game for 1–4 players; Formaggio is not included.
Setup:
Each player receives 15 Cheese Tokens, one Soft, Hard, and Bleu Worker, and a random Player Board. Venues and Resources are randomized. Start with 2 Resources from the quadrant to your left and 1 from the opposite quadrant. Use the appropriate inserts for 1–2, 3, or 4 players; choose I or II separately for each Venue. Side 0 is for four players only. With advanced Structures, draft four tiles: choose one of four and pass left until all are kept. Solo players choose one tile from fresh sets of 4, 3, 2, then 1. Replace any default abilities with kept tiles, or retain the defaults.
Turns:
All players act simultaneously in their current quadrant. Once per turn, assign one available Worker to Make Cheese and one to Gather Resources, in either order. Either action is optional. Build, milk Livestock, and use completed Structures at any time. When everyone finishes, rotate the board 90 degrees clockwise.
· Make Cheese: choose an available Worker, then an empty space matching its type. Place a Cheese Token there. The Worker returns after the indicated 1, 2, or 3 turns. You may immediately complete one existing Order matching that cheese type and age. Newly drawn Orders cannot be completed retroactively. Fruited Cheese and Jam spaces require one Fruit, moved to the appropriate spent area.
· Gather: any available Worker can occupy an empty Resource space labeled 1, 2, or 3 in the current quadrant. Immediately gain that many Resources; the Worker returns after that many turns. Occupied spaces are unavailable.
· Milk: pay 2, 3, 4, or 5 Livestock to use an unused Milking Parlour. Place its Bonus Cheese in a matching type/age space in the current Venue, without a Worker or consuming your Make Cheese action. Fruit is still required where shown. Each Parlour is normally usable once per game.
· Build: pay Structure Tokens to unlock an ability. Abilities apply whenever their conditions are met; the second default ability grants its extra Resource only once per turn. Read each advanced tile for its effect. Newly completed abilities do not apply retroactively to past events.
Venues:
· Bistro: completing pairs at tables improves every own cheese. With 0, 1, 2, or at least 3 complete tables, each Bronze/Silver/Gold cheese scores respectively 0/2/4, 1/3/5, 2/4/6, or 3/6/9 points.
· Fromagerie: occupy 1–6 different shelves to score 0, 2, 5, 9, 14, or 20 points. Upper shelves add 1/2/3 per Bronze/Silver/Gold cheese. On lower shelves, Bronze lets you discard any Resource to gain any one; Silver gains any one; Gold gains two different Resources.
· Festival: your cheese and Free Samples form orthogonally connected groups; opposing cheese cannot connect them. A group of 1–7 scores 0, 2, 4, 6, 9, 12, or 15, then 5 more per additional token.
· Villes: each cheese influences every region it touches. The most influence wins that region’s Customer: 3/4/5 points with 1–2 players, 5/6/7 with 3, or 7/8/9 with 4. Tied leaders each score 0, 2, or 3 in those player counts respectively.
Scoring and end:
Multiply Fruit spent on Fruited Cheese by Fruit spent on Jam. Completing 1–6 Orders scores 1, 3, 5, 8, 11, or 14; each further Order adds 4. Every two unused Resources, including incomplete Orders, score 1. Add all completed Structure bonuses.
When anyone places their 15th Cheese Token, finish the current turn. Cheese scores regardless of whether its Worker has returned. Workers’ Quarters grants its owner one extra turn after one more board rotation. Highest Prestige wins; break ties by cheese placed, then share victory.
Solo corporation:
The corporation draws first. Choose any matching empty space in your current Venue for its cheese, without paying Fruit. If none matches, or it has no cheese left, it keeps the Order for 3 points at game-end. Levels 1–4 have 15/17/18/19 cheese; their printed base Prestige increases as cheese is placed. The corporation competes for Villes Customers only, worth 3/4/5; it does not score other Venues. Level 2 draws twice from the turn after its 10th cheese, Level 3 after its 8th, and Level 4 after its 6th. At Level 3+, placing on a Fruited/Jam space gains a Fruit: 2/4/6/8 Fruit score 1/3/6/10, then 5 per further pair. At Level 4, the last drawn Silver Order blocks the 2 Resource space that turn, and Gold blocks the 3 space. Either side exhausting cheese triggers the final turn. Compare Prestige, then cheese placed; remaining ties share victory.

zh.name: 郁金香庄园
zh.desc: 轮盘拿块建花园,连通花海抢目标
zh.rules:
目标:10 轮建设郁金香庄园,终局总分最高者胜。
· 终局总分为计分轨、升级标记、目标板块与剩余金币四部分之和。
准备:
· 每人 1 块起始板块与 10 张景观卡(洗匀抽 3 张作手牌)。
· 按回合顺序获得 1/2/3/4 金币。
· 44 块景观板块洗混成袋,翻 5 块摆上市场;按人数翻 8/10/12 块目标板块。
流程(每回合四步):
· 拿板块:花朵标记顺时针移向要拿取的市场板块,每跳过 1 块须在其旁放 1 金币。
· 拿走板块与其旁积累的金币,再从袋中补 1 块。
· 放板块:至少一边与已有板块相邻(元素无需同类相接),可自由旋转翻面;放下后不可移动。
· 打 1 张景观卡:按刚放置板块的同元素连通组计分。
· 单元素卡每元素 2 分,双元素卡每类各 1 分;然后补牌至 3 张,牌库空后不重洗。
· 填升级(能填必填):围出的空地立即按格数填充。
· 1 格填 1 个花农;2 格填 1 个谷仓;3 格填 1 个谷仓与 1 个花农。
· 4 格 T 形填 1 个谷仓与 2 个花农;4 格其他非方形填 2 个谷仓。
· 4 格方形填 1 座风车。
· 每放置 1 个花农立即获得 1 金币。
认领目标(可选):
· 景观类:本回合放置板块的连通组达 6/8/10(花按朵数、水按格数)。
· 升级类:本回合放置过升级标记,且该类总数达标。
· 升级类目标值:花农 3/4/5、谷仓 2/3/4、风车 1/2/3。
· 每人每类限 1 块;达标本回合可领多块,放弃则可能被对手抢走。
结算:
· 升级分:花农 3 / 谷仓 10 / 风车 25;目标板块 3/10/25 分。
· 每枚剩余金币 1 分。
· 平分比剩余金币,再平则共享胜利。

en.name: Frosted Blooms
en.desc: Draft tiles from the rondel, grow flower groups, claim objectives
en.rules:
Goal: 10 rounds to build the most valuable tulip estate; the highest final score wins.
· Final score is the sum of score track, improvements, objective tiles, and leftover coins.
Setup:
· Each player gets a starting tile and a deck of 10 Landscape cards (shuffle, draw 3).
· Gain 1/2/3/4 coins in turn order.
· Shuffle all 44 Landscape tiles into a bag and reveal 5 onto the market; reveal 8/10/12 objective tiles by player count.
Play (four steps per turn):
· Take a tile: move the Flower token clockwise toward the market tile you want, placing 1 coin next to each tile you skip.
· Take the tile and any coins beside it, then refill from the bag.
· Place the tile: at least one edge adjacent to your garden (elements need not match), rotating and flipping freely; placed tiles cannot move.
· Play 1 Landscape card: score the connected group of the just-placed tile.
· Single-type cards score 2 points per element, dual-type cards 1 point per element of each type; then draw back to 3, no reshuffle when the deck runs out.
· Fill gaps (mandatory): an enclosed gap is filled immediately according to its size.
· 1 space takes 1 Worker; 2 spaces take 1 Barn; 3 spaces take 1 Barn and 1 Worker.
· A 4-space T takes 1 Barn and 2 Workers; other non-square 4-space gaps take 2 Barns.
· A 4-space square takes 1 Windmill.
· Each Worker placed earns 1 coin at once.
Claiming objectives (optional):
· Landscapes: the group formed by the tile placed this turn reaches 6/8/10 (flowers counted by blooms, water by spaces).
· Improvements: you placed an improvement this turn and your total for that type meets the target.
· Improvement targets: Workers 3/4/5, Barns 2/3/4, Windmills 1/2/3.
· At most 1 objective per type per player; you may claim several in one turn, but passing lets opponents snatch them.
Final scoring:
· Improvements: Worker 3 / Barn 10 / Windmill 25; objective tiles 3/10/25.
· Each leftover coin scores 1 point.
· Ties are broken by leftover coins, then shared victory.

zh.name: 纸牌帮
zh.desc: 合作估牌力:各拿名次筹码,摊牌全对才算赢
zh.rules:
目标:全队合作,累计猜对全桌牌力名次 3 局即通关。
准备:
· 每人 2 张底牌,只有自己能看到。
· 中央备有与人数相同的星数筹码:1 星表示自认牌力最弱,星数越多表示自认越强。
流程:
· 一局分四个阶段,依次亮出公共牌。
· 翻牌前(0 张)、翻牌(3 张)、转牌(1 张)、河牌(1 张)。
· 每个阶段中,任何人可随时从中央拿取一枚筹码,或放回重换。
· 也可以直接拿走别人手中的筹码,被拿的人必须重新拿取。
· 全员都持有筹码后,自动进入下一阶段。
胜负:
· 河牌亮出后摊牌,按扑克牌型比较真实牌力。
· 每人持有的星数都与自己的真实名次一致,全队赢下本局;否则记一次失败,失败次数不限。

en.name: The Gang
en.desc: Co-op hand reading: claim rank chips, showdown must match
en.rules:
Goal: cooperate as one gang and correctly call every member’s hand rank in 3 rounds.
Setup:
· Each player holds 2 hole cards, visible only to themselves.
· Star chips sit in the middle, one per player: 1★ claims the weakest hand; more stars claim a stronger one.
Play:
· A round has four stages as community cards are revealed.
· Pre-flop (0 cards), flop (3), turn (1), river (1).
· During each stage anyone may take a chip from the middle, or swap theirs back, at any time.
· You may even take a chip out of another player’s hand; they must then take a new one.
· Once everyone holds a chip, the next stage begins automatically.
Result:
· After the river, hands are revealed and ranked by poker hand strength.
· If every chip matches its holder’s true rank, the gang wins the round; otherwise it counts as a loss, with no limit on losses.

zh.name: 圣诞魅影
zh.desc: 穿越时空的叫标吃墩:预估赢墩数,在过去/现在/未来各放一张牌
zh.rules:
目标:打满与人数相同的手数,总分最高者胜(并列共享胜利)。
牌:
· 四种花色(红心/蜡烛/音符/天平)各 1~12,3 人局移除各花色的 1~3。
· 红心永远是王牌。
每手流程:
· 叫标:从起始玩家开始,预测这一手赢几墩;可再加 1 扇红门。
· 红门:命中叫标数或比叫标数多 1 墩都算叫中,但每墩只值 1 分(无红门时每墩 2 分)。
· 没叫中则本手获得 0 分。
· 出牌:共 4 轮,每轮每人往过去/现在/未来三个时代各放 1 张,顺序任选。
· 每个时代的花色由本轮该时代第一张牌定,手上有该花色必须跟。
· 结算:每轮按过去→现在→未来逐墩结算。
· 计分花色为起始玩家在该时代所出牌的花色(与时代花色无关)。
· 墩内有红心则比较最大的红心,否则比较计分花色中最大者。
· 赢家接过起始玩家标记,下一墩改用他的牌定计分花色。
起始玩家不轮换:下一手由上一手最后一墩的赢家担任。

en.name: Ghosts of Christmas
en.desc: Time-traveling trick-taking with bidding: place one card in each era
en.rules:
Goal: play as many hands as there are players; highest total wins (ties share the victory).
Cards:
· Four suits (Hearts/Candles/Notes/Scales) ranked 1~12; with 3 players, remove 1~3 of each suit.
· Hearts are always trump.
Each hand:
· Bid: starting from the start player, predict how many tricks you will win; you may add 1 red door.
· Red door: hitting your bid or one more than your bid both count, but each trick is worth only 1 point (2 without a red door).
· Missing the bid scores 0 for the hand.
· Play: 4 rounds; each round everyone places 1 card into each of the three eras (Past/Present/Future) in any order.
· An era suit is set by its first card of the round; you must follow if you can.
· Resolve: each round settles Past, then Present, then Future.
· The scoring suit is the suit of the card the start player played in that era (not the era suit).
· If the trick contains a Heart, the highest Heart wins; otherwise the highest card of the scoring suit wins.
· The winner takes the start player marker, and the next trick scores off their card.
The start player does not rotate: the winner of the last trick of a hand takes the marker for the next hand.

zh.name: 爆珠发明
zh.desc: 取能、归档、建造、研究,连锁触发你的发明引擎
zh.rules:
目标:用能量弹珠建造发明,触发连锁效果;总分最高者胜。
准备:
· 三个等级牌堆摆开三行展示区;分配器滚出 6 颗能量成能量行。
· 每人一张起始发明:归档时随机抽 1 颗能量。
流程:每回合从四个动作中选一个执行。
· 归档:从展示区取 1 张放入存档,初始至多存 1 张。
· 取能:从能量行取 1 颗放入储能环,初始至多存 5 颗。
· 建造:从展示区或存档付费建造 1 张,能量退回分配器。
· 研究:选定牌堆抽 3 张,建造或归档 1 张,其余放回牌堆底。
· 已建的转换器可以变色或一变二,每个每回合限一次。
· 动作会触发同类已建发明,顺序自选,每个每回合一次。
结束:有人建出第 4 张 3 级卡或第 16 张卡后,补完一轮。
· 计卡面分与分标记;平分依次比激活卡数、剩余能量。

en.name: Gizmos
en.desc: Pick, file, build and research — chain your engine of inventions
en.rules:
Goal: spend energy marbles to build Gizmos and chain effects; most points win.
Setup:
· Three decks form three display rows; 6 marbles roll out as the energy row.
· Everyone starts with one Gizmo: when you file, draw 1 random energy.
Play: on your turn, perform exactly one of four actions.
· File: take 1 card from the display into your archive, which holds 1.
· Pick: take 1 marble from the energy row; storage holds up to 5.
· Build: pay to build 1 card from the display or your archive.
· Research: draw 3 from one deck; build or file 1, return the rest.
· Built converters recolor or duplicate energy, each once per turn.
· Actions trigger matching built Gizmos in any order, once per turn.
End: after a 4th level-3 or 16th card is built, finish the round.
· Score card points plus VP tokens; ties break on cards, then energy.

zh.name: 光源
zh.desc: 直线数格点亮版图,逐房间比拼点数
zh.rules:
目标:所有房间结算后,胜利分最高者获胜。
准备:
· 2 人用斜对角,3-4 人用四角等指定格放起始标记。
· 每人 24 枚双面筹码(1/6、2/5、3/4 各 8 枚)。
· 抽 1 枚自选一面放到起始标记上,再抽 1 枚扣在手中。
流程:
· 回合内先放后抽:从自己场上一枚顶层筹码出发,沿横或竖的直线数出等于其点数的格数。
· 把手中筹码放到数出的落点,任选一面朝上。
· 起点与落点之间有任意筹码则该方向被挡,出界也不行。
· 落点已有 1 枚筹码(任何人的)可以叠放,已有 2 枚则不行;叠放后只有顶层筹码参与计分。
· 落点不能是他人的起始标记;整局限一次,可不经计数直接把手中筹码叠到自己的起始标记上。
· 不能跳过;无法合法放置时必须用掉那次免计数机会,机会已用过则出局,只等终局结算。
结算:
· 所有玩家无筹码可抽,或无人能放置时,逐房间结算。
· 按各自顶层筹码点数总和排名。
· 第 1 名 4 分、第 2 名 2 分(2 人局只发第 1 名)。
· 并列第 1 名则都获得 4 分且不发第 2 名的分,并列第 2 名则都获得 2 分。
· 房间里没有筹码的玩家不参与该房间排名。
· 总分最高者胜;平分则中央 9 格房间点数多者胜,仍平分则共享胜利。

en.name: Glüx
en.desc: Count straight lines, light up rooms, outscore rivals
en.rules:
Goal: after every room is scored, the player with the most victory points wins.
Setup:
· With 2 players use the diagonal start squares; with 3-4 players use the illustrated squares (corners for 4).
· Each player has 24 two-sided chips (8 each of 1/6, 2/5, 3/4).
· Draw one chip, choose a face, and place it on your start marker; then draw one more chip and keep it hidden in your hand.
Play:
· On your turn, place then draw: from any of your own top chips, count exactly its pip value in a straight horizontal or vertical line.
· Place your hand chip on the destination square, either face up.
· Any chip between the start and the destination blocks that direction, and you may not count off the board.
· A destination holding a single chip (anyone's) may be stacked on; a stack of two may not. Only the top chip of a stack counts.
· You may never place on another player's start marker. Once per game you may place your chip onto your own start marker without counting.
· No passing. If you cannot place legally, you must use that once-per-game option; if it is already used, you are out until the final scoring.
Scoring:
· When no player can draw a chip, or nobody can place, rooms are scored one by one.
· Sum your top-chip pips per room to rank the players.
· 1st place scores 4 VP, 2nd place 2 VP (in a 2-player game only 1st place scores).
· Tied for 1st: all tied players get 4 VP and no 2nd place is awarded; tied for 2nd: all tied players get 2 VP.
· Players with no chip in a room do not rank in it.
· Most VP wins; ties are broken by pips in the central 3×3 room, and a persisting tie is a shared victory.

zh.name: 丰收季节
zh.desc: 双人农场牌库构筑:浇水收割赚金币,投资升级农场,先填满版图者胜
zh.rules:
目标:先把自己版图填满的玩家立即获胜;版图每格需投资 10 金币。
准备:
· 每名玩家起始持有 3 块基础地块、3 金币、15 张起始牌组(10 张浇水、5 张收割)。
· 先手玩家预种价值 2 的小麦,后手价值 3。
· 中央翻开作物店 5 张、铁匠铺 3 张、农场升级 3 张。
流程:每回合依次进行以下阶段。
· 抽 5 张牌:牌组恒为 15 张,抽完将弃牌堆洗回。
· 自动装置与动物结算;浇水与收割;挖矿或弃牌;购买;结束回合。
浇水与收割:
· 浇水卡每点可分给不同作物;作物不会失去已浇的水。
· 轨道上的编号格是集收:走到立即收钱,不耗收割卡。
· 到达轨道末格(镰刀)即成熟:弃 1 点收割卡收割 1 株,按收割价值收钱。
· 多点收割卡必须用于不同作物。
· 收割的作物放进独立弃牌堆,不进玩家牌组。
挖矿与购买:
· 挖矿:弃 2 张本回合未使用的卡,翻 1 张矿卡收钱;石头一无所获。
· 手牌未清空不能购买;店铺在你回合结束后才补货。
· 铁匠工具:付款后从弃牌堆选 1 张同类型卡移出游戏,新工具进弃牌堆。
农场与投资:
· 每 10 金币可在购买阶段填版图 1 格(一回合可填多格)。
· 谷仓格:填上时从农场升级陈列中选 1 个安装;浅蓝工具格(长局):免费拿铁匠铺当前全部工具。
· 动物从安装的下回合起循环产出。
· 洒水器每回合开始给全体作物浇 1 点水;收割机每回合开始收走所有成熟作物。
· 肥料使每次收割多获得 1 币;阶梯地块只给匹配阶梯的作物加收割收入。
变体:
· 钓鱼:替换挖矿。弃任意张未用的卡累加捕鱼值(基础卡各 0.5),逐张翻鱼牌。
· 鱼图标数小于剩余捕鱼值则捕获并扣减。
· 翻到不小于剩余值的鱼则翻船,损失该条与最后捕获的一条,其余入账。
· 高级工具:秘银可浇水 1 点并收割 1 点;铱金可浇水 2 点并收割 2 点。
· 高级工具的浇水与收割须用于不同作物。
· 购入高级工具时可选择替换水壶或镰刀。
· 快速版图:开局轮抽升级牌,每人预装 3 个升级。
· 长局:150 金币、15 格版图、8 次升级。

en.name: Growing Season
en.desc: A two-player farming deck-builder: water, harvest, invest — first to fill the board wins
en.rules:
Goal: the first player to fill their own board wins immediately; each square costs 10 coins.
Setup:
· Each player starts with 3 basic plots, 3 coins, and a 15-card deck (10 watering, 5 harvest).
· The first player plants wheat worth 2, the second player wheat worth 3.
· Reveal 5 crop cards (store), 3 blacksmith tools, and 3 farm upgrades.
Play: each turn proceeds through the following steps.
· Draw 5 cards: your deck always has 15; reshuffle the discard pile when it runs out.
· Resolve machines and animals; water and harvest; mine or discard; buy; end turn.
Watering & Harvesting:
· Each watering point may go to a different crop; crops never lose water.
· Numbered squares on the track are gatherings: they pay immediately when reached, costing no harvest card.
· A crop at the sickle square is ripe: spend 1 harvest point to harvest 1 crop and earn its harvest value.
· Multi-point harvest cards must target different crops.
· Harvested crops go to a separate discard pile, not into your deck.
Mining & Buying:
· Mining: discard 2 unused cards to flip 1 mining card for coins; stones yield nothing.
· You cannot buy while holding cards; shops refill only after your turn ends.
· Blacksmith tools: pay, remove a card of the same type from your discard pile from the game, and add the new tool to your discard pile.
Farm & Investing:
· In the buying phase, every 10 coins fills 1 board square (multiple per turn allowed).
· Barn squares: choose 1 farm upgrade from the display; light-blue tool squares (long game): take all tools the blacksmith currently offers for free.
· Animals produce in a cycle starting the turn after installation.
· The sprinkler waters every crop once at turn start; the harvester reaps all ripe crops at turn start.
· Fertiliser earns 1 extra coin per harvest; tiered plots boost harvests only of matching-tier crops.
Variants:
· Fishing: replaces mining. Discard any number of unused cards to sum fishing value (0.5 each for basic cards), then flip fish cards one by one.
· If the fish icons are fewer than your remaining value, the fish is caught and subtracted.
· Flipping one that is not smaller capsizes the boat: lose that fish and your last catch, keeping the rest.
· Advanced tools: Mythril waters 1 and harvests 1; Iridium waters 2 and harvests 2.
· The watering and harvesting of an advanced tool must target different crops.
· When buying an advanced tool, you may replace either a watering can or a sickle.
· Quick board: draft upgrades before the game and start with 3 installed.
· Long game: 150 coins, 15 squares, 8 upgrades.

zh.name: 昆特牌
zh.desc: 五大阵营，运用手牌与领袖争夺三线战场
zh.rules:
目标:
· 使对手失去两颗生命宝石，赢得整场对局。
准备:
· 双方选择阵营、领袖和牌组，可选择相同阵营。
· 牌组至少包含 22 张单位，至多包含 10 张特殊牌。
· 每张牌受构筑上限限制，英雄异画不增加副本。
· 起手抽 10 张牌，最多更换两张；换出的牌暂时移开。
· 完成换牌后，将移开的牌洗回牌库。
· 松鼠党决定首局先手，否则随机决定。
流程:
· 每回合打出一张牌、使用主动领袖，或放弃本局。
· 主动领袖整场仅能使用一次，占用一个回合。
· 放弃后不能在本局再次行动，对手可继续出牌。
· 单位置于标示的战斗行；敏捷单位可选择近战或远程行。
· 计分依次应用天气、同名羁绊、士气和号角。
· 英雄免疫其他卡牌与领袖的效果，但仍会触发自身技能。
· 集合从手牌和牌库拉出对应单位，医师复活弃牌堆中的非英雄单位。
· 诱饵回收己方非英雄单位；间谍为对手计分，并使打出者抽两张牌。
· 号角和蘑菇共用行内特殊牌槽，同一行不能同时放置。
· 召唤复仇者离场后，在下一局开始召唤对应单位。
· 卡牌详情列出领袖和单位技能；所有模组领袖均可使用。
结算:
· 双方均放弃后比较总战力，败方失去一颗生命宝石。
· 平局时双方各失去一颗；仅一方为尼弗迦德时，该方获胜。
· 离场牌进入当前控制者的弃牌堆，特殊衍生牌按其能力移出。
· 北方领域获胜后抽一张牌；怪兽随机保留一个非英雄单位。
· 史凯利杰在第三局开始随机复活两个非英雄单位。
· 上一局获胜者先手，平局保留原先手。
· 双方同时失去最后一颗生命宝石时，整场平局。

en.name: Gwent
en.desc: Command five factions across three battle lines
en.rules:
Goal:
· Win by taking both of your opponent’s life gems.
Setup:
· Choose a faction, leader, and deck. Both players may use the same faction.
· A deck needs at least 22 units and at most 10 special cards.
· Respect copy limits. Alternate Hero artwork does not add copies.
· Draw 10 cards and exchange up to 2; set exchanged cards aside.
· Shuffle the set-aside cards back into the deck after exchanging.
· Scoia’tael chooses the first player; otherwise decide randomly.
Play:
· Play a card, use an active leader, or pass the round.
· An active leader is usable once per match and takes the whole turn.
· After passing, you cannot act again this round; the opponent may continue.
· Use the indicated row. Agile units choose close combat or ranged.
· Apply weather, Tight Bond, Morale Boost, then horns when scoring.
· Heroes ignore other cards and leaders, but still use their own abilities.
· Muster pulls matching hand and deck units; Medics revive non-Hero units.
· Decoys return your non-Hero units. Spies score for the enemy and draw 2.
· Horns and Mardroeme share a row slot and cannot coexist there.
· Summon Avengers summon their replacement at the start of the next round.
· Card details explain abilities. All leaders included in the mod are available.
Resolution:
· Once both players pass, the lower total loses a life gem.
· On a tie both lose a gem, unless exactly one is Nilfgaard, which wins.
· Discards belong to the current controller. Certain tokens leave the game.
· Northern Realms draws on a win; Monsters keeps a random non-Hero unit.
· Skellige revives 2 random non-Hero units at the start of round 3.
· The winner starts the next round; a tie preserves the previous starter.
· Losing the final gems simultaneously draws the match.

search.py: kun te pai wu shi san

zh.name: 花火 Hanabi
zh.desc: 合作放烟花:你看得见所有人的牌,唯独看不见自己的,只能靠队友的提示出牌
zh.rules:
目标:全队合作,按颜色把 5 条烟花各从 1 放到 5,争取得分越高越好。
准备:
· 2~3 人每人 5 张手牌,4~5 人每人 4 张。
· 牌背对自己——你看不到自己的牌,只能看到别人的。
· 桌面有 8 枚提示标记与 3 格引信。
流程:
· 轮到你时三选一:给提示、弃一张牌、打出一张牌。
· 给提示:花 1 枚提示标记,指定一名队友的一种颜色或一个数字。
· 对方所有符合条件的牌都会被指出;不能只指出一部分,也不能指定「零张」。
· 弃牌:弃掉一张手牌,收回 1 枚提示标记;提示标记全满时不能弃牌。
· 出牌:打出一张手牌,若恰好是某色烟花的下一数字则接入该烟花。
· 否则浪费这张牌并烧掉 1 格引信。
· 打出数字 5 完成一条烟花时,免费收回 1 枚提示标记。
· 行动后从牌堆摸一张牌(末轮除外)。
结束:
· 引信烧完 3 格:立即失败,本局记 0 分。
· 抽空牌堆前完成全部烟花:满分完胜。
· 牌堆抽空后,每人(含抽空者)再行动一次,随后结算:得分为各条烟花顶端数字之和。

en.name: Hanabi
en.desc: Co-op fireworks: you can see everyone’s cards but your own — play yours off your teammates’ clues
en.rules:
Goal: work together to build 5 fireworks, each color rising from 1 to 5, and score as high as possible.
Setup:
· With 2–3 players each holds 5 cards; with 4–5 players, 4 cards.
· Hold them facing away — you never see your own cards, only everyone else’s.
· The table starts with 8 clue tokens and 3 fuse marks.
Play:
· On your turn, do exactly one of: give a clue, discard a card, or play a card.
· Give a clue: spend 1 clue token, name one color or one number held by a teammate.
· Every matching card is pointed out; you may not point to only some of them, and “you have zero of something” is not allowed.
· Discard: drop a card from your hand to take back 1 clue token; you cannot discard while all tokens are available.
· Play: play a card from your hand; if it is exactly the next number of its color’s firework it is added.
· Otherwise the card is lost and 1 fuse burns.
· Playing a 5 completes a firework and returns 1 clue token for free.
· After acting, draw a replacement card (except in the final round).
End:
· Burning the 3rd fuse: the show explodes — immediate loss, 0 points.
· Completing every firework before the deck runs out: a perfect maximum score.
· Once the deck is empty, everyone (including the player who emptied it) acts once more, then the team scores the sum of the top card of each firework.

zh.name: 花札
zh.desc: 按月配对收牌凑役:来来、花合、八八三玩法
zh.rules:
目标:打出手牌与翻开的牌按月配对收取,凑役得分;全部局数打完后总分最高者获胜。
2 人玩「来来」;3 人玩「花合」或「八八」,由开局选项决定,默认花合。
准备:
· 牌共 48 张,分 12 个月,每月 4 张。
· 按牌面分光牌(20 点)、种牌(10 点)、短册(5 点)、皮牌(1 点)四类。
· 来来:每人 8 张手牌、场牌 8 张;花合/八八:每人 7 张、场牌 6 张;其余为山札。
· 共 12 局(可在开局选项改为 6 局)。
流程:
· 轮到你时打出一张手牌:场上有同月牌必须配对收取。
· 有 2 张同月时任选一张收取;有 3 张同月时四张全部收走;无同月则打出的牌留在场上。
· 随后翻开山札一张,按同样规则配对。
· 手牌全部出尽,本局结束;得分者担任下一局庄家,流局时庄家连任。
来来(2 人):
· 役:五光 10、四光 8、雨四光 7、三光 5、猪鹿蝶 5。
· 赤短 5、青短 5、花见酒 5、月见酒 5。
· 种 1 分(5 张起每多 1 张多 1 分)、短 1 分(同种)。
· 皮 1 分(10 张起每多 1 张多 1 分)。
· 光牌役只计最高一档,其余役全部叠加。
· 成役或役增值时必须二选一:「结算」立即收下役分结束本局,或「来来」继续追分。
· 来来了之后役点没有增加就不能结算。
· 结算时役点达 7 分以上翻倍;来来了之后被对方抢先结算,对方得分再翻倍。
· 起手摸到 4 张同月或 4 组对子是手役,直接获得 6 分并结束本局。
· 双方手牌出尽仍无人结算为流局,本局无人得分。
花合(3 人):
· 终局按(牌点 −88)加上自己役点的 2 倍、减去另两家役点之和计得失,三人得失相加为零。
· 役:五光 200、四光 60、赤短/青短/七短各 40、六短/表菅原/幕月盏各 30。
· 松桐坊主/猪鹿蝶/花见酒/月见酒/草/藤岛/桐岛/雨岛各 20。
· 五光、四光、松桐坊主三者只计最高一档;表菅原与七短两者只计最高一档。
八八(3 人):
· 场牌出现松/樱/芒的光牌,本场一切收支按 2 倍计;出现柳/桐的光牌按 4 倍计。
· 同场出现多张光牌时,多余的逐张结转到下一局。
· 起手自动结算手役,由另两家按本场倍率支付。
· 手役(单位贯):四三 20、握短 10、一二四 8、羽见 7、手四/双三本 6。
· 喰付/空素/素无/光一各 4;赤/短一/十一/立三本/向立三本各 3;三本/向三本各 2。
· 局中凑成下列役时,可「收役」结账,或「追役」继续。
· 五光 12 贯、四光 10、赤短/青短 7、七短 10。
· 素十六 12 贯(每多 1 张多 1 贯)。
· 追役后本局未再成役,须退还已收役分的一半;被他人抢先收役,追役者赔付双倍。
· 素十六成立时,本局已付的手役分全部退还。
· 无人收役打完全部手牌为场流,按(牌点 −88)乘以本场倍率计得失。
· 1 贯合 12 文,得分以文显示。
牌面:Louie Mantia,Wikimedia Commons,CC BY-SA 4.0。

en.name: Hanafuda
en.desc: Match cards by month to build yaku: Koi-Koi, Hana-Awase, Hachi-Hachi
en.rules:
Goal: capture cards by matching months and score with yaku; after all rounds the highest total wins.
Two players play Koi-Koi; three play Hana-Awase or Hachi-Hachi (set in the game options, default Hana-Awase).
Setup:
· 48 cards in 12 months of 4.
· Ranks: Bright (20), Animal (10), Ribbon (5) and Chaff (1).
· Koi-Koi: 8 cards each, 8 on the field; Hana-Awase/Hachi-Hachi: 7 each, 6 on the field; the rest is the draw pile.
· 12 rounds (can be changed to 6 in the game options).
Play:
· On your turn play one hand card: if the field has the same month you must capture.
· With 2 matches pick one; with 3 matches take all four; with none the card stays on the field.
· Then flip the top of the draw pile and match it the same way.
· The round ends when all hands are empty; the scorer deals next round (dealer stays after a draw).
Koi-Koi (2 players):
· Yaku: Goko 10, Shiko 8, Ame-Shiko 7, Sanko 5, Ino-Shika-Cho 5.
· Akatan 5, Aotan 5, Hanami 5, Tsukimi 5.
· Tane 1 point (from 5 animals, 1 more per extra card), Tan 1 (likewise from 5 ribbons).
· Kasu 1 point (from 10 chaff, 1 more per extra card).
· Only the best bright yaku counts; all other yaku stack.
· When a yaku forms or improves you must choose: "Stop" to bank the points and end the round, or "Koi-Koi" to press on.
· After calling Koi-Koi you may only stop once your points have increased.
· Scores of 7 or more are doubled; if you called Koi-Koi and your opponent stops first, their score is doubled.
· A starting hand of 4 of a month or 4 pairs is a lucky hand: score 6 points and end the round.
· If both hands run out with no stop, the round is a draw and nobody scores.
Hana-Awase (3 players):
· Scoring: (card points −88) plus twice your own yaku, minus the sum of both rivals' yaku; the three deltas sum to zero.
· Yaku: Goko 200, Shiko 60, Akatan/Aotan/Nanatan 40 each, Rokutan/Omote-Sugawara/Nomi 30 each.
· Matsu-Kiri/Ino-Shika-Cho/Hanami/Tsukimi/Kusa/Fuji-shima/Kiri-shima/Ame-shima 20 each.
· Of Goko, Shiko and Matsu-Kiri only the best counts; of Omote-Sugawara and Nanatan only the best counts.
Hachi-Hachi (3 players):
· A Pine/Cherry/Susuki bright on the field doubles all payments this round; a Willow/Paulownia bright quadruples them.
· Extra brights on the same field carry over, one per following round.
· Hand yaku are settled automatically at the start, paid by both rivals at the field multiplier.
· Hand yaku (in kan): Shiso 20, Nigiri 10, Ichi-Yon 8, Haneken 7, Teshi/Double Threes 6.
· Pairs/All Chaff/No Chaff/One Bright 4 each; Red Ribbons/One Ribbon/Toichi/Standing Three/Field Standing 3 each; Three of a Kind/Field Three 2 each.
· During play, forming any of these yaku lets you "Collect" or "Press":
· Goko 12 kan, Shiko 10, Akatan/Aotan 7, Nanatan 10.
· Kasu-16 12 kan, 1 more per extra card.
· If you pressed and form nothing more, you refund half of what you collected; if a rival collects first, you pay double.
· When Kasu-16 forms, all hand-yaku payments this round are refunded.
· If nobody collects before hands run out, the field washes out: settle (card points −88) times the field multiplier.
· 1 kan equals 12 mon; scores are shown in mon.
Card art: Louie Mantia, via Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0.

zh.name: 花见小路
zh.desc: 在七位艺伎之间争取支持的双人卡牌对决
zh.rules:
目标:
· 每轮争取艺伎的支持;取得至少 4 位艺伎或 11 点魅力值时获胜。
准备:
· 七位艺伎的魅力值依次为 2、2、2、3、3、4、5;对应物品牌共 21 张。
· 每轮暗中移除 1 张物品牌,双方各获得 6 张,其余 8 张形成牌堆。
流程:
· 双方轮流摸 1 张牌,再使用一枚尚未用过的行动牌;每种行动每轮各用一次。
· 密藏:从手牌暗放 1 张,轮末揭开并计入己方。
· 弃置:从手牌暗放 2 张,本轮不计分。
· 赠礼:亮出 3 张手牌,对手选 1 张归自己,其余 2 张归你。
· 竞争:亮出 4 张手牌并分成两组,对手选一组归自己,另一组归你。
结算:
· 双方揭开密藏牌,逐位比较各自获得的对应物品牌数量;较多的一方获得该艺伎。
· 双方数量相同时,该艺伎的归属标记留在原处。
· 若无人达成胜利条件,归属标记保留,全部 21 张牌重新洗牌,并交换先手。
· 一方获得 4 位艺伎、另一方同时获得至少 11 点时,11 点的一方获胜。

en.name: Hanamikoji
en.desc: A two-player card duel for the favor of seven geisha
en.rules:
Goal:
· Win the favor of at least 4 geisha or 11 Charm Points at the end of a round.
Setup:
· The seven geisha are worth 2, 2, 2, 3, 3, 4 and 5 points; there are 21 matching Item Cards.
· Remove 1 Item Card unseen each round, deal 6 to each player and leave 8 in the deck.
Play:
· Take turns drawing 1 card, then use one unused Action Marker; each action is used once per round.
· Secret: place 1 hand card face down; reveal it at round end and score it for yourself.
· Trade-off: place 2 hand cards face down; neither scores this round.
· Gift: reveal 3 hand cards; your rival takes 1 and you take the other 2.
· Competition: reveal 4 hand cards in two pairs; your rival takes one pair and you take the other.
Scoring:
· Reveal both Secret cards and compare matching Item Cards beside each geisha; the side with more wins her favor.
· On a tie, the Victory Marker stays where it was.
· If nobody wins, keep the markers, reshuffle all 21 cards and alternate the starting player.
· If one player controls 4 geisha while the other has at least 11 points, the 11-point player wins.

zh.name: 养猪趣
zh.desc: 买猪、喂猪、配种,赶在换季瘟疫前把猪卖出好价钱
zh.rules:
目标:一年(四季共 16 回合)结束时现金最多者获胜。
准备:
· 每人获得 1 块猪舍(6 列 11 行共 66 格)和 $45。
· 从起始玩家开始,每人轮流进行开局采购,最多购买 5 件(猪、道具、猪舍任意组合),买到的猪立即放入猪舍。
· 猪价:猪仔 $3、小猪 $6、中猪 $10、大猪 $15,买价与卖价相同。
· 道具各 $1;猪舍第 2 块 $10、第 3 块 $15、第 4 块 $20,之后每块递增 $5。
回合流程:
· 翻开本回合季节卡,卡上四个数字是本回合全体玩家共享的喂食、购买、交配、出售次数上限。
· 每人秘密选择一种行动,同时揭示。
· 选择同一行动的玩家平分该行动的次数:从起始玩家开始顺时针一次一次分发,分完为止。
· 从起始玩家开始,每人依次执行自己的行动,次数用完为止;每有 1 次未执行,获得 $1 补偿。
· 喂食:使 1 只猪长大一级,每只猪每回合只能喂食一次。
· 交配:使 1 只中猪或大猪产下 1 只猪仔,每只猪每回合只能交配一次。
· 购买:买一件商品;出售:按当前市价卖出 1 只猪。
· 季节卡在回合末结算效果(改价类效果在回合内即时生效)。
换季:
· 每季第 4 回合结束后换季,所有未接种疫苗的猪死亡并退回市场;此时可以立即使用疫苗救猪。
· 冬季结束后再经历最后一次换季,存活的猪按基础市价全部卖出,结算现金。
道具:
· 疫苗 $1:随时可以使用,使 1 只猪翻为已接种面;接种状态在猪长大后保留,直到卖出。
· 营养剂 $1:执行喂食时使用,猪仔或小猪额外多长大一级。
· 生产御守 $1:执行交配时使用,直接产下 1 只小猪。
猪舍摆放:
· 猪的占格:猪仔占 2 列 2 行、小猪占 2 列 3 行、中猪占 3 列 3 行、大猪占 3 列 4 行。
· 猪可以旋转,猪之间不得重叠。
· 新获得的猪若完全放不下,立即退回市场。
平手:现金相同时,把剩余道具(各 $1)和猪舍(按购入价)变卖后比较,再相同则共同获胜。

en.name: Happy Pigs
en.desc: Buy, feed and breed pigs, and sell them before the seasonal plague hits
en.rules:
Goal: have the most cash at the end of the year (16 rounds over 4 seasons).
Setup:
· Each player gets 1 field board (6×11 grid) and $45.
· Starting with the first player, each player takes a setup shopping turn, buying at most 5 items (pigs, items or fields in any combination). Pigs bought are placed in your field immediately.
· Pig prices: Piglet $3, Small $6, Average $10, Big $15; buy and sell prices are equal.
· Items cost $1 each; fields cost $10 for the 2nd, $15 for the 3rd, $20 for the 4th, then +$5 each.
Round flow:
· Reveal the Season card. Its four numbers are the shared limits for Feed, Buy, Mate and Sell this round.
· Everyone secretly picks one action, then all choices are revealed at once.
· Players who picked the same action split its uses: dealt one at a time clockwise from the first player until exhausted.
· Starting with the first player, each player performs their action up to their allotted count; each unused action pays $1 compensation.
· Feed: grow one pig one size; each pig can be fed once per round.
· Mate: one Average or Big pig births a Piglet; each pig can mate once per round.
· Buy: purchase one item; Sell: sell one pig at the current market price.
· The Season card effect resolves at the end of the round (price-changing effects apply during the round).
Change of season:
· After the 4th round of each season, all unvaccinated pigs die and return to the market; Vaccines may be used immediately to save pigs.
· After winter ends there is one last change of season, then surviving pigs are sold at base market price.
Items:
· Vaccine $1: usable at any time; flips one pig to its vaccinated side. Vaccination survives growth until the pig is sold.
· Dietary Supplement $1: used while feeding; a Piglet or Small pig grows one extra size.
· Amulet of Life $1: used while mating; the newborn is a Small pig instead of a Piglet.
Fields:
· Pig sizes in grid cells: Piglet 2 by 2, Small 2 by 3, Average 3 by 3, Big 3 by 4.
· Pigs may be rotated and must not overlap.
· A pig that cannot fit at all returns to the market immediately.
Ties: sell leftover items ($1 each) and fields (at purchase price); players still tied share the victory.

zh.name: 自然和弦
zh.desc: 叠起自然景观，构筑动物栖息地；含律动扩展与单人挑战。
zh.rules:
目标：
· 放置地形木片，构筑栖息地，以景观、动物与自然精灵得分。
准备：
· 每人使用相同一面的 23 格版图。多人供给为五组木片、五张动物牌；单人为三组、三张。
· 木片共 120 枚：灰、蓝各 23，棕 21，绿、黄各 19，红 15。
· 律动扩展加入 10 张动物牌，并允许镜像栖息地图案。
· 启用自然精灵时，首回合从私下获得的两张牌中选择一张。
流程：
· 每回合必须选择一组三枚木片，并将三枚全部放到自己的版图上。
· 木片可放空格；叠放仅限山峰、树木或建筑，不得插入已有木片下方。
· 山峰最多三枚灰色木片；树木为一枚绿色木片，下方可有零至两枚棕色木片。
· 建筑为一枚红色木片叠在一枚灰、棕或红色木片上。水域和田野不叠放。
· 有动物或精灵方块的格子不能继续叠放木片。
· 每回合可领取一张公共动物牌；尚未完成的动物牌和精灵牌合计最多四张。
· 栖息地符合牌面时，可将牌上一个方块放在图案指定、尚无方块的木片上。
· 图案可旋转；木片颜色和层数必须相符，建筑底层颜色不限。
· 动物可在放木片前、两次放片之间或放完后安置，次数不限。
· 同一木片可参与多个栖息地；动物放置后保留，即使周围地形改变。
· 放完一张牌的全部方块后，该牌不再占用四张牌的额度。
· 回合结束时才补充木片和动物牌。
计分：
· 高度一、二、三的树木分别为 1、3、7 分。
· 山峰同样按高度计分，但必须与另一座山峰相邻。
· 每片至少两格相连的田野计 5 分；整片田野只计一次。
· 建筑周围顶层木片有至少三种颜色时计 5 分。
· A 面只计最佳河流；两端间最短路径含一至六枚时计 0、2、5、8、11、15 分。
· 河流超过六枚后，每多一枚计 4 分；支流不重复计入，环按最短路径判断。
· B 面每座岛屿计 5 分，空格也属于陆地；至少计一座岛屿。
· 动物牌按已移走方块对应的最高分计分；未放出方块为零分。
· 精灵方块已放置时，按终局景观追加该牌奖励。
结束：
· 回合结束时版图空格不超过两格，或需要补货时袋中木片不足，即触发最终轮。
· 完成当前轮，使所有玩家回合数相同，再比较总分。
· 同分时，动物方块较多者获胜；仍相同则共享胜利。
单人：
· 每回合结束弃置供给中剩余六枚木片，再补充三组木片。
· 本回合未领取动物牌时，可在结束回合时替换一张公共动物牌。
· 总分达到 40、70、90、110、130、140、150、160 时分别获得一至八枚太阳。
· A 面额外一枚太阳；未用精灵额外两枚，按连通区域奖励的精灵额外一枚。

en.name: Harmonies
en.desc: Build natural landscapes and animal habitats, with Pulse and solo play.
en.rules:
Goal:
· Build habitats with landscape tokens and score landscapes, animals and Nature’s Spirits.
Setup:
· Use the same side of the 23-space boards. Display five token groups and cards, or three of each solo.
· There are 120 tokens: 23 gray, 23 blue, 21 brown, 19 green, 19 yellow and 15 red.
· Pulse adds 10 animal cards and allows reflected habitat patterns.
· With Nature’s Spirits, privately choose one of two cards on your first turn.
Play:
· Each turn, take one group of three tokens and place all three on your board.
· Place tokens on empty spaces or form legal mountains, trees or buildings; never insert tokens underneath.
· Mountains contain up to three gray tokens; trees have one green token above zero, one or two brown tokens.
· Buildings have a red token above one gray, brown or red token. Water and fields cannot be stacked.
· Never add tokens to a space occupied by an animal or spirit cube.
· You may take one animal card per turn; hold no more than four incomplete animal and spirit cards.
· When a habitat matches, move a cube from its card onto the indicated, unoccupied token.
· Rotate patterns freely; colors and heights must match. A building’s bottom token may be any legal color.
· Settle animals before, between or after placing tokens, as often as you wish.
· Tokens may serve several habitats. Settled animals remain even if surrounding landscapes change.
· A card no longer occupies an active-card slot when all its cubes have been placed.
· Refill token groups and animal cards only at the end of the turn.
Scoring:
· Trees of heights one, two and three score 1, 3 and 7 points.
· Mountains score the same, but must be adjacent to another mountain.
· Each connected field of at least two yellow tokens scores 5 points, once for the whole field.
· Each building scores 5 points if adjacent top tokens include at least three different colors.
· Side A scores your best river: shortest paths of one to six tokens score 0, 2, 5, 8, 11 and 15.
· Beyond six tokens, score 4 per extra token. Do not double-count branches; use shortest paths in loops.
· Side B scores 5 per island. Empty spaces are land; count at least one island.
· Animal cards score their highest uncovered value; cards with no placed cubes score zero.
· A settled Nature’s Spirit adds its bonus based on the final landscape.
Ending:
· Trigger the final round with at most two empty board spaces, or insufficient tokens when refilling.
· Finish the round so everyone has played equally, then compare total scores.
· Ties favor the player with more animal cubes. Further ties share victory.
Solo:
· Discard the six unchosen supply tokens at turn end, then refill all three groups.
· If you took no animal card this turn, you may replace one public animal card at turn end.
· Scores of 40, 70, 90, 110, 130, 140, 150 and 160 earn one through eight suns.
· Add one sun for side A; add two without a spirit, or one for a spirit rewarding connected groups.

zh.name: 热力狂飙
zh.desc: 换挡冲刺,管理引擎热量,过弯别超速
zh.rules:
目标:最先完成规定圈数者胜;同回合冲线比超出终点距离,再并列则贴赛车线者靠前。
准备:
· 选择赛道(长度、圈数与弯道限速各异),按随机杆位在起点线后的发车格落位。
· 每人 18 张牌:1-4 速各三张、滑行(0)、全速(5)、备用热量与三张压力牌。
· 起手抽 7 张。
· 引擎中放入(赛道热量数减一)张热量牌,最后一张以备用热量牌代替、混入牌库。
· 备用热量牌打出时按 0 速计算,冷却进引擎后与普通热量无异。
流程:每回合全员同时行动,之后按车位从前到后逐车结算。
· 规划:换挡并暗打出等于档位数的牌;升降一档免费,连换两档须先从引擎支付 1 点热量。
· 亮牌结算:全员亮牌;压力牌逐张翻出牌库顶牌,直到翻出 1-4 基础速度牌定值。
· 翻牌时翻出的其他牌进弃牌堆;按总速前进,落点满员逐格后退。
· 反应:末位车手获得 1 点肾上腺素速度;1 档可冷却 3 点、2 档可冷却 1 点。
· 冷却即将等量热量牌从手牌放回引擎;也可支付 1 点热量翻牌库顶牌推进。
· 滑流:你的落点格有他车、或紧随他车之后一格时,可再前进 2 格。
· 滑流不计弯道超速、不触发弯检,也不可滑过终点线。
· 弃牌:可弃任意手牌;热量与压力牌不可弃。补牌阶段补至 7 张。
弯道:每越过一条弯线,超出限速的部分须从引擎支付等量热量。
· 付不起立即打滑:退回弯线前第一个空位,按当前档位获得 1-2 张压力牌,降回 1 档。
结束:全部车手冲线后按冲线名次结算。
改装(Garage,可选):
· 开赛前进行 3 轮蛇形选秀(车尾、车头、车尾依次先选),每轮市场为人数加 3 张。
· 每轮选秀后弃掉市场余卡并换新;每人选 3 张升级卡,替换起手升级后洗入牌库。
· 起手升级指滑行、全速、备用热量三张。
· 升级卡符号:🔥 打出时必须支付 1 点热量(付不起则弃掉此卡,改为翻牌定值)。
· 🗑️ 打出时从牌库顶弃掉所示张数;⏱️ 本回合第一条弯线限速按所示增减。
· ❄️ 打出后可冷却所示点数;🧘 反应步可弃掉所示张数的压力牌。
· 💨 滑流距离增加所示格数;🎣 从弃牌堆取回所示张数的牌洗回牌库。
· ♻️ 可将此卡放回牌库顶;👆 反应步可从手牌直接打出。
· ⚡ 本回合每翻一张牌,速度加 1。
· 翻牌(压力/推进/⚡)只认 1-4 基础速度牌,翻出的升级卡直接弃掉。
传奇车手(Legends,可选):
· 由牌堆自动驾驶的虚拟对手,与玩家一起随机混入发车格。
· 每回合第一辆传奇车行动时,揭示一张全员共用的传奇卡。
· 已过传奇线(弯前 7 格):按「下一弯限速加菱形值」前进,一次移动不跨越两条弯线。
· 未过传奇线:按顶速前进;若会越过弯线,则停在弯前编号格(编号为菱形值 0-3)。
· 传奇车不参与滑流、不耗热、不冷却;判定末位肾上腺素时计入车数,但自身不受益。
· 传奇牌堆抽空时立即重洗。

en.name: Heat
en.desc: Shift gears, manage engine heat, mind the corners
en.rules:
Goal: first to complete the required laps wins; same-round finishers rank by distance past the line, then by racing-line position.
Setup:
· Pick a track (length, laps and corner speed limits differ); cars fill grid slots behind the start line in a random pole order.
· Each deck has 18 cards: three each of speeds 1-4, Coast (0), Full Send (5), an Extra Heat, and three Stress cards.
· Draw a starting hand of 7.
· Your engine holds (the track’s Heat minus one) Heat cards; the last one enters the deck as the Extra Heat card.
· Extra Heat plays as speed 0, and becomes ordinary Heat once cooled into the engine.
Play: everyone acts at once each round, then cars resolve from front to back.
· Plan: shift gears and play face-down as many cards as your gear; shifting one gear is free, shifting two first costs 1 Heat from the engine.
· Reveal: all cards flip; each Stress card flips the top of your deck until a basic 1-4 speed card sets its value.
· Any other cards flipped this way go to the discard; move your total speed, and full landing spaces drop you back.
· React: the rearmost driver gains 1 adrenaline speed; in gear 1 you may cool 3, in gear 2 cool 1.
· Cooling returns that many Heat cards from hand to the engine; you may also pay 1 Heat to flip the top card and move (Boost).
· Slipstream: if your landing space holds another car, or sits directly behind one, you may move 2 more spaces.
· Slipstream never counts for corner speeding, never triggers corner checks, and may not cross the finish line.
· Discard: discard any cards you like (Heat and Stress cannot be discarded); then draw back up to 7.
Corners: for each corner line you cross, pay Heat from the engine equal to your excess speed.
· If you cannot pay, you spin out: drop to the first open space before the line, take 1-2 Stress cards by gear, and reset to gear 1.
End: once every driver has finished, rank by finishing order.
Garage (optional):
· Before the race, draft upgrades in 3 snake rounds (back marker, then leader, then back marker picks first); each market has as many cards as players plus 3.
· Leftover market cards are discarded and refreshed between rounds; your 3 drafted cards replace the starting upgrades and are shuffled into your deck.
· The starting upgrades are Coast, Full Send and Extra Heat.
· Upgrade symbols: 🔥 must pay 1 Heat when played (if you cannot, discard it and flip for a value instead).
· 🗑️ discard the shown number of cards from the top of your deck; ⏱️ adjust the first corner’s speed limit this round by the shown amount.
· ❄️ cool the shown amount after playing; 🧘 during React you may discard the shown number of Stress cards.
· 💨 slipstream distance increased by the shown amount; 🎣 take the shown number of cards from your discard and shuffle them into your deck.
· ♻️ return this card to the top of your deck; 👆 during React you may play it directly from hand.
· ⚡ this turn, gain 1 speed for each card flipped.
· Flipping (Stress/Boost/⚡) only counts basic 1-4 speed cards; flipped upgrades are discarded.
Legends (optional):
