The round ends only when the tracker reaches the top; it cannot be used in second position. Stored resources carry over. Both players finish before cooperative or competitive decisions and the next round. Solo ratings: 10–19 Needs work, 20–29 Respectable, 30–39 Exceptional, 40+ Astounding.
Cooperative:
Choose Famine, Eruption, or Hurricane. At a round end, jointly pay the full current disaster cost, multiplied by the player count, to advance one level. Contributions can be split freely. Complete all 3 levels by the end of round 8 to win together; otherwise everyone loses. The group score is the lowest individual score. One optional ability may be used: Storage banks resources for the next disaster payment; Rebuild lets each player move any one card to the top at each round start after activation; Shipping lets each player pay all or part of another player’s cost once per round after activation.
Competitive:
· Casual: randomly choose one Forest, Sea, and Mountain Outpost. At a round end, upgrade all 3 corresponding Loggers, Canoe Houses, or Quarries to at least level 1 to claim it. If both qualify in the same round, remove it without an award.
· Speed: purchase in the order players reached their trackers, one Outpost at a time for 1 wood, 1 fish, and 1 stone. Purchase from 4 points down to 2 points. Continue alternating until both pass; passing ends that player’s purchases for this round. With Villagers enabled, 3 random Villagers replace Outposts.
Villagers:
Solo and Casual add 3 random unique Villagers between the buildings and tracker; Casual excludes Villagers printed on the chosen Outpost backs. Recruit by paying their cost, then place them after the tracker permanently. Chief scores Housing upgrade arrows, Merchant scores Market and Trade House arrows, and Priest scores 5. At each round start, choose Active abilities: Builder reduces each cost by 1 resource for the round; Elder raises storage capacity to 5; Wayfinder and Raider can store their resources but score −4 and −6 respectively.
Feats:
Solo endings check 9 achievements and save unlocks for future games. Selected earned Feats begin after the tracker. Any number is Easy, one is Medium, none is Hard. Statue of Trust, Strength of Spirit, and Horn of Honor still require the printed upgrades. Strength of Spirit requires both Housing cards at level 3 before flipping. Tooth of the Beast and Axe of Greatness each upgrade one matching building at setup; Vision Stone moves any one card to the top at setup; Monument of Glory may be stored only once per game.

zh.name: 仙境梦游
zh.desc: 把牌接进游行队伍,别被迫收走太多——分数最低者胜
zh.rules:
目标:终局计分后总分最低者获胜。分数来自面前收走的牌,收牌越少越好。
准备:
· 牌共 66 张,分 6 种颜色,每色 11 张,面值从 0 到 10。
· 每人获得 5 张手牌;桌面翻出 6 张排成一列作为游行队伍。
· 队伍一端是队首,另一端是队尾。
流程:
· 轮到你时,从手牌中选 1 张放到队尾,再从摸牌堆摸 1 张补回手牌。
· 队伍原有张数大于打出牌的面值时触发收牌:从队尾向队首跳过与面值等量的牌。
· 更早入队的牌进入离队判定;张数不超过面值时无人离队。
· 进入离队判定的牌中,与打出牌同色的牌全部被你收走,放到面前按颜色分列。
· 面值小于或等于打出牌面值的牌也同样被你收走。
· 打出面值 0 的牌时,全队都进入离队判定。
结束:
· 有玩家面前集齐 6 种颜色,或摸牌堆耗尽时,进入最后一轮。
· 最后一轮包括触发者在内,每人再出 1 张牌,不再摸牌。
· 最后一轮结束后,每人从手牌中选 2 张弃置,剩余 2 张加入面前。
计分:
· 逐色比较面前该色的张数:张数最多的玩家(可并列)该色每张只计 1 分。
· 其余玩家该色的牌按面值计分;二人局须比对方多至少 2 张才算最多。
· 总分最低者获胜;平分则面前总牌数更少者获胜。

en.name: Parade
en.desc: Play cards into the parade and avoid collecting them — lowest score wins
en.rules:
Goal: After final scoring, the lowest total wins. Points come from the cards collected in front of you.
Setup:
· There are 66 cards in 6 colors, 11 cards per color, with values from 0 to 10.
· Each player receives 5 hand cards; 6 cards are revealed in a row as the parade.
· One end of the parade is the front and the other end is the back.
Play:
· On your turn, play 1 card from your hand to the back of the parade, then draw 1 card.
· If the parade had more cards than the played card’s value, cards are taken: skip that many cards from the back.
· The earlier cards enter the leaving check; if the parade was short enough, nothing leaves.
· Among the cards in the leaving check, you collect every card of the played card’s color.
· You also collect every card with a value less than or equal to the played card.
· When a card with value 0 is played, the whole parade enters the leaving check.
End:
· When a player has collected all 6 colors, or the draw pile runs out, the final round begins.
· In the final round, everyone, including that player, plays 1 more card without drawing.
· Afterwards, each player discards 2 cards from hand; the remaining 2 join the collected cards.
Scoring:
· For each color, the player with the most cards of it (ties included) scores only 1 point per card.
· All other players score the printed values; with 2 players you need at least 2 more cards to have the most.
· The lowest total wins; on a tie, the player with fewer collected cards wins.

zh.name: 拼布艺术
zh.desc: 双人对决:买补丁、缝被子,纽扣省着花
zh.rules:
目标:双方各自缝制一床 9 格见方的被子;终局得分 = 剩余纽扣 − 每个空格扣 2 分,分高者胜。
回合:
· 时间轨上落后的一方行动(可能连续行动);同格时后到的一方先动。
行动(二选一):
· 买补丁:从中立标记起顺时针的前 3 块中选 1 块,支付纽扣并缝到被子上。
· 补丁可旋转、翻面,不可重叠;放下后时间标记前进补丁标注的格数。
· 前进:跳到对手的前一格,每前进 1 格获得 1 枚纽扣。
时间轨:
· 经过纽扣格:按被子上印的纽扣总数领取纽扣。
· 经过皮革格:获得单格皮革补丁并立即补上(共 5 块,先到先得)。
· 首个拼出完整 7 格见方区域的玩家获得 7 分奖励牌。
结束:
· 双方都抵达终点后结算;平分则先抵达者胜。

en.name: Patchwork
en.desc: A two-player duel: buy patches, sew your quilt, spend buttons wisely
en.rules:
Goal: each player sews a 9×9 quilt. Final score = buttons left − 2 per empty space; highest wins.
Turns:
· The player behind on the time track acts (possibly several turns in a row); on the same space, the last to arrive goes first.
Actions — pick one:
· Buy a patch: choose 1 of the 3 patches clockwise from the neutral token, pay buttons, and sew it onto your quilt.
· Patches may be rotated and flipped but not overlapped; after placing, advance your time token by the patch's time cost.
· Advance: jump to the space right in front of your opponent and gain 1 button per space moved.
Time track:
· Passing a button space: collect income equal to the buttons printed on your quilt.
· Passing a leather space: take the single-cell leather patch and place it immediately (5 total, first come).
· The first player to complete a solid 7×7 area gets the 7-point bonus tile.
End:
· Once both reach the final space, scores are settled; a tie goes to the player who arrived first.

zh.name: 哲学
zh.desc: 摆想法、推连锁,先连成三连者胜
zh.rules:
目标:己方三块牌在棋盘上连成横/竖/斜一线(结论)即获胜。
准备:每人 12 种想法牌各 1 块;棋盘为 7 行 7 列切去四角共 37 格,中央九格是放置区。
回合:
· 从手牌选 1 块放进中央九格的空格,可自选朝向;全场第一手不能放正中心。
· 新放的牌若指向对手牌,立即激活结算。
· 随后检查连锁:指向刚动过的对手牌、或刚动过的自己的牌指向了对手牌,都必须激活;多个连锁同时出现时任选一个先结算。
· 每块牌每回合至多激活一次。
· 轮到自己时无处可放(手牌已空或放置区已满)直接判负。
效果:牌面三角标指向目标格,效果全部相对朝向结算(见下图鉴);转述可指己方牌。
移动通则:落点有牌则整列同向推挤;被推出棋盘的牌回到持有者手牌,之后可再放。
结束:一方连成三连即获胜(对方回合被推成也算);双方同时三连则继续。

en.name: Philosophy
en.desc: Place ideas, chain reactions, first to make 3-in-a-row wins
en.rules:
Goal: make a row of 3 of your tiles (horizontal, vertical or diagonal) — a Conclusion — to win.
Setup: each player has 12 idea tiles, one of each kind; the board is a 7×7 cross of 37 cells, the central 3×3 is the placement zone.
Turn:
· Place 1 tile from your unplayed pile onto an empty cell of the central 3×3, in any orientation; the very first placement of the game may not be the dead-center cell.
· If the new tile targets an enemy tile, it activates immediately.
· Then check chain reactions: a tile targeting a just-moved enemy tile, or one that just moved and now targets an enemy tile, must activate; if several are available, pick one first.
· Each tile activates at most once per turn.
· If you cannot place (no tiles left or the zone is full), you lose.
Effects: the triangle marks the targeted cell; all effects are relative to facing (see gallery). Rephrase may target your own tiles.
Movement: entering an occupied cell pushes the whole line; tiles pushed off the board return to their owner's pile.
End: a single Conclusion wins (even formed on the opponent's turn); if both sides conclude at once, play continues.

zh.name: 朝圣者：一场奇幻冒险
zh.desc: 招募奇妙旅伴，收集物品，穿越童话乡野，写下自己的冒险故事。
zh.rules:
目标：
带领队伍在童话乡野旅行四天，以冒险、三叶草、公共任务及可选旅程获得最高分。基础版支持1–4人；单人模式与官方驯鹰人竞争。所有玩家使用同一面的领袖。
准备：
地图有25格，其中6格为营火，放置同伴，其余格放置物品。公共区展示3张一级冒险、2张二级冒险，以及A、B、C组各一张公共任务。每位玩家获得1张手牌和1枚三叶草。随机确定先手，再从末位开始逆序选择不同角落并取得该格物品。
回合：
共4轮，每人每轮3回合。每回合依次移动、激活、冒险、补充。四种移动方式每轮各只能用一次，选择其中三种。移动图案可以旋转和翻转，先取得落点卡牌，再移动人物。营火招募同伴，其余格取得物品；落点无牌或被人物占据时，从对应牌库抽取。队伍最多有领袖与3位同伴；超限时，必须让一位原有同伴退休，并弃置其持有的物品，新同伴不能直接退休。手牌数量不限且对他人保密。
激活：
从手牌打出一张物品，激活符号匹配的领袖或同伴；也可支付1枚三叶草转换符号。角色最多持有一张物品，再激活前弃掉旧物。可以不激活而获得1枚三叶草。多项能力由玩家选择顺序，每项每次激活只执行一次；额外激活只能选择本回合尚未激活的其他角色。能力可以移动、取得指定物品、抽二选一、交换物品或预留冒险，具体图案见卡牌详情。预留通常上限1张；超过上限前先选择旧预留放回对应牌库底，再取得新的冒险。预留牌公开。
冒险与公共任务：
每回合至多完成一张冒险或报名一个公共任务，也可跳过。冒险可以来自公共展示区或自己的预留。支付物品可取自手牌及角色持物；金色物品可代替任意颜色，每支付1枚三叶草可转换一张物品的颜色。改善的指定颜色折扣可叠加，不能转换颜色；隐藏的宝藏允许每次支付1枚三叶草抵扣一张任意颜色物品。
选择符合冒险要求的参与同伴，领袖不参与。双类型同伴只能填一个位置；问号表示任意一位独立同伴。每支付2枚三叶草，可转换一位参与同伴的类型。冒险需要退休时，只能从参与者中选择对应数量，所持物品一并弃置。获得卡牌所示分数、三叶草与永久改善；新取得的完成冒险触发改善不作用于它自己。
三张公共任务分别收取3张红、蓝、绿物品，可以使用折扣及颜色转换。每位玩家最多报名两个任务，同一任务只能报名一次，每项最多三人。报名位置在终局依次获得 2、1、0 分；C组任务报名时另获得1枚三叶草。任务收集1、2、3、4张及以上匹配牌，分别获得 1、2、4、6 分。A组检查同伴类型，B组检查同伴激活符号，均包括现役与退休同伴而不包括领袖；C组检查已完成冒险，不含预留。详情说明具体收集条件。
三叶草与补充：
自己的回合中，随时可以支付2枚三叶草抽取一张物品，可重复。物品牌库耗尽时洗混弃牌；同伴不回收。回合末从上到下、从左到右补满地图空格，人物所在格不补，再补满冒险展示区；指定等级的冒险牌库耗尽时，改从另一级牌库补充，两叠均耗尽则保留空位。第二天结束后，若中间展示位仍是一级冒险，将其放回一级牌库底；已补入的二级冒险保留。从第三天起，展示区优先补为两张一级和三张二级冒险。
旅程（默认关闭）：
启用后，每人抽两张旅程保留一张，另一张放回牌库底。人物落到三个目标格时分别标记；完成三格后获得所示分数及即时奖励，再抽二选一。新旅程中的当前位置不会自动标记，必须离开再返回。终局时，未完成旅程中每个已到访的目标格也获得 1 分。正式二版共17张旅程牌。
单人模式：
玩家先手。驯鹰人与猎鹰从中央格出发，取得中央物品及额外一张物品。四档难度分别使用AB、BC、AD、CD两组共6张单人牌，每轮洗混。每次对手回合翻两张牌，先移动猎鹰，再移动驯鹰人；图案不旋转，选择编号最小的有效目标。每张单人牌的顶部奖励都先领取。对手招募同伴时另获得1枚三叶草，同伴无能力与数量限制；只要有2枚三叶草，立即换一张物品。
第二张牌的箭头决定检查公共冒险与任务的方向。对手完成第一张付得起物品的冒险，忽略同伴、退休要求和改善，金色物品仅在必要时使用；没有可完成冒险时尝试报名公共任务。终局时，对手每张剩余物品获得 1 分，三叶草不计分；启用旅程时另加5分。
终局：
第四轮结束后，计算已完成冒险分数、每3枚剩余三叶草1分、报名位置及公共任务收集分、旅程分。总分最高者获胜；平分时比较剩余手牌，仍同分则共享胜利。

en.name: Pilgrims: Curious Adventures
en.desc: Gather curious companions and useful items, cross a fairytale land, and collect your own stories.
en.rules:
Goal:
Lead a party through four days of fairytale travels. Score adventures, clovers, public quests, and optional journeys. The game supports 1–4 players; solo play uses the official Falconer. All leaders use the same side.
Setup:
The 25-space map holds companions on six campfires and items elsewhere. Display three level I adventures, two level II adventures, and one quest each from groups A, B, and C. Each player receives one item and one clover. Choose a random first player, then select different corners in reverse turn order and take those items.
Turns:
Play four rounds, with three turns per player per round. Each turn has Move, Activate, Adventure, and Replenish phases. Use three of the four travel diagrams each round, each at most once. Diagrams may be rotated or reflected. Take the destination card before moving your figure. Campfires recruit companions; other spaces provide items. Empty or occupied spaces give a card from the corresponding deck. Your party holds a leader and up to three companions. To recruit beyond that limit, retire an existing companion and discard its held item; you cannot retire the newly recruited companion. Your private hand has no limit.
Activation:
Play a hand item under a character with a matching activation symbol, or spend one clover to convert the symbol. A character holds at most one item; discard an old item before reactivation. Instead of activating, gain one clover. Choose the order of multiple abilities, using each once per activation. Extra activations must use other characters not yet activated this turn. Abilities provide movement, specific map items, draw-two-keep-one drafts, item swaps, or adventure reserves; inspect the diagrams for details. The normal reserve limit is one. Return an old reserve to its deck before taking a replacement. Reserved adventures are public.
Adventures and quests:
Complete at most one adventure or join one public quest per turn, or skip. Adventures may come from the display or your reserve. Pay with hand items and/or held items. Gold is wild. Spend one clover to convert an item's color. Permanent color discounts stack and cannot change color; Hidden Treasure lets you spend one clover to discount any one item.
Choose participating companions matching the party requirement. Leaders never participate. A dual-type companion fills only one requirement, and each question mark requires a separate companion. Spend two clovers to convert a participant's type. If retirement is required, retire the required number of participants and discard their held items. Gain the adventure's points, clovers, and permanent improvement. An improvement triggered by completing adventures does not trigger for itself.
The three quest positions cost three red, blue, or green items respectively, with discounts and conversions allowed. Join at most two quests, each only once; each quest holds at most three players. Signing positions score 2, 1, and 0 VP. Group C quests also grant one clover immediately. Collecting 1, 2, 3, or at least 4 matching cards scores 1, 2, 4, or 6 VP. Group A counts companion types and group B their activation symbols, including active and retired companions but excluding leaders. Group C counts completed adventures, never reserves. Inspect each quest for its objective.
Clovers and replenishment:
At any time during your turn, spend two clovers to draw one item, repeatedly if affordable. Reshuffle item discards when needed; companions do not recycle. Refill unoccupied map spaces from top to bottom and left to right, then refill adventures. If the required adventure deck is empty, draw from the other level; leave the space empty if both decks are exhausted. After day two, return the middle display card to the bottom of the level I deck only if it is still a level I card; keep any level II card already there. From day three, refill toward two level I and three level II display cards.
Journeys (off by default):
Draw two journeys, keep one, and return the other to the bottom. Mark its three destinations as your figure lands on them. Completing all three grants its points and any immediate reward, then draft another journey. A new journey does not mark your current space until you leave and return. Each visited space on an unfinished journey scores one VP. The second printing has 17 journeys.
Solo:
You play first. The Falconer and falcon start at the center, taking its item plus one extra item. The four difficulties use AB, BC, AD, or CD, six solo cards reshuffled each round. Reveal two cards per opponent turn, moving the falcon first and the Falconer second. Do not rotate diagrams; take the lowest-numbered valid destination. Grant each card's top reward before movement. Recruiting a companion grants the Falconer one clover; companions have no abilities or limit. Immediately exchange each two clovers for an item.
The second card's arrow sets the order for checking adventures and then quests. The Falconer completes the first affordable adventure, ignoring party requirements, retirement, and improvements, and using gold only when necessary. If none is affordable, try to join a quest. Each remaining Falconer item scores one VP, clovers score nothing, and journeys add a flat five VP if enabled.
Scoring:
After round four, score completed adventures, one VP per three remaining clovers, signing positions and quest objectives, and journeys. Highest total wins. Ties go to the player with more hand items; remaining ties share victory.

zh.name: X行星之谜
zh.desc: 推理 X 行星的藏身扇区，提出理论，抢先定位
zh.rules:
目标:推理出 X 行星藏在哪个扇区;首位正确定位(连同左右邻格的天体)触发终局,总分最高者获胜。
盘面:12 个扇区围成一圈,各藏一个天体:
· 4 颗小行星(两两相邻),2 颗彗星(只在带标记的素数扇区)。
· 2 朵气体云(都与空扇区相邻),1 颗矮行星(不与 X 相邻)。
· 1 颗 X 行星(显示为空),2 个真正的空扇区。
回合:棋子最靠后的玩家行动(同格先到先动)。
· 行动后棋子按花费前进,箭头转到最靠后棋子处。
· 经过理论格(每 3 格)触发理论阶段;第一圈经过扇区 9 触发 X1 会议。
行动(四选一):
· 调查:选一种天体与可见天空内的连续区间,私下得知数量;调查「空」会把 X 计入。
· 调查按区间宽前进:宽 1-3 格前进 4 步,宽 4-6 格前进 3 步。
· 锁定:私下得知一个可见扇区的内容,限 2 次,前进 4 步。
· 研究:私下查看一个主题的规则,不能连续两回合研究,前进 1 步。
· 定位:指认 X 与左右邻格,前进 5 步,只公布成败。
理论:
· 理论阶段每人可秘密提交 1 个「某扇区是某天体」,进入该扇区评审轨最外格。
· 每个理论阶段所有理论内移一格;到最内格时评审:正确则该扇区确认公开,错误则移除并罚前进 1 格。
· 被确认扇区上的其余理论全部翻开,错误者同样移除并罚前进 1 格;每种天体的理论标记有限。
终局:有人定位成功后,落后其 1-5 格的玩家按从后到前各获最后一次机会。
· 落后 1-3 格可提交 1 个理论,4-5 格可提交 2 个,或尝试定位。
计分:首位定位 X 者获得 10 分,其余定位成功者按落后格数的两倍得分。
· 正确理论按天体获得 2/3/4/4 分;每个你最先(含并列)猜中的扇区获得 1 分领袖分。
· 平手依次比定位分、领袖分,再平则共享胜利。

en.name: The Search for Planet X
en.desc: Deduce which sector hides Planet X, publish theories, locate it first
en.rules:
Goal: deduce which sector hides Planet X; the first player to locate it (naming both neighbors) triggers the endgame — highest score wins.
Board: 12 sectors in a ring, each hiding an object:
· 4 asteroids (each adjacent to another), 2 comets (marked prime sectors only).
· 2 gas clouds (each adjacent to an empty sector), 1 dwarf planet (not adjacent to X).
· 1 Planet X (appears empty), 2 truly empty sectors.
Turns: the player furthest back acts (earliest arrival breaks ties).
· After acting, your pawn advances by the action cost and the arrow rotates to the rearmost pawn.
· Passing a theory space (every 3) triggers a theory phase; passing sector 9 on the first rotation triggers the X1 conference.
Actions — pick one:
· Survey: pick an object type and a range within the visible sky; you privately learn how many are there. Surveying "empty" counts Planet X.
· Survey cost by width: 1-3 wide advances 4 steps, 4-6 wide advances 3 steps.
· Target: privately learn one visible sector, twice per game, advances 4 steps.
· Research: privately read one topic's rule, never twice in a row, advances 1 step.
· Locate: name X and both neighbors, advances 5 steps, only success/failure is public.
Theories:
· In each theory phase everyone may secretly submit 1 theory ("sector S is object O") onto the outermost space of that sector's review track.
· All theories advance one space per theory phase; at the innermost space they are reviewed — correct ones confirm the sector, wrong ones are removed and their owners advance 1 space.
· Other theories on a confirmed sector are revealed, wrong ones likewise removed with penalty; theory tokens per object are limited.
Endgame: once someone locates X, players 1-5 sectors behind (back to front) each get one last chance.
· 1-3 behind: submit 1 theory; 4-5 behind: submit 2 theories; or attempt a locate.
Scoring: the first locator scores 10 pts; later locators score twice their sectors behind.
· Correct theories score 2/3/4/4 by object; 1 leader point per sector you were first (or tied first) to guess.
· Ties: locate points, then leader points, then shared victory.

zh.name: L计划
zh.desc: 拿拼图、升拼块,每回合三动拼出最高分
zh.rules:
目标:完成拼图得分;黑牌堆耗尽触发终局,补完本轮再打一整轮后结算,总分最高者胜。
准备:
· 白拼图 32 张洗混;黑拼图按人数随机取(2 人 12 张 / 3 人 14 张 / 4 人 16 张)洗混。
· 两种拼图各翻开 4 张,分成两行。
· 每人起手 1 个 1 级块和 1 个 2 级块。
流程(每回合 3 个行动,任意组合):
· 拿拼图:从某行拿取 1 张明置拼图(该行补新),或从牌堆顶盲取 1 张;未完成拼图至多 4 张。
· 回收:选一行,整行按从左到右顺序放回牌堆底,重翻 4 张。
· 升级:退回 1 块,换成同级、任意更低等级或高一级的一块。
· 放置:把 1 块放进自己某张拼图的凹槽(可旋转翻面,放下不可移动)。
· 大师行动(每回合限 1 次):往自己每张未完成拼图各放至多 1 块。
完成拼图:
· 凹槽填满即完成:收回全部拼块、获得卡面奖励块,拼图放入得分堆。
· 储备里该形状拿完时,改拿同级任意块;同级也拿完时,改拿相邻等级。
结束:
· 黑牌堆空触发终局;此后黑拼图不再补充,每人每回合限拿取 1 张黑拼图。
· 收尾:依次往未完成拼图自由放块,每块扣 1 分;此时完成的拼图计分但无奖励、不回收拼块。
计分:得分堆总分 − 未完成拼图面值 − 收尾罚分;平分依次比完成张数、剩余拼块数,再平则共享胜利。

en.name: Project L
en.desc: Draft puzzles, upgrade pieces — three actions a turn to outscore everyone
en.rules:
Goal: complete puzzles for points. When the black deck runs out, finish the round and play one final round; highest score wins.
Setup:
· Shuffle 32 white puzzles; take black puzzles at random by player count (12 for 2P / 14 for 3P / 16 for 4P) and shuffle.
· Reveal 4 of each into two rows.
· Everyone starts with one level-1 and one level-2 piece.
Play (3 actions per turn, any mix):
· Take: take 1 face-up puzzle from a row (the row refills) or the top of a deck blind; at most 4 unfinished puzzles.
· Recycle: send a row's puzzles to the bottom of its deck in left-to-right order, then reveal 4 new ones.
· Upgrade: return 1 piece, take a piece of the same level, any lower level, or one level higher.
· Place: put 1 piece into a recess of one of your puzzles (rotate/flip freely; placed pieces cannot move).
· Master (once per turn): place up to 1 piece into each of your unfinished puzzles.
Completing puzzles:
· A full recess completes the puzzle: take back all its pieces, gain the depicted bonus piece, and stack it into your score pile.
· If that shape is gone from the reserve, take any piece of the same level; if the level is empty, take an adjacent level.
Game end:
· An empty black deck triggers the end; black puzzles no longer refill, and each player may take at most 1 black puzzle per turn.
· Finishing Touches: in turn order, freely place pieces into unfinished puzzles at a cost of 1 point each; puzzles completed now score but give no bonus and return no pieces.
Scoring: score pile total − face value of unfinished puzzles − finishing penalties. Ties: most completed puzzles, then most pieces left, then shared victory.

zh.name: 波多黎各
zh.desc: 选择角色，建设岛屿，生产、贸易并装船得分；采用 2020 豪华版规则。
zh.rules:
游戏目标：
· 通过开垦种植园、兴建建筑、生产和装运货物，取得胜利分。
· 游戏结束时，总分最高的玩家获胜；平分时按文末规则比较。
· 本说明采用 2020 版规则，扩展内容仅在相应选项开启时使用。
岛屿与资源：
· 每位玩家拥有一座岛屿，种植区与城市各有 12 格。
· 每块种植园、采石场或森林占用一格种植区。
· 小型建筑占用一格城市，大型建筑占用两格城市。
· 人员分为普通工人与贵族；未安排上岗的人员留在自己的港口。
· 种植园和采石场各有一个工位；建筑的工位数以其标示为准。
· 工位上有人即为上岗；无人上岗的种植园不生产，建筑能力不生效。
· 森林与雕像没有工位，其特殊规则见对应建筑说明。
· 货物分为玉米、靛蓝、糖、烟草和咖啡，以货桶计数。
· 钱币用于购买建筑等支出，胜利分筹码用于记录游戏过程中取得的分数。
· 货物、人员与胜利分筹码均有公共供应；钱币没有数量限制。
· 自己的货物与港口人员属于自己，不属于公共供应。
· 钱币、货物与人员公开；各人的胜利分筹码在终局前保密。
游戏准备：
· 确定人数与扩展选项后，按顺时针方向确定座次。
· 第一席玩家担任首轮总督，其后按顺时针方向传递总督。
· 三人游戏每人有 2 枚钱币；四人有 3 枚；五人有 4 枚。
· 三人和四人游戏，前两席各有一块靛蓝种植园，其余各有一块玉米种植园。
· 五人游戏，前三席各有一块靛蓝种植园，后两席各有一块玉米种植园。
· 所有起始种植园均无人上岗；玩家起初没有建筑、货物、人员或胜利分筹码。
· 三人游戏，筹码供应为 76 分，普通工人供应为 55 名，招聘所有 3 名。
· 四人游戏，筹码供应为 101 分，普通工人供应为 75 名，招聘所有 4 名。
· 五人游戏，筹码供应为 126 分，普通工人供应为 95 名，招聘所有 5 名。
· 上述普通工人数量适用于基础游戏；贵族扩展另行调整人员供应。
· 三人游戏使用容量为 4、5、6 桶的三艘公共货船。
· 四人游戏使用容量为 5、6、7 桶的三艘公共货船。
· 五人游戏使用容量为 6、7、8 桶的三艘公共货船。
· 货物供应为玉米 10 桶、靛蓝 11 桶、糖 11 桶、烟草 9 桶、咖啡 9 桶。
· 种植园总数为玉米 10 块、靛蓝 12 块、甘蔗 11 块、烟草 9 块、咖啡 8 块。
· 先发放起始种植园，再将其余种植园洗混，组成暗置抽取堆。
· 公开翻出比玩家人数多一块的种植园，另备 8 块采石场。
· 交易所与所有公共货船起初均为空，角色牌上没有钱币。
· 使用拓荒者、建筑师、工头、工匠、商人和船长六种基本角色。
· 三人不使用勘探者；四人加入一张勘探者；五人加入两张。
· 同名的两张勘探者牌视为两张独立角色牌，可以在同一轮分别选择。
· 未开启新建筑扩展时，基础建筑直接进入市场；贵族建筑随贵族选项加入。
· 三至五人时，两种小型生产建筑各有 4 座，其余基础生产建筑各有 3 座。
· 每种小型商业建筑各有 2 座，每种大型建筑各有 1 座。
双人游戏：
· 两人各有 3 枚起始钱币；第一席持靛蓝种植园，第二席持玉米种植园。
· 胜利分筹码供应为 65 分，普通工人供应为 40 名，招聘所初始有 2 名普通工人。
· 使用容量为 4 桶和 6 桶的两艘公共货船，并加入一张勘探者。
· 每种货物比通常供应减少 2 桶，每种种植园总数减少 3 块。
· 采石场仅使用 5 块；每种商业建筑各有 1 座，每种生产建筑各有 2 座。
· 每轮两人交替选择角色，各选择三次，共执行六次角色阶段。
· 所选扩展先按其规则准备，再应用双人数量调整。
· 贵族与庆典所需的额外准备，见各扩展章节。
每轮流程：
· 从总督开始，按顺时针方向轮流选择一张本轮尚未被选过的角色牌。
· 选择角色时，先取得该牌上积累的全部钱币，再执行该角色阶段。
· 角色选择者先行动，并享有该角色的特权。
· 其余玩家按顺时针方向依次跟随行动，但不享有选择者的特权。
· 勘探者与海盗仅由选择者行动，其他玩家不跟随。
· 一个角色阶段全部结束后，才由下一位玩家选择角色。
· 三至五人时，每人每轮选择一次角色；双人按前述规则各选择三次。
· 本轮已选角色暂不可再选，直到下一轮重新开放。
· 轮末在每张未选角色牌上放置 1 枚钱币；海盗牌不积累钱币。
· 将角色牌恢复为可选状态，总督传给下一席，然后开始新一轮。
拓荒者阶段：
· 每位玩家可以从公开种植园中取得一块，放在自己的空种植区。
· 选择者可以改取一块公共供应中的采石场，代替公开种植园。
· 玩家可以放弃取地；种植区已有 12 块田地时，不能再取得田地。
· 新取得的种植园或采石场没有人员，须安排人员后才会生效。
· 庄园、建筑小屋、济贫院、图书馆与林务所的例外，见各建筑说明。
· 所有玩家完成后，弃置剩余公开种植园，再翻出人数加一块的新种植园。
· 暗置抽取堆用尽时，将弃置种植园洗混为新的抽取堆。
· 采石场不进入种植园抽取堆，其数量受公共供应限制。
建筑师阶段：
· 每位玩家可以支付钱币，从建筑市场购买一座建筑，也可以放弃。
· 所购建筑必须仍有库存，且自己的城市必须有足够空格。
· 每位玩家不能拥有两座同名建筑；一次行动最多购买一座。
· 选择者的建造费用减少 1 枚钱币。
· 自己的每座已上岗采石场可减少 1 枚钱币，受建筑市场行数限制。
· 第一至第四行，采石场合计最多分别优惠 1、2、3、4 枚钱币。
· 按市场行数确定采石场上限；雕像属于第四行，上限仍为 4 枚。
· 森林、区公所与角色特权可另行叠加，最终费用最低为零。
· 新购建筑通常没有人员；大学可为有工位的新建筑立即安排一名人员。
· 建筑一经建成即计入城市占格；填满 12 格会触发本轮结束后的终局。
工头阶段：
· 选择者先从普通工人供应额外取得 1 名工人，放入自己的港口。
· 供应没有普通工人时，不能从招聘所补领这项特权。
· 随后从选择者开始，按顺时针方向每次从招聘所领取一名人员。
· 重复分配直到招聘所无人；人数不能整除时，部分玩家会多领一名。
· 每位玩家可以重新安排自己的全部人员，包括原有上岗人员与港口人员。
· 每个工位最多安排一名人员，森林和雕像不能安排人员。
· 人员不足时，可自行选择工位，但必须把所有人员安排上岗。
· 人员多于工位时，必须填满全部工位，多余人员留在自己的港口。
· 阶段结束时，统计所有玩家建筑中的空工位总数，不计种植园空工位。
· 下一批招聘人数取该总数与玩家人数中的较大值。
· 从普通工人供应补充招聘所；基础游戏补不足时，触发本轮结束后的终局。
· 使用贵族扩展时，人员种类、领取方式与结束条件另有规定。
工匠阶段：
· 每位玩家按自己的已上岗种植园与生产建筑，从公共供应取得货物。
· 每块已上岗玉米种植园最多生产 1 桶玉米，不需要生产建筑。
· 其余货物须同时有对应的已上岗种植园与生产建筑工位。
· 产量取已上岗种植园数与对应生产建筑上岗人数中的较小值。
· 例如有三块已上岗靛蓝种植园、两个已上岗靛蓝工位，最多生产 2 桶靛蓝。
· 玩家按行动顺序领取，共用同一供应；供应不足时，只能取得尚余货桶。
· 玩家可以少取或不取某种货物，未领取的产量以后不补发。
· 所有玩家生产后，选择者可从自己本次实际生产过的种类中额外取得 1 桶。
· 额外货桶也须有公共供应；没有实际生产货物时，不能领取。
· 工厂与专门工厂按正常生产计算钱币，不因选择者领取额外货桶而重新计算。
商人阶段：
· 每位玩家可以出售自己的一桶货物，也可以放弃出售。
· 基础售价为玉米 0 枚、靛蓝 1 枚、糖 2 枚、烟草 3 枚、咖啡 4 枚钱币。
· 选择者成功出售时，额外取得 1 枚钱币；未出售则没有这项奖励。
· 交易所最多容纳四桶货物；通常不能出售其中已有的货物种类。
· 事务所允许重复种类，贸易站允许改为私人出售，详见各建筑说明。
· 玉米基础售价虽为零，仍可以出售，并可取得适用的特权和市场奖励。
· 整个阶段结束时，交易所若已满四桶，将全部货桶归还公共供应。
· 交易所未满时，货物留存至以后的商人阶段，不会每轮自动清空。
船长阶段：
· 从选择者开始，玩家按顺时针方向反复轮流装船，直到无人继续装运。
· 每次公共装船只能选择一种货物；玩家可以选择本次要装运的种类。
· 只要仍能向公共货船装运，就不能直接放弃；私人装运仍可优先使用。
· 每艘公共货船只能装一种货物；同种货物不能同时装在两艘公共货船上。
· 若已有装载该货物的货船，必须使用该船，并尽可能装满其剩余空间。
· 若该种货物的货船已满，不能另开一艘空船装同种货物。
· 若没有对应货船，须在空船中选择本次能装走最多该种货物的船。
· 所选货船能装多少就必须装多少，不能主动少装。
· 两艘船都能装走全部所选货物时，可以任选其一。
· 例如有 5 桶玉米，空船容量为 4 和 6 桶，须向 6 桶船装入全部 5 桶。
· 每实际装运一桶货物，取得 1 分胜利分筹码。
· 装运货物不要求自己拥有或启用对应的生产建筑。
· 选择者在本阶段第一次实际装运时额外取得 1 分，每阶段仅一次。
· 选择者没有装运货物时，不会取得这项特权分数。
· 码头与小型码头提供私人装运，其使用次数、货物范围和分数另有规定。
· 私人装运可以放弃；同一玩家可能在本阶段多次轮到装船。
· 满载公共货船仅在整个船长阶段结束时卸货，货物归还公共供应。
· 阶段进行期间，满船不会提前清空；未满货船继续保留原有货物。
船长阶段的仓储：
· 所有装运结束后，每位玩家决定保留哪些未装出的货物。
· 没有仓储建筑时，每人合计只能保留一桶货物，可以自行选择种类。
· 小型仓库额外保留一种货物的全部货桶，大型仓库额外保留两种。
· 两座仓库同时生效时，额外保留三种货物的全部货桶。
· 基础的一桶可以属于仓库所保留种类以外的另一种货物。
· 储藏室再增加任意三桶的保留数量，也可与两种仓库叠加。
· 例如小型仓库可保留全部 4 桶玉米，再使用基础额度保留 1 桶咖啡。
· 超出保留范围的货桶全部归还公共供应；仓储无需支付钱币。
勘探者阶段：
· 仅选择者从钱币供应取得 1 枚钱币，其他玩家不行动。
· 这枚钱币与角色牌原有积币分别领取。
建筑能力通则：
· 除雕像外，建筑必须至少有一名人员上岗，其能力才生效。
· 生产建筑的上岗人数决定生产能力，并非上岗一名即取得全部产能。
· 建筑的印刷胜利分不要求人员上岗，游戏结束时一律计入。
· 大型建筑的额外计分能力，须在终局时有人员上岗才能结算。
· 一项能力只在其规定时机结算，不会因随后启用建筑而追溯补发。
· 不同建筑的能力可以叠加，但仍须遵守各自的条件、次数与数量限制。
· 下列建筑说明中的人员，在贵族扩展中也可由贵族替代，除非明确区分种类。
基础生产建筑：
小型靛蓝作坊：
· 本建筑有一个工位；上岗后，配合一块已上岗靛蓝种植园，最多生产 1 桶靛蓝。
· 产量受公共货物供应限制；没有对应已上岗种植园时不生产。
小型糖厂：
· 本建筑有一个工位；上岗后，配合一块已上岗甘蔗种植园，最多生产 1 桶糖。
· 产量受公共货物供应限制；没有对应已上岗种植园时不生产。
靛蓝作坊：
· 本建筑有 3 个工位，每名上岗人员提供 1 桶靛蓝的生产能力。
· 每桶货物还须有一块对应的已上岗种植园，整座建筑最多生产 3 桶。
· 实际领取数量受公共供应限制；多座同类生产建筑的产能可以合计。
糖厂：
· 本建筑有 3 个工位，每名上岗人员提供 1 桶糖的生产能力。
· 每桶货物还须有一块对应的已上岗种植园，整座建筑最多生产 3 桶。
· 实际领取数量受公共供应限制；多座同类生产建筑的产能可以合计。
烟草加工厂：
· 本建筑有 3 个工位，每名上岗人员提供 1 桶烟草的生产能力。
· 每桶货物还须有一块对应的已上岗种植园，整座建筑最多生产 3 桶。
· 实际领取数量受公共供应限制；多座同类生产建筑的产能可以合计。
咖啡烘焙厂：
· 本建筑有 2 个工位，每名上岗人员提供 1 桶咖啡的生产能力。
· 每桶货物还须有一块对应的已上岗种植园，整座建筑最多生产 2 桶。
· 实际领取数量受公共供应限制；多座同类生产建筑的产能可以合计。
基础商业建筑：
小型市场：
· 商人阶段在交易所成功出售一桶货物时，额外取得 1 枚钱币。
· 可以与商人特权、大型市场叠加；通过贸易站私人出售时不适用。
庄园：
· 每个拓荒者阶段，在自己的正常取地行动之前，可以额外抽取一块暗置种植园。
· 抽取前须有空种植区；抽取后必须放到岛上，不能因不满意而弃置。
· 庄园所得田地不能使用济贫院领取人员；林务所允许将其改为森林。
· 如果仅余一格，庄园田地将其占满后，不能再进行正常取地。
建筑小屋：
· 拓荒者阶段，即使自己不是角色选择者，也可以改取一块采石场代替公开种植园。
· 图书馆允许取得第二块田地时，也可用本能力选择采石场；供应仍须有剩余。
小型仓库：
· 船长阶段仓储时，除基础可保留的一桶外，可以保留一种货物的全部货桶。
· 保留种类由自己选择；本能力可与大型仓库、储藏室同时使用。
济贫院：
· 拓荒者阶段正常取得第一块种植园或采石场时，可立即为其安排一名人员。
· 先从普通工人供应领取；该供应用尽时，改从招聘所领取可用人员。
· 招聘所可领取普通工人；启用贵族扩展时，也可选择其中的贵族。
· 庄园额外田地与图书馆的第二块田地均不能取得济贫院人员。
· 若将正常取得的种植园改为森林，领到的人员改放入自己的港口。
事务所：
· 商人阶段，可以向交易所出售其中已有的一种货物。
· 交易所仍最多容纳四桶；已经满载时，事务所不能让自己继续出售。
大型市场：
· 商人阶段在交易所成功出售一桶货物时，额外取得 2 枚钱币。
· 与小型市场同时启用时，两座市场合计额外取得 3 枚钱币。
· 商人特权可另行叠加；通过贸易站私人出售时，两种市场均无奖励。
大型仓库：
· 船长阶段仓储时，除基础可保留的一桶外，可以保留两种货物的全部货桶。
· 与小型仓库同时启用时，可额外保留三种货物的全部货桶；储藏室另行增加容量。
工厂：
· 每个工匠阶段，按自己正常生产实际取得的货物种类数领取钱币。
· 生产两种取得 1 枚，三种取得 2 枚，四种取得 3 枚，五种取得 5 枚钱币。
· 只生产零种或一种没有奖励；按种类计数，不按货桶总数计数。
· 玉米计入种类数；选择者随后取得的额外货桶不会重新触发奖励。
大学：
· 建筑师阶段购买有工位的新建筑时，可立即领取一名人员，放入该建筑的空工位。
· 先从普通工人供应领取；该供应用尽时，可从招聘所领取普通工人或可用贵族。
· 无论新建筑有几个工位，每次最多取得一名人员。
· 购买大学自身时没有这项奖励；雕像没有工位，也不能领取人员。
海港：
· 船长阶段每次实际装运货物时，额外取得 1 分胜利分筹码。
· 公共货船、码头和小型码头均适用；每次装运加一分，不按桶数增加。
· 可以与船长特权叠加；皇家供应商与海盗行动不属于装船。
码头：
· 每个船长阶段可以使用一次私人货船，将自己任意一种货物的全部货桶装运。
· 私人货船没有容量限制，也不受公共货船已有货物种类或满载状态影响。
· 每桶取得 1 分，货桶立即归还公共供应；适用船长、海港与灯塔奖励。
· 可以放弃私人装运；与小型码头各有一次使用机会，可在不同装船轮次使用。
基础大型建筑：
公会会馆：
· 终局时本建筑须有人员上岗，才结算以下额外分数。
· 每座小型靛蓝作坊和小型糖厂各额外取得 1 分，其余每座生产建筑各额外取得 2 分。
· 被计数的生产建筑无须上岗；贵族扩展的珠宝作坊属于大型生产建筑。
官邸：
· 终局时本建筑须有人员上岗，按自己的种植区占格数取得额外分数。
· 占用零至九格取得 4 分，占十格取得 5 分，占十一格取得 6 分，十二格取得 7 分。
· 所有种植园、采石场与森林均占格，无须有人员上岗。
要塞：
· 终局时本建筑须有人员上岗，自己的人员总数每满三名，额外取得 1 分。
· 统计种植园、采石场、建筑与港口的全部人员；贵族也计入，不足三名的余数不计分。
海关：
· 终局时本建筑须有人员上岗，自己的胜利分筹码每满 4 分，额外取得 1 分。
· 不足 4 分的余数不计；建筑印刷分、贵族分与其他终局奖励均不纳入计算。
市政厅：
· 终局时本建筑须有人员上岗，自己每座商业建筑额外取得 1 分。
· 市政厅自身也计入；其他商业建筑无须上岗。
· 所有生产建筑均不计入，贵族扩展的珠宝作坊也不计入。
新建筑扩展与市场轮选：
· 开启新建筑后，先从基础、新建筑及已启用贵族扩展的商业建筑中轮选市场。
· 从总督开始，按顺时针方向，每次选择一种尚未入市的商业建筑。
· 所选建筑的费用必须匹配一个剩余市场槽位，随后占用该槽位。
· 同种小型商业建筑成对入市；双人仅一座；大型建筑均只有一座。
· 反复轮选直到所有槽位填满；未入选的建筑本局不能购买。
· 生产建筑固定入市，不参加商业建筑轮选；珠宝作坊也属于生产建筑。
· 开启贵族扩展时，加入贵族建筑候选和相应的额外市场槽位。
黑市：
· 只有自己的钱币不足以支付建造费用时，才可以使用黑市补足差额。
· 可以归还最多一名人员、一桶货物和 1 分胜利分筹码，每项抵付 1 枚钱币。
· 最多抵付 3 枚钱币；必须花光自己的钱币，归还项目须恰好补足差额，不找零。
· 人员可以来自种植园、采石场、其他建筑或港口，但不能归还黑市自身的人员。
· 普通工人归还普通供应，贵族归还贵族供应，货物与筹码归还各自供应。
· 移走采石场、区公所或图书馆的人员后，失去的优惠也须计入最终建造费用。
· 已经触发的终局条件，不会因归还筹码或人员而撤销。
林务所：
· 本建筑启用时，新取得的种植园可以改放为森林；已在岛上的田地不能转换。
· 庄园抽取或地政所购买的暗置种植园，也可先查看再决定是否改为森林。
· 采石场不能转为森林；森林占一格种植区，没有工位，也不生产货物。
· 自己的森林每满两块，所有建造费用减少 1 枚钱币，可与其他优惠叠加。
· 已经建成的森林不再要求林务所保持启用；所有森林均视为同一种田地。
引水渠：
· 工匠阶段，已上岗靛蓝作坊或糖厂配合对应种植园能正常生产时，对应货物多产 1 桶。
· 只有大型靛蓝作坊与糖厂适用，小型靛蓝作坊和小型糖厂不能触发。
· 两种大型建筑均满足条件时，靛蓝和糖各多产 1 桶；仍受公共供应限制。
储藏室：
· 船长阶段仓储时，可以额外保留任意种类的三桶货物，不要求三桶同种。
· 加上基础的一桶，合计可保留四桶；小型仓库与大型仓库的整类保留另行叠加。
旅馆：
· 本建筑有两个工位，可在工头阶段安排人员作为客人，贵族也可以入住。
· 在阶段开始、进行或结束时，可以将客人移至自己其他合法的空工位。
· 种植园、采石场与建筑均可接收客人；两名客人可以在不同时机分别移出。
· 客人移入后立即使该工位生效，但不会补发已经错过时机的能力奖励。
· 移出的人员直到下次工头阶段前不能再移动，也不能送回旅馆反复使用。
教堂：
· 建筑师阶段建造第二行或第三行建筑时，取得 1 分胜利分筹码。
· 建造第四行建筑时取得 2 分，第一行没有奖励。
· 建造教堂自身没有奖励；这些筹码不影响新建筑原有的印刷胜利分。
贸易站：
· 商人阶段可以改在自己的贸易站出售一桶货物，货桶直接归还公共供应。
· 私人出售不受交易所已满或已有同种货物的限制。
· 仍可取得商人特权，但不能取得小型市场与大型市场的钱币奖励。
· 本建筑不增加出售次数，每个商人阶段仍最多出售一桶。
小型码头：
· 每个船长阶段可以使用一次，装运任意种类与数量的货物，可以混装。
· 可以只交出部分库存，每满两桶取得 1 分，不足两桶的余数不计基础分。
· 至少须交出一桶，所有货桶立即归还公共供应；只交一桶时基础分为零。
· 仍适用船长特权、海港与灯塔奖励；可以与码头在不同装船轮次分别使用。
· 私人装运可以放弃，不受公共货船的种类与容量限制。
灯塔：
· 船长阶段每次实际装运货物，取得 1 枚钱币，公共货船和两种私人码头均适用。
· 如果自己选择了船长，本阶段还额外取得 1 枚钱币，即使没有装运。
· 选择船长的钱币奖励每阶段仅一次；图书馆不会将这项建筑奖励加倍。
专门工厂：
· 每个工匠阶段，在自己正常生产取得的非玉米货物中，选择桶数最多的一种。
· 取得该桶数减一的钱币，最低为零；例如生产 4 桶糖可取得 3 枚钱币。
· 玉米不参与计算；选择者随后取得的额外货桶不重新计算奖励。
图书馆：
· 自己选择角色时，该角色特权加倍；跟随其他玩家时不获得角色特权。
· 拓荒者可以取得第二块田地，须等其他玩家完成正常取地后再取。
· 第二块可选剩余公开种植园；只有建筑小屋启用时，才可改选采石场。
· 第二块不能使用济贫院；仍须有空种植区，可以放弃领取。
· 建筑师优惠变为 2 枚钱币；工头从普通供应额外取得 2 名工人。
· 工匠可额外取得两桶本次实际生产过的货物，可以同种，也可以不同种。
· 商人成功出售时额外取得 2 枚钱币；船长首次实际装运额外取得 2 分。
· 勘探者取得 2 枚钱币；这些奖励仍受各角色原有条件限制。
· 图书馆不加倍角色牌积币、其他建筑奖励或海盗行动。
同业会馆：
· 每个船长阶段，在自己首次行动之前，按此时拥有的货物取得胜利分筹码。
· 每种货物分别计算，每满两桶取得 1 分，不同种类的零散货桶不能合并。
· 例如三桶玉米、一桶咖啡与两桶靛蓝，合计取得 2 分。
· 计分不消耗货物，此后仍可正常装船、皇家供应或仓储。
修道院：
· 终局时本建筑须有人员上岗，按自己同类田地每三块组成一组。
· 各类种植园分别计算，采石场与森林也各算一类，同一种可组成多组。
· 一组取得 1 分，两组取得 3 分，三组取得 6 分，四组取得 10 分，零组没有奖励。
· 例如六块玉米种植园与三块森林共组成三组，取得 6 分；田地无须上岗。
雕像：
· 本建筑占两格城市，没有工位，不需要安排人员。
· 终局按印刷值计入 8 分，没有另行启用的额外计分能力。
· 雕像属于第四行建筑，采石场优惠上限为 4 枚钱币。
贵族扩展：
· 加入 20 名贵族与八种贵族建筑；贵族可以替代普通工人安排到所有合法工位。
· 部分贵族建筑按上岗者是普通工人还是贵族，提供不同能力。
· 三至五人使用全部 100 名普通工人，招聘所初始人数等于玩家人数。
· 初始招聘所中一名为贵族，其余为普通工人；贵族供应另有 19 名。
· 因此普通工人供应分别为三人 98 名、四人 97 名、五人 96 名。
· 双人初始招聘所仍为两名普通工人，普通供应 40 名，贵族供应 20 名。
· 双人首次补充招聘所时，才开始加入贵族。
· 每次补充招聘所时，只要供应允许，将目标人数中的一名普通工人替换为贵族。
· 普通工人不足时，也最多加入一名贵族；招聘所人数可以低于目标人数。
· 工头分配招聘人员时，每次轮到自己，可在尚余人员中选择普通工人或贵族。
· 工头特权仍只从普通供应领取；图书馆也不会将该特权改为贵族。
· 终局时自己每名贵族取得 1 分，种植园、建筑与港口中的贵族全部计入。
· 取消因招聘所补充不足而结束游戏的条件；城市填满与筹码用尽仍会触发终局。
区公所：
· 普通工人上岗时，购买小型建筑的费用减少 1 枚钱币。
· 贵族上岗时，改为购买大型建筑的费用减少 2 枚钱币。
· 两种能力不同时生效；可以叠加其他优惠，最终费用最低为零。
皇家供应商：
· 每个船长阶段，在自己首次正常装船行动前，可以向皇家供应一次货物。
· 每种货物最多交出一桶，总桶数不超过自己拥有的贵族人数，港口贵族也计入。
· 交出的货桶立即归还公共供应，每桶取得 1 分胜利分筹码。
· 不享有船长、海港或灯塔的额外奖励；供应后仍按正常船长规则继续行动。
礼拜堂：
· 每个工匠阶段开始时，普通工人上岗取得 1 枚钱币，贵族上岗取得 1 分胜利分筹码。
· 即使本阶段没有生产货物，仍可取得对应奖励；每阶段只结算一次。
珠宝作坊：
· 工匠阶段轮到自己生产时，自己每名贵族带来 1 枚钱币，港口贵族也计入。
· 本建筑不生产货桶，也不需要对应种植园；没有生产其他货物时仍可取得钱币。
· 公会会馆将本建筑视为大型生产建筑，市政厅不将其视为商业建筑。
别墅：
· 每个工头阶段，自己首次收到人员时，额外从贵族供应取得一名贵族，放入港口。
· 工头特权取得人员也会触发；同一阶段不能因以后再领取人员而重复触发。
· 贵族供应用尽时改取一名普通工人；两种供应均用尽时没有额外人员。
狩猎小屋：
· 拓荒者阶段结束时，普通工人上岗可以弃置自己一块种植园或森林，不能弃采石场。
· 被弃田地上的人员移至自己的港口，弃置田地进入种植园弃置堆。
· 贵族上岗时，比较所有玩家的空种植区；自己严格最多则取得 2 分胜利分筹码。
· 其他玩家的弃置先完成，再比较空格；并列最多没有奖励，无须自己选择拓荒者。
地政所：
· 每个商人阶段可使用一次，可以在自己出售货物之前或之后使用。
· 普通工人上岗时，可以支付 1 枚钱币，抽取并放置一块暗置种植园，须有空格。
· 贵族上岗时，可以出售自己一块种植园或森林，取得 1 枚钱币，不能出售采石场。
· 出售田地上的人员移至港口，田地进入弃置堆；本能力不占出售货物的次数。
· 林务所启用时，购买的新种植园可以改为森林。
皇家花园：
· 终局时本建筑须有人员上岗，自己每名贵族额外取得 1 分。
· 种植园、建筑与港口中的贵族均计入，连同贵族基础分，每名共计 2 分。
海盗扩展：
· 在原有角色外加入海盗；选择者取得海盗标记，并从以下四种行动中选择一种。
· 其他玩家不跟随海盗行动，图书馆不加倍其效果。
· 持有海盗标记的玩家不能再次选择海盗，直到另一位玩家选择并取走标记。
· 海盗牌在未被选择时不积累钱币。
海盗的劫掠行动：
· 选择一艘有货物的公共货船，将其全部清空。
· 可以保留其中零至三桶货物，放入自己的货物库存，其余归还公共供应。
· 清空后的货船重新为空船；劫掠不算装船，不取得装船分数或相关建筑奖励。
海盗的掠夺行动：
· 将交易所全部货桶归还公共供应，每归还一桶取得 1 分胜利分筹码。
· 掠夺不算出售或装船，不享有商人、船长、市场、海港或灯塔等奖励。
海盗的袭击行动：
· 只有招聘所人数多于玩家人数时才可袭击，将其人数移除至等于玩家人数。
· 可以保留被移除人员中的最多三名，立即安排到自己合法的空工位。
· 种植园、采石场与建筑空工位均可接收，不能将这些人员留在港口。
· 未保留的人员归还各自供应；使用贵族时，可决定留下和带走的人员种类。
海盗的劫持行动：
· 选择一张本轮尚未被选、且不是海盗的角色牌，先取得其全部积币。
· 若本轮稍后有对手选择该角色，自己取得 3 枚钱币赎金。
· 对手仍正常执行该角色并取得特权，劫持不会取消对手行动。
· 若自己后来选择该角色，不取得赎金，也不再于轮末额外执行。
· 若本轮无人选择该角色，则在轮末由海盗额外执行，自己取得该角色特权。
· 其他玩家按该角色的通常规则跟随；即使已触发终局，也须先完成这次额外阶段。
庆典扩展：
· 本局设种植、生产与建筑三个公共目标，各自只奖励第一位达成的玩家一次。
· 同一玩家可以取得多个目标；满足条件后立即结算，不需要额外申领奖励。
· 用于展示目标的一块种植园、三桶货物与一座建筑，暂时从相应供应中移出。
· 某项目标达成时，将该目标展示物归还原供应，不交给获奖玩家。
· 玩家无须交出自己为达成目标而拥有的种植园、货物或建筑。
庆典种植目标：
· 随机确定一种种植园；最先拥有三块该种种植园的玩家取得奖励，无须上岗。
· 从普通工人供应取得最多三名工人，放入自己的港口，稍后才能安排上岗。
· 普通工人不足时只取尚余人数，不从招聘所领取，也不以贵族替代。
庆典生产目标：
· 从五种货物各三桶的组合中随机抽三桶作为要求，可能出现相同种类。
· 在同一个工匠阶段，实际生产的种类与数量满足要求，即取得 3 枚钱币。
· 工匠特权取得的额外货桶也计入；以前库存与不同阶段的产量不能累积。
· 例如目标为两桶糖和一桶咖啡，须在同次工匠阶段至少取得这些生产货物。
庆典建筑目标：
· 从本局建筑市场第三行的建筑中随机选择一项作为目标。
· 若某种货物出现在生产目标中，生产该货物的建筑不作为建筑目标候选。
· 第一位建成指定建筑的玩家取得 3 分胜利分筹码，不要求该建筑立即上岗。
触发游戏结束：
· 任一玩家的城市填满 12 格，或胜利分筹码公共供应用尽，均触发游戏结束。
· 未开启贵族扩展时，工头阶段不能按要求补足招聘所，也会触发游戏结束。
· 种植区填满、种植园抽取堆或货物供应用尽，本身不会触发游戏结束。
· 触发后仍须完成本轮所有角色，以及海盗劫持所需的轮末额外阶段。
· 筹码用尽后仍照常记录应得胜利分，不因公共筹码不足而少计。
· 随后直接进行终局计分，不再开始新一轮。
终局计分与胜负：
· 总分包括自己的胜利分筹码、全部建筑印刷分、已启用大型建筑奖励与贵族分。
· 所有建筑印刷分均计入，无须上岗；大型建筑额外奖励须在终局时启用。
· 普通工人与剩余钱币、货物不直接增加总分，除非某项建筑能力明确规定。
· 总分最高者获胜；总分相同时，比较各自的钱币枚数与剩余货桶数之和。
· 货桶一律每桶计一，不按商人售价折算；该合计较高者获胜。
· 例如剩余 5 枚钱币和 3 桶货物，平分比较值为 8。
· 若总分与平分比较值仍完全相同，则相关玩家共享胜利。

en.name: Puerto Rico
en.desc: Choose roles, develop your island, produce, trade and ship goods. Uses the 2020 edition rules.
en.rules:
Object of the game:
· Earn victory points by developing plantations, constructing buildings, producing goods and shipping cargo.
· The player with the highest final score wins; resolve ties as described at the end of these rules.
· These rules use the 2020 edition; expansion rules apply only when their respective options are enabled.
Game components:
· Each player has an island with 12 plantation spaces and 12 city spaces.
· Each plantation, quarry or forest occupies one plantation space.
· A small building occupies one city space; a large building occupies two.
· People are ordinary workers or nobles; people without a workplace remain in their owner's harbor.
· Each plantation and quarry has one workplace; each building has the number of workplaces shown on it.
· An occupied workplace is staffed; unstaffed plantations do not produce, and unstaffed buildings have no active ability.
· Forests and the Statue have no workplaces; their special rules appear under the relevant buildings.
· Goods are corn, indigo, sugar, tobacco and coffee, counted in barrels.
· Coins pay for buildings and other expenses; victory point tokens record points earned during play.
· Goods, people and victory point tokens have shared supplies; coins are not limited.
· Your goods and harbor personnel belong to you and are separate from the shared supplies.
· Coins, goods and personnel are public; each player's victory point tokens remain private until final scoring.
Setup:
· After choosing the player count and expansions, establish clockwise seating order.
· The first player is the governor for round one; the governorship then passes clockwise.
· Each player starts with 2 coins in a three-player game, 3 in a four-player game, or 4 in a five-player game.
· With three or four players, the first two players start with an indigo plantation each; the others start with corn.
· With five players, the first three players start with indigo; the last two start with corn.
· Starting plantations are unstaffed; players begin without buildings, goods, people or victory point tokens.
· With three players, set aside 76 points in tokens, 55 ordinary workers in supply and 3 in recruitment.
· With four players, set aside 101 points in tokens, 75 ordinary workers in supply and 4 in recruitment.
· With five players, set aside 126 points in tokens, 95 ordinary workers in supply and 5 in recruitment.
· These worker quantities apply to the base game; the Nobles expansion changes the personnel supplies.
· With three players, use three public cargo ships with capacities of 4, 5 and 6 barrels.
· With four players, use public ships with capacities of 5, 6 and 7 barrels.
· With five players, use public ships with capacities of 6, 7 and 8 barrels.
· The goods supply contains 10 corn, 11 indigo, 11 sugar, 9 tobacco and 9 coffee barrels.
· Plantation totals are 10 corn, 12 indigo, 11 sugar, 9 tobacco and 8 coffee, including starting plantations.
· Deal the starting plantations, then shuffle the remaining plantations into a face-down draw pile.
· Reveal one more plantation than the number of players, and set aside 8 quarries.
· The trading house and all public ships start empty; role cards start without coins.
· Use the six main roles: Settler, Builder, Foreman, Craftsman, Trader and Captain.
· Use no Prospector with three players, one Prospector with four, or two Prospectors with five.
· The two Prospector cards are separate role cards and may both be chosen in the same round.
· Without New Buildings, the base buildings enter the market directly; noble buildings are added when Nobles is enabled.
· With three to five players, use 4 copies of each small production building and 3 of each other base production building.
· Use 2 copies of each small commercial building and 1 of each large building.
Two-player game:
· Both players start with 3 coins; the first starts with indigo and the second with corn.
· Set aside 65 points in tokens, 40 ordinary workers in supply and 2 ordinary workers in recruitment.
· Use two public ships with capacities of 4 and 6 barrels, and include one Prospector.
· Remove 2 barrels of each good and 3 plantations of each type from the usual totals.
· Use only 5 quarries, 1 copy of each commercial building and 2 of each production building.
· Players alternate role choices three times each per round, resolving six role phases in total.
· Prepare the selected expansions before applying the two-player quantity adjustments.
· Additional Nobles and Festival setup details appear in their expansion sections.
Round sequence:
· Starting with the governor, take turns clockwise choosing a role card that has not yet been chosen this round.
· Take all accumulated coins from the chosen card, then resolve that role's phase.
· The chooser acts first and receives the role's privilege.
· Other players follow clockwise, performing the role's action without the chooser's privilege.
· Only the chooser acts for the Prospector and Buccaneer; other players do not follow.
· Finish the entire role phase before the next player chooses a role.
· With three to five players, each chooses one role per round; with two players, each chooses three.
· Chosen role cards remain unavailable until the next round.
· At round end, place 1 coin on each unchosen role card; the Buccaneer never accumulates coins.
· Make all role cards available again, pass the governorship clockwise and begin the next round.
Settler phase:
· Each player may take one face-up plantation and place it in an empty plantation space on their island.
· The chooser may take a quarry from supply instead of a face-up plantation.
· A player may decline; a player whose 12 plantation spaces are occupied cannot acquire another tile.
· Newly acquired plantations and quarries arrive unstaffed and work only after receiving personnel.
· The Hacienda, Construction Hut, Hospice, Library and Forest House provide exceptions described below.
· After all players finish, discard the remaining face-up plantations and reveal the player count plus one new tiles.
· When the draw pile runs out, shuffle the discarded plantations to form a new draw pile.
· Quarries do not enter the plantation draw pile and are limited by their shared supply.
Builder phase:
· Each player may pay coins to buy one building from the market, or decline.
· The building must be in stock, and the player's city must have enough empty spaces for it.
· A player cannot own two buildings with the same name and may buy at most one building per action.
· The chooser pays 1 coin less for construction.
· Each of the player's staffed quarries reduces the cost by 1 coin, subject to the building's market-row limit.
· Quarries save at most 1, 2, 3 or 4 coins in total for buildings in rows one through four respectively.
· Use the market row to determine this limit; the Statue is in row four and permits at most 4 coins of quarry savings.
· Forests, the District Office and the role privilege provide additional cumulative discounts; the final cost cannot be negative.
· New buildings normally arrive unstaffed; the University may immediately staff one workplace in a new building.
· A completed building immediately occupies city spaces; filling all 12 triggers the end of the game after the round.
Foreman phase:
· The chooser first takes 1 extra ordinary worker from supply into their harbor.
· If the ordinary worker supply is empty, recruitment cannot replace this privilege worker.
· Starting with the chooser, distribute recruitment personnel clockwise, one person per turn.
· Continue until recruitment is empty; some players receive one extra person if the total is not evenly divisible.
· Each player may rearrange all their personnel, including those already working and those in their harbor.
· Each workplace holds at most one person; forests and the Statue cannot receive personnel.
· If personnel are fewer than workplaces, choose which workplaces to fill, but assign every person.
· If personnel exceed workplaces, fill every workplace and leave the surplus in your harbor.
· At phase end, count empty workplaces in all players' buildings, excluding empty plantation and quarry workplaces.
· The next recruitment total is the greater of that count and the number of players.
· Refill recruitment from the worker supply; in the base game, a shortage triggers the end of the game after the round.
· Nobles changes personnel types, recruitment choices and the shortage end condition as described below.
Craftsman phase:
· Each player takes goods from supply according to their staffed plantations and production buildings.
· Each staffed corn plantation produces up to 1 corn barrel without a production building.
· Every other good requires both a matching staffed plantation and a staffed workplace in its production building.
· Production equals the smaller of the matching staffed plantation count and staffed production-building workplaces.
· For example, three staffed indigo plantations and two staffed indigo production workplaces produce at most 2 barrels.
· Players take goods in action order from the same supply; a shortage limits production to the barrels still available.
· Players may take fewer barrels or none of a good; unused production is not made up later.
· After everyone produces, the chooser may take 1 extra barrel of a good they actually produced in this phase.
· The extra barrel must be available in supply; producing no goods gives no extra barrel.
· The Factory and Specialty Factory use regular production for their coin awards; privilege barrels do not recalculate those awards.
Trader phase:
· Each player may sell one barrel they own, or decline to sell.
· Base prices are 0 coins for corn, 1 for indigo, 2 for sugar, 3 for tobacco and 4 for coffee.
· The chooser receives 1 additional coin for a completed sale; declining to sell gives no privilege income.
· The trading house holds at most four barrels; normally, a good already present cannot be sold there again.
· The Office permits duplicate goods, and the Trading Post permits a private sale, as described under those buildings.
· Corn may be sold even at a base price of zero and still earns applicable privilege and market bonuses.
· At the end of the entire phase, return all trading-house barrels to supply only if all four spaces are occupied.
· If the trading house is not full, its goods remain for later Trader phases rather than clearing each round.
Captain phase:
· Starting with the chooser, players repeatedly take loading turns clockwise until nobody continues shipping.
· Each public loading contains one type of good; the player chooses which eligible type to ship.
· A player who can load a public ship cannot simply pass, but may use an available private shipment first.
· Each public ship carries one good; two public ships cannot carry the same good simultaneously.
· If a ship already carries the chosen good, use that ship and load as many barrels as its remaining space allows.
· If that good's ship is full, an empty ship cannot be started with the same good.
· If no ship carries that good, choose an empty ship that can take the greatest number of your barrels of that good.
· Load the maximum number the chosen ship can take; voluntarily loading fewer is not allowed.
· If either of two ships can take all your barrels of the chosen good, either ship may be chosen.
· For example, with 5 corn barrels and empty ships of capacity 4 and 6, load all 5 onto the capacity-6 ship.
· Gain 1 point in victory point tokens for each barrel actually shipped.
· Shipping a good does not require you to own or staff its corresponding production building.
· The chooser gains 1 extra point on their first actual shipment of the phase, once per phase.
· A chooser who ships no goods receives no privilege points.
· The Wharf and Small Wharf provide private shipments with their own usage, cargo and scoring rules.
· Private shipping is optional; a player may receive several loading turns during the phase.
· Full public ships unload only at the end of the entire Captain phase, returning their cargo to supply.
· Full ships do not clear during loading turns; ships that are not full retain their cargo between phases.
Storage:
· After all shipping ends, each player chooses which unshipped goods to keep.
· Without storage buildings, each player may keep only one barrel in total, of a type they choose.
· A Small Warehouse preserves every barrel of one additional good; a Large Warehouse preserves two additional goods.
· If both Warehouses are active, preserve every barrel of three additional goods.
· The ordinary single barrel may be a good other than those preserved by Warehouses.
· The Storehouse adds capacity for three barrels of any goods and combines with both Warehouses.
· For example, a Small Warehouse can preserve all 4 corn barrels, while the ordinary allowance keeps 1 coffee barrel.
· Return every barrel beyond storage capacity to supply; storing goods costs no coins.
Prospector phase:
· Only the chooser takes 1 coin from the coin supply; other players do not act.
· This coin is separate from any accumulated coins taken from the role card.
Building rules:
· Except for the Statue, a building needs at least one person in a workplace for its ability to operate.
· A production building's staffed workplaces determine its capacity; one person does not activate its full capacity.
· Printed building points count at game end regardless of whether the building is staffed.
· A large building must be staffed at game end to provide its additional scoring ability.
· Resolve an ability only at its stated time; staffing a building afterward does not grant earlier missed benefits.
· Different building abilities may combine, subject to each ability's conditions, usage limits and quantities.
· In the building rules below, nobles may replace workers unless the ability explicitly distinguishes personnel types.
Production:
Small Indigo Plant:
· This building has one workplace; when staffed and matched with a staffed indigo plantation, it produces up to 1 indigo barrel.
· Production is limited by the shared goods supply; without a matching staffed plantation, it produces nothing.
Small Sugar Mill:
· This building has one workplace; when staffed and matched with a staffed sugar plantation, it produces up to 1 sugar barrel.
· Production is limited by the shared goods supply; without a matching staffed plantation, it produces nothing.
Indigo Plant:
· This building has 3 workplaces; each staffed workplace provides capacity for 1 indigo barrel.
· Each barrel also requires a matching staffed plantation; the building produces at most 3 barrels in total.
· The shared supply limits the barrels received; capacities from different buildings producing the same good may be combined.
Sugar Mill:
· This building has 3 workplaces; each staffed workplace provides capacity for 1 sugar barrel.
· Each barrel also requires a matching staffed plantation; the building produces at most 3 barrels in total.
· The shared supply limits the barrels received; capacities from different buildings producing the same good may be combined.
Tobacco Storage:
· This building has 3 workplaces; each staffed workplace provides capacity for 1 tobacco barrel.
· Each barrel also requires a matching staffed plantation; the building produces at most 3 barrels in total.
· The shared supply limits the barrels received; capacities from different buildings producing the same good may be combined.
Coffee Roaster:
· This building has 2 workplaces; each staffed workplace provides capacity for 1 coffee barrel.
· Each barrel also requires a matching staffed plantation; the building produces at most 2 barrels in total.
· The shared supply limits the barrels received; capacities from different buildings producing the same good may be combined.
Base commerce:
Small Market:
· When you sell a barrel to the trading house during a Trader phase, gain 1 additional coin.
· This combines with the Trader privilege and Large Market; it does not apply to private Trading Post sales.
Hacienda:
· Once per Settler phase, before your regular tile-taking action, you may draw one additional face-down plantation.
· You must have an empty plantation space before drawing and must place the tile on your island rather than reject it.
· The Hacienda tile does not receive a Hospice person; an active Forest House allows it to become a forest.
· If only one space remains and the Hacienda tile fills it, you cannot take a regular tile afterward.
Construction Hut:
· During a Settler phase, you may take a quarry instead of a face-up plantation even when you did not choose the role.
· This also permits a quarry for the Library's second tile, provided one remains in supply.
Small Warehouse:
· During Captain-phase storage, keep every barrel of one good in addition to the ordinary one-barrel allowance.
· Choose the preserved good yourself; this ability combines with the Large Warehouse and Storehouse.
Hospice:
· When taking your first regular plantation or quarry in a Settler phase, you may immediately staff it with one person.
· Take an ordinary worker from supply first; if that supply is empty, take an available person from recruitment instead.
· Recruitment may provide an ordinary worker or, when Nobles is enabled, an available noble.
· Neither the extra Hacienda tile nor the Library's second tile receives a Hospice person.
· If the regular plantation becomes a forest, place the received person in your harbor instead.
Office:
· During a Trader phase, you may sell a good that is already present in the trading house.
· The trading house still holds at most four barrels; the Office cannot permit a sale when it is full.
Large Market:
· When you sell a barrel to the trading house during a Trader phase, gain 2 additional coins.
· When both Markets are active, they provide a combined bonus of 3 coins.
· The Trader privilege applies in addition; neither Market rewards a private Trading Post sale.
Large Warehouse:
· During Captain-phase storage, keep every barrel of two goods in addition to the ordinary one-barrel allowance.
· With an active Small Warehouse, preserve three additional goods in full; the Storehouse adds separate barrel capacity.
Factory:
· Each Craftsman phase, earn coins based on the number of different goods you actually receive from regular production.
· Producing two types earns 1 coin, three earns 2, four earns 3, and five earns 5.
· Producing zero or one type earns nothing; count types rather than the total number of barrels.
· Corn counts as a type; the chooser's later extra barrels do not trigger a recalculation.
University:
· When buying a new building with workplaces in a Builder phase, you may immediately take one person and place them in that building.
· Take an ordinary worker from supply first; if it is empty, take an available ordinary worker or noble from recruitment.
· Receive at most one person per new building, regardless of its number of workplaces.
· Buying the University itself gives no such reward; the Statue has no workplace and cannot receive a person.
Harbor:
· Each time you actually ship goods in a Captain phase, gain 1 additional point in victory point tokens.
· This applies to public ships, the Wharf and Small Wharf; award one point per shipment rather than per barrel.
· It combines with the Captain privilege; Royal Supplier deliveries and Buccaneer actions are not shipments.
Wharf:
· Once per Captain phase, you may use a private ship to ship every barrel you own of one chosen good.
· This private ship has unlimited capacity and ignores goods already assigned to public ships and their loading status.
· Gain 1 point per barrel and return the barrels to supply immediately; Captain, Harbor and Lighthouse bonuses apply.
· Private shipping is optional; the Wharf and Small Wharf each have one use and may be used on separate loading turns.
Large buildings:
Guild Hall:
· This building must be staffed at game end to award the following bonus points.
· Gain 1 point per Small Indigo Plant and Small Sugar Mill, and 2 points per other production building.
· Counted production buildings need not be staffed; the Nobles expansion's Jeweler counts as a large production building.
Residence:
· If staffed at game end, this building awards bonus points for occupied plantation spaces on your island.
· Occupying zero through nine spaces earns 4 points, ten earns 5, eleven earns 6, and twelve earns 7.
· All plantations, quarries and forests count as occupied spaces, whether staffed or not.
Fortress:
· If staffed at game end, this building awards 1 bonus point for every three people you own.
· Count all personnel on plantations, quarries, buildings and in your harbor, including nobles; ignore any remainder below three.
Customs House:
· If staffed at game end, this building awards 1 bonus point for every 4 points in your victory point tokens.
· Ignore any remainder below 4; exclude printed building points, noble points and other endgame bonuses.
City Hall:
· If staffed at game end, this building awards 1 bonus point for each commercial building you own.
· Include the City Hall itself; the other commercial buildings need not be staffed.
· Exclude all production buildings, including the Nobles expansion's Jeweler.
New Buildings draft:
· With New Buildings enabled, draft the market from base commercial buildings, new commercial buildings and enabled noble commercial buildings.
· Starting with the governor, take turns clockwise choosing one commercial building type not yet in the market.
· The building's cost must match a remaining market slot; fill that slot with the chosen type.
· Add two copies of each small commercial type, or one with two players; each large type has one copy.
· Continue until every slot is filled; buildings not drafted cannot be bought in this game.
· Production buildings enter automatically rather than being drafted; the Jeweler is also a production building.
· With Nobles enabled, add its commercial building candidates and the corresponding extra market slots.
Black Market:
· Use the Black Market only when your coins are insufficient to pay the construction cost.
· Return at most one person, one barrel and 1 point in victory point tokens; each returned item pays for 1 coin of the cost.
· Pay at most 3 coins this way; spend all your coins and return exactly enough items to cover the shortfall, with no change.
· Personnel may come from your plantations, quarries, other buildings or harbor, but never from the Black Market itself.
· Return ordinary workers and nobles to their respective supplies, and return goods and tokens to theirs.
· If returning personnel disables a quarry, District Office or Library, recalculate the final construction cost without its discount.
· Returning tokens or people does not cancel an end condition that has already been triggered.
Forest House:
· While this building is active, you may place newly acquired plantations as forests; tiles already on your island cannot be converted.
· You may also inspect a face-down plantation drawn by the Hacienda or bought through the Land Office before deciding to make it a forest.
· Quarries cannot become forests; a forest occupies one plantation space, has no workplace and produces no goods.
· Each pair of forests you own reduces every construction cost by 1 coin, cumulatively with other discounts.
· Existing forests keep their discount even if the Forest House becomes unstaffed; all forests count as one tile type.
Aqueduct:
· During a Craftsman phase, a staffed Indigo Plant or Sugar Mill that can produce normally with matching plantations produces 1 extra barrel of its good.
· Only the large Indigo Plant and Sugar Mill qualify; the Small Indigo Plant and Small Sugar Mill do not.
· If both large buildings qualify, produce 1 extra indigo and 1 extra sugar barrel, subject to the shared supply.
Storehouse:
· During Captain-phase storage, keep three additional barrels of any goods; they need not be of one type.
· Together with the ordinary single barrel, this preserves four barrels; either Warehouse adds its full-type storage separately.
Guesthouse:
· This building has two workplaces that may receive guests during a Foreman phase, including nobles.
· At the beginning, during or end of a phase, you may move guests to other legal empty workplaces on your island.
· Plantations, quarries and buildings may receive guests; the two guests may move at different times.
· A guest activates the destination immediately, but does not grant ability rewards whose timing has already passed.
· Once moved, that person cannot move again until the next Foreman phase or return to the Guesthouse for repeated use.
Church:
· When constructing a row-two or row-three building in a Builder phase, gain 1 point in victory point tokens.
· Gain 2 points for a row-four building and no points for a row-one building.
· Constructing the Church itself gives no reward; these tokens do not replace the new building's printed points.
Trading Post:
· During a Trader phase, you may sell one barrel through your own Trading Post instead, returning it directly to supply.
· A private sale ignores whether the trading house is full or already contains the good.
· The Trader privilege still applies, but Small Market and Large Market coin bonuses do not.
· This building does not grant another sale; you still sell at most one barrel per Trader phase.
Small Wharf:
· Once per Captain phase, ship any number of barrels of any goods, including mixed cargo.
· You may ship only part of your stock; gain 1 point per two barrels, ignoring an unmatched barrel for base points.
· Ship at least one barrel and return all cargo to supply immediately; a one-barrel shipment has zero base points.
· Captain, Harbor and Lighthouse bonuses still apply; this and the Wharf may be used on separate loading turns.
· This private shipment is optional and ignores public ships' assigned goods and capacities.
Lighthouse:
· Each actual shipment during a Captain phase earns 1 coin, whether made on a public ship or through either private Wharf.
· If you chose the Captain, gain 1 further coin during the phase even if you ship nothing.
· The chooser's additional coin is awarded once per phase; the Library does not double this building bonus.
Specialty Factory:
· Each Craftsman phase, find the largest number of barrels of one non-corn good received from your regular production.
· Gain that number minus one in coins, with a minimum of zero; for example, producing 4 sugar barrels earns 3 coins.
· Exclude corn; extra barrels later taken through the role privilege do not recalculate the award.
Library:
· When you choose a role, double its privilege; following another player's role gives you no role privilege.
· As Settler, you may take a second tile after every other player has completed their regular tile-taking action.
· For the second tile, choose a remaining face-up plantation; a quarry requires an active Construction Hut.
· The second tile receives no Hospice person; you need an empty plantation space and may decline it.
· The Builder discount becomes 2 coins; the Foreman takes 2 extra ordinary supply workers.
· The Craftsman may take 2 extra barrels of goods actually produced in the phase, either matching or different.
· A completed Trader sale earns 2 extra coins; the Captain's first actual shipment earns 2 extra points.
· The Prospector takes 2 coins; all these privileges retain their original role conditions.
· The Library does not double role-card coin accumulations, other building rewards or Buccaneer actions.
Union Hall:
· Once per Captain phase, before your first action, gain victory point tokens based on the goods you own at that time.
· Count each good separately and gain 1 point per two barrels; unmatched barrels of different goods cannot be combined.
· For example, three corn, one coffee and two indigo barrels earn 2 points in total.
· Scoring does not consume the goods; they remain available for normal shipping, royal supply or storage afterward.
Cloister:
· If staffed at game end, this building awards points for groups of three matching tiles on your island.
· Count each plantation type separately; quarries and forests are separate types, and one type may form multiple groups.
· One group earns 1 point, two earn 3, three earn 6 and four earn 10; zero groups earn nothing.
· For example, six corn plantations and three forests form three groups and earn 6 points; the tiles need not be staffed.
Statue:
· This building occupies two city spaces, has no workplace and requires no personnel.
· It provides its printed value of 8 points at game end and has no separate activated scoring ability.
· The Statue is a row-four building, so its quarry discount is limited to 4 coins.
Nobles expansion:
· Add 20 nobles and eight noble building types; nobles may replace ordinary workers in any legal workplace.
· Some noble buildings provide different abilities depending on whether an ordinary worker or noble staffs them.
· With three to five players, use all 100 ordinary workers; the initial recruitment total equals the player count.
· Initially, one recruit is a noble and the rest are ordinary workers; the separate noble supply contains 19.
· The remaining ordinary worker supply is therefore 98 with three players, 97 with four, or 96 with five.
· With two players, start with two ordinary recruits, 40 ordinary supply workers and all 20 nobles in supply.
· In a two-player game, nobles first enter recruitment on the first refill.
· On each recruitment refill, replace one ordinary worker in the target total with a noble if supplies allow.
· Even when ordinary workers are insufficient, add at most one noble; recruitment may contain fewer people than the target total.
· On each recruitment turn during a Foreman phase, choose an available ordinary worker or noble.
· The Foreman privilege still draws only ordinary supply workers; the Library does not turn that privilege into noble recruitment.
· At game end, each noble you own is worth 1 point, including nobles on plantations, in buildings and in your harbor.
· Recruitment shortages no longer end the game; filling a city or exhausting victory point tokens still triggers the end.
District Office:
· With an ordinary worker staffing this building, a small building costs 1 coin less.
· With a noble staffing it, a large building costs 2 coins less instead.
· These two abilities are alternatives, not simultaneous; other discounts combine with them, and final cost cannot be negative.
Royal Supplier:
· Once per Captain phase, before your first normal loading turn, you may supply goods to the royal court.
· Supply at most one barrel of each good, with the total no greater than your noble count, including harbor nobles.
· Return the supplied barrels to the shared supply immediately and gain 1 point in victory point tokens per barrel.
· Captain, Harbor and Lighthouse bonuses do not apply; afterward, continue under the normal Captain rules.
Chapel:
· At the beginning of each Craftsman phase, gain 1 coin if an ordinary worker staffs this building, or 1 point in tokens if a noble does.
· Receive the applicable reward even if you produce no goods that phase; resolve it only once per phase.
Jeweler:
· On your production turn in a Craftsman phase, gain 1 coin per noble you own, including those in your harbor.
· This building produces no barrels and needs no plantation; it earns coins even if you produce no other goods.
· The Guild Hall counts it as a large production building; the City Hall does not count it as a commercial building.
Villa:
· The first time you receive personnel in each Foreman phase, take one additional noble from supply into your harbor.
· Receiving a Foreman privilege worker also triggers this; later recruitment in the same phase does not trigger it again.
· If no nobles remain in supply, take one ordinary supply worker instead; if both supplies are empty, take nobody extra.
Hunting Lodge:
· At the end of a Settler phase, an ordinary worker lets you discard one of your plantations or forests, but not a quarry.
· Move any person on the discarded tile to your harbor and put the tile into the plantation discard pile.
· With a noble, compare all players' empty plantation spaces; gain 2 points in tokens only if you alone have the most.
· Finish any tile discards before comparing empty spaces; a tie earns nothing, and you need not have chosen Settler.
Land Office:
· Use this ability once per Trader phase, either before or after your sale of goods.
· With an ordinary worker, pay 1 coin to draw and place a face-down plantation, provided you have an empty plantation space.
· With a noble, sell one plantation or forest you own for 1 coin; quarries cannot be sold.
· Move any person from a sold tile to your harbor and discard the tile; this does not use your sale of goods.
· With an active Forest House, a newly bought plantation may be placed as a forest.
Royal Garden:
· If staffed at game end, this building awards 1 additional point for every noble you own.
· Count nobles on plantations, in buildings and in your harbor; including each noble's base point, each is worth 2 points in total.
Buccaneer expansion:
· Add the Buccaneer to the existing roles; its chooser takes the Buccaneer token and performs one of the following four actions.
· Other players do not follow Buccaneer actions, and the Library does not double them.
· The token holder cannot choose Buccaneer again until another player chooses it and takes the token.
· The Buccaneer card accumulates no coins when left unchosen.
Piracy:
· Choose a public cargo ship containing goods and empty it completely.
· Keep zero to three of its barrels in your own stock and return the rest to supply.
· The cleared ship becomes empty again; Piracy is not shipping and earns no shipping points or related building rewards.
Plunder:
· Return every barrel in the trading house to supply and gain 1 point in victory point tokens per barrel returned.
· Plunder is neither a sale nor a shipment and receives no Trader, Captain, Market, Harbor, Lighthouse or similar bonuses.
Raid:
· Raid is available only if recruitment contains more people than the player count; remove people until that many remain.
· Keep up to three removed people and immediately place them in legal empty workplaces of your own.
· Empty plantation, quarry and building workplaces may receive them; these people cannot be left in your harbor.
· Return unkept people to their respective supplies; with Nobles, choose the personnel types left behind and taken.
Kidnap:
· Choose an unchosen role card other than Buccaneer and immediately take all accumulated coins on it.
· If an opponent chooses that role later in the round, gain a ransom of 3 coins.
· That opponent still resolves the role normally with its privilege; Kidnap does not cancel their action.
· If you later choose the role yourself, receive no ransom and do not resolve an extra copy at round end.
· If nobody chooses the role that round, the Buccaneer resolves it as an extra role at round end, receiving its privilege.
· Other players follow under that role's normal rules; finish this extra phase before scoring even if the game end has been triggered.
Festival expansion:
· The game has three public goals: plantation, production and building; each rewards only its first achiever, once.
· One player may claim several goals; resolve a reward immediately when its condition is met, without a separate claim action.
· Temporarily remove the plantation tile, three goods barrels and building used to display the goals from their respective supplies.
· When a goal is achieved, return its display components to their supplies rather than giving them to the achiever.
· Players do not surrender the plantations, goods or buildings they used to meet a goal.
Plantation goal:
· Randomly choose a plantation type; the first player to own three plantations of that type earns the reward, whether staffed or not.
· Take up to three ordinary supply workers into your harbor, where they wait for a later opportunity to be assigned.
· If the ordinary supply is insufficient, take only those remaining; do not draw from recruitment or substitute nobles.
Production goal:
· Draw three barrels from a pool containing three of each of the five goods; repeated types are possible.
· Gain 3 coins when the types and quantities you actually produce within one Craftsman phase satisfy the displayed requirements.
· Extra Craftsman privilege barrels count; existing stock and production from different phases do not accumulate toward the goal.
· For a goal of two sugar and one coffee, for example, produce at least those quantities within a single Craftsman phase.
Building goal:
· Randomly choose a building from the third row of this game's market as the goal.
· Exclude production buildings whose good appears in the production goal.
· The first player to construct the designated building gains 3 points in victory point tokens; the new building need not be staffed.
Ending the game:
· The game end is triggered when any player's city fills all 12 spaces or the shared victory point token supply is exhausted.
· Without Nobles, failing to refill recruitment to the required total after a Foreman phase also triggers the end.
· Filling a plantation area or exhausting the plantation draw pile or goods supply does not itself end the game.
· After a trigger, finish all remaining roles in the round, including any extra round-end role required by Kidnap.
· Continue recording all earned victory points after tokens run out; the shortage does not reduce awards.
· Then proceed directly to final scoring without starting another round.
Scoring and victory:
· Your total is your victory point tokens, all printed building points, active large-building bonuses and noble points.
· All printed building points count without staffing; a large building must be active at game end to award its extra bonus.
· Ordinary workers, remaining coins and goods do not directly add points except through an explicitly applicable building ability.
· The highest total wins; tied players compare the sum of their remaining coins and goods barrels.
· Every barrel counts as one regardless of its selling price; the higher combined total wins the tie.
· For example, 5 remaining coins and 3 goods barrels give a tiebreak total of 8.
· If both the score and tiebreak total remain equal, those players share the victory.

zh.name: 量化宽松
zh.desc: 印钱收购公司,花得最多的人直接出局
zh.rules:
目标:扮央行印钱收购公司,得分最高者胜——但印钱最多的人直接淘汰,印钱最少有奖励。
准备:
· 按人数用 16 张(3–4 人)或 15 张(5 人)公司板块洗成牌堆。
· 每人代表一国,暗置抽 1 个产业标记(计垄断时多算 1 个该产业)。
流程(每拍一家公司,共 16/15 拍):
· 拍卖师亮出公司并公开开价(任意正整数)。
· 其余人秘密出价(0 或正整数,不得等于开价)。
· 最高价得公司,金额记在板块背面保密;拍卖师自己中标则须公开金额。
· 零出价(3 人局跳过):出 0 的人获得 2 分,每轮(每人各当一次拍卖师)限一次。
· 平局:平标者重报(仍不得等于开价),连平 3 次则由未平标的最高出价中标,全员仍平则流拍。
· 拍卖师左移轮转。
结算:
· 公司面值分 + 零出价分 + 国有化(本国板块)+ 垄断(同产业,含暗置标记)+ 多样化(不同产业成套)。
· 总花费最多者淘汰(并列则全部淘汰),花费最少者获得 6 分(5 人局 7 分,并列则都获得);平分时花费少者胜。
财货扩展(可开关):
· 每拍第二高出价者选一堆拿顶板(类别公开、面值仅本人见),该金额计入其花费;拍卖师记同额卖出,抵扣自己总花费。
· 零出价不再得分。金堆耗尽后,全场金板各扣 3 分;油最多者获得 5 分(并列均分,向下取整)。
· 第二高平局:公司归最高价,其余人全员重报争财货;连平 3 次由拍卖师选一堆弃掉顶板。

en.name: QE
en.desc: Print money to buy companies — the biggest spender is out
en.rules:
Goal: play a central bank printing money to buy companies. Highest score wins — but the biggest spender is eliminated, and the smallest spender gets a bonus.
Setup:
· Shuffle 16 company tiles (3–4 players) or 15 (5 players) into a deck.
· Each player is a nation and secretly draws an industry token (counts as +1 of that industry for monopolies).
Flow (one company per auction, 16/15 auctions):
· The auctioneer reveals a company and openly bids any positive integer.
· Others bid secretly (0 or any positive integer, never equal to the opening bid).
· Highest bid wins the company; the amount stays secret on the tile back. If the auctioneer wins, the amount is public.
· Zero bids (skipped with 3 players): bidding 0 scores 2 VP, once per round (each player auctions once).
· Ties: tied players rebid (still ≠ opening). Three ties in a row → highest non-tied bid wins; if everyone is still tied, the tile is discarded.
· Auctioneer passes left.
Scoring:
· Tile VP + zero-bid VP + nationalization (home-nation tiles) + monopolies (same industry, token counts) + diversification (sets of distinct industries).
· Biggest total spender is eliminated (ties are all eliminated); smallest spender scores 6 VP (7 with 5 players, ties all get it). Tie-break: lower spend wins.
Commodities expansion (optional):
· Each auction, the second-highest bidder takes the top tile of one pile (type public, value secret); that bid adds to their spend, and the auctioneer records it as a sale, offsetting their own total.
· Zero bids no longer score. An empty gold pile makes gold tiles lose 3 VP each; most oil scores 5 VP (ties split, rounded down).
· Second-place tie: company goes to the highest bid, everyone else rebids for the commodity; three ties → auctioneer discards a pile top.

zh.name: 郎中闯江湖
zh.desc: 往锅里一味味加料熬药,白片超量就爆锅
zh.rules:
目标:游戏共进行 9 轮,计分轨得分最高者获胜;若平分,最后一轮锅中进度更远者获胜。
准备:
· 芯片以「颜色+面值」表示,如白 2 即白色 2 值芯片。
· 每人的起始袋中有白 1 四片、白 2 两片、白 3 一片、橙 1 与绿 1 各一片,另有红宝石 1 枚与装满的烧瓶 1 个。
· 配料书按开局所选套数生效;黄色芯片第 2 轮起开放购买,紫色芯片第 3 轮起开放。
流程:
· 每轮开始翻开 1 张预言卡:紫色卡立即结算,蓝色卡持续生效至本轮结束。
· 第 2 轮起,落后者按与领先者相差的鼠尾数,获得锅内起手位置加成。
· 熬药:从自己袋中盲抽芯片,自水滴位置起沿锅轨前进该片面值格数,可随时停手。
· 白片是炸药材:锅内白片面值之和超过 7 立即爆锅,本轮熬药强制结束。
· 烧瓶可将最后抽到的白片放回袋中,每次装满只能使用一次。
· 红、蓝、黄书的能力在对应颜色片放上锅轨时触发;绿、紫、黑书的能力在结算时触发。
结算(按序):
· 奖励骰:未爆锅者中结算格钱数最高者掷 1 次;钱数相同则比较锅内进度,仍相同则一同掷骰。
· 芯片动作:结算黑、绿、紫书能力。
· 红宝石:结算格带有红宝石标记则获得 1 枚红宝石,爆锅者同样获得。
· 得分:按结算格分数前进计分轨;爆锅者只能在得分与购买之间二选一。
· 购买:按结算格钱数购买 1 至 2 片不同颜色的芯片放入袋中,余款作废。
· 轮末:每支付 2 枚红宝石可将水滴推前 1 格,次数不限;可支付 2 枚红宝石补满烧瓶,每轮限一次。
结束:
· 第 6 轮开始时,每人袋中加入白 1 一片。
· 第 9 轮结束后,每余 5 钱换 1 分,每余 2 枚红宝石换 1 分。
试炼大锅(可选变体):
· 水滴前进时,可将进度自由分配给锅轨与试管奖励轨。
· 试管轨共 12 格,每前进 1 格立即领取该格奖励(红宝石、分数或指定芯片);轮末也可用红宝石推进试管轨。
草药女巫(可选扩展):
· 支持第 5 人;开局从银、铜、金三色女巫中各随机翻 1 张生效。
· 每人持银、铜、金便士各 1 枚,整局各用 1 次,未使用的便士终局每个计 2 分。
· 溢流碗:芯片到达锅底最后一格后,继续抽的片放入溢流碗。
· 碗内彩片不触发能力,白片仍计入爆炸值;结算按碗内面值总和的一半(向下取整)加分。
· 新配料痴愚草(青色)无固定面值,按所选书套在放置时动态定值;新南瓜书增加南瓜 6,一切升级对南瓜无效。
· 第 5/6 套配料书提供全新能力,随扩展解锁。

en.name: Quacks of Quedlinburg
en.desc: Push your luck brewing potions — too many white chips and the pot explodes
en.rules:
Goal: the game lasts 9 rounds; the player furthest along the score track wins. Ties go to the player whose pot advanced further in the final round.
Setup:
· Chips are written as color plus value, e.g. white 2 is a white chip of value 2.
· Each player's starting bag holds four white 1, two white 2, one white 3, one orange 1 and one green 1, plus 1 ruby and 1 filled flask.
· Ingredient books follow the set chosen at game start; yellow chips can be bought from round 2, purple chips from round 3.
Play:
· Each round opens by revealing 1 fortune card: purple cards resolve at once, blue cards stay in effect until the round ends.
· From round 2, anyone behind the leader gains a head start in the pot equal to the rat tails between them and the leader.
· Brewing: draw chips blind from your bag; starting from the droplet, each chip advances along the pot track by its face value. You may stop at any time.
· White chips are explosive: if their combined value in your pot exceeds 7, the pot explodes and your brewing ends at once.
· The flask returns the last drawn white chip to your bag; each filling allows one use.
· Red, blue and yellow book abilities trigger when a chip of that color is placed; green, purple and black book abilities trigger during scoring.
Scoring (in order):
· Bonus die: among players who did not explode, the highest money value on the scoring space rolls once; ties compare track progress, and players still tied all roll.
· Chip actions: resolve black, green and purple book abilities.
· Rubies: if the scoring space shows a ruby, gain 1 ruby; exploded players gain it as well.
· Points: advance on the score track by the scoring space's points; exploded players choose either points or buying.
· Buying: spend the scoring space's money on 1 or 2 chips of different colors for your bag; unspent money is lost.
· End of round: every 2 rubies may advance your droplet by 1 space, without limit; 2 rubies refill the flask, once per round.
End:
· At the start of round 6, each player adds one white 1 to their bag.
· After round 9, every 5 unspent money converts to 1 point, and every 2 leftover rubies convert to 1 point.
The Trial Pot (optional variant):
· When the droplet advances, its progress may be split freely between the pot track and the test tube reward track.
· The test tube track has 12 spaces; each space grants its reward (rubies, points or a named chip) as soon as it is reached. Rubies may also advance the test tube at the end of a round.
The Herb Witches (optional expansion):
· Supports a 5th player; at setup, one witch of each penny color (silver, copper, gold) is revealed at random.
· Each player holds one penny of each color, usable once per game; unspent pennies score 2 points each at the end.
· Overflow bowl: once a chip reaches the final space, further drawn chips go to the overflow bowl.
· Colored chips there trigger nothing, white chips still count toward exploding, and half the bowl's total face value (rounded down) scores.
· The new locoweed (turquoise) chip has no fixed value and is priced dynamically by book set; the new pumpkin book adds pumpkin 6, and pumpkins can never be upgraded.
· Book sets 5 and 6 bring all-new abilities and unlock with the expansion.

zh.name: 爱丽丝女王
zh.desc: 穿越镜中世界，以棋子行进构筑牌组，种花、传信、攀树和筑墙，助爱丽丝加冕。
zh.rules:
目标：争取最多影响力。
· 所有玩家共用红、白棋子，都能操作两种颜色。

准备：选择起始列车和颜色。
· 从两张列车卡中选择一张及其颜色面，领取起始奖励。
· 每人有十张基础牌，起始手牌三张，资源容量三格。
· 每级市场提供两张陈列牌及牌堆顶。王冠供给为人数加四。
· 单人对局加入黛娜，可选择四种难度。

回合：弃牌、打牌、移动和行动。
· 先弃置一张手牌，领取弃牌奖励；再打出另一张，领取打出奖励。
· 移动与打出牌类型、颜色相符的棋子；通配牌可选择红色或白色。
· 使用国际象棋走法；兵只前进一步，不使用双步、王车易位或将军限制。
· 对应棋子无合法移动时，可以原地激活。
· 可以救出任意监狱中的对应棋子，放在本色出生三行的空格。
· 出生区没有空格时可放任意空格；监狱主人获得一时间。
· 吃子获得一时间；吃掉非兵棋子，另得白棋对应的蛋糕或红棋对应的吐司。
· 吃掉王或后，再推进被吃棋子颜色的猫一步。
· 先领取落点行的资源，再执行所在列的行动；棋子颜色决定行动颜色。
· 星列支付任意一资源后选择行动；王牌可选择任意行动，仍须支付星列费用。
· 可以把刚获得的资源直接用于星列费用；也可放弃行动，获得两时间。
· 兵抵达对面底线后推进本色猫一步，返回出生区，再激活一次行列。

支付与奖励
· 红色行动支付蛋糕，白色行动支付吐司；部分费用另需茶。
· 每三时间可代替任意一资源；时间上限十，溢出部分每点转为一影响力。
· 资源满时可替换已有资源；黑方块增加容量，最多解锁五格。
· 交回一个已解锁黑方块可抵付一资源；同一行动内每个方块只能使用一次。
· 先付清费用，再领取奖励；多项奖励的次序由你选择，须在本次行动结清。

♥ 花园
· 依次支付一、二、二、二、三蛋糕或吐司，移去最低的同色红心。
· 园丁跨相邻区域每步支付一茶；从休息区进入任意区域免费。
· 获得个人板揭示奖励，再占据该区域的空花位，获得覆盖奖励。
· 区域满后，园丁回到休息区。
· 微行动免费移去任意颜色的最低红心，只领取个人板奖励。

♠ 信使
· 前进一、二、三步，分别支付一资源、二资源、二资源加一茶。
· 获得落点奖励和卡牌奖励；卡牌奖励可获得对应等级的牌，或邀请一张牌。
· 经过印章另得奖励，首位到达者奖励更多；进入金色路段推进爱丽丝。
· 终点给予王冠；微行动使任意颜色信使免费前进一步。

♣ 双子树
· 沿一条箭头移动；黄色路径支付对应蛋糕或吐司，黑色路径支付茶。
· 领取落点印刷书本；多种颜色叠印表示任选其中一本，分开印刷则分别领取。
· 首位到达者还领取实体白书，被白书覆盖的奖励此次不领取。
· 可用书本购买一个书签；即时书签立即生效，永久书签每回合可用一次。
· 从第二高度进入第三高度推进爱丽丝，抵达第四高度获得王冠。
