· 微行动使任意双子沿一条相邻黑色箭头免费移动，照常领奖和购买书签。

♦ 蛋墙
· 放在所选列最低的可用空位；行费用依次为一、二、二、三、四资源。
· 从蛋人向外数第三、第四列另付一茶；封锁格不参与放置或填满判断。
· 移去任意同色个人方块，获得揭示奖励和墙面覆盖奖励。
· 在蛋人当前高度建造得两分；填满该行改得四分，并把蛋人升一行。
· 微行动免费移去任意颜色的个人方块，只领取个人板奖励。
· 第三、第四、第五个同色红心或方块，分别给予爱丽丝推进、微行动、王冠。

重复与休整
· 每回合可支付六时间，重复一次同色同类行动，重新支付行动费用。
· 重复时不再出牌、移动棋子、领取行资源或支付星列费用。
· 休整时补牌或弃牌至手牌上限，牌库空时洗入弃牌。
· 市场向左滑动补齐，永久书签恢复；本回合触发的愿望为所有人计分。

花朵与卡牌
· 一朵粉花免星列费用；两朵在落点为中央四行时获得一或两时间。
· 一朵橙花把重复费用降为五时间；两朵再减免重复行动的一资源。
· 一朵黄花把手牌上限提高至五；两朵可花费或获得时间来调整购牌等级。
· 一朵蓝花使两时间可代替一资源；两朵允许把一茶换成两时间。
· 同类第三朵起不再增加能力。
· 市场三个位置的附加费用依次为免费、一时间、任意一资源。
· 获得的牌立即入手；邀请可从手牌或弃牌中选牌，移入宾客区。
· 保留至少三张未邀请的牌；出牌前不能邀请掉最后一张手牌。

爱丽丝、愿望与终局
· 推进爱丽丝时跳过王冠格，获得落点印刷分；到愿望格移走供给中的一冠。
· 获得王冠时，放在同色爱丽丝前方首个无冠且非愿望的空格，得双倍印刷分。
· 无王冠或无合法位置时获得十分；最后一冠移走后完成当前整轮。
· 领先颜色的愿望翻为白金；每个该色王冠再得八分。
· 两色爱丽丝并列时，两色王冠都得八分，愿望不翻面。
· 每色猫达到第六步可选一个同色愿望计分，达到第十步则两个都计分。
· 加上宾客和终局书签分；黛娜另按难度结算书签套组、花朵和未邀请牌。
· 影响力最高者获胜，同分共享胜利。

en.name: Queen Alice
en.desc: Build your deck through chess movement, plant flowers, deliver messages, climb the tree and build the wall to crown Alice.
en.rules:
Goal: Earn the most Influence Points (IP).
· All players share the red and white chess pieces and may use either colour.

Setup: Choose a starting Train and colour.
· Choose one of two Train cards and its colour, then receive its starting benefits.
· Each player has ten basic cards, three cards in hand and three resource spaces.
· Each market tier offers two display cards and its deck top. Crown supply equals player count plus four.
· Solo play adds Dinah with a choice of four difficulty levels.

Turn: Discard, play, move and act.
· Discard one hand card for its discard benefit, then play another for its play benefit.
· Move a piece matching the played card’s type and colour. Wild cards allow either colour.
· Use chess movement with one-step pawns, no castling and no check restrictions.
· A matching piece with no legal move may activate its current square.
· You may rescue a matching piece from any prison into an empty square in its home three ranks.
· If its home ranks are full, use any empty square. The prison owner gains one Time.
· Captures grant one Time. A captured non-pawn also grants Cake for white or Toast for red.
· Capturing a King or Queen also advances the cat of the captured colour one step.
· Gain the landing rank’s resource, then perform its column action in the moved piece’s colour.
· Pay any one resource in the star column to choose a suit. Kings may choose any suit but still pay the star fee.
· A newly gained resource may directly pay the star fee. You may decline the action for two Time.
· A pawn reaching the opposite edge advances its cat, returns home and activates another square.

Costs and benefits
· Red actions cost Cake and white actions cost Toast. Some costs also require Tea.
· Three Time may replace any one resource. Time is capped at ten; each excess Time becomes one IP.
· When storage is full you may replace a stored resource. Black cubes unlock up to five extra spaces.
· Return an unlocked black cube to provide one resource. Each cube may be used once per action.
· Pay costs before receiving benefits. Choose the order of multiple benefits and resolve them within the action.

♥ Garden
· Pay 1/2/2/2/3 Cake or Toast for successive hearts and remove your lowest matching heart.
· Moving the shared gardener between adjacent regions costs one Tea per step. Entry from rest is free.
· Gain the revealed personal benefit and cover a free space in that region for its reward.
· A filled region sends the gardener to rest.
· The mini-action removes either colour’s lowest heart for free and grants only its personal benefit.

♠ Messengers
· Advance 1/2/3 steps for one resource, two resources, or two resources plus one Tea.
· Gain the landing benefit and a card reward: acquire from the indicated tier or invite one card.
· Crossed seals grant extra benefits, larger for the first visitor. Entering the Gold section advances Alice.
· The end grants a Crown. The mini-action advances either messenger one step for free.

♣ Twins’ Tree
· Follow one arrow. Yellow paths cost matching Cake or Toast; black paths cost Tea.
· Take the landing printed books. Overlapping colours mean choose one; separate book icons each grant a book.
· The first visitor also takes the physical white book and does not receive the benefit it covered.
· You may buy one Bookmark with books. Immediate benefits apply now; permanent benefits refresh each turn.
· Moving from height two to three advances Alice. Reaching height four grants a Crown.
· The mini-action moves either Twin for free along an adjacent black arrow, with benefits and Bookmark purchase as usual.

♦ Wall
· Build in the lowest available space of a column. Rows cost 1/2/2/3/4 matching resources.
· The third and fourth columns counted outwards from the egg cost one extra Tea. Blocked spaces are ignored.
· Remove any matching personal diamond and gain its revealed benefit and the covered wall reward.
· Building at the egg’s height scores two IP. Completing that row instead scores four IP and raises the egg.
· The mini-action removes a personal diamond of either colour for free and grants only its personal benefit.
· The third, fourth and fifth matching hearts or diamonds grant Alice progress, a mini-action and a Crown.

Repeat and rest
· Once per turn, pay six Time to repeat the same colour and suit, paying its action costs again.
· Repetition does not play a card, move a piece, grant a rank resource or repay the star fee.
· Rest by drawing or discarding to your hand limit, shuffling discards when the deck is empty.
· Slide and refill the market, refresh permanent Bookmarks and score triggered Wishes for all players.

Flowers and cards
· One pink flower removes the star fee. Two grant one or two Time when landing in the central four ranks.
· One orange flower reduces repetition to five Time. Two also discount one resource from the repeated action.
· One yellow flower raises the hand limit to five. Two allow changing acquisition tiers by paying or gaining Time.
· One blue flower reduces resource substitution to two Time. Two allow exchanging one Tea for two Time.
· Further flowers of a type do not improve these abilities.
· Market position surcharges are free, one Time and any one resource.
· Acquired cards enter your hand immediately. Invite a card from hand or discard into the guest area.
· Keep at least three non-invited cards and do not invite away your last hand card before the mandatory play.

Alice, Wishes and final scoring
· Alice skips Crown spaces and scores printed IP. Reaching a Wish removes one Crown from supply.
· Place an earned Crown in the first empty non-Wish space ahead of matching Alice for double its printed IP.
· Gain ten IP if no Crown or valid space remains. Finish the current round after the last Crown leaves supply.
· Turn the leading colour’s Wishes platinum and score eight IP per Crown of that colour.
· If Alice is tied, all Crowns score eight IP and no Wishes turn platinum.
· Each cat reaching step six scores one matching Wish of your choice. Reaching step ten scores both.
· Add guest and final Bookmark points. Dinah uses her difficulty’s Bookmark sets, flowers and acquired-card bonuses.
· Highest Influence wins. Tied players share victory.

zh.name: 花砖物语:花园宫殿
zh.desc: 为女王造园:按图案或颜色拿砖,付费造景,围住喷泉雕像赚 joker
zh.rules:
目标:四轮结束后总分最高者获胜,平分共享胜利。
流程(轮到你,四选一):拿取 / 放砖 / 放扩展 / 跳过。
拿取:
· 从供应区选一种图案(各色)或一种颜色(各图案),拿走全部匹配的砖与翻面扩展;重复的组合只拿一件。
· 仓储放不下就不能选:砖 12 格、扩展 2 格。
· 若从回合堆顶块拿了砖,该块带着剩砖移入供应区,新顶块补 4 砖。
· 被拿空的扩展翻面,露出凉亭与印刷砖,可被之后的拿取选走。
放砖:
· 选仓储里一块砖,支付等于图案值的件数:树 1、鸟 2、蝶 3、花 4、枝 5、蜂 6。
· 支付方式:从仓储弃掉含该砖在内的等量件,须全是同图案异色,或全同色异图案;🌈 joker(百搭)可顶替其它件。
· 落点须是空格:孤立,或与相邻砖同图案/同色;且同一连通组里不许出现两块完全相同的砖。
放扩展:
· 仓储里的扩展支付其上印刷砖的成本,凉亭面朝上放进花园周围 6 个凹槽之一(6 种朝向任选,印刷砖同样遵守放砖规则)。
· 或花正好 6 分从供应堆买素面扩展(7 个空格)。
跳过:
· 可弃掉仓储里的任意件,按值扣分。
· 本轮第一个跳过的人拿先手标记并扣 1 分。
轮末计分:
· 全员跳过后按转盘计分:花园中每个匹配本轮 3 个符号的砖按徽章得分(图案颜色可双计),每个凉亭获得 1 分。
· 完全围住喷泉/雕像/长椅/凉亭(相邻 6 格全有砖)立即获得 1/2/2/3 个 joker。
终局计分:
· 仓储里的 joker 各获得 1 分,其余件按值扣分。
· 逐色逐图案评估:至少 3 块的连通组获得成员图案值之和,恰好 6 块再加 6 分。

en.name: Azul: Queen's Garden
en.desc: Draft hexes by pattern or color, pay to plant them, surround fountains for jokers
en.rules:
Goal: after four rounds the highest score wins; ties share the victory.
On your turn, choose one: acquire / place a tile / place an expansion / pass.
Acquire:
· Pick one pattern (all colors) or one color (all patterns) from the display and take every matching tile and face-up expansion; duplicate combos are taken only once.
· You must have room in storage: 12 tile slots, 2 expansion slots.
· Taking from the round stack's top block moves it into the display and deals 4 tiles to the new top.
· An expansion emptied of tiles flips over, revealing a pavilion and a printed hex that later acquires can claim.
Place a tile:
· Pick a tile in storage and pay its pattern value: tree 1, bird 2, butterflies 3, flower 4, branch 5, swarm 6.
· Payment: discard that many items including the tile, all sharing its pattern with distinct colors, or all sharing its color with distinct patterns; 🌈 jokers stand in for other items.
· The target cell must be empty and either isolated or adjacent to a tile of the same pattern or color; no connected group may hold two identical hexes.
Place an expansion:
· Pay the printed hex's cost to place one from storage pavilion-side-up into one of the 6 recesses around the garden (any of 6 rotations; the printed hex follows the same placement rules).
· Or spend exactly 6 points to buy a plain expansion (7 empty cells) from the supply.
Pass:
· You may discard stored items to lose their values.
· The first passer takes the starting marker and loses 1 point.
Round scoring:
· Once everyone passes, score the wheel: each garden hex matching one of the round's 3 symbols scores its badge value (pattern and color can both count), plus 1 point per pavilion.
· Fully surrounding a fountain/statue/bench/pavilion (all 6 neighbors filled) instantly grants 1/2/2/3 jokers.
Endgame scoring:
· Jokers in storage score 1 point each; leftover items cost their values.
· Then colors and patterns are evaluated — each connected group of at least 3 scores the sum of its members' pattern values, and exactly 6 scores 6 more.

zh.name: 快可思
zh.desc: 六骰齐掷全员抢画,四行数字越锁越快
zh.rules:
目标:在四行数字上尽量多地画记,终局总分最高者获胜。
流程:
· 主动玩家掷 6 颗骰:2 颗白骰 + 红黄绿蓝各 1 颗;已锁行的色骰移出游戏。
· 白骰阶段:所有人可自行把两颗白骰的点数和画进任一行;只能画在该行已画格的右侧,跳过的格子之后不能再画。
· 色骰阶段:仅主动玩家可再画一记——任选一颗白骰与一颗色骰求和,画进该色对应的行。
· 主动玩家整回合一记未画,记 1 格罚分(终局每格扣 5 分)。
锁行:
· 某行画满至少 5 格后,画记该行最右端数字(12 或 2)可同时画下锁格,该行对所有玩家关闭。
结束:
· 任一玩家画满 4 格罚分,或第 2 行被锁(累计两行关闭),对局立即结束。
结算:
· 每行按画记数查表得分(1 记 1 分,12 记 78 分;锁格也算 1 记),减去罚分;总分最高者胜,平分共同获胜。

en.name: Qwixx
en.desc: Everyone plays on every roll — cross off numbers across four rows before they lock away
en.rules:
Goal: Mark as many numbers as you can in four rows; highest total wins.
Play:
· The active player rolls 6 dice: 2 white plus one each of red, yellow, green, blue; dice of locked rows leave the game.
· White phase: everyone may cross the sum of the two white dice in any one row; you may only mark to the right of your existing marks, and skipped cells are gone for good.
· Color phase: only the active player may mark once more — add one white die to one colored die and mark that sum in the matching row.
· If the active player marks nothing all turn, they take a penalty box (−5 each).
Locking:
· With at least 5 marks in a row, marking its rightmost number (12 or 2) also crosses the lock, closing that row for everyone.
End:
· The game ends immediately when anyone takes a 4th penalty or a 2nd row is locked.
Scoring:
· Each row scores by its mark count (1 mark = 1 pt, 12 marks = 78; the lock counts as a mark), minus penalties; highest total wins, ties share the win.

zh.name: 赛马大亨
zh.desc: 实时下注的赛马派对,四场比赛谁钱多谁赢
zh.rules:
目标:四场比赛后,持有金钱最多的玩家获胜。
准备:
· 九匹马对应骰点和 2-12,赛道 15 格,所有人起始资金为 0。
· 每人持有 2、3、3、4、5 五个注码;7 人以上改为 2、3、4、5。
流程:
· 比赛自动进行:定时掷两枚骰子,点数和驱动对应的马前进一格。
· 同一匹马连续两次被驱动时额外冲刺(7 号马无冲刺,连续第三次不触发)。
· 赛跑期间随时把注码放上投注板空格,先到先得,每格限一枚。
· 第三匹马越过红线后停止下注;任一马到达终点比赛立即结束。
· 第一至三场赛后,每人从两张 VIP 卡中选一张保留,效果累积。
结算:
· 押中冠军:头马、前二、前三注全中;押中亚军:前二、前三注中;押中季军:仅前三注中;并列同享。
· 赢注赔付 = 注码面值 × 格上倍率;输注付格上红圈罚金,无红圈不付钱。
· 输光不负债;四场后金钱最多者获胜,平分则并列获胜。

en.name: Ready Set Bet
en.desc: Real-time betting horse-racing party; richest after four races wins
en.rules:
Goal: after four races, the player with the most money wins.
Setup:
· Nine horses map to dice sums 2-12; the track has 15 spaces; everyone starts at $0.
· Each player holds bet tokens 2, 3, 3, 4, 5; with 7+ players drop one 3.
Play:
· Races run automatically: two dice roll on a timer and move the matching horse one space.
· A horse moved twice in a row sprints bonus spaces (not horse 7; never thrice in a row).
· During the race, place tokens on open board spots at any time, first come first served.
· Betting closes once three horses cross the red line; the race ends at the finish.
· After races 1-3, each player keeps one of two dealt VIP cards; effects accumulate.
Scoring:
· 1st pays WIN+PLACE+SHOW, 2nd pays PLACE+SHOW, 3rd pays SHOW; ties share.
· Winning bets pay token value × spot multiplier; losing bets pay the red-circle penalty.
· You never go into debt; richest after four races wins, ties share the victory.

zh.name: 52个王国:冒险
zh.desc: 纯单人地城爬行:一副扑克牌闯荡四张地图,击败首领并带走战利品
zh.rules:
目标:深入地城击败首领,并尽可能多地带走战利品;创伤牌等级合计达到生命上限,或需要抽牌时牌库已空,则冒险失败。
准备:先抽 2 张牌作为物品,再逐张抽牌作为装备,直到装备等级合计达到 20;期间抽到的 A 先搁置,最后全部洗回牌库。
回合流程:
· 沿走廊移动到相邻房间,然后结算该房间的效果。
· 数字门需耗尽等级合计足够的就绪装备,字母门需先击败对应等级的敌人。
· 火炬门需要火炬等级达标,扭曲走廊抽牌决定费用。
战斗:抽 2 张牌,等级高者是敌人(花色决定种类),另 1 张是奖励牌;平局按 ♣>♠>♥>♦ 决胜。
· 每个战斗回合揭示 1 张战斗卡,敌人的格挡先生效。
· 然后你选择攻击、防御、使用角色技能或休息,最后敌人按战斗卡花色行动。
攻击:耗尽 1 张就绪装备,造成其等级点伤害;敌人生命标记的落点若印有符号,立即结算该符号。
防御:耗尽任意数量就绪装备,按等级合计减免本回合受到的伤害。
受到伤害时抽牌判定:抽到的牌等级不超过伤害值,则成为创伤牌;幽灵类敌人造成的伤害直接成为创伤。
奖励牌三选一放置:作为物品、装备或战利品。
物品效果:
· ♣ 力量药水:重置全部装备。
· ♠ 欺骗斗篷:改变 1 张装备的等级或花色。
· ♥ 治疗药水:弃 1 张创伤,或抵消一次诅咒。
· ♦ 幸运水晶:将刚抽到的牌换为重新抽 1 张。
无论何时抽到 A,立即承受当前地图对应的诅咒效果,然后补抽 1 张。
计分:每张物品 2 分,战利品按等级计分;永恒午夜森林的赏金、沉没的大教堂的蜡烛另有加分。

en.name: 52 Realms: Adventures
en.desc: A solo dungeon crawl: four maps, one deck of cards, slay the boss and keep the loot
en.rules:
Goal: delve deep, defeat the boss, and get out with as much loot as you can. You lose if your wound ranks reach your health total, or if you must draw from an empty deck.
Setup: draw 2 cards as items, then draw equipment until your equipment ranks total 20; set aside any Aces and shuffle them back in at the end.
Each turn:
· Move along a corridor to an adjacent room, then resolve the room you enter.
· Numbered gates require exhausting ready equipment of sufficient total rank; lettered gates require defeating a guardian of that rank.
· Torch gates require torch level, and twisted corridors draw a card to set the cost.
Combat: draw 2 cards — the higher one is the enemy (its suit sets the type), the other is the reward; ties break ♣>♠>♥>♦.
· Each combat round, reveal a battle card: enemy block applies first.
· Then you attack, defend, use a character skill, or rest, and the enemy acts by the suit of its battle card.
Attack: exhaust 1 ready equipment to deal its rank in damage; symbols on the space where the enemy health marker lands trigger immediately.
Defend: exhaust any number of ready equipment to reduce incoming damage by their total rank.
When you take damage, draw a card: if its rank does not exceed the damage, it becomes a wound; wounds from wraiths are automatic.
Place each reward card in one of three places: as an item, equipment, or loot.
Item effects:
· ♣ strength potion: refresh all equipment.
· ♠ cloak of deception: change the rank or suit of 1 equipment.
· ♥ healing potion: discard 1 wound, or cancel a curse.
· ♦ lucky crystal: redraw a card you just drew.
Whenever you draw an Ace, immediately suffer the curse of the current map, then draw a replacement.
Scoring: 2 points per item, loot scores its rank; the Forest of the Eternal Midnight scores bounty, and the Sunken Cathedral scores candles.

zh.name: 重筑家园
zh.desc: 重建苏格兰与爱尔兰，发展农场、争夺城堡并完成使命
zh.rules:
目标：通过重建家园获得最高总分。
准备：
· 可选择苏格兰或爱尔兰地图，采用官方 1.2b 规则。
· 每人有能源农场和粮食农场各 12 块，影响力为 1、2、3、4 的聚落板块各 3 块。
· 4 人局每人移除能源农场和粮食农场各 3 块。
· 4 人局每人另移除影响力为 2、3、4 的聚落板块各 1 块。
· 将自己的板块洗混。苏格兰随机留出 2 块，本局不使用。
· 爱尔兰随机留出 4 块，供圆塔奖励使用。可以随时查看自己留出的板块种类。
· 每人提前抽取 1 块作为手牌。从首位玩家开始，顺时针行动。
· 2 人局封锁地图上标记的区域：苏格兰 32 格，爱尔兰 24 格。封锁格不参与游戏。
放置：
· 每回合将手牌放在一个未被占用的合法格上，结算后抽取下回合的 1 块手牌。
· 能源农场放在能源或空白农场格；粮食农场放在粮食或空白农场格。
· 聚落板块只能放在聚落格。城堡、教堂、圆塔格不能放置板块。
· 对应类型的农场格和空白农场格均已被占用时，才允许改放到另一类型的农场格。
得分：
· 同一玩家、同一类型且相连的农场构成农场群。不同类型或不同玩家的农场不能连成同一群。
· 每次放置农场板块，立即获得放置后所在农场群的板块数量分数。
· 单格小型聚落立即获得所放板块的影响力分数。
· 多格聚落填满时，按各玩家在其中的影响力总和排名。
· 中型聚落奖励为 5、3 分；大型聚落为 8、5 分，其余玩家不得分。
· 爱尔兰的四格扩展聚落奖励为 12、8、5 分，其余玩家不得分。
· 聚落影响力相同时，完成该聚落的玩家排在并列玩家之后。
· 其他并列玩家从完成者的下一位开始，按顺时针优先。未分配的奖励归第一名。
· 放置在苏格兰港口格或爱尔兰离岸农场格，额外获得 1 分。
· 每座城堡由占用相邻格最多的玩家控制。相同时，比较相邻农场板块数量。
· 相邻格数和农场数量仍相同时，当前落子者不能夺取城堡。
苏格兰：
· 每位玩家第一次在一座教堂旁放置板块时，获得一张私人任务。每座教堂每人限一次。
· 私人任务在终局计分：达成条件获得 5 分，条件并列最多也视为达成。
· 教堂奖励卡无条件获得 3 分。
爱尔兰：
· 随机公开 8 张公共任务，其余 4 张放在任务牌堆中。每人每张公共任务只能完成一次。
· 首次完成者获得较高分，之后完成者获得较低分。一次放置可以完成多张任务。
· 连接城堡或圆塔的任务，要求用自己的连续板块接触指定数量的建筑。建筑本身不能作为路径。
· 沿海任务要求占用连续的沿海格。
· 每位玩家首次占用圆塔相邻格时，触发该塔奖励。同一圆塔每人只能触发一次。
· 两座奖励圆塔各提供 3 分；到访全部三座同类圆塔获得 13 分。
· 额外放置圆塔：从留出的板块中随机抽取 1 块并立即放置，正常结算。
· 每回合最多触发一次额外放置。额外板块触及另一座此类圆塔时，忽略该塔奖励。
· 抽取三块圆塔：回合结束时，从供应中抽取最多 3 块。
· 下回合选择其中 1 块放置，然后将其余板块洗回供应。
· 私人任务圆塔：从剩余任务牌堆抽取 1 张私人任务。
· 私人任务在终局达成时获得牌面较高分；抽取前已经达成也可计分。
· 翻倍圆塔：到访两座此类圆塔后，将翻倍标记放在一张自己尚未完成的公共任务上。
· 之后完成该任务时，实际获得的高分或低分均翻倍。
终局：
· 所有玩家用完手牌与供应后游戏结束。未完成聚落中的板块各按影响力计分。
· 每座控制的城堡获得 5 分。公开并结算私人任务。
· 苏格兰最高分并列时，优先由并列玩家中控制爱丁堡城堡者获胜。
· 若无人符合，则控制斯特灵城堡的玩家获胜，即使其并非最高分。
· 斯特灵城堡也无人控制时，最高分玩家共享胜利。
· 爱尔兰最高分并列时，优先由并列玩家中控制布拉尼城堡者获胜。
· 若无人符合，则所有玩家中占用塔拉山圆塔相邻格最多者获胜，即使其并非最高分。
· 塔拉山仍并列时，共享胜利。

en.name: Rebirth
en.desc: Restore Scotland and Ireland with farms, castles and missions
en.rules:
Goal: rebuild the land and earn the most points.
Setup:
· Choose Scotland or Ireland. Both maps follow official rulebook 1.2b.
· Each player has 12 Energy Farms, 12 Food Farms and 3 Settlement Tiles of each Influence value from 1 to 4.
· With 4 players, each player removes 3 of each farm type.
· With 4 players, each player also removes 1 Settlement Tile of each value 2, 3 and 4.
· Shuffle your tiles. In Scotland, set aside 2 at random; these are not used.
· In Ireland, set aside 4 at random for tower bonuses. You may inspect the types of your set-aside tiles at any time.
· Each player draws 1 tile into their hand. The first seat starts; play proceeds clockwise.
· With 2 players, the marked spaces are blocked: 32 in Scotland, 24 in Ireland. Blocked spaces do not take part.
Placement:
· Place your hand tile on an unoccupied legal space, score it, then draw 1 tile for your next turn.
· Energy Farms go on Energy or blank farm spaces; Food Farms go on Food or blank farm spaces.
· Settlements go only on Settlement spaces. Castles, Cathedrals and Towers cannot be occupied.
· Only when all matching farm spaces and blank farm spaces are occupied may you use a space of the other farm type.
Scoring:
· Connected farms of the same type and player form a cluster. Different types or players never share a cluster.
· Each farm placement scores the size of its resulting cluster.
· A Small Settlement scores its tile’s Influence immediately.
· A larger Settlement scores once full, ranking players by total Influence within it.
· Medium Settlements award 5 and 3 points; Large Settlements award 8 and 5. Other players score nothing.
· Ireland’s four-space Sprawling Settlements award 12, 8 and 5 points. Other players score nothing.
· Influence ties put the player completing the Settlement last among tied players.
· Other ties favor clockwise order starting after the completing player. Any unassigned prizes go to first place.
· Placing on a Scottish Port or Irish Offshore Farm scores 1 extra point.
· A Castle is controlled by the player with the most adjacent occupied spaces. Ties favor more adjacent farm tiles.
· If both counts remain equal, the active player cannot take control.
Scotland:
· Your first placement beside each Cathedral earns a Private Mission, once per player per Cathedral.
· Private Missions score 5 points at game end if fulfilled; ties for most also qualify.
· Cathedral Bonus cards award 3 points unconditionally.
Ireland:
· Reveal 8 Public Missions, leaving 4 in the deck. Each player can complete each Public Mission once.
· The first player earns the higher score; later players earn the lower score. One placement may complete several missions.
· Linking missions require your connected tiles to touch the required number of Castles or Towers. Buildings cannot be part of the path.
· Coastal missions require consecutive coastal spaces.
· Your first placement beside each Tower activates its bonus, once per player per tower.
· Two towers award 3 points each; visiting all three matching towers awards 13 points.
· Extra placement: randomly draw one set-aside tile and place it immediately, scoring normally.
· Extra placement can activate only once per turn. An extra tile touching another such tower ignores that bonus.
· Draw three: draw up to 3 supply tiles at turn end.
· On your next turn, place one, then shuffle the rest back into your supply.
· Private Mission: draw one remaining mission card privately.
· It scores its higher value at game end if fulfilled, including a condition met before drawing it.
· Doubling: after visiting both matching towers, mark one Public Mission you have not completed.
· When you later complete it, double the actual higher or lower award.
End:
· End when all hands and supplies are exhausted. Tiles in incomplete Settlements score their Influence.
· Each controlled Castle scores 5 points. Reveal and score Private Missions.
· In a Scottish top-score tie, a tied player controlling Edinburgh Castle wins.
· Otherwise, Stirling Castle’s controller wins even if outside the top-score tie.
· If Stirling is uncontrolled too, the top scorers share victory.
· In an Irish top-score tie, a tied player controlling Blarney Castle wins.
· Otherwise, whoever occupies the most spaces beside the Hill of Tara wins, even if outside the top-score tie.
· Further ties at Tara share victory.

zh.name: 弑君者
zh.desc: 合作讨伐:全队接力挑战 12 位 J/Q/K 君王,扑克牌就是武器
zh.rules:
目标:全队合作,依次击败城堡中的 12 位君王(4 张 J、4 张 Q、4 张 K);击败最后的 K 即全员获胜。
牌的面值:A 计 1,2~10 按面值,J 计 10、Q 计 15、K 计 20。
敌人生命:J 为 20、Q 为 30、K 为 40。
流程(轮到你):
· 打出一张牌攻击;也可以打出同点数的多张(合计不超过 10),或用一张 A 带任意一张牌。
· 敌人未被击败则会反击:弃掉合计不低于其攻击力的手牌;弃不够则全员落败。
· 也可以放弃攻击,直接承受反击。
花色能力(按打出牌的面值生效):
· ♣ 本次攻击伤害翻倍。
· ♥ 从弃牌堆随机洗回等量的牌进牌库。
· ♦ 从你开始全队轮流补牌,手牌已满的跳过。
· ♠ 永久降低当前敌人的攻击力。
特殊规则:
· 敌人免疫自己的花色:该花色的牌只算伤害,不发动能力。
· 小丑只能单独打出:解除当前敌人的免疫、跳过本次反击,并指定下一位行动者。
· 伤害恰好等于敌人剩余生命时,敌人放回牌库顶,之后可被抽成手牌;否则进弃牌堆。
· 手牌上限:2 人 7 张、3 人 6 张、4 人 5 张;小丑数量:3 人 1 张、4 人 2 张。

en.name: Regicide
en.desc: Co-op card battle: take down 12 royal J/Q/K together
en.rules:
Goal: work together to defeat the 12 royals in the castle (4 Jacks, 4 Queens, 4 Kings); defeating the final King wins the game for everyone.
Card values: A=1, 2–10 face value, J=10, Q=15, K=20.
Enemy health: J=20, Q=30, K=40.
On your turn:
· Play one card to attack; you may also play several cards of the same rank (total ≤ 10), or an Ace together with any one card.
· If the enemy survives, it strikes back: discard cards totaling at least its attack; if you cannot, everyone loses.
· You may also yield and take the counterattack without attacking.
Suit powers (scaled by the values played):
· ♣ doubles this attack’s damage.
· ♥ shuffles that many cards from the discard back into the deck at random.
· ♦ draws cards for the team in turn, starting with you; full hands are skipped.
· ♠ permanently lowers the current enemy’s attack.
Special rules:
· An enemy is immune to its own suit: cards of that suit deal damage but grant no power.
· A Jester must be played alone: it breaks the current enemy’s immunity, skips the counterattack, and lets you choose who acts next.
· Damage exactly equal to the enemy’s remaining health is a perfect kill: the royal goes on top of the deck and can later be drawn as a hand card; otherwise it is discarded.
· Hand limit: 7 cards with 2 players, 6 with 3, 5 with 4. Jesters: 1 with 3 players, 2 with 4.

zh.name: 弑君者:传承
zh.desc: 12 任务合作传承战役:队伍随战役成长,腐蚀、佣兵与神器改变每一局
zh.rules:
目标:全队合作击败本任务的全部敌人;任一玩家承受不住伤害则全员落败。
回合流程(轮到你):
· 打出一张牌攻击;或打出同点数的组合(合计不超过 10 点)、动物/野兽带 1 张搭档;也可以放弃攻击直接承受反击。
· 花色能力:牧师=弃牌堆洗切后取等量牌垫入库底;吟游诗人=全队轮流补牌;战士=本次伤害翻倍;圣骑士=永久削减敌攻。
· 敌人未被击败则反击:弃掉合计不低于其攻击力的手牌来承受伤害;一次性弃光整副手牌可「假死」,抵挡任意数值的伤害。
· 敌人免疫自身花色:该花色只算伤害不发动能力;小丑打出后由任意玩家认领,认领者的攻击无视免疫。
战役演化:
· 腐蚀卡:打出时先放逐牌库顶 1 张,无视同色免疫。
· 法师:翻牌垫牌连锁;守护者:打出当回合格挡全部伤害;德鲁伊:重分配弃牌堆;吟唱者:从牌库任意补牌。
· 失败得金币,可在下次尝试前招募佣兵;通关任务解锁新职业、神器与卡牌。

en.name: Regicide Legacy
en.desc: A 12-mission co-op legacy campaign: your party evolves with corruption, mercenaries and relics
en.rules:
Goal: cooperate to defeat every enemy of the mission; if any player cannot suffer the damage, the whole party falls.
On your turn:
· Play a card to attack; or a same-value combo (totalling no more than 10), or an Animal/Beast with 1 partner; or yield and take the hit.
· Suits: Cleric shuffles the discard and tucks cards under the deck; Bard refills hands around the table; Warrior doubles damage; Paladin permanently reduces enemy attack.
· If the enemy survives it strikes back: discard cards totaling at least its attack; discarding a full hand (Feign Death) covers any amount.
· Enemies are immune to their own suit: that suit only deals damage; a claimed Jester attack ignores immunity.
Campaign twists:
· Corrupted cards banish the top of the deck when played and ignore immunity.
· Mages tuck chained flips; Guardians block all damage that turn; Druids redistribute the discard; Chanters draw freely from the deck.
· Losing earns gold to hire mercenaries for the next attempt; winning missions unlocks new suits, relics and cards.

zh.name: 黑色左轮
zh.desc: 藏进大宅,听音辨位,先中两枪者出局
zh.rules:
目标:率先命中对手两枪的人获胜。
准备:
· 两人各自秘密挑选一个房间作为起始位置。
· 八间房的移动路线、射击范围与房间效果各不相同,点房间可查看。
流程:轮流行动,每回合默认 2 点行动力。
· 从厨房开始回合的人有 3 点行动力。
· 移动(1 点):走到一间相邻房间,目的地对对手保密。
· 射击(2 点):射击射程内的一间房;开枪会暴露你的位置,
  之后必须免费移动一步。
· 听音(1 点):对手必须公开一间其当前可以移动到的房间。
· 设陷阱(1 点):布置在当前房间,最多同时持有两枚;
  花 1 点可以引爆已布置的陷阱,炸伤当时房中的人。
· 房间效果:发动即暴露你的位置——门厅回声免费听音,
  并逼二楼的对手报出确切位置;卧室放水淹没地下室,
  淹伤并赶走其中的人,直到你的下个回合无法进入;
  书房暗门把厨房里的人倒进地下室;地下室控制面板在
  任意其他房间布置自动陷阱,你的下回合开始时自动引爆;
  阳台可以免费翻越栏杆直接进入厨房。
结束:
· 任意一方累计中枪两次,另一方立即获胜。

en.name: Revolver Noir
en.desc: Hide in the mansion, listen, deduce — two hits and you are out
en.rules:
Goal: the first to land two hits on the opponent wins.
Setup:
· Each player secretly picks a room as their starting position.
· The eight rooms differ in move links, shooting range and effects.
Turns: take turns with 2 action points per turn.
· Starting your turn in the Kitchen grants 3 action points.
· Move (1 point): enter an adjacent room; the destination stays secret.
· Shoot (2 points): fire at a room in range; shooting reveals your
  position, and you must then move one step for free.
· Listen (1 point): the opponent must name one room they can move to.
· Traps (1 point): arm a trap in your current room, at most two at a time;
  spend 1 point to detonate an armed trap, hurting whoever is inside.
· Room effects reveal your position — Foyer: a free Listen, and an
  opponent upstairs must name their exact room; Bedroom: flood the
  Basement, hurting and expelling anyone inside, sealed until your
  next turn; Library: dump whoever is in the Kitchen into the Basement;
  Basement: arm an auto-trap in any other room, going off for free at
  the start of your next turn; Balcony: vault the railing into the Kitchen.
End:
· As soon as a player has been hit twice, the other player wins.

zh.name: 银河竞逐
zh.desc: 同时暗选五个阶段:探索、开发、殖民、消费、生产,用手牌付款建起你的银河帝国
zh.rules:
目标:建成最强大的星际帝国——桌面卡满 12 张或 VP 筹码用光时终局,总分最高者胜。
准备:每人随机一个起始世界,抽 6 张手牌弃 2 张。
流程(每回合):
· 每人暗选 1 个行动:探索(两种)、开发、殖民、贸易+消费、双倍消费、生产。
· 全员亮开后,只有被选中的阶段会执行,按 I→V 顺序;所有人都执行该阶段,选了它的人多得一份奖励。
阶段:
· I 探索:抽 2 留 1;选它则「抽 7 留 1」或「抽 3 留 2」。
· II 开发:弃手牌付费用打出 1 张发展卡;选它费用 −1。发展卡每人每种只能有一张。
· III 殖民:打出 1 个世界——非军事世界弃手牌付费用;军事世界靠军事值征服(不付牌),两者不能混用。
· 选殖民的玩家放置后摸 1 张;风陨世界入场时自带 1 份货。
· IV 消费:用消费能力把货换成 VP 筹码或手牌。
· 选「贸易」先卖 1 份货换牌(新异品 2/稀有 3/基因 4/异星 5 张);选「双倍消费」本阶段所得 VP 翻倍。
· V 生产:所有生产世界产 1 份货;选它可额外在 1 个风陨世界产货。
细则:卡上能力从打出的下一阶段起才生效;每回合结束手牌上限 10 张;终局平分比手牌+货数。
计分:桌面卡面分、VP 筹码与 6 费发展的倍数计分之和(单卡只计最高一档)。

en.name: Race for the Galaxy
en.desc: Simultaneously pick phases — Explore, Develop, Settle, Consume, Produce — and pay cards from hand to build your galactic empire
en.rules:
Goal: build the strongest galactic empire. The game ends when anyone has 12+ cards in play or the VP chips run out; highest score wins.
Setup: each player gets a random start world, draws 6 cards and discards 2.
Each round:
· Everyone secretly picks 1 action: Explore (two kinds), Develop, Settle, Trade+Consume, Double Consume, or Produce.
· Only the chosen phases happen, in order I→V; everyone performs them, but choosers get a bonus.
Phases:
· I Explore: draw 2 keep 1; choosers instead draw 7 keep 1 or draw 3 keep 2.
· II Develop: discard cards to pay for 1 development; choosers pay 1 less. Each development is unique to your tableau.
· III Settle: play 1 world — pay cards for non-military worlds, or conquer military worlds with Military power; never both.
· Settle choosers draw 1 after placing; windfall worlds start with a good.
· IV Consume: use powers to turn goods into VP chips or cards.
· Trade choosers first sell 1 good for cards (Novelty 2 / Rare 3 / Genes 4 / Alien 5); Double Consume choosers double VPs earned.
· V Produce: production worlds each gain a good; choosers also produce on one windfall world.
Details: powers only work from the phase AFTER the card enters play; hand limit is 10 at round end; ties break on cards in hand plus goods.
Scoring: printed VP of cards, VP chips, and 6-cost development multipliers (each card scores only its best single category).

zh.name: 茂林源记
zh.desc: 八大阵营以各自的方式争夺森林，支持本体、河岸和地底扩展。
zh.rules:
目标：
· 率先达到 30 分立即获胜；移除敌方建筑或标记各得一分。
· 至少 10 分时，可在白天启用支配牌，改用其胜利条件。
准备：
· 选择地图与阵营，按提示摆放起始棋件，每人取得三张手牌。
· 支持本体、河岸扩展和地底扩展，以及九种游侠角色。
回合：
· 依次进行清晨、白天、夜晚，按阵营板执行各自流程。
· 鸟牌通常可代替其他花色；蜥蜴仪式不适用此替代。
移动与控制：
· 士兵与建筑最多的阵营控制领地；飞鹰赢得非零平手。
· 庭院强制控制领地。一般移动须控制起点或终点。
· 沿道路移动；游侠、阴谋羽党、小舟与商会有特殊移动规则。
战斗与锻造：
· 防守方可打出匹配奇袭，进攻方可用匹配奇袭反制。
· 双骰高点归进攻方；联盟防守时取高点。
· 掷骰伤害不超过参战士兵或未损坏的剑数量。
· 双方同时受伤，先移除士兵，再自行选择建筑与标记。
· 激活匹配花色的锻造棋件支付费用，每件每回合使用一次。
· 道具数量有限；不能重复锻造同名持续效果。
猫咪贵族与飞鹰王朝：
· 猫咪生产木材，白天锻造后执行三行动，可支付鸟牌追加。
· 行军至多移动两次，招募每回合一次，建造需控制连通木材。
· 失去士兵后，可支付匹配牌将其放回仍在场的城堡。
· 飞鹰清晨增加法令，白天锻造后依次履行招募、移动、战斗、建造。
· 无法履行则动乱：扣除法令鸟牌分数、弃法令并更换领袖。
森林联盟与蜥蜴神教：
· 联盟花费支持者传播民意或起义，训练长官以执行夜晚行动。
· 他人移除民意或移动士兵进入民意领地时，必须平息民愤。
· 无基地时支持者最多五张；失去基地还会失去匹配支持者和半数长官。
· 蜥蜴用揭示的手牌建造、招募、献祭，用弃牌仪式得分。
· 遭弃者由遭弃者牌堆决定；仆从可发动圣战、转化或净化。
河岸商会与鼹鼠地国：
· 清晨可用待命士兵购买商会手牌、小舟与佣兵服务。
· 商会调用资金执行行动，花费资金招募、建立贸易站。
· 鼹鼠地国白天两次议会前行动，随后使用大臣并说服一名新大臣。
· 揭示牌夜晚归还，鸟牌须弃置；建筑损失触发失败的代价。
阴谋羽党与神秘游侠：
· 阴谋羽党锻造、翻开阴谋、招募后执行三行动，可竭力追加一次。
· 对手可出示匹配手牌猜测暗阴谋，猜错须交出该牌。
· 游侠重整道具并潜行，以耗竭道具支付移动、协助、任务等行动。
· 游侠受伤时损坏道具；在树林中休息可修复受损道具，夜晚检查背包容量。
· 两名游侠共享任务与遗迹，各自管理道具和关系。
地图：
· 冬图河流分隔树林；湖图海岸经湖相连，渡轮每回合一次并抽牌。
· 山图可在白天支付任意牌清路得一分，夜晚结束控制山口得一分。

en.name: Root
en.desc: Eight asymmetric factions with the base game, Riverfolk and Underworld expansions.
en.rules:
Goal:
· Reach 30 points to win immediately. Removing enemy buildings or tokens scores one each.
· At 10 points, activate dominance in Daylight to change your victory condition.
Setup:
· Choose map and factions, place starting pieces, and draw three cards each.
· Includes the base game, Riverfolk, Underworld, and nine Vagabond characters.
Turns:
· Resolve Birdsong, Daylight, and Evening following your faction board.
· Birds are usually wild, except for Cult rituals.
Movement and rule:
· Most warriors and buildings rules a clearing. Eyrie wins nonzero ties.
· Gardens force rule. Normal moves require rule at origin or destination.
· Move along paths; Vagabond, Corvids, Riverboats, and Riverfolk have exceptions.
Battle and crafting:
· Defender may ambush; attacker may foil with a matching ambush.
· Attacker takes the high die, except when attacking the Alliance.
· Rolled hits are limited by warriors or undamaged swords.
· Take hits simultaneously, warriors first, then choose buildings and tokens.
· Activate matching crafting pieces; each can be used once per turn.
· Items are limited. Identical persistent effects cannot be crafted twice.
Marquise and Eyrie:
· Cats produce wood, craft, then take three actions. Spend birds for extra actions.
· March moves up to twice, recruit once per turn, and build using connected ruled wood.
· Spend a matching card to return removed warriors to a surviving Keep.
· Eyrie adds to Decree, crafts, then resolves recruit, move, battle, and build.
· Failure causes Turmoil: lose bird-card points, discard Decree, and replace leader.
Alliance and Cult:
· Spend supporters to spread sympathy or revolt. Train officers for Evening operations.
· Enemies removing sympathy or moving warriors into sympathy must pay Outrage.
· Without bases, keep five supporters. Losing a base loses matching supporters and half officers.
· Cult reveals cards to build, recruit, or sacrifice, and spends cards to score.
· Lost Souls determines Outcast; acolytes crusade, convert, or sanctify.
Riverfolk and Duchy:
· Buy Riverfolk cards, Riverboats, or Mercenaries with supply warriors in Birdsong.
· Riverfolk commits funds for actions, and spends funds to recruit or establish trade posts.
· Duchy takes two Assembly actions, uses Parliament, and may sway one minister.
· Revealed cards return in Evening; birds are discarded. Lost buildings trigger Price of Failure.
Corvids and Vagabond:
· Corvids craft, flip plots, recruit, and take three actions; Exert adds one without drawing.
· Enemies may show matching cards to guess hidden plots; wrong guesses surrender the card.
· Vagabond refreshes items and slips, then exhausts items to move, aid, quest, and act.
· Hits damage items. Forest rest repairs damaged items; check satchel capacity in Evening.
· Two Vagabonds share quests and ruins, but keep separate items and relationships.
Maps:
· Winter rivers divide forests. Lake coasts connect; Ferry moves once per turn and draws.
· On Mountain, spend a card to clear a path for one point; rule the Pass at turn end for one.

zh.name: 交运之星
zh.desc: 竞拍铁路公司、组建集团、炒股分红,18XX 血统的纯金融卡牌游戏
zh.rules:
目标:游戏结束时总资产(现金 + 私有公司面值 + 持股×股价)最高者胜。
准备:每人 30 元(6 人局 25 元);按人数组公司牌堆(红在顶、蓝垫底、终局卡压底),翻开等于人数的公司作为待拍区。
每回合 9 个阶段:
· 1 投资:轮流行动——发起拍卖(公开竞价,起拍价不低于面值)、买入或卖出股票,或过;全员连续过则结束。
· 买入付下一张更高可用股价卡的价格,卖出收下一张更低可用卡的价格。
· 持股严格超过总裁即夺权;银行持有全部已发行股时,该集团进入托管。
· 2 收尾:按现金重排玩家顺序;外商(每回合收入加 5)按面值升序买入买得起的最便宜公司。
· 3 收购:集团可用金库现金收购玩家、外商或其他集团的公司,价格须在卡面区间内。
· 外商只按最高价出售;股价更高的集团可干预抢买(外商贸易集团恒最优先、付面值)。
· 4 关闭:可关闭亏损公司;若下阶段总收入为负且现金不够付,必须关到够付为止。
· 5 收入:玩家与集团结算(公司收入减去持有成本;集团另加协同与能力加成)。
· 6 分红:按股价降序,总裁定每股分红(上限为股价除以 3 向下取整)。
· 再按星数(公司星 + 现金除以 10 向下取整)对比股价卡要求调整股价。
· 星数多 2 跳两格、多 1 升一格、少 1 降一格、少 2 降两格,降到 0 破产。
· 7 终局检查:有集团持 75 股价卡,或终局卡已翻面,游戏结束;否则无公司可买时翻开终局卡。
· 8 增发:按股价降序,各集团可增发一股给银行换取现金(股价下移一格)。
· 9 IPO:按面值降序,私有公司可组建集团——选一张可用执照和该颜色区间内的初始股价。
· 股价低于面值获得 2 股,否则获得 1 股并补差价,银行配等量股并把股款付入金库。
集团能力:
· 普鲁士铁路每公司收入加 1;多普勒最佳公司收入翻倍;协同每 2 个协同标记收入加 1。
· 老爷车总持有成本减 10;股票大师增发不变价;外商贸易买外商付面值且最优先。
· 废品回收关闭公司收入翻倍;星星公司星数加 2。

en.name: Rolling Stock Stars
en.desc: Auction railroads, form corporations, trade shares and pay dividends — a pure financial card game in the 18XX family
en.rules:
Goal: when the game ends, the richest player wins — cash + face value of private companies + shares × share price.
Setup: each player gets 30 (25 in a 6-player game); the company deck is built by player count (red on top, blue at the bottom, end card at the very bottom); reveal as many companies as players as the offering.
Each turn has 9 phases:
· 1 Investment: take turns starting auctions (open bidding, opening bid at least face value), buying or selling shares, or passing; the phase ends when everyone passes in a row.
· Buying pays the next higher available price card; selling receives the next lower one.
· Owning strictly more shares than the president takes over the presidency; if the bank holds all issued shares, the corporation goes into receivership.
· 2 Wrap-up: player order is re-sorted by cash; the foreign investor (+5 income per turn) buys the cheapest companies it can afford, in ascending face value.
· 3 Acquisition: corporations may spend treasury cash to buy companies from players, the foreign investor, or other corporations, at a price within the printed span.
· The foreign investor only sells at the maximum price; corporations with a higher share price may intervene (Overseas Trading always has priority and pays face value).
· 4 Closing: companies may be closed; if your next income would be negative beyond your cash, you must close until you can pay.
· 5 Income: players and corporations collect (company income minus cost of ownership; corporations add synergy and ability bonuses).
· 6 Dividends: in descending share price order, the president sets a dividend per share (up to one third of the price, rounded down).
· Then the share price adjusts by stars (company stars plus cash divided by 10, rounded down) against the card requirement.
· 2 stars over jumps two cards, 1 over rises one, 1 under drops one, 2 under drops two; reaching 0 means bankruptcy.
· 7 End check: if a corporation holds the 75 card, or the end card is already flipped, the game ends; otherwise flip the end card once no companies are left to buy.
· 8 Issue shares: in share price order, each corporation may issue one share to the bank for cash (price moves down one card).
· 9 IPO: in descending face value order, private companies may form corporations — pick an unused charter and a starting price in the company color range.
· Below face value you take 2 shares, otherwise 1 share and pay the difference; the bank takes the same number of shares and pays into the treasury.
Corporation abilities:
· Prussian Railway +1 income per company; Doppler AG doubles its best company; Synergistic +1 per 2 synergy markers.
· Vintage Machinery −10 total cost of ownership; Stock Masters issues at unchanged price; Overseas Trading pays face value to the foreign investor with top priority.
· Junkyard Scrappers doubles income when closing a company; Stars Inc. +2 stars.

zh.name: 圣家族大教堂
zh.desc: 挑选彩色玻璃骰子，拼出独一无二的彩绘玻璃窗。
zh.rules:
目标：
在10轮中选取骰子填满4行5列的玻璃窗，通过公共目标、私密目标和剩余恩惠标记取得最高分。本游戏采用2017版；基础版支持1–4人，5–6人扩展提供更多玩家位置。
准备：
每人获得两张双面窗格图样，从四个面中选择一个，按图样难度领取恩惠标记。每人领取一张秘密目标，中央公开三张工具和三张公共目标。基础版骰袋有五种颜色、每色18枚骰子。
流程：
每轮抽取每人2枚再加1枚骰子并掷出。从首位开始顺时针，每人进行第一次回合；再从末位逆时针，每人进行第二次回合。每回合可以选取并放置1枚公共骰子，以及使用1张工具，顺序不限，均可放弃。完成后结束回合。每轮剩余的全部骰子移至轮次轨，首位顺时针轮换。
· 第一枚骰子必须放在边缘或角落；以后每枚骰子必须与已有骰子相邻，斜角也算相邻。骰子必须符合格子的颜色或点数限制，正交相邻的骰子不能同色，也不能同点数。
· 工具首次使用支付1个恩惠标记，以后支付2个。工具的具体效果可点击牌面查阅。忽略格子的颜色或点数限制不代表可以违反相邻限制。随机操作提交后不能撤回，无法合法放置时按效果归还骰子。
5–6人及个人骰池：
启用5–6人扩展后，2/3/4/5/6人骰袋分别使用每色10/14/18/22/26枚骰子，并加入6种区域私密目标。可选个人骰池模式适用于2–6人：每人先掷出每色2枚的个人骰子；袋中每色改为6/8/10/12/14枚。每轮公共骰子为人数加1，每人仅一个回合，可以各放1枚公共骰、1枚个人骰，并用1次工具。个人骰全部公开。工具7和8移除，加入与个人骰池互动的工具13和14。
Passion扩展：
· 灵感：每人获得一种公开能力，按牌面支付费用并遵守每轮或每局次数。
· 稀有玻璃：随机稀有玻璃板替代一张工具。支付该板的恩惠费用，额外放置1枚稀有玻璃骰；每窗最多1枚。这种骰子可覆盖任何颜色格，仍须满足点数和相邻点数限制，并视为一种独立颜色。该模块使用7种专属私密目标；中央稀有骰耗尽时补满并掷出。
· 对称目标：加入水平对称、上下半窗平衡、同色对角连通及交织颜色目标。
Life扩展：
· 学徒：使用带两个学徒符号的专用窗格图样。用骰子覆盖符号时，可以抽两张学徒卡留一张、另一张弃置，或拿取弃牌堆顶。一回合最多获得1张；移开后将来再次覆盖仍可触发。手中的卡秘密保存，打出时按牌面执行一次性能力或公开持续计分效果。
· 杰作：选取骰子时，可将符合杰作市场空槽颜色或点数的骰子换成对应橙色杰作骰，保持符号并选择朝向后放置，同时获得所示恩惠标记。杰作骰可覆盖点数格，不能覆盖其他颜色格，不能正交相邻橙色骰；不同符号视为不同点数，数值加总时为0。终局每枚满足全部箭头条件获得5分，否则失去2分；箭头指向空格或窗外必定失败。
· 辛劳目标：加入复制、交替列、最低行合计、最高列合计、轮次轨匹配等目标。
Glory扩展：
· 纷争：随机灰骰限制板，加入一张专属工具和一张专属公共目标。每轮从袋中抽每人2枚骰子，再加入1枚灰骰。灰骰遵守点数、格色及相邻限制，并额外遵守所选板的限制。与个人骰池组合时，每轮抽人数枚袋骰再加1枚灰骰。
· 先驱：公开三张竞速目标，回合末首先完成者获得对应卡，之后移动骰子导致条件失效也保留。
· 装饰：每人收到两张秘密装饰目标，选窗时可各自保留或弃置，每保留一张额外获得1个恩惠标记。终局以恰好两种颜色拼成牌面图样获得分数，否则扣除相同分数。图样可平移，不能旋转或翻转。
· 竞争目标：按排名分配12/8/5分，部分灰骰目标分配10/5分或奖励最高、惩罚最低。并列者平分所占名次的分值，向下取整。
结束与计分：
完成第10轮后，结算三张公共目标、自己的秘密目标、剩余恩惠标记（每个1分），每个空格扣1分，再计入启用扩展的得失分。总分最高者获胜。同分依次比较秘密目标得分、剩余恩惠数、最终轮的逆序座位。
单人模式：
每轮掷4枚骰子，进行两次回合；选择1–5张工具决定难度，公开两张公共目标和两张私密目标。基础单人没有恩惠标记，工具用同色公共骰支付并连同该骰移除，每张只用一次。终局选择得分较高的一张私密目标，每空格扣3分，分数必须严格超过轮次轨全部骰子的点数总和才获胜。
· Passion单人同时使用灵感、稀有玻璃及恩惠标记，稀有玻璃板不使用Glue Chip；工具少一张，两张私密目标中一张为稀有目标；获得稀有骰会占用一次普通选骰机会，让轮次轨多留一枚骰子。可照常花恩惠重复使用工具，剩余恩惠每个1分。
· Life单人同时使用学徒和6枚杰作骰，不使用工具或恩惠标记，涉及恩惠的学徒卡不加入。杰作市场中的支付骰不计入目标分。
官方单人模式分别提供，不混用不同扩展的单人规则。Glory和个人骰池只用于多人模式。

en.name: Sagrada
en.desc: Draft colored glass dice to craft a radiant stained-glass window.
en.rules:
Goal:
Draft dice over 10 rounds to fill a 4 by 5 stained-glass window. Score public and private objectives and unused Favor tokens. This implementation uses the 2017 edition. The base game supports 1–4 players; the 5–6 Player expansion adds more seats.
Setup:
Each player receives two double-sided Window Pattern cards and chooses one of the four faces. Gain Favor tokens equal to its difficulty, and receive one secret Private Objective. Reveal three Tools and three Public Objectives. The base bag contains 18 dice in each of five colors.
Play:
Each round, roll two dice per player plus one. Starting with the first player, take turns clockwise, then reverse from the last player. Each turn you may draft and place one public die and use one Tool, in either order. Both are optional. End your turn when finished. Put every leftover die on that round of the Round Track, then rotate first player clockwise.
· Your first die must touch an edge or corner. Later dice must touch an existing die, including diagonally. Match printed color and value restrictions. Orthogonal neighbors may share neither color nor value.
· A Tool costs one Favor the first time, then two. Inspect each Tool for its effect. Ignoring a printed space restriction does not ignore adjacency. Random effects cannot be undone; return an unplaceable die as instructed by its effect.
5–6 Players and Private Dice Pools:
With the expansion, use 10/14/18/22/26 dice per base color for 2/3/4/5/6 players, and add six area Private Objectives. Optional Private Pools support 2–6 players. Each player publicly rolls two dice of each color; the bag then uses 6/8/10/12/14 per color. Roll one public die per player plus one each round. Each player takes one turn and may place one public die, one private die, and use one Tool. Remove Tools 7 and 8; add Tools 13 and 14. Ordinary drafted-die Tools only affect public drafts.
Passion:
· Inspiration gives each player one public ability, with its printed costs and per-round or per-game limits.
· Rare Glass replaces one Tool with a random Rare Glass board. Pay its Favor cost to place an additional Rare Glass die, at most one per window. It can cover any color restriction but must obey value and value adjacency restrictions. It counts as a distinct color. Use the seven dedicated Private Objectives. Refill and roll the Rare Glass supply when empty.
· Symmetry objectives add horizontal symmetry, balance between the top and bottom halves, diagonal color links, and entwined colors.
Life:
· Apprentice uses dedicated windows with two Apprentice spaces. Covering a symbol lets you draw two Apprentice cards, keep one and discard the other, or take the top discard. Gain at most one card per turn. A vacated symbol can trigger again on a later turn. Keep cards secret until using a discard ability or activating a public ability or scoring condition.
· Masterwork lets a drafted die matching an open market color or value slot be exchanged for the corresponding orange die. Keep its symbol, choose its orientation, place it, and gain the indicated Favors. Orange dice ignore printed value restrictions, obey color restrictions, and cannot share an edge with orange dice. Symbols are distinct values; their numeric sum is zero. Each die scores 5 if all arrow conditions are met, otherwise loses 2. An arrow pointing outside the window or at an empty space fails.
· Toil adds objectives for copies, alternating columns, the lowest completed row sum, highest completed column sum, and Round Track matches.
Glory:
· Strife selects a gray-die restriction board and adds one dedicated Tool and Objective. Each round draw two bag dice per player, then add one gray supply die. Gray dice obey ordinary placement rules and the selected board. With Private Pools, draw one bag die per player and add one gray die instead.
· Pioneer reveals three races. The first player meeting a goal at turn end takes its card. Ordinary later moves do not forfeit it.
· Flourish gives two secret patterns. Keep or discard each when choosing your window; gain one Favor per kept card. At game end form its exact pattern in exactly two different colors to gain its points, or lose the same number. Patterns may translate but never rotate or reflect.
· Rivalry awards 12/8/5 points by rank. Some gray objectives award 10/5, or reward the highest and penalize the lowest. Ties split the rewards for the occupied places, rounded down.
End:
After round 10, add the three Public Objectives, Private Objective, one point per remaining Favor, and all enabled expansion rewards and penalties. Lose one per empty space. Highest total wins. Break ties by Private Objective, remaining Favors, then reverse order in the final round.
Solo:
Roll four dice per round and take two turns. Use 1–5 Tools to set difficulty and reveal two Public and two Private Objectives. Base solo has no Favors: pay a matching-color public die to use a Tool, removing both; each is usable once. Score the better Private Objective and lose three per empty space. Your score must strictly exceed the sum of every die on the Round Track.
· Passion solo uses Inspiration, Rare Glass, and Favors; exclude Glue Chip Glass. Use one fewer Tool and one Rare Private Objective among the two. Gaining Rare Glass replaces one normal draft, leaving an extra die on the Round Track. Favors may pay to reuse Tools; unused Favors score one each.
· Life solo uses Apprentice windows and six Masterwork dice, without Tools or Favors. Exclude Favor-related Apprentice cards. Dice paid to the Masterwork board do not contribute to the target.
The official solo variants are offered separately. Glory and Private Dice Pools are multiplayer only.

zh.name: 三千鸦杀
zh.desc: 双人合作:Feth 以记忆牌搭建幻境,Ren 寻回失落的内心写成诗,赶在乌鸦吞尽记忆前做完三场梦
zh.rules:
目标:两人合作完成三场梦。每场梦中,Ren 将 4 张心牌写成「7-7-7-5」四行诗;诗成时幻境颜色与心牌颜色一致,梦才圆满。
分工:
· Feth(通灵者)负责抽牌与搭建幻境;Ren(忆主)负责从幻境取牌写诗。
Feth 回合:
· 从牌堆任意抽牌放入记忆列:安全区大小等于乌鸦列的乌鸦数,区内抽到的乌鸦作废,区外的进入乌鸦列。
· 随后至少叠放 1 张牌进幻境:象限明暗必须一致,且至少一处褪色压褪色;用不上的牌弃掉,若同色乌鸦在列则被其偷走。
共鸣:
· 放入的牌与同色相连牌恰好凑满 7 点时,赶走该色乌鸦(最终梦中为击败),Ren 翻开一张同色心牌。
Ren 回合:
· 从幻境取 1 张可见牌:能放进当前诗行就必须放,否则弃掉。
· 取牌可能使幻境分裂,须选择一簇保留。
诗牌能力:
· 入诗的牌提供一次性能力:金 = 回牌堆,红 = 剪幻境,蓝 = 凑 7 辅助,绿 = 摆放辅助,紫 = 防乌鸦。
· 红与金双方皆可使用,其余仅 Feth 可用。
败北(任一触发):
· 牌堆抽空;五色乌鸦齐聚乌鸦列;幻境清空;Feth 无牌可放。
· 最终梦中 Ren 未完成诗行,或诗成时幻境颜色与心牌不合。
计分与结局:
· 每场梦结算时,因共鸣翻开的心牌进入得分堆;最终梦中击败的乌鸦连同其赃物一并计分。
· 0~3 分为普通结局,4~10 分为好结局,11 分以上且击败至少 2 只乌鸦为圆满结局。

en.name: The Ravens of Thri Sahashri
en.desc: 2-player co-op: Feth builds the Atman from memory cards while Ren writes her heart into a poem — finish three dreams before the ravens devour everything
en.rules:
Goal: complete three Dreams together. Each Dream, Ren turns 4 Heart cards into a 7-7-7-5 poem; the Dream only closes if the Atman’s colors match her Heart colors.
Roles:
· Feth (the psychic) draws cards and builds the Atman; Ren (the dreamer) takes cards from the Atman to write the poem.
Feth’s turn:
· Draw any number of cards into the Memory Row: the safe zone equals the ravens in the Raven Row; ravens drawn inside it are discarded, outside they join the Row.
· Then place at least 1 card onto the Atman: quadrants must match light and dark, with at least one faded-on-faded; unused cards are discarded — stolen instead if that color’s raven is in the Row.
Relive:
· If the placed card plus connected same-color cards sum to exactly 7, chase that raven away (defeat it in the final Dream) and Ren reveals a matching Heart card.
Ren’s turn:
· Take 1 visible Atman card: if it fits the current poem row she must add it, otherwise discard it.
· Taking may split the Atman; she chooses one chunk to keep.
Poem abilities:
· Cards in poem rows grant one-shot powers: gold returns cards to the deck, red cuts the Atman, blue aids reliving, green aids placement, purple wards off ravens.
· Red and gold are usable by both; the rest only by Feth.
Defeat (any one triggers):
· The deck runs out; all five ravens gather in the Row; the Atman empties; Feth cannot place.
· In the final Dream Ren fails a row, or the Atman colors mismatch her Hearts when the poem closes.
Scoring and endings:
· At each Dream’s end, Hearts revealed by reliving enter the score pile; ravens defeated in the final Dream score together with their loot.
· 0-3 is the normal ending, 4-10 the good ending, 11 or more with at least 2 defeated ravens the happy ending.

zh.name: 深海迷途
zh.desc: 双人合作吃墩:驾船穿越风暴与克拉肯,抵达终点
zh.rules:
目标:两人合作驾船,在第 5 轮结束前驶入终点格;触发任一败北条件即失败。
牌:
· 玩家牌堆 21 张:灰、绿、蓝三花色各 3~9;另有克拉肯牌堆,由三花色的 1 和 2 各一张组成。
· 牌面图标决定动作:1~3 为舵+触手,4~5 为炮,6~8 为舵,9 为触手。
每轮:
· 重洗全部玩家牌,各发 9 张;随后互递 1 张(收到前看不到对方递出的牌),然后开始吃墩。
· 必须跟花色;领出花色中数字较大者赢墩,并领出下一墩。
· 任一玩家赢下第 4 墩时本轮结束:克拉肯按其轨道当前数字对船造成伤害,随后重洗进入下一轮。
动作:
· 按一墩两张牌的图标组合结算(见下方速查表)。
版图:
· 斜进即朝赢墩方一侧斜向前进,直行即向正前方;岛屿不可驶入,出界则停留原地。
· 驶入克拉肯格受 1 点伤害。
· 第 2、4 轮结束时,船必须完全越过风暴线。
胜负:
· 船驶入终点格,立即获胜。
· 以下情况立即失败:克拉肯卡成为克拉肯牌堆唯一一张;克拉肯标记走到骷髅格;终点已无法到达。

en.name: Sail
en.desc: 2-player co-op trick-taking: sail past storms and the Kraken to reach the end
en.rules:
Goal: cooperate to sail the ship onto an end space within 5 rounds; triggering any defeat condition ends the game.
Cards:
· The player deck has 21 cards: three suits (gray/green/blue), 3–9 each; a separate Kraken deck holds the 1s and 2s of all suits.
· Card icons drive the actions: 1–3 wheel+tentacle, 4–5 cannon, 6–8 wheel, 9 tentacle.
Each round:
· Reshuffle and deal 9 cards each, pass 1 card face down (before seeing what you receive), then play tricks.
· You must follow suit; the highest card of the led suit wins and leads next.
· The round ends when either player wins their 4th trick: the Kraken deals damage equal to its current track number, then reshuffle for the next round.
Actions:
· Resolve the icon pair of the two cards in a trick (see the cheat sheet below).
Board:
· Diagonal = forward toward the trick winner; straight = straight ahead. Islands block movement; moving off-board does nothing.
· Entering a Kraken space deals 1 damage.
· At the end of rounds 2 and 4 the ship must be fully past the storm line.
Win/Lose:
· Sailing onto an end space wins immediately.
· Immediate defeat: the Kraken card becomes the only card in its deck; the Kraken marker reaches the skull; no end space can ever be reached.

zh.name: 得分沙拉
zh.desc: 拿计分卡、囤蔬菜,108 种计分方式叠出最高分
zh.rules:
目标:牌堆和市场全部拿完后,计分卡总分最高者获胜。
流程(每回合):
· 先拿牌,二选一:拿取 1 张计分卡(3 堆顶之一,顶卡条件全员可见),或拿取 2 张市场里的蔬菜。
· 拿完自动补货;某堆抽空时,把最大堆分一半补过去。
· 拿牌后还可把 1 张自己的计分卡翻成蔬菜面,每回合至多 1 次,单向不可逆。
终局计分:
· 只看蔬菜面朝上的卡;同一张蔬菜能同时喂饱多张计分卡。
· 「最多 / 最少某蔬菜」并列同得分;0 个也算数(0 是偶数)。
· 平分由回合序靠后者胜。

en.name: Point Salad
en.desc: Draft point cards and veggies, mix 108 ways to score
en.rules:
Goal: when every pile and the market is gone, the highest point-card total wins.
Each turn:
· First draft, one of two: take 1 point card (from the top of any of the 3 piles; the top condition is public), or take 2 veggie cards from the market.
· The market refills automatically; an emptied pile is replaced by half of the largest pile.
· After drafting, you may flip 1 of your point cards to its veggie side — at most once per turn, and it cannot be flipped back.
Final scoring:
· Only veggie-side-up cards count; each veggie feeds every point card you have.
· “Most / fewest of a veggie” ties all score; 0 counts (0 is even).
· Ties go to the player later in turn order.

zh.name: 三国杀
zh.desc: 主忠反内身份局,杀闪攻防与锦囊博弈
zh.rules:
目标:主公与忠臣消灭所有反贼和内奸;反贼杀死主公获胜;内奸需在只剩自己与主公时杀死主公。
准备:
· 按人数分发身份牌,只有主公亮出身份;主公先从五张武将牌中选一张,随后其他人同时各从三张中选一张。
· 主公体力上限加一;每人起手摸四张牌,主公先行动。
流程(每个回合依次进行):
· 判定阶段:依次判定判定区里的延时锦囊,后放置的先判定。
· 摸牌阶段:从牌堆摸两张牌。
· 出牌阶段:可以使用手牌。【杀】每回合限用一次,只能攻击范围内的角色;【闪】只能在响应【杀】时打出。
· 弃牌阶段:手牌数超过当前体力值时,须弃置至等于体力值。
结算:
· 【杀】未被【闪】抵消时,目标受到一点伤害;体力降到零进入濒死,所有角色可以依次打出【桃】营救。
· 杀死反贼的角色摸三张牌;主公杀死忠臣须弃置所有手牌和装备。
· 装备牌提供攻击范围或防御效果;延时锦囊【乐不思蜀】使目标跳过出牌阶段,【闪电】判定黑桃二至九时造成三点伤害。

en.name: Legends of the Three Kingdoms
en.desc: Hidden-role battle of Slash, Dodge and trick cards
en.rules:
Goal: the Lord and Loyalists must eliminate all Rebels and the Renegade; Rebels win by killing the Lord; the Renegade must kill the Lord when no one else remains.
Setup:
· Deal identity cards by player count; only the Lord is revealed. The Lord picks 1 of 5 generals first; then all others choose simultaneously from 3 each.
· The Lord gets +1 max HP. Everyone draws 4 cards; the Lord acts first.
Play (each turn in order):
· Judge phase: resolve delayed tricks in your judge area, last placed first.
· Draw phase: draw 2 cards.
· Play phase: play cards from hand. [Slash] is limited to once per turn and only within attack range; [Dodge] can only be played in response to [Slash].
· Discard phase: discard down to your current HP.
Resolution:
· An uncountered [Slash] deals 1 damage; at 0 HP a player is dying and everyone may play [Peach] to save them in turn.
· Killing a Rebel draws you 3 cards; if the Lord kills a Loyalist, the Lord discards all hand and equipped cards.
· Equipment grants attack range or protection; [Indulgence] skips the target's play phase, [Lightning] deals 3 damage on a spade 2-9 judgment.

zh.name: 圣胡安
zh.desc: 选择角色，以手牌支付费用，在圣胡安建造繁荣的城市。
zh.rules:
目标：
以第二版规则建设圣胡安。建筑上的分数、埋藏牌及特殊建筑共同决定胜负。
准备：
2至4人，每人拥有1座靛蓝染料厂和4张手牌。手牌可建造、支付费用或成为货物，牌库与弃牌均背面朝上。起始手牌变体下，依座位抽5、6、7、8张，各保留4张。新建筑扩展默认关闭，开启时加入33张建筑和公共大教堂。
流程：
每轮从总督开始顺时针各选择一个未用角色，所有人从选择者开始依次行动，只有选择者获得角色特权。两人局依次由总督、另一人、总督选择，共3个不同角色。行动可以放弃；角色不能放弃。
· 建筑师：建造1张手牌，弃置其他手牌支付其费用。选择者少支付1张。生产建筑可以重复，同名城市建筑只可拥有1座。也可以建造公共大教堂。
· 生产者：在1座空置生产建筑上放置1张牌库牌作为货物；选择者可以额外生产1件。每座建筑最多存1件货物，货物牌不能查看。
· 商人：按当前交易所价格出售1件货物，选择者可以额外出售1件，每件货物换取对应数量的手牌。阶段结束后交易所移到牌堆底部，下一次交易才翻开新的价格。
· 议员：抽2张并保留1张，选择者额外抽3张，其余弃置。档案馆允许从原手牌与新牌中一起选择弃牌，行政厅额外保留1张。
· 淘金者：只有选择者抽1张牌。拥有金矿或金匠铺的人仍可使用相应能力。第二版金矿私下抽取4张牌，仅在费用全部不同时获得最低费用牌。
图书馆可以将角色特权翻倍；两人局每轮只能使用一次，由玩家选择使用时机。建筑能力详情可查看卡牌。起重机覆盖建筑后，旧建筑失去效果与印刷分数，其原有埋藏牌仍计分；覆盖货物会弃置。新建建筑不对自己的建造触发效果。
每轮开始：
角色全部归还，总督移至下一人。办公楼先交换手牌，再处理小教堂每轮1张、银行整局一次的埋藏，最后检查手牌上限7张；高塔为12张，有警卫室时未拥有警卫室的人为6张。轮内不检查手牌上限。牌库耗尽时洗混弃牌继续抽牌。
结束与计分：
有人拥有12座建筑时，完成整个建筑师阶段后结束。统计有效建筑印刷分数与埋藏牌每张1分，再计特殊建筑：同业公会为生产建筑数量加生产种类数；市政厅为城市建筑数量（含自身）；凯旋门按1、2、3种纪念建筑计4、6、8分；宅邸按同费用且类型不同的3座建筑组成不重复使用建筑的组，1至4组计4、7、9、10分；大教堂按对手的费用6建筑数量计4、7、9、10分；宫殿最后按其他分数每满4分加1分。同分时比较手牌加货物的数量，再同分则共享胜利。

en.name: San Juan
en.desc: Choose roles and spend cards to build a thriving city in San Juan.
en.rules:
Objective:
Build San Juan using the second edition rules. Building VP, buried cards and special buildings determine the winner.
Setup:
For 2–4 players. Each player starts with 1 indigo plant and 4 hand cards. Cards serve as buildings, payment and goods. Supply and discard piles stay face down. With varied starting hands, seats draw 5, 6, 7 or 8 cards and keep 4. The optional New Buildings expansion adds 33 buildings and the shared cathedral; it is off by default.
Round:
Starting with the Governor, each player selects an unused role. All players act clockwise from its selector, who alone receives the privilege. With 2 players the Governor, other player and Governor select 3 different roles. Actions may be passed; a role must be selected.
· Builder: Build 1 hand card and discard other hand cards equal to its cost. The selector pays 1 less. Production types may repeat; each city type is limited to 1 active copy. The shared cathedral may also be built.
· Producer: Place 1 supply card face down as a good on 1 empty production building. The selector may produce 1 extra good. Each building stores at most 1 good, whose face must remain unseen.
· Trader: Sell 1 good for hand cards at the current trading house prices. The selector may sell 1 extra good. Move the tile to the bottom after the phase; reveal the next tile only at the next Trader phase.
· Councillor: Draw 2 and keep 1. The selector draws 3 extra. Discard the rest. Archive allows discards from the old hand and new cards together; Prefecture keeps 1 extra card.
· Prospector: Only the selector draws 1 card. Other players may still use gold mines or goldsmiths. The second edition gold mine keeps the cheapest of 4 privately drawn cards only when all 4 costs differ.
Library may double a role privilege; with 2 players it can be used only once per round, at its owner's chosen time. Inspect cards for building abilities. Crane coverings remove the old building's effect and printed VP, but its buried cards retain their VP. Goods on a covered building are discarded. New buildings do not trigger on their own construction.
Round start:
Return roles and pass the Governor clockwise. Resolve office exchanges, then chapel deposits of at most 1 card and a bank's once-per-game deposit, then discard down to 7 cards. Tower allows 12; a guard room reduces players without one to 6. There is no hand limit during a round. Reshuffle the discard pile when the supply runs out.
End and scoring:
Finish the entire Builder phase when anyone reaches 12 buildings. Score active buildings' printed VP and 1 per buried card. Guild hall scores production count plus different production types. City hall scores city count including itself. Triumphal arch scores 4/6/8 for 1/2/3 monument types. Residence forms disjoint sets of 3 different buildings of the same cost, scoring 4/7/9/10 for 1–4 sets. Cathedral scores 4/7/9/10 for 1/2/3/4+ opponent-owned 6-cost buildings. Palace scores 1 per complete 4 VP from all other sources, calculated last. Break ties by hand cards plus stored goods, then share victory.

zh.name: 桑托里尼：万神殿
zh.desc: 在爱琴海小岛上运用神力，堆起白墙蓝顶的村落，抢先登上三级高塔。
zh.rules:
目标：
选择一个己方工人移动，再用同一个工人建造。第一个向上移动到三级的玩家获胜。神力可以改变基本规则；强制位移不会视为移动，也不能按普通条件获胜。

准备：
使用5行5列的棋盘。普通模式支持2至4人，四人时与对座玩家组队，共用工人，任一队友获胜或落败即全队获胜或落败。赫尔摩尼亚的考验支持4人或6人。四个扩展包分别增加17神和2模式，默认关闭，可在开局选项中启用。首局可选择阿尔忒弥斯对得墨忒耳；通常由起始玩家选择推荐组合，或从随机抽出的6神中选出所需数量，再由其左手边玩家起按顺时针选神，起始玩家最后选。四人标准模式按两组神卡配对分给队友。神卡之间的禁配限制双向生效。

回合流程：
· 移动：进入相邻的8格之一。不能进入有工人、穹顶或被冻结的格子。最多上升一层，可以下降任意层。先选择工人，再从盘面高亮目标中选择目的地。
· 建造：在该工人的一个未被占用的相邻格增加一层建筑；已有三级时放置穹顶。穹顶上不能再放任何物件。完整高塔由三层建筑与穹顶组成，建筑数量视为无限。
· 神力：按卡牌注明的准备、回合前、回合开始、移动、建造和回合结束时机执行。可选步骤可以跳过；每局一次的能力用过后不能再次使用。强制位移可以改变任意层数，但目的地仍须未被占用，除非能力另有说明。
· 失败：不能完成必须执行的移动、建造或神力限制时落败。移走落败方的工人、标记和神力；若仍有至少两支对立队伍，继续游戏，最后留下的一方获胜。

特殊物件：
所有玩家共用一枚骰子，只有模式或神力要求时才掷骰，并保留结果到下次掷骰。0、1、2、3各占三面，分别对应北、东、南、西；罗盘同时用颜色与数字标识。被冻结的格子及格内所有物件暂时视为不存在。标记通常在被建筑覆盖时移走；织网与旋涡会返回对应神卡。秘密工人、记忆、命运区、深渊和潘多拉骰值只向相应玩家展示；赫卡忒秘密工人阻挡对手的尝试时，该行动取消、回合结束，对手不会因此落败。

模式：
2人标准、3人标准、4人标准与集市属于基础内容。冥界包提供曼提柯尔之影与倪克斯之幕；混沌包提供金羊毛与混沌统治；奥林匹斯包提供奇美拉之翼与赫尔摩尼亚的考验；海神包提供特洛伊战争与喀耳刻的诅咒。各模式的准备与持续效果可在规则图鉴中查看。

en.name: Santorini: Pantheon Edition
en.desc: Build a white-walled, blue-domed island village and wield divine powers to reach the third level first.
en.rules:
Goal:
Move one of your workers, then build with that same worker. The first player to move up to level 3 wins. God powers change these basic rules. A force is not a move and cannot produce a normal win.

Setup:
Play on a 5×5 board. Standard games support 2–4 players. With 4 players, partners sit across from one another and share workers; either partner winning or losing applies to the team. Harmonia’s Test supports 4 or 6 players. Each optional expansion adds 17 gods and 2 modes and is disabled by default. For your first game, use Artemis versus Demeter. Normally the start player selects a recommended matchup or the required gods from 6 randomly drawn cards. Players choose gods clockwise, starting to the start player’s left; the start player chooses last. In 4 Player Standard, gods are paired for partners. Bans apply in both directions.

Turn:
· Move into one of up to eight neighboring spaces. Workers cannot enter occupied spaces, domes, or frozen spaces. Move up at most one level, or down any number of levels. Select a worker and then a highlighted destination.
· Build one block in an unoccupied neighboring space. Build a dome on level 3. Nothing may be placed on a dome. A complete tower consists of three blocks and a dome. Building pieces are considered unlimited.
· Resolve powers at their stated timing: setup, before a turn, start of turn, move, build, or end of turn. Optional steps may be skipped. Once-per-game powers cannot be reused. A force may change any number of levels, but still needs an unoccupied destination unless stated otherwise.
· Lose if you cannot complete a mandatory move, build, or restriction. Remove the losing side’s workers, tokens, and powers. Continue if two or more opposing teams remain; the last surviving team wins.

Special pieces:
All players share one die. Roll only when a power or mode instructs and retain its result until the next roll. The die has three faces each of 0, 1, 2, and 3, corresponding to North, East, South, and West. The compass uses both colors and numbers. Frozen spaces and everything in them temporarily do not exist. Tokens are normally removed when built upon; weave and whirlpool tokens return to their cards. Secret workers, memories, fate, the Abyss, and Pandora’s die are visible only to their owners. If Hecate’s secret workers invalidate an opponent’s attempted play, cancel that play and end their turn without making them lose.

Modes:
2, 3, and 4 Player Standard and The Agora are base content. Underworld adds Manticore’s Shadow and Nyx’s Veil; Chaos adds The Golden Fleece and Chaos Reigns; Olympus adds Chimera’s Flight and Harmonia’s Test; Poseidon adds Trojan War and Circe’s Curse. See the mode reference for each mode’s setup and ongoing effects.
