zh.name: 恶棍牌（Scoundrel）
zh.desc: 用一副扑克牌探索地牢，选择战斗、武器与药水。
zh.rules:
目标：
· 处理全部 44 张牌，并让生命保持在 0 以上。
准备：
· 生命初始为 20，上限为 20。
· 黑桃和梅花为怪物，包含 2 至 A。
· J、Q、K、A 的点数分别为 11、12、13、14。
· 方块 2 至 10 为武器，红桃 2 至 10 为药水。
房间：
· 每回合补牌至 4 张，自选顺序处理其中 3 张。
· 留下的牌保留原位，下回合补充其余空位。
· 牌堆耗尽后，继续处理剩余牌，每回合最多处理 3 张。
· 开始处理前，可以逃离有 4 张牌的房间。
· 逃离的牌按房间位置顺序移到牌堆底，不重新洗牌。
· 不能连续逃离，处理完一个回合后才能再次逃离。
战斗与装备：
· 徒手战斗会失去等于怪物点数的生命。
· 处理武器牌时，必须装备它并弃置旧武器及其击败记录。
· 武器攻击失去怪物点数超过武器点数的那部分生命。
· 同一把武器此后只能攻击比上次击败的怪物更弱的怪物。
· 徒手战斗不会改变已装备武器的攻击限制。
药水：
· 每回合只有第一瓶药水生效，恢复等于其点数的生命。
· 满血时使用第一瓶药水，也会消耗本回合的治疗机会。
· 同一回合处理的其余药水直接弃置，不恢复生命。
结束与计分：
· 生命降至 0 或以下时失败，保留实际生命值。
· 失败得分为生命减去房间与牌堆中未处理怪物的总点数。
· 处理全部牌后存活，得分等于剩余生命。
· 若最终满血且最后处理的是药水，再加上该药水点数。

en.name: Scoundrel
en.desc: Explore a dungeon of playing cards, choosing battles, weapons and potions.
en.rules:
Goal:
· Resolve all 44 cards while keeping your health above 0.
Setup:
· Start with 20 health. The maximum is 20.
· Spades and clubs from 2 through Ace are monsters.
· J, Q, K and A have values of 11, 12, 13 and 14.
· Diamonds 2–10 are weapons; hearts 2–10 are potions.
Rooms:
· Refill to 4 cards each turn. Resolve 3 in any order.
· Leave the remaining card in place and refill the empty slots.
· When the deck runs out, resolve the rest, up to 3 per turn.
· Before resolving any cards, you may flee a room of 4 cards.
· Put its cards at the bottom of the deck in slot order, without shuffling.
· You cannot flee twice in a row. Complete a turn before fleeing again.
Combat and equipment:
· Barehanded combat costs health equal to the monster’s value.
· Resolving a weapon equips it and discards the old weapon and its kills.
· A weapon attack costs only the monster’s value above the weapon’s value.
· That weapon may then attack only monsters weaker than its last kill.
· Barehanded combat does not change your equipped weapon’s limit.
Potions:
· Only the first potion each turn heals you, by its value.
· Using the first potion at full health still spends that turn’s healing.
· Any further potions resolved that turn are discarded without healing.
Ending and score:
· At 0 health or below, you lose. Keep the actual health value.
· On a loss, subtract all unresolved monster values in the room and deck.
· If you survive all cards, your score is your remaining health.
· If you finish at full health with a potion, also add its value.

zh.name: 马戏星探
zh.desc: 手牌不许重排!压过场上组合,或抽端牌补强
zh.rules:
目标:打满与人数相同的轮数,总分最高者获胜。
牌与手牌:
· 全组共 45 张牌,每张牌两端各印一个数字,覆盖 1~10 的全部两两组合。
· 手牌拿起后顺序不得改变;每轮开始前可将整手牌翻面(两端数字互换),不限次数,确认后开打。
行动(二选一):
· 出牌:打出手牌中相邻的一段,须构成同值或连号,且压过场上组合;被压过的原组合归你,每张 1 分。
· 侦查:抽走场上组合端头的一张牌,以任意位置、任意朝向插入手牌;组合的主人获得 1 分。
· 每人每轮有一次「侦查+出牌」:侦查后必须立即打出一组能压场的牌。
压场规则:张数多者胜;张数相同,同值压连号;再相同,数字大者胜。
轮末:
· 有人出完手牌,或一组牌一圈无人压过时,本轮结束。
· 结算:压场赢下的牌与侦查得分计正分,手中余牌每张 −1 分;压场成功的组合主人免罚余牌。
· 连续相当于人数四倍的行动次数内无人压场时,强制收轮,按现状结算(防僵局)。

en.name: SCOUT
en.desc: No rearranging your hand! Beat the set, or scout an end card
en.rules:
Goal: play as many rounds as there are players; the highest total score wins.
Cards:
· The deck has 45 double-ended cards, each showing a different pair of numbers — every pairing of 1–10.
· Your hand may never be rearranged once picked up. At the start of each round you may flip your whole hand (swapping the two ends of every card) as often as you like before confirming.
On your turn, choose one:
· Show: play an adjacent segment of your hand forming a set (equal values) or a run (consecutive values) that beats the current combination; the beaten combination is captured for 1 point per card.
· Scout: take either end card of the current combination and insert it into your hand at any position, either end up; the combination’s owner scores 1 point.
· Once per round you may Scout & Show: scout, then immediately play a combination that beats the table.
Beating: more cards wins; with equal counts a set beats a run; otherwise the higher value wins.
Round end:
· A round ends when someone empties their hand, or when a combination goes unbeaten for a full round of the table.
· Scoring: captured cards and scout income count positive; each card left in hand counts −1. The owner of an unbeaten combination is exempt from the hand penalty.
· If nobody captures for 4 turns per player in a row, the round is force-ended and scored as-is (anti-stall).

zh.name: SETI：搜寻地外文明
zh.desc: 探索旋转太阳系，研究科技，搜寻五种地外文明。2至4人，完整五轮，138张基础项目牌。
zh.rules:
游戏目标与准备：
通过探索行星、研究科技和寻找外星文明痕迹获得分数。基础版支持2至4人，进行完整五轮，使用138张各不相同的基础项目牌及本局两种文明的专属牌。
开局准备：
· 每位玩家获得 4 点信用、3 点能量、4 点推广和 5 张手牌。
· 按座次顺序，各玩家的起始分数依次为 1、2、3、4 分。
· 公开项目区放置 3 张牌；太阳系的初始位置随机确定。
· 本局使用两块尚未揭示身份的文明板，各有三个不同颜色的发现格。
· 从首位玩家开始，依次选择一张手牌放入自己的收入区。
· 立即获得牌底显示的 1 点资源；若牌底为卡牌图标，则从牌库抽取 1 张牌。
· 收入牌不再属于手牌，不能作为手牌打出或弃置。
· 所有玩家完成收入选择后，由首位玩家开始行动。
资源与卡牌：
· 信用用于发射、环绕、扫描和支付项目牌费用。
· 能量用于移动、环绕、着陆和分析；推广用于研究科技与购买卡牌。
· 推广最多保留 10 点；数据池最多保留 6 个数据，超出部分不保留。
· 已放入计算机的数据不占用数据池容量；信用和能量没有数量上限。
· 项目牌的费用、弃置收益、信号颜色和收入分别标示在牌面上。
· 打出项目牌、领取弃置收益和作为收入是不同用途，不能同时领取。
· 选择获得一张牌时，可选择一张公开项目，或从牌库顶抽取一张牌。
· 公开项目被拿取后补足至 3 张；效果另有补牌时机时，按该效果执行。
· 牌库耗尽时，将弃牌堆洗混作为新牌库。
回合流程：
· 玩家按座次轮流行动，已经退出本轮的玩家不再获得自己的行动回合。
· 每个回合执行一个主行动。发射、环绕、着陆、扫描和分析均为主行动。
· 打出项目牌、研究科技和退出本轮也各占用一个主行动。
· 可在主行动之前、之后，以及效果允许的间隙执行自由行动。
· 一个自由行动及其奖励必须全部完成，才能开始另一个自由行动。
· 任务奖励需要作出选择时，先完成该次选择及奖励，再继续当前行动。
· 主行动及其效果完成后，结算所有已经填满的扇区。
· 扇区全部结算后，可继续执行自由行动，再选择“结束回合”。
发射探测器：
· 支付 2 点信用，将一个探测器放置在地球所在的格位。
· 未获得“双探测器”科技时，每位玩家在太空中最多拥有一个探测器。
· 环绕器和着陆器不计入此上限；发射本身不视为访问地球。
探测器移动：
· 支付 1 点能量，可将自己的一个探测器移动到相邻格位。
· 相邻格位包括同一轨道环左右两格，以及同一扇区相邻轨道环的格位。
· 不能斜向移动、穿过太阳，或移出太阳系最外侧的轨道环。
· 离开小行星格位消耗 2 次移动；“小行星导航”科技可取消额外消耗。
· 卡牌或科技提供的移动可用于自己的探测器；移动不足时可支付能量补足。
· 例如，离开小行星需要 2 次移动；仅有 1 次可用移动时，另付 1 点能量。
· 拥有两个探测器时，同一次效果提供的移动可以分配给这两个探测器。
· 可提前结束一次移动效果；未使用的移动不保留到之后的效果或回合。
· 进入地球以外的行星格位或彗星格位时，获得 1 点推广。
· 再次进入这些格位仍可获得推广；停留在原格位不会重复获得奖励。
太阳系旋转：
· 研究科技，以及本轮首位玩家确认退出时，均会触发一次旋转。
· 旋转依次使用顶盘、中盘、底盘；每次逆时针旋转一个扇区。
· 旋转中盘或底盘时，其上方的转盘也随之旋转。
· 探测器随承载它的转盘移动；随盘移动不视为重新访问原有格位。
· 切口中的探测器可能保持原位，也可能被转盘边缘推动至相邻扇区。
· 被盘缘推动进入新格位时，按新格位处理推广和访问任务。
进入行星轨道：
· 自己的探测器位于地球以外的行星格位时，可以执行环绕主行动。
· 支付 1 点信用和 1 点能量，将该探测器移至对应行星的环绕轨道。
· 若首次环绕奖励位置尚未被占用，将环绕器放入该位置并获得 3 分。
· 每次环绕均获得该行星列出的环绕奖励；具体效果见行星详情。
· 环绕器不再是可移动的探测器，不能继续在太阳系格位之间移动。
行星与卫星着陆：
· 自己的探测器位于地球以外的行星格位时，可以执行着陆主行动。
· 着陆通常支付 3 点能量；该行星已有任意玩家的环绕器时，减少 1 点。
· 拥有“着陆改进”科技时再减少 1 点能量，两项减免可以同时生效。
· 例如，行星已有环绕器，且你拥有“着陆改进”时，着陆支付 1 点能量。
· 在行星上着陆时，获得该行星的着陆分数，并标记一次生命痕迹。
· 若有未占用的首次着陆位置，选择其中一个，并获得该位置的数据奖励。
· 首次着陆位置已全部占用时，仍可着陆，但不再获得该项数据奖励。
· 拥有“卫星探测”科技后，可改在该行星的卫星上着陆。
· 卫星着陆适用同一能量费用；通常每颗卫星只能容纳一个着陆器。
· 卫星着陆只获得该卫星列出的奖励，不同时获得行星着陆奖励。
· 着陆后，探测器成为着陆器，不能继续移动；卡牌例外以卡牌说明为准。
扫描：
· 支付 1 点信用和 2 点能量，执行一次扫描；不要求太空中有探测器。
· 基础扫描包含两个步骤：扫描地球扇区，以及弃置一张公开项目并标记信号。
· 扫描地球扇区时，在地球所在扇区放置一个自己的信号。
· 弃置公开项目时，在与该牌信号颜色相同的一个扇区放置一个信号。
· 同一颜色对应多个扇区时，从中选择一个；此处使用牌面右上角的颜色。
· 两个基础步骤的顺序可以自选；完成两步后才能结束扫描。
· 科技提供的额外步骤可穿插执行；每种额外步骤每次扫描至多执行一次。
· 扫描中的公开项目在整次扫描完成后补足；多张公开牌效果先全部弃置，再补牌。
信号奖励与扇区结算：
· 在信号轨道尚未填满的扇区放置信号时，获得 1 个数据。
· 放置该扇区的第二个信号时，额外获得 2 分，不论第一个信号属于谁。
· 扇区填满后仍可继续放置信号，计入竞争数量，但不再获得上述奖励。
· 主行动完成后，由当前回合的玩家选择已经填满的扇区逐一结算。
· 结算时，在该扇区拥有至少一个信号的每位玩家均获得 1 点推广。
· 信号最多的玩家获胜，并获得该扇区本次结算对应的分数。
· 数量并列时，比较并列玩家最后一次放置信号的时间，较晚放置者优先。
· 该比较方式也用于确定第二名；只有第二名保留一个信号，其余信号清除。
· 某扇区第一次结算时，获胜者获得一次标记信号痕迹的机会。
· 天狼星 A、比邻星、室女座 61 和绘架座 β 的后续胜利也给予信号痕迹。
· 获胜记录保留，但不作为该扇区下一次结算时的信号数量。
· 获胜者自行选择痕迹的放置位置，即使此时并非该玩家的行动回合。
计算机与数据：
· 放置数据是自由行动：从数据池取出一个数据，放入计算机上排。
· 上排必须从左至右连续放置，每次放入最左侧的空格。
· 未安装科技时，第二格给予 1 点推广，第四格允许增加一张收入牌。
· 增加收入时，从手牌选择一张放入收入区，并立即获得其收入；也可放弃。
· 上排格位已安装计算机科技时，放入数据改为获得 2 分。
· 科技下排格位只有在对应上排已有数据时才能放置数据。
· 下排不要求从左至右放置；每次消耗一个数据，并获得该科技的下排奖励。
· 已有数据的格位不能再次放置；每次放置数据各视为一次自由行动。
分析数据：
· 计算机上排六格全部放入数据后，可支付 1 点能量执行分析主行动。
· 分析移除计算机上下两排的全部数据，并获得一次标记分析痕迹的机会。
· 移除的数据不退回数据池；数据池原有的数据和已安装科技均保留。
研究科技：
· 支付 6 点推广执行研究主行动，先旋转太阳系，再选择一项科技。
· 科技分为探测器、望远镜和计算机三类，每类有四种。
· 只能选择自己尚未拥有、且仍有剩余板块的科技。
· 全局首位研究某种科技的玩家，额外获得 2 分。
· 每次研究还会获得所领取板块显示的即时奖励，并执行该科技的获得效果。
· 即时奖励可能为 1 点推广、1 点能量、选择一张牌，或获得 3 分。
· 卡牌提供的研究不另支付 6 点推广，但仍须旋转并遵守科技类别限制。
探测器科技：
· 双探测器：太空中的探测器上限提高至两个，获得时可免费发射一个。
· 小行星导航：离开小行星不再额外消耗移动，进入小行星格位获得 1 点推广。
· 着陆改进：行星和卫星着陆的能量费用减少 1 点。
· 卫星探测：允许在对应行星的卫星上着陆，按卫星奖励结算。
望远镜科技：
· 拓展观测：获得时取得 2 个数据；地球扫描可改在相邻的一个扇区进行。
· 项目观测：扫描时可从手牌弃置一张牌，在对应信号颜色的扇区额外标记一次。
· 水星观测：扫描时可支付 1 点推广，在水星所在扇区额外标记一次信号。
· 协同发射：扫描时可支付 1 点能量发射一个探测器，或免费获得 1 次移动。
· 协同发射的两种效果只能选择一种；发射仍须满足探测器数量上限。
计算机科技：
· 领取计算机科技后，将它安装到计算机中任意一个尚未安装科技的位置。
· 可以安装到已有数据的位置，但不会因此再次获得该位置的奖励。
· 四种计算机科技的上排奖励均为 2 分，替代该格原有奖励。
· 推广计算机的下排奖励为 2 点推广；项目计算机允许选择获得一张牌。
· 能量计算机的下排奖励为 1 点能量；信用计算机的下排奖励为 1 点信用。
其他自由行动：
· 从手牌弃置一张牌，获得其左上角显示的 1 点资源或 1 次移动。
· 支付 2 点信用，可获得 1 点能量，或选择获得一张牌。
· 支付 2 点能量，可获得 1 点信用，或选择获得一张牌。
· 从手牌弃置两张牌，可获得 1 点信用、1 点能量或选择获得一张牌。
· 支付 3 点推广，可获得一张公开项目，或从牌库顶抽取一张牌。
· 为扫描、交换或退出本轮而弃置卡牌时，不领取左上角的弃置收益。
· 移动探测器、放置数据和领取符合条件的任务奖励也属于自由行动。
· 自由行动没有统一次数上限，但每次都须满足资源和效果条件。
项目牌与任务：
· 打出项目牌时，从手牌选择一张，支付其信用费用，并依次执行牌面效果。
· 任务牌和需要保留的项目放入个人区域；其余项目执行后进入弃牌堆。
· 事件任务只记录该任务牌打出后发生的事件，不能追溯之前的行动。
· 同一事件在自己所有事件任务中，最多领取一个尚未领取的奖励。
· 可以放弃本次事件奖励；同一事件不能留待之后再领取。
· 每个任务奖励圈只能领取一次；已经标记的奖励圈不能重复使用。
· 先驱者 11 号任务：自己的探测器之后访问木星获得 1 个数据，访问土星获得 4 分。
· 望远镜时间分配：之后每完成一次扫描，可领取一个未完成奖励圈，在对应颜色的扇区标记信号。
· 轨道修正是即时项目：本回合发生过同环移动时，获得3分和1点推广。
· 条件任务可以检查本回合已经发生的移动，与事件任务的触发方式不同。
文明痕迹与发现：
红色为信号痕迹，黄色为生命痕迹，蓝色为分析痕迹。获得痕迹时，可以选择任意文明中颜色相符的空发现格，或已发现文明的研究位置。发现格给予1点推广，左侧文明另获得5分，右侧获得3分。也可以放入任一文明的溢出区获得3分；溢出标记保留所选颜色，计入痕迹数量。研究位置按所示奖励结算，部分需要支付数据或地外化石；最上方有无限标记的位置可以重复使用。
三个发现格均填满时，在回合结束且里程碑处理完后揭示文明。每位玩家按自己的发现格标记数量取得文明牌。普通文明牌可以作为手牌、弃置或收入；钻探者牌另行保管。
回合结束的里程碑：
达到25、50、70分时，分别标记一块自己未标记的黄金板块，按全体玩家选择该板块的先后占据档位。四块板块在准备时分别随机选择正面或反面。所有玩家按当前回合玩家起的座次处理自己的黄金与文明里程碑，不可在此期间执行自由行动。
两人局在20分、30分各有两个中立标记；三人局各一个；四人局没有。每位玩家首次达到相应分数时只取一个尚有剩余的中立标记，按从左至右的顺序放入空发现格。中立标记不奖励玩家，可能促成发现。中立里程碑最后处理。
退出与五轮流程：
退出本轮是主行动。选择退出前可以执行自由行动，之后按顺序将手牌弃至4张；若为本轮首位退出者，旋转太阳系；再从该轮私有候选牌中选择1张。前四轮各有一堆人数加一张的轮末牌。可以延迟决定，直到下一位玩家退出时交接；候选牌只供持有者查看。第五轮仍须旋转，但没有轮末选牌。
所有玩家退出并完成选牌后，弃置候选堆最后一张牌。前四轮结束时，每人获得3点信用、2点能量、从牌库抽1张牌，以及收入区所有牌的收入；再将起始玩家顺移一位，开始下一轮。
五种文明：
· 硫铵虫：木星和土星各有3个秘密样本，另1个公开成为蓝色研究位置。指定文明牌允许采集样本：查看所在行星的所有样本，秘密选择一个，放置样本舱。样本舱按探测器移动，不计入探测器上限，不可环绕或着陆。可以用自己的任意样本舱完成对应目的地的运输任务；交付时领取样本奖励，并将样本公开放到文明板上，成为新的蓝色研究位置。
· 异常点：在地球扇区及其左右相隔三个扇区的最外环，各放一个随机面的异常点。每次太阳系旋转后，若地球与异常点在同一扇区，对应颜色研究列中位置最高的玩家领取奖励；最高位置可重复标记，后来者在上。访问异常点不提供奖励。
· 奥陌陌：将奥陌陌放到第三转盘的指定格位；它视为行星，访问获得1点推广，可环绕或着陆。奥陌陌所在扇区的信号可以改放到其独立信号槽；第一格获得1分，第三格获得2分，每个未填满槽位仍提供数据。主行动后填满时，参与玩家各获得1个地外化石，清空并补满信号槽，不产生扇区胜者。化石用于部分研究位置和卡牌，剩余化石不计分。
· 半人马族：发现时每人设置一个当前分数加15的消息阈值；达到后选择一项尚可用的文明奖励。该文明牌支付能量，每打出一张，再设置一个当前分数加15的阈值，先执行白色区域，达到阈值后按发送顺序执行绿色区域。消息牌不算任务。研究位置的数据费用只能从数据池支付。
· 钻探者：发现时每人取得3张秘密牌，再按自己的发现贡献各多取1张，每份贡献可立即秘密打出1张。以发现时领先者分数加20、加40设置两个阈值；每人达到时可再秘密打出1张，第二个阈值需付1点信用。秘密牌不属于手牌，不能弃置或作为收入，也不算任务或终局项目。文明研究位置另增加公开危险值。
终局与胜负：
第五轮全部玩家退出，且最后一次旋转、任务响应、里程碑和发现均处理完毕后，先计已打出的终局项目，再计黄金板块，最后揭示钻探者秘密项目并按条件加分。
黄金板块按自己占据的档位，逐组计算科技组合、已完成任务、收入组合、三色痕迹组合或扇区胜利与棋件组合；只计算放入收入区的牌，不计每轮固定获得的3点信用、2点能量和1张随机牌。事件任务所有奖励圈均完成才算完成一张任务。《索尔维会议》额外选择一块自己未标记的黄金板块，按最右档计分。
最后合计公开危险值和已打出秘密牌的危险值，危险最高的所有玩家各扣除总分十分之一，向下取整。总分最高者获胜，同分并列。基础版仅支持2至4人，不包含官方单人对手、Space Agencies扩展及Promo牌。

en.name: SETI: Search for Extraterrestrial Intelligence
en.desc: Explore a rotating solar system, research technologies and discover five alien species. A complete five-round base game for 2–4 players with 138 distinct projects.
en.rules:
Goal and setup:
Earn points by exploring planets, researching technologies and finding traces of extraterrestrial life. The base game supports 2–4 players for five complete rounds, using 138 distinct base projects and the cards of the two species in play.
Setup:
· Each player receives 4 credits, 3 energy, 4 publicity, and 5 hand cards.
· Starting scores are 1, 2, 3, and 4 points in seating order, using only the occupied seats.
· Place 3 cards in the project market. The starting positions of the solar-system discs are randomized.
· Two civilizations begin with their identities hidden. Each has three discovery spaces of different colors.
· Starting with the first player, each player places one card from their hand in their income area.
· Immediately gain the 1 resource shown at the bottom of that card, or draw 1 card from the deck if it shows a card.
· An income card is no longer in your hand and cannot be played or discarded as a hand card.
· Once every player has chosen an income card, the first player begins their turn.
Resources and cards:
· Credits pay for launching, orbiting, scanning, and playing project cards.
· Energy pays for movement, orbiting, landing, and analysis. Publicity pays for research and card purchases.
· You may hold at most 10 publicity and 6 data in your pool. Any excess is lost.
· Data in your computer does not count toward your pool limit. Credits and energy have no holding limit.
· Each project card shows its play cost, discard benefit, signal color, and income.
· Playing a card, discarding it for its benefit, and placing it as income are separate uses. Do not combine their rewards.
· When instructed to choose a card, take one project from the market or draw the top card of the deck.
· Refill the market to 3 cards after taking a card, unless the effect specifies a different refill timing.
· When the deck is exhausted, shuffle the discard pile to form a new deck.
Turn sequence:
· Take turns in seating order. Players who have passed for the round receive no further turns of their own.
· Perform one main action per turn. Launching, orbiting, landing, scanning, and analysis are main actions.
· Playing a project, researching a technology, and passing for the round also each use one main action.
· You may take free actions before or after your main action, and between effects when permitted.
· Complete a free action and all its resulting rewards before starting another free action.
· When a mission reward requires a decision, resolve that decision and its reward before continuing the current action.
· After your main action and its effects are complete, resolve every sector whose signal track is full.
· After all such sectors are resolved, you may take further free actions, then select End turn.
Launching probes:
· Pay 2 credits to place one probe in the space containing Earth.
· Without Two probes technology, you may have at most one probe in space.
· Orbiters and landers do not count toward this limit. Launching does not count as visiting Earth.
Moving probes:
· As a free action, pay 1 energy to move one of your probes to an adjacent space.
· Adjacent spaces are the two neighboring sectors on the same ring and the neighboring rings in the same sector.
· You cannot move diagonally, through the Sun, or beyond the outermost ring.
· Leaving an asteroid space costs 2 movement. Asteroid navigation removes this additional cost.
· Movement granted by cards or technologies may move your own probes. Pay energy to cover any movement shortfall.
· For example, leaving an asteroid costs 2 movement. With only 1 granted movement available, pay 1 additional energy.
· If you have two probes, you may divide the movement from one effect between them.
· You may end a movement effect early. Unused movement is not saved for later effects or turns.
· Gain 1 publicity when entering a space containing a planet other than Earth, or a comet.
· Entering such a space again can grant publicity again. Remaining in the same space grants no repeated reward.
Rotating the discs:
· Researching a technology and the first player confirming their pass each trigger one rotation.
· Rotate the top, middle, and bottom discs in that order, advancing one sector counterclockwise each time.
· Rotating the middle or bottom disc also rotates every disc above it.
· A probe moves with its supporting disc. Being carried on that disc is not a new visit to its existing space.
· A probe in a cutout may remain in place or be pushed into the neighboring sector by a disc edge.
· If a disc edge pushes a probe into a new space, resolve that space for publicity and visit missions.
Entering orbit:
· You may take the orbit main action with your own probe in a space containing a planet other than Earth.
· Pay 1 credit and 1 energy, then move that probe to the planet’s orbit.
· If the first-orbiter reward space is unoccupied, place your orbiter there and gain 3 points.
· Every orbit action grants the orbit rewards listed for that planet. Consult its details for the individual rewards.
· An orbiter is no longer a movable probe and cannot move between solar-system spaces.
Landing:
· You may take the land main action with your own probe in a space containing a planet other than Earth.
· Landing normally costs 3 energy. Reduce the cost by 1 if any player has an orbiter at that planet.
· Improved landing reduces the cost by a further 1 energy. Both reductions may apply together.
· For example, landing costs 1 energy if an orbiter is present and you have Improved landing.
· Landing on a planet grants its landing points and one life trace.
· If an unoccupied first-landing space remains, choose one and gain its data reward.
· You may still land when all first-landing spaces are occupied, but receive no first-landing data reward.
· Moon exploration allows you to land on one of that planet’s moons instead.
· Landing on a moon uses the same energy cost. Normally, each moon can hold only one lander.
· Landing on a moon grants its listed rewards instead of the planet’s landing rewards.
· After landing, the probe becomes a lander and cannot move. Follow any exceptions stated by the card used.
Scanning:
· Pay 1 credit and 2 energy to scan. You do not need a probe in space.
· A basic scan has two steps: mark Earth’s sector, and discard one market project to mark a signal.
· For the Earth step, place one of your signals in the sector currently containing Earth.
· For the market step, discard one market project and place one signal in a sector matching its signal color.
· If several sectors match, choose one. Use the signal color shown at the top right of the card.
· Resolve the two basic steps in either order. Complete both before ending the scan.
· You may interleave additional technology steps. Each such step can be taken at most once per scan.
· Refill the card row after the entire scan. For multi-card effects, finish all required discards before refilling.
Signals and sectors:
· Placing a signal in a sector whose track is not yet full grants 1 data.
· Placing the second signal grants an additional 2 points, regardless of who placed the first signal.
· Further signals may be placed after the track is full. They count toward control but grant neither of those placement rewards.
· After the main action, the current player chooses the order in which completed sectors are resolved.
· Each player with at least one signal in that sector gains 1 publicity when it is resolved.
· The player with the most signals wins and gains the points applicable to that resolution of the sector.
· Break a tie by comparing the tied players’ last placements in that sector. The later placement ranks higher.
· Use the same comparison to determine second place. Only the runner-up keeps one signal; remove all other signals.
· On a sector’s first resolution, its winner receives one signal trace.
· Later victories at Sirius A, Proxima Centauri, 61 Virginis, and Beta Pictoris also grant a signal trace.
· Victory records remain, but do not count as signals in the next resolution of that sector.
· The winner chooses where to place their trace, even if it is another player’s turn.
Computer and data:
· Placing data is a free action. Spend one data from your pool to fill a space in your computer’s top row.
· Fill the top row from left to right, always using its leftmost empty space.
· Without installed technology, the second space grants 1 publicity and the fourth allows you to add an income card.
· To add income, place one hand card in your income area and receive its income immediately. You may decline.
· If computer technology is installed in the top space, placing data there grants 2 points instead.
· An installed technology’s lower space may be filled only if its top space already contains data.
· Lower spaces need not be filled left to right. Each placement costs one data and grants that technology’s lower reward.
· An occupied space cannot receive another data. Each individual data placement is a separate free action.
Analyzing data:
· When all six top spaces are filled, pay 1 energy to take the analyze main action.
· Analysis removes all data from both rows and grants one analysis trace.
· Removed data does not return to your pool. Existing pool data and installed technologies remain.
Research:
· Pay 6 publicity for the research main action. Rotate the solar system before choosing a technology.
· Technologies belong to three families: probe, telescope, and computer, with four technologies in each family.
· Choose a technology you do not already own and for which a tile remains available.
· The first player in the game to research a particular technology gains an additional 2 points.
· Each research also grants the immediate reward on the tile taken and any acquisition effect of that technology.
· An immediate tile reward is 1 publicity, 1 energy, a chosen card, or 3 points.
· Research granted by a card does not cost an additional 6 publicity, but still rotates the discs and obeys its family restriction.
Probe technologies:
· Two probes increases your limit in space to two probes and grants a free launch when acquired.
· Asteroid navigation removes the extra movement cost for leaving asteroids and grants 1 publicity when entering one.
· Improved landing reduces the energy cost of landing on planets and moons by 1.
· Moon exploration allows landing on a planet’s moons to receive the rewards of the chosen moon.
Telescope abilities:
· Extended observation grants 2 data when acquired and allows the Earth scan step to target either adjacent sector instead.
· Project observation adds an optional scan step: discard one hand card to mark a sector matching its signal color.
· Mercury observation adds an optional scan step: pay 1 publicity to mark the sector containing Mercury.
· Launch coordination adds an optional scan step: pay 1 energy to launch a probe, or gain 1 free movement.
· Choose only one of Launch coordination’s two effects. Its launch must obey your probe limit.
Computer technology:
· After acquiring computer technology, install it in any computer column that has no installed technology.
· You may install it beneath existing data, but installation does not award that space’s reward again.
· All four computer technologies give 2 points for top-row placement, replacing the space’s original reward.
· Publicity computer grants 2 publicity in its lower space. Project computer grants a chosen card.
· Energy computer grants 1 energy in its lower space. Credit computer grants 1 credit.
Other free actions:
· Discard one hand card to gain the 1 resource or 1 movement shown at its top left.
· Pay 2 credits to gain 1 energy or choose a card.
· Pay 2 energy to gain 1 credit or choose a card.
· Discard two hand cards to gain 1 credit, gain 1 energy, or choose a card.
· Pay 3 publicity to take one market project or draw the top card of the deck.
· Cards discarded for scanning, exchanging, or passing do not grant their top-left discard benefits.
· Moving probes, placing data, and claiming eligible conditional-mission rewards are also free actions.
· Free actions have no general per-turn limit, but each must meet its own resource and effect requirements.
Cards and missions:
· To play a project, choose one card from your hand, pay its credit cost, and resolve its effects in order.
· Keep mission cards and projects that must remain in play in your personal area. Discard other projects after resolving them.
· Event missions respond only to events that occur after the mission card was played. Earlier actions do not count.
· A single event can claim at most one unclaimed reward across all your event missions.
· You may decline an event reward, but cannot save that event to claim later.
· Each mission reward circle may be claimed only once. A marked circle cannot be used again.
· Pioneer 11 Mission grants 1 data for a later visit by your probe to Jupiter and 4 points for a later visit to Saturn.
· After each later scan, Telescope Time Allocation may mark a signal in the colour of one unclaimed reward circle.
· Trajectory Correction is an immediate project. Gain 3 points and 1 publicity if you moved within a ring this turn.
· A conditional mission may use movement that already occurred this turn, unlike an event mission.
Traces and discoveries:
Red is a signal trace, yellow a life trace and blue an analysis trace. Mark an empty discovery space or an available research space of the corresponding colour on either revealed species board. Discovery spaces give 1 publicity and 5 points on the left species or 3 on the right. You may instead use either overflow area for 3 points, retaining the chosen colour for trace counts. Research spaces grant their depicted rewards and may cost pool data or exofossils. Spaces marked as repeatable remain available.
Once all three discovery spaces are filled, reveal the species after end-turn milestones. Players receive one species card per discovery marker they placed. Regular alien cards may be held, discarded or tucked; Exertian cards are kept separately.
End-turn milestones:
At 25, 50 and 70 points, mark a gold tile you have not previously marked. Claim its value according to the order in which players choose that tile. Randomly select one side of each of the four tiles during setup. Starting with the player whose turn just ended, resolve each player’s gold and alien milestones in seating order. No free actions are allowed during this process.
At both 20 and 30 points, two-player games have two neutral markers and three-player games have one. Each player reaching that threshold takes only one remaining marker, placing it in the leftmost empty discovery space. Neutral markers grant no player rewards and may cause a discovery. Resolve neutral milestones last. Four-player games use none.
Passing and five rounds:
Passing is a main action. Take any desired free actions beforehand. Then discard to 4 hand cards; rotate the solar system if you are the first player to pass this round; choose one card from the round’s private offer. Prepare four end-of-round piles with one more card than the player count. You may defer your choice until the next player passes. Only the current holder sees the offer. In round five the first passer still rotates, but no cards are offered.
When all players have passed and chosen, discard the offer’s last card. After rounds one through four, each player gains 3 credits, 2 energy, 1 random deck card and all tucked income. Pass the starting-player marker to the next seat and begin the next round.
Five alien species:
· Mascamites: Jupiter and Saturn each receive three hidden samples; the remaining sample becomes a public blue research space. Specific cards allow collection: inspect all samples at that planet, secretly select one and place a capsule. Capsules move like probes, do not count toward the probe limit, and cannot orbit or land. Deliver any of your capsules to a mission’s destination to claim its reward. The delivered sample becomes a new public blue research space.
· Anomalies: place three randomly sided anomaly tokens in the outermost ring, in Earth’s sector and three sectors in either direction. After every rotation, trigger an anomaly sharing Earth’s sector. The highest marker on the matching research column gains its reward. The top space is repeatable and later markers go above earlier ones. Visiting anomalies grants nothing.
· ‘Oumuamua: place its tile in the designated space on disc three. It counts as a planet, grants 1 publicity per visit and may be orbited or landed on. Signals in its sector may be marked on its separate track instead. The first and third slots give 1 and 2 points, and unfilled slots grant data. Resolve a completed track after the main action: each participant gains 1 exofossil, then clear and refill it, with no sector winner. Exofossils pay for some research spaces and card effects; unused ones score nothing.
· Centaurians: on discovery, each player places a message milestone 15 points ahead of their score. On reaching it, claim one available board reward. Centaurian cards cost energy. Playing one creates another milestone 15 points ahead: resolve its white section immediately, then its green section when reached, in sending order. Messages are not missions. Research data costs must be paid from the data pool.
· Exertians: on discovery, deal three secret cards per player plus one per discovery contribution. Each contribution also allows one immediate face-down play. Set two milestones at 20 and 40 points ahead of the discovery-time leader. Each player may play one secret card upon reaching each; the second costs 1 credit. Secret cards are not hand cards, cannot be discarded or tucked, and are neither missions nor end-game scoring cards. Research spaces also add public danger.
Final scoring and winning:
After all players pass in round five, finish the last rotation, mission responses, milestones and discoveries. Score played end-game projects, then gold tiles, then reveal and score Exertian projects whose conditions are met.
Gold tiles score their depicted sets of technologies, completed missions, tucked income, trace colours, or sector wins paired with orbiters or landers, at the value you claimed. The fixed per-round income of 3 credits, 2 energy and 1 random card does not count. A triggered mission is complete only when all its reward circles are marked. Solvay Conference additionally scores an unmarked gold tile at its rightmost value.
Finally, add public danger to the danger on played secret cards. Every player tied for the most danger loses one tenth of their total points, rounded down. Highest score wins; ties share victory. This implementation covers the 2–4 player base game, excluding the official solo rival, Space Agencies expansion and promo cards.

zh.name: 天合小队
zh.desc: 正副驾驶合作开飞机:管姿态、控速度、清航道,7 轮内安全着陆
zh.rules:
目标:机长与副驾驶合作,在 7 轮内让飞机安全着陆。
流程(每轮):
· 先讨论战术,双方都点「就绪」后掷骰,此后不得再交谈。
· 每人 4 颗骰子,轮流将 1 颗放进驾驶盘槽位;先手按高度轨箭头交替。
· 姿态与引擎为强制位:每人每轮必须各放 1 颗,缺一即坠毁。
槽位:
· 姿态:两颗骰的差值使飞机向大的一侧倾斜,触到 ✕ 立即坠毁;倾斜跨轮不回正。
· 引擎:两颗之和对照速度表的蓝/橙标记前进 0/1/2 格。
· 当前格有飞机却必须前进即撞机;已在机场仍须前进即冲出跑道。
· 无线电:清除与当前格距离等于点数的 1 架飞机(1 = 当前格)。
· 起落架(机长):可按任意顺序展开,每展开 1 个,蓝色速度标记前进 1 格。
· 襟翼(副驾驶):必须按顺序展开,每展开 1 个,橙色速度标记前进 1 格。
· 刹车(机长):按 2/4/6 顺序展开;着陆时引擎之和不得超过刹车值。
· 专注力:获得 1 杯咖啡(至多存 3 杯);放骰时可花 1 杯咖啡,将点数加 1 或减 1。
· 重掷:高度轨离开 6000、2000 格时各获得 1 枚标记;花 1 枚,双方各重掷一次。
着陆(第 7 轮):
· 引擎之和改为与刹车值比较,本轮不再前进。
· 轮末安全着陆需同时满足:航道无飞机、起落架与襟翼全部展开、姿态回正、速度不超刹车值。

en.name: Sky Team
en.desc: Co-op cockpit: manage tilt, speed and traffic — land in 7 rounds
en.rules:
Goal: pilot and co-pilot work together to land the plane within 7 rounds.
Each round:
· Discuss tactics, then both tap "Ready" to roll (no talking afterwards!).
· Each player rolls 4 dice and takes turns placing one into a cockpit slot; the first player alternates by round.
· Axis and engines are mandatory: each player must place one die on each, or you crash.
Slots:
· Axis: the dice difference tilts the plane toward the higher side; reaching ✕ crashes. Tilt does not reset between rounds.
· Engines: the sum moves you 0/1/2 spaces (vs the blue/orange speed markers).
· Moving while a plane shares your space is a collision; moving while at the airport is an overshoot.
· Radio: remove 1 plane at distance = die value (1 = your space).
· Landing gear (pilot): any order; each one deployed advances the blue speed marker by 1.
· Flaps (co-pilot): must be deployed in order; each one advances the orange speed marker by 1.
· Brakes (pilot): 2/4/6 in order; on landing the engine sum must not exceed it.
· Concentration: gain 1 coffee (max 3 stored); when placing a die, spend 1 coffee to adjust its value up or down by 1.
· Reroll: leaving the 6000/2000 altitude steps collects a token; spend 1 so both players get one reroll.
Final round (round 7):
· The engine sum is now compared against the brakes, and the plane no longer moves.
· Land safely only if all hold at round end: no planes left, gear and flaps fully open, axis level, speed within brakes.

zh.name: 香料之路
zh.desc: 种香料、跑商队、做交易,攒够 5 张订单触发终局
zh.rules:
目标:有人拿到第 5 张计分卡(2-3 人局为第 6 张)时触发最后一轮。
补平回合数后,分数最高者获胜。
计分:计分卡面值分,另加金币每枚 3 分、银币每枚 1 分、商队里每个非黄色香料 1 分。
流程(每回合四选一):
· 打出产香料卡:直接收获卡面所示香料。
· 打出交易卡:支付上方香料换下方香料,可连续做任意次。
· 打出升级卡:把商队里最多 N 个香料各升一级(黄→红→绿→棕)。
· 买一张商人卡:在它前面每张卡上各铺 1 个任意香料;最左一张免费。
· 被买卡上铺着的香料全部归你。
· 休息:收回面前所有打出的牌。
· 兑换一张计分卡:支付它要求的全部香料;最左两张还附带金币/银币。
规则:
· 商队最多装 10 个香料,超出的部分须在本回合内弃掉。
· 起手固定为 Create 2(产 2 黄)+ Upgrade 2。
· 金币铺在计分行第 1 张上方、银币在第 2 张上方;金币拿完后银币挪到第 1 张。
· 平分则由回合顺序靠后者胜。

en.name: Century: Spice Road
en.desc: Grow spices, run caravans, trade up — race to 5 order cards
en.rules:
Goal: when someone takes their 5th point card (6th in a 2-3 player game), the final round is triggered.
After everyone has taken an equal number of turns, the highest score wins.
Scoring: point card values, plus 3 per gold coin, 1 per silver coin, and 1 per non-yellow spice in your caravan.
Each turn, choose one of four:
· Play a spice card: gain the spices shown on it.
· Play a trade card: pay the spices above for those below, repeatable any number of times.
· Play an upgrade card: raise up to N caravan spices one level (yellow→red→green→brown).
· Buy a merchant card: place 1 spice of any color on each card before it; the leftmost card is free.
· Spices piled on the bought card go to your caravan.
· Rest: take all your played cards back into hand.
· Claim a point card: pay the spices it requires; the leftmost two cards also grant a gold / silver coin.
Rules:
· Your caravan holds at most 10 spices; discard the excess within the same turn.
· You always start with Create 2 (produce 2 yellow) and Upgrade 2.
· Gold coins sit above the 1st point card, silver above the 2nd; once gold runs out, silver moves to the 1st.
· Ties go to the player later in turn order.

zh.name: 自旋电路
zh.desc: 用链条、分流器与机械零件搭出电路，挑战三册机械谜题
zh.rules:
目标：
用初始电路和库存完成目标。第一幕 1—67，第二幕 68—149，动力包 P1—P11。
搭建：
· 从托盘拖出零件，或先点零件再点空位。拖零件中心可以移动。
· 带固定标记的初始件不能移动或移除。蓝色标记表示可以移动或拆除。
· 先点选零件，再点击轮外标有层号的蓝色短弧线，选定起始层级与绕向。
· 接点标注层级，同一链条只能连接同层链轮。
· 牵链时，仅提示当前层的可用位置；点击蓝色方向弧线接入链轮，最后点击起点弧线闭环。
· 悬停或聚焦箭头可预览链路，点击后固定绕向。可以退回一步或取消。
· 点击已有链条，可以拆除允许移动的链，或选择“加入链轮”后重新闭环。
· 拖空白处平移，滚轮或双指缩放；居中按钮显示全盘。
机械与电路：
· 链轮转速对应电流，转向对应电流方向，转动力矩对应电压。
· 同一链条串联路径上的零件。电阻阻碍转动，断开的开关锁住链轮。
· 电容储存扭转能量，显示电压；电感通过飞轮储存运动能量。
· 分流器三个轮独立转动，下层轮电流等于中层与上层轮电流之和。
· 晶体管上层是闸门，下层是通道。反向安装改变闸门打开的方向。
· 二极管组合包含分流器、晶体管及内部链条，移动时保持一体。
运行：
· 启动后可点击开关、拖动轮心手动转动，也可用零件操作开闭闸门。
· 电容与电流读数随运行变化；电流表转得越快，音调越高。声音需手动开启。
· 电池短路会断路，返回搭建可恢复。储能耗尽后，电池停止供力。
· 可以单独切断电池，观察备用电源的工作情况。
检验：
· 检验从初态运行，尝试开关组合和手动输入，比较电压、电流及变化过程。
· 等效的绕法可以通过。开发版数值近似机械模型，有限输入检验并非严格证明。
· 题册图示和目标仍是最终依据。已完成关卡保存在本机。
· 房间保留各关搭建，重置只恢复当前关。

en.name: Spintronics
en.desc: Build mechanical circuits with chains and junctions across three puzzle books
en.rules:
Goal:
Use the starting circuit and inventory. Act One: 1–67; Act Two: 68–149; Power Pack: P1–P11.
Build:
· Drag parts from the tray, or tap a part and then an empty position. Drag centers to move parts.
· Fixed starting parts cannot move or be removed. Blue marks show movable parts and removable chains.
· Select a part, then click a blue arc labeled with a level to choose the starting level and winding direction.
· Contacts show the level. Every sprocket in a chain must be on the same level.
· While connecting, only available contacts on the current level are shown. Click blue arcs to add sprockets, then the starting arc to close the loop.
· Hover or focus an arrow to preview the route. Click to fix its direction. Undo a contact or cancel at any time.
· Select a chain to remove it where permitted, or choose Add sprockets and close the loop again.
· Drag empty space to pan, scroll or pinch to zoom, and recenter to show the whole circuit.
Mechanics:
· Speed represents current, rotation direction represents current direction, and torque represents voltage.
· A chain connects its parts in series. Resistors resist motion; an OFF switch locks its sprocket.
· Capacitors store torsional energy and show voltage. Inductors store motion in a flywheel.
· Junction wheels rotate independently. Bottom current equals middle plus top current.
· A transistor has a top gate and a bottom path. Reversing installation changes the opening direction.
· A diode kit retains its junction, transistor, and internal chains as one assembly.
Run:
· Start, click switches, drag wheel centers to turn them by hand, or open and close gates with part controls.
· Readings follow the circuit. Faster ammeter rotation makes a higher tone. Enable sound explicitly.
· A short trips the battery; return to building to reset it. Stored energy can also run out.
· Disconnect an individual battery to observe how a backup supply takes over.
Check:
· Checking starts from the initial state and compares voltage, current, and changes under switch and hand inputs.
· Equivalent windings can pass. This development model is approximate; finite checks are not a proof for every input.
· The book diagram and stated goal remain authoritative. Completed challenges are stored locally.
· The room retains each build. Reset affects only the current challenge.

zh.name: 尖塔奇兵
zh.desc: 四大职业合作攀登尖塔，探索四幕冒险、构筑牌组并挑战腐化之心
zh.rules:
游戏目标：
· 选择铁甲战士、静默猎手、故障机器人或观者，独自或合作探索四幕冒险。
· 依次击败各幕首领；集齐三把钥匙后，可以在第四幕挑战腐化之心。
· 生命降至0时，本局失败；能够避免死亡的物品按其说明生效。
冒险准备：
· 铁甲战士的初始生命和生命上限均为10点，其他职业均为9点。
· 静默猎手的起始牌组有12张牌，其他职业的起始牌组有10张牌。
· 冒险开始时，先获得3枚金币，并选择或跳过一组卡牌奖励。
· 处理完这组奖励后，从涅奥提供的三个祝福选项中选择一个。
· 单人完成祝福后，额外获得2枚金币和灌铅骰子；多人没有这项额外奖励。
牌组与牌堆：
· 每场战斗开始时，将当前牌组洗混，作为本场战斗的抽牌堆。
· 抽牌时，从抽牌堆顶部依次取牌，加入手牌。
· 抽牌堆没有牌时，将弃牌堆洗混，组成新的抽牌堆，再继续抽牌。
· 只有手牌中的卡牌才能直接打出，且必须满足该牌的使用条件。
· 弃牌堆中的卡牌不能直接打出，须先返回手牌。
· 消耗的牌通常放入消耗区，不能再次抽到，除非有其他效果将其取回。
· 消耗不会永久移除卡牌；战斗结束后，这些牌仍属于你的牌组。
· 移除卡牌会将其永久移出牌组，之后的战斗不再使用这张牌。
回合开始与骰子：
· 每个玩家回合开始时，能量重置为3点，并清除上一回合剩余的格挡。
· 能保留能量或格挡的卡牌、遗物，按各自的说明改变上述规则。
· 每回合通常抽取5张牌；已保留的手牌不计入这5张牌。
· 若场上能力要求在抽牌前进行预见，先完成预见，再抽取本回合的牌。
· 每回合掷一次六面骰子，骰子点数用于确定部分敌人行动和遗物效果。
· 接受骰子结果前，可以使用符合条件的物品调整点数或重新掷骰。
· 接受结果后，依次处理回合开始能力和符合该点数的遗物能力。
· 有多项待结算的能力时，由你决定它们的结算顺序。
打出卡牌：
· 在自己的出牌阶段，从手牌中选择卡牌，支付其当前能量费用。
· 费用为0的牌不消耗能量，但仍须满足牌面规定的使用条件。
· 费用为X时，自行选择支付的能量数量，并按所选数值结算效果。
· X通常可以选择0；未升级的强化机体至少支付1点能量。
· 指定一个敌人的效果只能选择一个目标；指定一排的效果作用于该排敌人。
· 首领视为属于每一排，因此作用于一排敌人的效果也会作用于首领。
· 按牌面顺序处理全部效果，再处理因这张牌触发的能力。
· 需要弃牌、消耗或选择目标时，完成该项选择后再继续结算。
· 攻击牌和技能牌结算后通常进入弃牌堆；写有消耗的牌进入消耗区。
· 能力牌打出后留在场上，按牌面规定持续生效，直至被移走或战斗结束。
· 同一张牌只能采用一种重复打出效果；有多个可用效果时，选择其中一种。
· 重复打出不再次支付费用；每次打出分别结算，并可重新选择合法目标。
· 破灭、乱战或混沌药水要求自动打出X费用牌时，直接消耗该牌，不结算其效果。
诅咒与状态牌：
· 诅咒通常不能打出，且会留在永久牌组中；负面效果按各张牌的说明处理。
· 眩晕不能打出，具有虚无；回合结束时，仍在手牌中的眩晕被消耗。
· 灼伤不能打出；回合结束时，每张仍在手牌中的灼伤对你造成1点伤害。
· 黏液可以支付1点能量打出，打出后消耗，没有其他效果。
· 状态牌不加入永久牌组；被消耗或战斗结束后，归还状态牌供应。
伤害与格挡：
· 打击伤害先计算力量等加成，再处理虚弱和易伤，最后由目标的格挡抵消。
· 每1点力量通常使每次打击增加1点伤害；特殊卡牌按牌面说明计算。
· 攻击者具有虚弱时，每次打击减少1点伤害，最低为0点。
· 目标具有易伤时，受到的每次打击伤害翻倍。
· 同一次打击同时受到虚弱和易伤影响时，两者抵消，伤害不变。
· 一张牌的多次打击沿用该次打出开始时的力量、虚弱和目标易伤状态。
· 整次攻击结束后，攻击者失去1层相关虚弱，各受击目标失去1层相关易伤。
· 即使打击被完全格挡，相关虚弱和易伤仍按上述规则减少。
· 直接伤害不属于打击，不受力量、虚弱、易伤影响，但可以被格挡抵消。
· 每1点格挡抵消1点伤害，并在抵消后消耗；不足的部分扣除生命。
· 写明失去生命的效果直接扣除生命，不消耗格挡，也不受格挡保护。
· 恢复生命不能超过生命上限；物品规定的额外限制仍然适用。
数值与标记上限：
· 玩家最多拥有20点格挡、6点能量和8点力量。
· 每名玩家或每个敌人的虚弱、易伤分别最多为3层。
· 力量标记总量为17点，虚弱标记总量为9层，易伤标记总量为7层。
· 敌人的格挡合计最多28点；玩家持有的金币合计最多59枚。
· 标记供应不足时，只能获得剩余数量；失去的标记会归还供应。
结束回合与敌人行动：
· 不再行动时，选择结束回合；不必先打完手牌或用尽能量。
· 先处理回合结束时生效的能力、诅咒、状态牌和职业效果。
· 有多项待结算的回合结束效果时，由你决定它们的结算顺序。
· 带有虚无的牌若仍在手牌中，须在回合结束时消耗，即使它也具有保留。
· 完成结束效果后，将未保留的剩余手牌放入弃牌堆。
· 结束效果中新抽到的牌留在手牌中，不在本次整理手牌时弃置。
· 随后，存活的敌人依照公开的行动意图依次行动，首领最后行动。
· 敌人的多次打击分别造成伤害，但整次攻击结束后才减少相关标记。
· 所有敌人行动完毕后，开始下一个玩家回合。
保留、预见与临时费用：
· 保留使卡牌在回合结束时留在手牌中，不随其他手牌一起弃置。
· 由效果赋予的保留只持续到下一回合；牌面自带的保留每回合均有效。
· 预见时，查看抽牌堆顶部指定数量的卡牌，并可将其中任意数量弃置。
· 未弃置的牌仍留在抽牌堆顶部，相对顺序保持不变。
· 预见不会抽取卡牌；抽牌堆不足指定数量时，只查看现有卡牌。
· 卡牌离开手牌后，清除临时费用和由效果赋予的保留。
· 本回合的临时费用变化在回合结束时失效，即使卡牌被保留。
铁甲战士：
· 每场战斗结束后，恢复1点生命；其他职业没有这项初始能力。
静默猎手：
· 每场战斗的第一个玩家回合额外抽2张牌，通常共抽7张牌。
· 玩家回合结束时，每个中毒敌人失去与其毒层数相等的生命。
· 毒造成的生命损失无视格挡；毒层数不会因此减少。
· 全部敌人的毒层数合计最多为30层；敌人死亡后归还其毒标记。
· 小刀以标记记录，最多可以持有5把；使用小刀不消耗能量。
· 使用小刀时，消耗1把小刀，对一个敌人造成1点打击伤害。
· 每把小刀作为一次独立攻击，受到力量、虚弱、易伤及相关攻击效果影响。
· 使用小刀不算打出卡牌，不触发仅在打出卡牌时生效的能力。
· 获得小刀时若已达持有上限，可以立即使用已有小刀，再获得新的小刀。
故障机器人：
· 每场战斗开始时，生成1个闪电充能球。
· 初始拥有3个充能球槽位；增加槽位的效果按牌面说明生效。
· 生成充能球时，将其放入空槽位；没有空槽位时，先激发一个已有充能球。
· 激发时可选择任意已有充能球，结算其激发效果，并将它从槽位中移走。
· 每个闪电充能球在玩家回合结束时，对一个敌人造成1点直接伤害。
· 激发闪电充能球时，对一个敌人造成2点直接伤害。
· 每个冰霜充能球在玩家回合结束时提供1点格挡，激发时也提供1点格挡。
· 黑暗充能球没有回合结束效果；激发时，对一个敌人造成3点直接伤害。
· 激发黑暗时，你场上每有一张能力牌，该次伤害增加1点。
· 不同充能球的伤害可分别选择目标；牌面提供的额外加成仍然适用。
· 闪电、冰霜和黑暗充能球的供应分别为6个、6个和3个。
· 某种充能球的供应已用尽时，不能继续生成该种充能球。
观者：
· 每场战斗开始时，获得1个奇迹；最多持有5个奇迹。
· 在出牌阶段，能量未达上限时，可消耗1个奇迹，获得1点能量。
· 支付卡牌费用时，可以直接消耗奇迹补足能量，本次支付可以超过6点。
· 平静和愤怒是两种姿态；不处于这两种姿态时，视为没有姿态。
· 从平静切换到其他姿态，或退出平静时，获得2点能量。
· 再次进入当前已有的姿态，不视为离开或切换姿态。
· 处于愤怒时，每次打击额外造成1点伤害；这项加成也适用于小刀。
· 玩家回合结束时，若仍处于愤怒，受到1点伤害；这次伤害可以用格挡抵消。
地图、事件与奖励：
· 完成当前房间后，沿地图连接的路线选择下一个房间。
· 普通战斗和精英战斗需要击败敌人；宝箱房间提供遗物奖励。
· 事件按所选选项处理，金币支出、生命损失和其他条件均以选项说明为准。
· 战斗胜利后，先处理战斗结束能力，再处理敌人提供的奖励。
· 每组奖励分别处理；卡牌或首领遗物有多个候选时，从该组选择一个。
· 选择前可以查看全部候选，也可以跳过整组奖励。
· 未选择的奖励卡牌须放回各自奖励牌堆的底部，并可安排其返回顺序。
· 同一奖励牌堆内，较早放回的卡牌位于较晚放回的卡牌上方。
· 完成全部奖励后，整理战斗中的卡牌和标记，再继续地图上的冒险。
· 能量、格挡、力量、虚弱、易伤、充能球、小刀、奇迹和姿态均不带入下一场战斗。
· 生命、金币、牌组、遗物和未使用的药水继续保留。
营火与牌组调整：
· 每次到达营火，通常选择休息或升级卡牌，不能同时选择两项。
· 休息恢复3点生命；遗物提供的额外恢复或限制按其说明生效。
· 升级时，从牌组中选择一张尚未升级的攻击牌、技能牌或能力牌。
· 升级后使用该牌的升级面，后续战斗继续保留升级；诅咒和状态牌不能升级。
· 转化会移除指定卡牌，并从职业奖励牌堆获得一张替代卡牌。
商店、遗物与药水：
· 商店的普通卡牌售价为2枚金币，罕见卡牌为3枚金币，稀有卡牌为6枚金币。
· 遗物和药水按标价购买；商店陈列的第一件遗物比原价便宜1枚金币。
· 每次进入商店，可以支付3枚金币，从牌组中永久移除一张允许移除的卡牌。
· 同一次商店访问只能购买一次移除服务；离开商店不要求购买商品。
· 遗物按其规定的时机生效；主动使用的遗物须满足条件和次数限制。
· 最多持有3瓶药水；药水使用后失去，也可以主动弃置，为新药水腾出位置。
· 药水只能在允许的时机使用；调整骰子的药水须在接受骰子结果前使用。
· 大部分药水在出牌阶段使用；明确允许在战斗外使用的药水按其说明处理。
首领与冒险结束：
· 首领的生命、行动和特殊能力以其牌面为准，仍须遵守伤害和格挡规则。
· 史莱姆老大被击败后，下一回合仍会召唤分裂后的史莱姆，战斗尚未结束。
· 击败首领后，仍须击败存活的召唤敌人并完成奖励，才能决定继续下一幕或结束冒险。
合作与排位：
· 支持1至4名玩家合作。多人开局时，各自选择一个不同的职业，共用地图、骰子与玩家回合。
· 玩家可以交替出牌、使用药水和能力；所有人结束回合后，才共同结算回合结束效果和敌人行动。
· 可以攻击任意排的敌人。普通敌人攻击所在排的玩家，带全体标记的行动攻击所有玩家；首领视为位于每一排。
· 遭遇战中，每名玩家领取自己排的敌人奖励；精英与首领的奖励由全队领取。首领遗物揭示人数加1件（单人3件），每人至多选择一件。
· 战斗之间可以点击队友状态请求交换排位，对方同意后交换；排位决定下一场遭遇战的敌人分配。
· 全队共有5把小刀、5个奇迹及各色充能球供应，不能因跨职业获得相同资源而增加供应。
· 获得其他职业的充能球或姿态卡时，使用棱彩碎片的2个球槽或姿态。故障机器人仍用自己的球槽。
四幕冒险与钥匙：
· 第一幕为塔底，第二幕为城市，第三幕为深处；第四幕为终幕，最终挑战腐化之心。
· 击败一幕首领及全部召唤敌人、结算奖励后，全队选择继续下一幕或结束本次冒险。可以调整终止幕，只挑战所选范围。
· 进入下一幕时回复全部生命，重新洗混普通职业奖励与先前跳过的牌；稀有牌与无色牌不洗混。进阶6起仅回复4点生命。
· 只有第一幕使用首场遭遇牌；之后每幕按该幕的地图、遭遇、精英、事件与首领继续。
· 进入第四幕须先集齐全队共用的三把钥匙：红宝石、蓝宝石与绿宝石。
· 红宝石钥匙：在营火由全队同意放弃本次营火行动。
· 蓝宝石钥匙：在精英或宝箱房间由全队同意放弃本次遗物奖励；已经领取遗物后不能改选钥匙。
· 绿宝石钥匙：击败地图上标有火焰的燃烧精英。战斗开始时，每名玩家向抽牌堆洗入2张灼伤。
· 第四幕依次经过营火、商店与腐化之心。进阶11起，商店后还须击败尖塔之盾与尖塔之矛。
· 盾矛战在回合开始能力全部处理后选择面向，每侧最多两名玩家。
· 全队选完后，立即受到所面向敌人的面向能力影响。
· 单体攻击可选任一敌人，整排效果只影响所选一侧。
· 腐化之心拥有死亡律动与无敌。无敌解除前，不能获得虚弱，生命不能低于初始生命的一半；死亡律动在玩家回合结束时对全队造成伤害。
累计进阶：
· 进阶等级为0至13。选择某级时，同时启用此前全部等级的规则。
· 1：使用更难的精英。2：初始生命上限减少1。3：加入更难的事件。
· 4：药水上限变为2。5：起始牌组加入进阶之灾。6：跨幕仅回复4点生命。
· 7：使用更难的遭遇并加入相应召唤牌。8：商店移除卡牌改为4金币。
· 9：冒险开始时额外失去1点生命。10：使用更难的首领。
· 11：使用更难的腐化之心，并在第四幕加入盾矛精英。12：进一步强化前三幕精英。
· 13：击败第三幕首领后，立即与另一名随机第三幕首领战斗，两战之间不跨幕回复。
· 原版进度模式的标准冒险从第一幕出发，多人击败第二幕首领、单人击败第三幕首领后解锁下一进阶。
· 必须完成当前已解锁的最高进阶，才能继续提升进阶等级。
内容开放与本机进度：
· 全部开放模式直接使用四职业、全部卡牌、第四幕与13级进阶。原版进度模式按累计进度逐步解锁，开局采用主机本机的解锁配置。
· 每次冒险结束，无论胜败，每名玩家获得已击败首领数量加1格进度。
· 先填满所用职业的8格，溢出的进度可分配给无色牌3格或第四幕5格。
· 职业累计1、4、8格分别开放对应编号的锁定牌；无色牌与第四幕在各自全部格填满后开放。进度和成就保存在当前设备。
· 完成力量8、格挡20、毒30、单回合7把小刀、场上7张能力等目标时记录成就。
· 击败第三幕还可达成四职业、四人合作、精简牌组等成就。
· 无限连招成就由玩家在终局页确认本局确实达成后记录。
每日挑战、自定义与快速开局：
· 每日挑战按桌游规则掷骰两次，分别从两组修正中各随机选一项，全队共同适用。自定义冒险可以自行组合修正。
· 全明星：起始获得5张随机无色牌。闪亮登场：起始获得5张随机稀有牌。传家宝：起始获得1件随机首领遗物。
· 转化之旅：普通卡牌奖励改为转化一张牌。古董收藏：遭遇战的普通卡牌奖励改为遗物。
· 棱彩碎片：起始获得特殊遗物；每次奖励的3张牌须分别来自不同奖励牌堆，稀有奖励须来自不同职业的稀有牌堆。
· 绝症：每场战斗结束后失去1点生命。精神错乱：每场战斗结束时转化一张随机牌。
· 未知未来：进入房间时才揭示地图上的房间标记。诅咒缠身：起始获得2张随机诅咒。
· 致命事件：每次事件结束后失去2点生命。夜惊：不能在营火休息。
· 背水一战为可选变体：只在首领战中允许倒下的玩家退出当前战斗，由队友继续；所有人倒下仍失败，且不能带倒下的队友进入下一幕。
· 自选遗物为可选变体：精英和宝箱的遗物一起揭示，由每名玩家各选一件。
· 从第二、三或四幕开始时，先完成涅奥祝福，再按该幕快速开局表逐项领取金币、卡牌、遗物、药水、移除与升级。
· 快速开局的最后一步是全队共同访问商店；每项奖励在前一项完成后才揭示。
· 第四幕快速开局直接持有三把钥匙。

en.name: Spire Trial
en.desc: Climb four acts together with four characters, build your deck and challenge the Corrupt Heart
en.rules:
Goal:
· Choose the Ironclad, Silent, Defect or Watcher and explore four acts alone or cooperatively.
· Defeat each act’s Boss. Collect all three Keys to challenge the Corrupt Heart in Act IV.
· You lose at 0 health, unless an item prevents your death as described on that item.
Setup:
· The Ironclad starts with 10 health and maximum health; each other character starts with 9.
· The Silent starts with 12 cards. Each other character starts with 10 cards.
· Begin by gaining 3 gold, then choose or skip a card reward.
· After resolving that reward, choose one of the three blessings offered by Neow.
· In solo, gain 2 extra gold and Loaded Die after Neow. Multiplayer has no solo bonus.
Deck and piles:
· At the start of each combat, shuffle your current deck to form your draw pile.
· Draw cards from the top of your draw pile and add them to your hand.
· When the draw pile is empty, shuffle the discard pile to form a new draw pile and continue drawing.
· To play a card directly, it must be in your hand and you must meet its conditions.
· Cards in the discard pile must return to your hand before they can be played.
· Exhausted cards normally go to the exhaust pile and cannot be drawn again unless an effect retrieves them.
· Exhausting a card does not permanently remove it. It remains in your deck after combat.
· Removing a card permanently takes it out of your deck, so it is not used in later combats.
Turn start and die:
· At the start of each player turn, reset your Energy to 3 and clear your remaining Block.
· Cards and relics that preserve Energy or Block change these rules as described on them.
· Normally draw 5 cards each turn. Cards retained in your hand do not count toward these 5 cards.
· If a Power requires Scrying before the turn’s draw, resolve that Scry before drawing those cards.
· Roll a six-sided die each turn. Its result determines some enemy actions and relic effects.
· Before accepting the result, you may use eligible items to adjust it or reroll the die.
· After accepting the result, resolve start-of-turn abilities and relic abilities matching that result.
· When several abilities are waiting to resolve, choose their resolution order.
Playing cards:
· During your play phase, choose a card from your hand and pay its current Energy cost.
· A card costing 0 spends no Energy, but you must still meet its printed conditions.
· For an X-cost card, choose how much Energy to pay and use that value for its effects.
· You may normally choose 0 for X. Unupgraded Reinforced Body requires at least 1 Energy.
· An effect targeting one enemy affects one chosen target. An effect targeting a row affects that row.
· The Boss counts as being in every row, so an effect targeting a row also affects the Boss.
· Resolve all printed effects in order, then resolve abilities triggered by that card.
· If an effect asks you to discard, Exhaust or choose a target, complete that choice before continuing.
· Attacks and Skills normally go to the discard pile after resolving. Cards with Exhaust go to the exhaust pile.
· Powers remain in play after being played and work as described until removed or combat ends.
· Apply only one repeat-play effect to a card. If several are available, choose one.
· Repeated plays cost no additional Energy. Resolve each play separately and choose legal targets again.
· If Havoc, Mayhem or Distilled Chaos would automatically play an X-cost card, Exhaust it without resolving its effects.
Curses and Statuses:
· Curses normally cannot be played and remain in your permanent deck. Apply each card’s negative effects as described.
· Daze cannot be played and is Ethereal. Exhaust any Daze still in your hand at turn end.
· Burn cannot be played. At turn end, each Burn still in your hand deals 1 damage to you.
· You may pay 1 Energy to play Slime. It Exhausts and has no other effect.
· Status cards do not enter your permanent deck. Return them to their supply when Exhausted or when combat ends.
Damage and Block:
· For Hit damage, apply Strength and other bonuses, then Weak and Vulnerable, then the target’s Block.
· Each Strength normally adds 1 damage to each Hit. Follow the card text for exceptions.
· If the attacker has Weak, each Hit deals 1 less damage, to a minimum of 0.
· If the target has Vulnerable, double the damage of each Hit against it.
· If Weak and Vulnerable both apply to the same Hit, they cancel and neither changes its damage.
· Multiple Hits from one play use the Strength, Weak and target Vulnerable present when that play began.
· After the entire attack, remove 1 applicable Weak from the attacker and 1 applicable Vulnerable from each target hit.
· Applicable Weak and Vulnerable are still removed if Block absorbs all the Hit damage.
· Direct damage is not a Hit. Strength, Weak and Vulnerable do not change it, but Block can absorb it.
· Each Block absorbs 1 damage and is spent when used. Any remaining damage reduces health.
· An effect that says to lose health reduces health directly, without using or being prevented by Block.
· Healing cannot exceed maximum health. Additional limits stated on items still apply.
Resource limits:
· A player may have at most 20 Block, 6 Energy and 8 Strength.
· Each player or enemy may have at most 3 Weak and 3 Vulnerable.
· The shared supply contains 17 Strength, 9 Weak and 7 Vulnerable.
· Enemies share a supply of 28 Block. Players may hold a total of at most 59 gold.
· If a supply is short, gain only what remains. Removed tokens return to the supply.
Ending the turn:
· Choose End turn when you are finished. You do not have to play every card or spend all your Energy.
· First resolve end-of-turn abilities, Curses, Status cards and character effects.
· When several end-of-turn effects are waiting to resolve, choose their resolution order.
· At turn end, Exhaust any Ethereal card still in your hand, even if it also has Retain.
· After resolving end-of-turn effects, discard the remaining cards that are not retained.
· Cards drawn during end-of-turn effects stay in your hand instead of being discarded during that cleanup.
· Surviving enemies then act according to their displayed intents. The Boss acts last.
· Resolve each enemy Hit separately, but remove applicable tokens only after its entire attack.
· After all enemies finish acting, begin the next player turn.
Retain and Scry:
· Retain keeps a card in your hand at turn end instead of discarding it with the other cards.
· Retain granted by an effect lasts until the next turn. Printed Retain applies every turn.
· To Scry, look at the specified number of cards from the top of your draw pile and discard any number of them.
· Cards you do not discard remain on top of the draw pile in the same relative order.
· Scrying does not draw cards. If the draw pile has fewer cards, look only at those present.
· When a card leaves your hand, clear its temporary cost and any Retain granted by an effect.
· Temporary cost changes for the turn expire at turn end, even on retained cards.
The Ironclad:
· After each combat, heal 1 health. Other characters do not have this starting ability.
The Silent:
· Draw 2 extra cards on the first player turn of each combat, normally drawing 7 in total.
· At player turn end, each poisoned enemy loses health equal to its Poison.
· Health lost to Poison ignores Block, and Poison does not decrease when it deals damage.
· All enemies share a supply of 30 Poison. When an enemy dies, its Poison returns to the supply.
· Shivs are represented by tokens. You may hold up to 5, and using a Shiv costs no Energy.
· To use a Shiv, spend 1 Shiv token to deal 1 Hit damage to one enemy.
· Each Shiv is a separate attack, affected by Strength, Weak, Vulnerable and applicable attack effects.
· Using a Shiv does not count as playing a card and does not trigger abilities requiring a card to be played.
· If you gain Shivs while at the limit, you may use existing Shivs immediately before gaining the new ones.
The Defect:
· At the start of each combat, Channel 1 Lightning Orb.
· Start with 3 Orb slots. Effects that add slots work as described on the card.
· To Channel an Orb, place it in an empty slot. If no slot is empty, first Evoke an existing Orb.
· To Evoke, choose any existing Orb, resolve its Evoke effect and remove it from its slot.
· At player turn end, each Lightning Orb deals 1 direct damage to one enemy.
· Evoking a Lightning Orb deals 2 direct damage to one enemy.
· Each Frost Orb grants 1 Block at player turn end and also grants 1 Block when Evoked.
· Dark Orbs have no end-of-turn effect. Evoking one deals 3 direct damage to one enemy.
· When Evoking Dark, add 1 damage for each Power you have in play.
· Choose a target separately for each Orb damage effect. Additional bonuses from cards still apply.
· The Orb supply contains 6 Lightning, 6 Frost and 3 Dark.
· If a type of Orb has no remaining supply, you cannot Channel another Orb of that type.
The Watcher:
· Gain 1 Miracle at the start of each combat. You may hold at most 5 Miracles.
· During your play phase, if below the Energy limit, spend 1 Miracle to gain 1 Energy.
· When paying for a card, you may spend Miracles directly to cover missing Energy, even for a payment above 6.
· Calm and Wrath are stances. If you are in neither, you have no stance.
· Gain 2 Energy when changing from Calm to another stance or leaving Calm.
· Entering the stance you already have does not count as leaving or changing stances.
· While in Wrath, each Hit deals 1 extra damage. This bonus also applies to Shivs.
· At player turn end, if still in Wrath, take 1 damage. Block can absorb this damage.
Map and rewards:
· After completing a room, follow a connected path on the map to choose the next room.
· Defeat enemies in normal and Elite combats. Treasure rooms offer relic rewards.
· Resolve the event option you choose, following its stated gold costs, health loss and other conditions.
· After winning a combat, resolve end-of-combat abilities, then the rewards provided by the enemies.
· Resolve each reward separately. When a card or Boss Relic reward offers several choices, choose one.
· You may inspect all choices before deciding, or skip the entire reward.
· Return unchosen reward cards to the bottoms of their respective reward decks in an order you choose.
· Within a reward deck, a card returned earlier is placed above a card returned later.
· After resolving all rewards, clear the combat cards and tokens, then continue along the map.
· Energy, Block, Strength, Weak, Vulnerable, Orbs, Shivs, Miracles and stances do not carry into the next combat.
· Keep your health, gold, deck, relics and unused potions.
Campfires:
· At each campfire, normally choose either resting or upgrading a card, not both.
· Resting heals 3 health. Apply any extra healing or restrictions stated on your relics.
· To upgrade, choose an unupgraded Attack, Skill or Power from your deck.
· Use the upgraded face from then on, including later combats. Curses and Status cards cannot be upgraded.
· Transforming removes the chosen card and gains a replacement from your character’s reward deck.
Shops and items:
· Shop cards cost 2 gold for Common, 3 for Uncommon and 6 for Rare cards.
· Buy relics and potions at the displayed prices. The first displayed relic costs 1 gold less than its normal price.
· Each time you visit a shop, you may pay 3 gold to permanently remove one eligible card from your deck.
· You may buy the removal service once per shop visit. You may leave without buying anything.
· Relics work at their stated times. Manually activated relics must meet their conditions and use limits.
· Hold at most 3 potions. A potion is lost after use; you may also discard one to make room for a new potion.
· Use potions only at their permitted times. Die-changing potions must be used before accepting the die result.
· Most potions are used during your play phase. Potions permitted outside combat follow their own descriptions.
Ending the run:
· Follow each Boss card for its health, actions and special abilities. Normal damage and Block rules still apply.
· After the Slime Boss is defeated, its split Slimes are still summoned next turn, so combat has not ended.
· After defeating the Boss and surviving summons, resolve rewards before deciding to continue to the next act or end the run.
Cooperation and rows:
· Play cooperatively with 1–4 players. In multiplayer, choose different characters and share a map, die and Player Turn.
· Players may alternate cards, potions and abilities. End-of-turn effects and enemy actions begin after everyone ends their turn.
· Target enemies in any row. Normal enemies target their row, area actions target everyone, and Bosses count as being in every row.
· Encounter rewards belong to the player in that row. Elite and Boss rewards go to the party. Reveal players plus 1 Boss relics (3 in solo); each player may take one.
· Between combats, select a teammate to request a row swap. Swap after they accept. Rows determine the next Encounter’s enemy placement.
· The party shares 5 Shivs, 5 Miracles and the Orb supply, including resources gained through another character’s cards.
· Prismatic Shard supplies 2 Orb slots or Stances when gaining cards from other characters. The Defect keeps its own Orb slots.
Four acts and keys:
· Act I is the Exordium, Act II the City, Act III the Beyond, and Act IV the Ending, where the Corrupt Heart awaits.
· After defeating the act’s Boss and summons and resolving rewards, everyone votes to continue or end the expedition. The final act setting can limit the run.
· At the next act, heal to full and shuffle ordinary character rewards with skipped cards. Do not shuffle rare or colorless rewards. From Ascension 6, heal only 4 HP.
· Only Act I uses the First Encounter deck. Later acts use their own maps, Encounters, Elites, Events and Bosses.
· To enter Act IV, the party must collect the shared Ruby, Sapphire and Emerald Keys.
· Ruby: everyone agrees to give up their action at a campfire.
· Sapphire: everyone agrees to give up the relic rewards in an Elite or Treasure room. You cannot choose the key after taking a relic there.
· Emerald: defeat the Burning Elite marked by flames on the map. Each player shuffles 2 Burns into their draw pile at combat start.
· Act IV consists of a campfire, Merchant and Corrupt Heart. From Ascension 11, fight Spire Shield and Spire Spear after the Merchant.
· In the Shield and Spear fight, choose sides after all start-of-turn abilities. Each side holds up to 2 players.
· After everyone chooses, immediately resolve the enemy’s Facing ability.
· Single-target effects can hit either enemy; row effects affect one side.
· The Heart has Beat of Death and Invincible. While Invincible, it cannot gain Weak or drop below half its starting HP. Beat of Death damages every player at the end of the Player Turn.
Cumulative Ascension:
· Ascension ranges from 0 to 13. Every level includes all earlier levels.
· 1: harder Elites. 2: lose 1 starting Max HP. 3: add harder Events.
· 4: potion limit is 2. 5: start with Ascender’s Bane. 6: heal only 4 HP between acts.
· 7: harder Encounters and their Summons. 8: Merchant card removal costs 4 gold.
· 9: lose 1 HP at run start. 10: harder Bosses.
· 11: harder Heart and Shield/Spear in Act IV. 12: further strengthen Elites in Acts I–III.
· 13: after the Act III Boss, immediately fight a different random Act III Boss, with no between-act healing.
· In original progression, Standard runs starting in Act I unlock the next Ascension after beating Act II in multiplayer or Act III in solo.
· Beat your highest unlocked Ascension to advance further.
Content and local progress:
· Everything unlocked gives access to all characters, cards, Act IV and 13 Ascensions. Original progression unlocks content gradually and uses the host device’s progress for setup.
· At the end of a run, win or lose, each player earns 1 box plus 1 per defeated Boss.
· Fill the current character’s 8 boxes first, then assign overflow to Colorless (3 boxes) or Act IV (5 boxes).
· Character totals of 1, 4 and 8 unlock the corresponding numbered cards. Colorless and Act IV unlock when their tracks are full. Progress and achievements are saved on this device.
· Achievements include reaching 8 Strength, 20 Block or 30 Poison, playing 7 Shivs in one turn and keeping 7 Powers in play.
· Act III goals include characters, four-player groups and special decks.
· Confirm the Infinity achievement on the result screen only if you created an infinite combo during that run.
Daily Climb, Custom Run and quick start:
· Daily Climb follows the board game: roll twice for one modifier from each of two groups, affecting everyone. Custom Run lets you choose a combination.
· All Star: start with 5 random colorless cards. Shiny: start with 5 random rare cards. Heirloom: start with a random Boss relic.
· Transformed: ordinary card rewards become a card Transform. Vintage: Encounter card rewards become relics.
· Prismatic Shard: start with the special relic; the 3 revealed reward cards must come from different reward decks. Rare rewards must use different characters’ rare decks.
· Terminal: lose 1 HP after combat. Insanity: Transform a random card at the end of combat.
· Uncertain Future: reveal map tokens only when entering their rooms. Cursed: start with 2 random Curses.
· Deadly Events: lose 2 HP after every Event. Night Terrors: you cannot Rest.
· Last Stand is optional: only in Boss fights, fallen players leave combat while teammates continue. Everyone falling still loses, and fallen teammates cannot enter the next act.
· Choose a Relic is optional: reveal Elite and Treasure relics together and let each player choose one.
· Starting in Act II, III or IV first resolves Neow, then the act’s quick-start gold, cards, items, removals and upgrades one at a time.
· Finish with a shared Merchant. Do not reveal the next reward until the previous one is complete.
· Act IV quick start begins with all 3 Keys.

zh.name: 灵迹岛
zh.desc: 合作御敌:扮演岛屿精灵,用元素之力驱逐入侵的殖民者
zh.rules:
目标:所有玩家合作扮演精灵,在入侵者占领岛屿前将其驱逐。
胜利条件随恐怖等级放宽:等级一需消灭全部入侵者,等级二需消灭全部村镇与城市,等级三只需消灭全部城市。
准备:每名玩家选择一名精灵与一块版图,按版图印刷放置入侵者、达罕人与枯萎,再按精灵说明放置初始灵气。
组建入侵者牌堆(第一阶段 4 张、第二阶段 5 张、第三阶段随机 3 张)与 9 张恐惧牌堆,枯萎池为玩家人数的两倍加一。
流程:每个回合依次进行以下阶段。
· 成长阶段:每人同时选择一组成长选项并执行,例如放置灵气、获得能量、获得威力牌或收回已打出的牌。
· 出牌阶段:每人同时选择本回合打出的威力牌并支付能量,数量不超过灵气轨上露出的出牌数。
· 快速阶段:按座次结算所有快速威力,以及元素达标后的快速天赋能力。
· 入侵者阶段:先结算已集满的恐惧牌,再依次结算破坏、建造与探索,最后推进入侵者牌槽。
· 慢速阶段:按座次结算所有慢速威力与慢速天赋能力。
· 时光流逝:本回合打出的牌进入弃牌堆,所有本回合增益清除。
破坏:入侵者的伤害先被防御抵免,之后每 2 点伤害消灭 1 个达罕人。
地格受到 2 点或以上伤害时添加 1 个枯萎;若该格已有枯萎,再向相邻地格蔓延 1 个。
破坏结算后存活的达罕人反击,每个达罕人对入侵者造成 2 点伤害。
恐惧:消灭 1 个村镇获得 1 点恐惧,消灭 1 个城市获得 2 点恐惧。
恐惧池为玩家人数的四倍;集满时清空并结算一张恐惧牌,效果按当前恐怖等级执行。
威力:射程从你的灵气或圣地(你至少有 2 个灵气的地格)起量。
获得低级威力牌时摸 4 张选 1 张;获得高级威力牌时同样摸 4 张选 1 张,再遗忘你的 1 张牌。
失败:任一精灵在岛上没有灵气、需要放置枯萎时枯萎池已空且枯萎卡已翻面、或需要抽取入侵者牌时牌堆已空,所有玩家战败。

en.name: Spirit Island
en.desc: A cooperative game: play spirits of the island and drive out the invading colonizers
en.rules:
Goal: all players cooperate as Spirits of the island and drive the Invaders away.
The victory condition relaxes with the Terror Level: at Level I destroy every Invader, at Level II all Towns and Cities, at Level III only all Cities.
Setup: each player picks a Spirit and one island board. Place Invaders, Dahan and Blight as printed, then place starting Presence per the Spirit panel.
Build the Invader deck (4 Stage I, 5 Stage II, 3 random Stage III cards) and a Fear deck of 9 cards; the Blight pool is twice the player count plus one.
Play: each round proceeds through the following phases in order.
· Spirit Phase: everyone simultaneously picks one Growth option group and resolves it, such as adding Presence, gaining Energy, gaining Power Cards or reclaiming played cards.
· Play Phase: everyone simultaneously chooses Power Cards to play this turn and pays their Energy, up to the Card Plays shown on the Presence track.
· Fast Phase: resolve all Fast powers in seat order, including Fast innate powers whose element thresholds are met.
· Invader Phase: resolve earned Fear cards first, then Ravage, Build and Explore in order, and finally advance the Invader card slots.
· Slow Phase: resolve all Slow powers and Slow innate powers in seat order.
· Time Passes: played cards go to discard piles and all this-turn bonuses are cleared.
Ravage: Defense absorbs the damage first, then every 2 damage destroys 1 Dahan.
A land taking 2 or more damage gains 1 Blight; if it already had Blight, 1 more Blight cascades into an adjacent land.
After Ravage, surviving Dahan fight back, each dealing 2 damage to the Invaders.
Fear: destroying a Town earns 1 Fear and destroying a City earns 2 Fear.
The Fear pool is four times the player count; when it fills, clear it and resolve a Fear card at the current Terror Level.
Powers: measure Range from your Presence or from a Sacred Site (a land with at least 2 of your Presence).
When gaining a Minor Power draw 4 and keep 1; when gaining a Major Power also draw 4 and keep 1, then Forget one of your cards.
Defeat: all players lose if any Spirit has no Presence left on the island, if Blight must be placed while the pool is empty and the Blight Card is already flipped, or if an Invader card must be drawn while the deck is empty.

zh.name: 璀璨宝石
zh.desc: 拿宝石、买发展卡、吸引贵族,先冲 15 分
zh.rules:
目标:有人达到 15 分触发最后一轮,所有人补平回合数后,分数最高者获胜。
流程(每回合四选一):
· 拿取 3 枚异色宝石;银行不足 3 色时,有多少拿多少。
· 拿取 2 枚同色宝石;该色银行剩 4 枚以上才行。
· 保留 1 张发展卡并拿取 1 枚黄金:明留市场卡或盲留牌堆顶,最多保留 3 张。
· 购买 1 张发展卡(市场上的或自己保留的),黄金可抵任意颜色。
规则:
· 已购卡上的宝石是永久折扣。
· 手里宝石总数(含黄金)不能超过 10 枚,超出的部分须在本回合退还。
· 回合结束时若满足贵族的折扣要求,贵族自动来访,值 3 分;同时满足多位则自己挑一位。
· 平分比发展卡张数,少者胜;再平则共享胜利。

en.name: Splendor
en.desc: Collect gems, buy cards, charm nobles — race to 15
en.rules:
Goal: reaching 15 points triggers the final round; after everyone has taken an equal number of turns, the highest score wins.
Each turn, choose one of four:
· Take 3 gems of different colors; if the bank has fewer than 3 colors, take what is left.
· Take 2 gems of the same color; only if that stack holds 4 or more.
· Reserve 1 development card and take 1 gold: a face-up market card or blind from a deck top; at most 3 reserved.
· Buy 1 development card (from the market or your reserve); gold counts as any color.
Rules:
· Gems on bought cards are permanent discounts.
· You may hold at most 10 gems in total (gold included); excess must be returned the same turn.
· At the end of your turn, any noble whose gem requirements you meet visits you for 3 points; if several qualify, pick one.
· Ties go to fewer cards bought; a further tie shares the victory.

zh.name: 璀璨宝石:对决
zh.desc: 两人对决:从版图连线取标记、买卡攒折扣,率先达成 20 声望、10 皇冠或单色 10 声望
zh.rules:
目标:率先达成任一条件获胜
· 声望达到 20 分
· 皇冠达到 10 个
· 同色卡牌的声望合计达到 10 分
准备:
· 25 枚标记随机放满版图
· 三级、二级、一级卡各翻 3、4、5 张组成金字塔
· 后手玩家获得 1 个特权
流程:每回合先做可选动作(可跳过),再做一个强制动作
· 可选:归还 1 个特权,从版图取 1 枚非黄金标记,可以重复归还
· 可选:将袋中标记补充到版图空格,对手获得 1 个特权
· 取标记:取 1 至 3 枚横、竖或斜向连续不断的非黄金标记
· 取到 3 枚同色标记或 2 枚珍珠时,对手获得 1 个特权
· 扣牌:从版图获得 1 枚黄金,再扣 1 张金字塔明牌或牌堆顶盲牌,至多 3 张
· 购买:从金字塔或自己的扣牌中购买 1 张卡,折扣抵费用,黄金抵任意颜色
结算:
· 购入带能力的卡立即结算:额外回合、取同色标记、获得特权或偷取对手标记
· 变色卡购买时必须叠放在自己已有折扣的颜色上,之后视作该色
· 获得第 3 个和第 6 个皇冠时,各挑选 1 张王室卡并结算其能力
· 回合结束时手中标记超过 10 枚,须弃置至 10 枚

en.name: Splendor Duel
en.desc: Two-player duel: take tokens in lines from the board, buy cards for discounts, race to 20 prestige, 10 crowns, or 10 prestige in one color
en.rules:
Goal: be the first to reach any one condition
· 20 prestige points
· 10 crowns
· 10 prestige points on cards of one color
Setup:
· 25 tokens are placed at random on the board
· reveal 3 level-3, 4 level-2 and 5 level-1 cards as a pyramid
· the second player takes 1 Privilege
Play: take any optional actions first, then exactly one mandatory action
· Optional: return 1 Privilege to take 1 non-Gold token from the board; you may repeat it
· Optional: refill empty board spaces from the bag; your opponent takes 1 Privilege
· Take tokens: take 1 to 3 non-Gold tokens in an uninterrupted straight line
· Taking 3 of one color or 2 Pearls lets your opponent take 1 Privilege
· Reserve: take 1 Gold from the board, then reserve a pyramid card or a deck top card; at most 3
· Purchase: buy 1 card from the pyramid or your reserve; bonuses reduce the cost, Gold is wild
Resolution:
· A purchased ability resolves at once: extra turn, same-color token, Privilege or steal
· A color-changing card must be attached to a bonus color you already own
· Upon your 3rd and 6th crown, choose 1 Royal card and resolve its ability
· At the end of your turn, discard down to 10 tokens if you hold more
